verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ حُكْمًا عَرَبِيًّا وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَآءَهُم بَعْدَ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا وَاقٍ

english_rwwad.text: Thus We have sent it down as a commandment in Arabic. If you were to follow their[1] desires after the knowledge that has come to you, you would have no supporter or protector against Allah.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the People of the Book.

verses.translation: Thus We have sent it down as a commandment in Arabic. If you were to follow their[1] desires after the knowledge that has come to you, you would have no supporter or protector against Allah.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَذُرِّيَّةً وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍ كِتَابٌ

english_rwwad.text: We have sent messengers before you and gave them wives and offspring[1]. It was not for any messenger to bring a sign except with Allah’s permission. Every matter has a destined time.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] These are the basic human needs, for Messengers are human beings, not angelic beings.

verses.translation: We have sent messengers before you and gave them wives and offspring[1]. It was not for any messenger to bring a sign except with Allah’s permission. Every matter has a destined time.

verses.arabic: يَمْحُوا۟ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثْبِتُ وَعِندَهُۥٓ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ

english_rwwad.text: Allah eliminates what He wills or affirms it[1], and with Him is the Master Book[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Although everything is set in the Record, He decrees whatever He wishes and the angels erase or affirm in the scrolls whatever He dictates.
 [2] The Preserved Tablet.

verses.translation: Allah eliminates what He wills or affirms it[1], and with Him is the Master Book[2].

verses.arabic: وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ وَعَلَيْنَا ٱلْحِسَابُ

english_rwwad.text: Whether We show you [O Prophet] part of what We warn them or cause you to die [before that], your duty is only to convey the message, and the reckoning is for Us.

verses.translation: Whether We show you [O Prophet] part of what We warn them or cause you to die [before that], your duty is only to convey the message, and the reckoning is for Us.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا وَٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكْمِهِۦ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ

english_rwwad.text: Do they not see that We advance to the land, diminishing it from its sides[1]? It is Allah Who decrees; there is none to reverse His decree, and He is swift in reckoning.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Referring to the spread of Islam by diminishing the lands controlled by the disbelievers.

verses.translation: Do they not see that We advance to the land, diminishing it from its sides[1]? It is Allah Who decrees; there is none to reverse His decree, and He is swift in reckoning.

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَكْرُ جَمِيعًا يَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلْكُفَّٰرُ لِمَنْ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: Those who came before them did devise plans, but Allah has the ultimate plan. He knows what every soul does, and the disbelievers will come to know who will have the final abode.

verses.translation: Those who came before them did devise plans, but Allah has the ultimate plan. He knows what every soul does, and the disbelievers will come to know who will have the final abode.

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَسْتَ مُرْسَلًا قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ

english_rwwad.text: Those who disbelieve say, “You are not a messenger.” Say, “Allah is sufficient as a Witness between me and you, as well as those who have knowledge of the Scripture[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As he is clearly mentioned in their Scripture.

verses.translation: Those who disbelieve say, “You are not a messenger.” Say, “Allah is sufficient as a Witness between me and you, as well as those who have knowledge of the Scripture[1].”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓر كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: Alif Lām Ra[1]. This is a book that We have sent down to you, so that you may bring people out of the depths of darkness into the light, by their Lord’s permission, to the path of the All-Mighty, the Praiseworthy.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.

verses.translation: Alif Lām Ra[1]. This is a book that We have sent down to you, so that you may bring people out of the depths of darkness into the light, by their Lord’s permission, to the path of the All-Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: Allah, to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth. And woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment!

verses.translation: Allah, to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth. And woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment!

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: Those who prefer the life of this world to the Hereafter and prevent [people] from Allah’s way, seeking to make it crooked[1]; it is they who have gone far astray.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., showing it as defective and imperfect.

verses.translation: Those who prefer the life of this world to the Hereafter and prevent [people] from Allah’s way, seeking to make it crooked[1]; it is they who have gone far astray.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: We did not send any messenger but in the language of his people to make things clear for them. Allah causes to stray whom He wills[1] and guides whom He wills, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those who refuse His guidance.

verses.translation: We did not send any messenger but in the language of his people to make things clear for them. Allah causes to stray whom He wills[1] and guides whom He wills, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُم بِأَيَّىٰمِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ

english_rwwad.text: We sent Moses with Our signs [saying], “Bring your people out of the depths of darkness into the light, and remind them of Allah’s days[1]. Indeed, there are signs in this for every patient and grateful person.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., days of favors upon the Children of Israel, or days of destruction of the former nations.

verses.translation: We sent Moses with Our signs [saying], “Bring your people out of the depths of darkness into the light, and remind them of Allah’s days[1]. Indeed, there are signs in this for every patient and grateful person.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ أَنجَىٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when Moses said to his people, “Remember Allah’s favor upon you when He saved you from Pharaoh’s people who were inflicting upon you the worst torment, slaughtering your sons and keeping your women alive; that was a great trial from your Lord.

verses.translation: And [remember] when Moses said to his people, “Remember Allah’s favor upon you when He saved you from Pharaoh’s people who were inflicting upon you the worst torment, slaughtering your sons and keeping your women alive; that was a great trial from your Lord.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when your Lord declared, ‘If you are grateful, I will surely give you more; but if you are ungrateful, My punishment is severe indeed.’”

verses.translation: And [remember] when your Lord declared, ‘If you are grateful, I will surely give you more; but if you are ungrateful, My punishment is severe indeed.’”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِن تَكْفُرُوٓا۟ أَنتُمْ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: And Moses said, “If you and all those who are on earth were to disbelieve, indeed Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”

verses.translation: And Moses said, “If you and all those who are on earth were to disbelieve, indeed Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرَدُّوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِىٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كَفَرْنَا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَنَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ

english_rwwad.text: Have there not come to you the stories of those who came before you – the people of Noah, ‘Ād and Thamūd, and those who came after them? No one knows them except Allah. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs, but they shoved their hands into their mouths[1] and said, “We disbelieve in what you are sent with, and we surely doubt what you are calling us to.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] as a gesture of denial and rejection.

verses.translation: Have there not come to you the stories of those who came before you – the people of Noah, ‘Ād and Thamūd, and those who came after them? No one knows them except Allah. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs, but they shoved their hands into their mouths[1] and said, “We disbelieve in what you are sent with, and we surely doubt what you are calling us to.”

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ أَفِى ٱللَّهِ شَكٌّ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِيَغْفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَأْتُونَا بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Their messengers said, “Can there be any doubt about Allah, the Creator of the heavens and earth? He calls you so that He may forgive some of your sins, and give you respite for an appointed term.” They said, “You are but humans like us! You want to turn us away from what our forefathers used to worship; then bring us a clear proof.”

verses.translation: Their messengers said, “Can there be any doubt about Allah, the Creator of the heavens and earth? He calls you so that He may forgive some of your sins, and give you respite for an appointed term.” They said, “You are but humans like us! You want to turn us away from what our forefathers used to worship; then bring us a clear proof.”

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ لَهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ إِن نَّحْنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نَّأْتِيَكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Their messengers said to them, “We are no more than human beings like you, but it is Allah Who bestows His favor upon whom He wills of His slaves. It is not for us to bring you proof except with Allah’s permission, and in Allah let the believers put their trust.

verses.translation: Their messengers said to them, “We are no more than human beings like you, but it is Allah Who bestows His favor upon whom He wills of His slaves. It is not for us to bring you proof except with Allah’s permission, and in Allah let the believers put their trust.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنَا سُبُلَنَا وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاذَيْتُمُونَا وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Why should we not put our trust in Allah, and it is He Who has guided us to our ways? We will surely be patient against whatever harm you cause us. And in Allah let the faithful put their trust.”

verses.translation: Why should we not put our trust in Allah, and it is He Who has guided us to our ways? We will surely be patient against whatever harm you cause us. And in Allah let the faithful put their trust.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِرُسُلِهِمْ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِنَآ أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِى مِلَّتِنَا فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ لَنُهْلِكَنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: The disbelievers said to their messengers, “We will surely drive you out of our land unless you return to our religion.” Their Lord then inspired them, “We will certainly destroy the wrongdoers,

verses.translation: The disbelievers said to their messengers, “We will surely drive you out of our land unless you return to our religion.” Their Lord then inspired them, “We will certainly destroy the wrongdoers,

verses.arabic: وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِى وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: and We will make you dwell in the land after them. This is for those who fear standing before Me[1], and who fear My warning.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., for account.

verses.translation: and We will make you dwell in the land after them. This is for those who fear standing before Me[1], and who fear My warning.”

verses.arabic: وَٱسْتَفْتَحُوا۟ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: [The messengers] sought victory, and every obstinate tyrant was doomed.

verses.translation: [The messengers] sought victory, and every obstinate tyrant was doomed.

verses.arabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٍ صَدِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: Hell awaits him, and he will be made to drink of oozing pus,

verses.translation: Hell awaits him, and he will be made to drink of oozing pus,

verses.arabic: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأْتِيهِ ٱلْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌ

english_rwwad.text: which he will sip with difficulty and can hardly swallow, and death will come to him from every direction, yet he will not die. And ahead of him will be a harsh punishment.

verses.translation: which he will sip with difficulty and can hardly swallow, and death will come to him from every direction, yet he will not die. And ahead of him will be a harsh punishment.

verses.arabic: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ

english_rwwad.text: The deeds of those who disbelieve[1] in their Lord are like ashes that are blown away by the wind on a stormy day. They will gain nothing from what they did; that is the farthest misguidance.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., their good deeds, as they were not based on solid ground of faith.

verses.translation: The deeds of those who disbelieve[1] in their Lord are like ashes that are blown away by the wind on a stormy day. They will gain nothing from what they did; that is the farthest misguidance.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see that Allah has created the heavens and earth for a true purpose? If He wills, He can take you away and replace you with a new creation[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] “If you turn away, He will replace you with other people, then they will not be like you.” See 47:38.

verses.translation: Do you not see that Allah has created the heavens and earth for a true purpose? If He wills, He can take you away and replace you with a new creation[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ

english_rwwad.text: That is not difficult for Allah.

verses.translation: That is not difficult for Allah.

verses.arabic: وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيْنَٰكُمْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَجَزِعْنَآ أَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٍ

english_rwwad.text: All will appear before Allah, then those who were weak will say to those who were arrogant, “We were your followers; can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allah?” They will say, “If Allah had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we cry or suffer patiently, we have no escape[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The pain of these disbelievers is not only physical, but also psychological.

verses.translation: All will appear before Allah, then those who were weak will say to those who were arrogant, “We were your followers; can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allah?” They will say, “If Allah had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we cry or suffer patiently, we have no escape[1].”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى فَلَا تَلُومُونِى وَلُومُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُم مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِىَّ إِنِّى كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Satan will say when the matter is finally decided, “Allah gave you a true promise; I also gave you a promise, but I betrayed you[1]. I had no authority over you, except that I called you and you responded to me[2]. So do not blame me, but blame yourselves. I cannot rescue you, nor can you rescue me. I deny your previous association of me with Allah. Indeed, for the wrongdoers there will be a painful punishment.”
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] “Satan makes no promises to them except delusion!” See 4:120.
 [2] By obeying me instead of Him during life on earth.

verses.translation: Satan will say when the matter is finally decided, “Allah gave you a true promise; I also gave you a promise, but I betrayed you[1]. I had no authority over you, except that I called you and you responded to me[2]. So do not blame me, but blame yourselves. I cannot rescue you, nor can you rescue me. I deny your previous association of me with Allah. Indeed, for the wrongdoers there will be a painful punishment.”

verses.arabic: وَأُدْخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever, by the permission of their Lord. Their greeting therein will be, “Peace!”

verses.translation: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever, by the permission of their Lord. Their greeting therein will be, “Peace!”

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَفَرْعُهَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see how Allah compares a good word[1] to a good tree[2]? Its root is firm and its branches reach the sky[3],
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the testimony of faith.
 [2] i.e., the palm tree.
 [3] i.e., Its foundation is firm in the heart and its branches, the good deeds, are high up in the sky, being constantly raised to Allah.

verses.translation: Do you not see how Allah compares a good word[1] to a good tree[2]? Its root is firm and its branches reach the sky[3],

verses.arabic: تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: yielding its fruit all the times[1], by the permission of its Lord. Allah makes such comparisons for people, so that they may take heed.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., day and night, summer and winter; likewise is the testimony of faith, it never ceases to yield good deeds all the time.

verses.translation: yielding its fruit all the times[1], by the permission of its Lord. Allah makes such comparisons for people, so that they may take heed.

verses.arabic: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجْتُثَّتْ مِن فَوْقِ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٍ

english_rwwad.text: But an evil word[1] is like an evil tree[2], uprooted from the surface of the earth, having no stability.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the word of disbelief and polytheism.
 [2] i.e., the tree of colocynth; it has no stable root and its stalks are so feeble; such is disbelief which is shaky in the heart, and their deeds are not raised to benefit them in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: But an evil word[1] is like an evil tree[2], uprooted from the surface of the earth, having no stability.

verses.arabic: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْقَوْلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ وَيَفْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ

english_rwwad.text: Allah keeps those who believe steadfast with the firm Word [of faith] in the life of this world[1] and in the Hereafter. But Allah causes to stray the wrongdoers[2]; Allah does whatever He wills.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] When questioned in their graves by the angels.
 [2] For doing wrong to themselves and others, Allah casts doubts and blindness in their hearts and does not guide them to say what is truthful in this life or in the grave.

verses.translation: Allah keeps those who believe steadfast with the firm Word [of faith] in the life of this world[1] and in the Hereafter. But Allah causes to stray the wrongdoers[2]; Allah does whatever He wills.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفْرًا وَأَحَلُّوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ ٱلْبَوَارِ

english_rwwad.text: Did you not see those who exchanged Allah’s blessings with disbelief[1], and led their people to the abode of ruin[2]?
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] They met Allah’s blessings with denial instead of gratitude.
 [2] i.e., the Hellfire.

verses.translation: Did you not see those who exchanged Allah’s blessings with disbelief[1], and led their people to the abode of ruin[2]?

verses.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا وَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ

english_rwwad.text: In Hell they will burn; what an evil place to settle in!

verses.translation: In Hell they will burn; what an evil place to settle in!

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: They set up rivals to Allah to mislead people from His way. Say, “Enjoy yourselves for a while! Your destination will be the Fire.”

verses.translation: They set up rivals to Allah to mislead people from His way. Say, “Enjoy yourselves for a while! Your destination will be the Fire.”

verses.arabic: قُل لِّعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا بَيْعٌ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ

english_rwwad.text: Tell My slaves who believe to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them, secretly and openly, before there comes a Day when there will be no bargaining or friendship[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As everyone will have enough affairs and busied away with their own record; nothing will avail a person except his good deeds.

verses.translation: Tell My slaves who believe to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them, secretly and openly, before there comes a Day when there will be no bargaining or friendship[1].

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِىَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ

english_rwwad.text: It is Allah Who has created the heavens and earth and sent down rain from the sky, producing therewith fruits as provision for you. He has made the ships for your service to sail through the sea by His command and has made for you the rivers.

verses.translation: It is Allah Who has created the heavens and earth and sent down rain from the sky, producing therewith fruits as provision for you. He has made the ships for your service to sail through the sea by His command and has made for you the rivers.

verses.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيْنِ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ

english_rwwad.text: He has made the sun and the moon for your service, both constant in their courses, and has made for you the night and the day[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the day in which people go about their living and the night during which they get rest.

verses.translation: He has made the sun and the moon for your service, both constant in their courses, and has made for you the night and the day[1].

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٌ كَفَّارٌ

english_rwwad.text: And He gave you of all that you have asked for[1]. If you try to count the blessings of Allah, you cannot count them[2]. Indeed, mankind is truly unjust and ungrateful.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] It is not only these grand favors that Allah grants people, but their prayers are also answered, be they uttered or merely wished for.
 [2] If a person were to ever try to count Allah’s blessings on him, he would never be able to count them, let alone be duly grateful for them.

verses.translation: And He gave you of all that you have asked for[1]. If you try to count the blessings of Allah, you cannot count them[2]. Indeed, mankind is truly unjust and ungrateful.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when Abraham said, “My Lord, make this city [of Makkah] secure and save me and my children from worshiping idols.

verses.translation: And [remember] when Abraham said, “My Lord, make this city [of Makkah] secure and save me and my children from worshiping idols.

verses.arabic: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: My Lord, they[1] have led many people astray. So whoever follows me, he belongs to me; and whoever disobeys me, then You are All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., idols.

verses.translation: My Lord, they[1] have led many people astray. So whoever follows me, he belongs to me; and whoever disobeys me, then You are All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Our Lord, I have settled some of my offspring in a barren valley near Your Sacred House, our Lord, so that they may establish prayer[1]. So make the people’s hearts incline towards them, and provide for them fruits, so that they may be grateful.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Prayer is specifically mentioned here because it is the best, most comprehensive act of worship and that it is key to all good.

verses.translation: Our Lord, I have settled some of my offspring in a barren valley near Your Sacred House, our Lord, so that they may establish prayer[1]. So make the people’s hearts incline towards them, and provide for them fruits, so that they may be grateful.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ

english_rwwad.text: Our Lord, You know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing is hidden from Allah on earth or in heaven.

verses.translation: Our Lord, You know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing is hidden from Allah on earth or in heaven.

verses.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ

english_rwwad.text: All praise be to Allah Who has granted me in old age Ishmael and Isaac[1]. Indeed, my Lord is the All-Hearing of prayers.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This is a practical demonstration of Abraham’s gratitude to Allah for His blessings.

verses.translation: All praise be to Allah Who has granted me in old age Ishmael and Isaac[1]. Indeed, my Lord is the All-Hearing of prayers.

verses.arabic: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ

english_rwwad.text: My Lord, make me steadfast in prayer and [likewise] some my offspring. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

verses.translation: My Lord, make me steadfast in prayer and [likewise] some my offspring. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ

english_rwwad.text: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will take place.”

verses.translation: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will take place.”

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ

english_rwwad.text: Never think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do[1]; He only delays them for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror][2] –
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] It serves both as comfort to the oppressed and as a warning to the oppressors.
 [2] Because of the horrifying sights they see, they will be unblinkingly staring upwards in horror.

verses.translation: Never think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do[1]; He only delays them for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror][2] –

verses.arabic: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ وَأَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌ

english_rwwad.text: rushing forward with their heads raised up, eyes not blinking[1] and hearts void[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] This is their state at the time of resurrection from the graves.
 [2] Their terror-struck hearts are empty; perceiving nothing.

verses.translation: rushing forward with their heads raised up, eyes not blinking[1] and hearts void[2].

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍ

english_rwwad.text: Warn people of the Day when the punishment will come upon them, and the wrongdoers will say, “Our Lord, give us a little more time, so that we may respond to Your call and follow the messengers!” [They will be told], “Did you not swear before that you would never cease to exist?”

verses.translation: Warn people of the Day when the punishment will come upon them, and the wrongdoers will say, “Our Lord, give us a little more time, so that we may respond to Your call and follow the messengers!” [They will be told], “Did you not swear before that you would never cease to exist?”

verses.arabic: وَسَكَنتُمْ فِى مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ

english_rwwad.text: You lived[1] in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it became clear to you how We dealt with them, and We gave you examples.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As Qurayshites would pass by the ruined dwellings of the destroyed nations; on their way to Yemen, they would pass by the dwellings of the ‘Ād tribe, and on their way to the Levant, they would pass by the dwellings of the Thamūd tribe, using them as resting posts.

verses.translation: You lived[1] in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it became clear to you how We dealt with them, and We gave you examples.”

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ

english_rwwad.text: They hatched their plot[1], but their plot was known to Allah; even if their plot were such that would move mountains[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., to kill the Prophet (ﷺ).
 [2] But due to its feebleness, their plotting was never to remove mountains.

verses.translation: They hatched their plot[1], but their plot was known to Allah; even if their plot were such that would move mountains[2].

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ

english_rwwad.text: Never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers[1]. Allah is All-Mighty, Capable of Retribution.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., that they would be given victory both in this life and in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: Never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers[1]. Allah is All-Mighty, Capable of Retribution.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: The Day when the earth will be changed to another earth and so will the heavens[1], and all will appear before Allah, the One, the Subjugator[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Many exegetes who talk about what befalls the heavens and earth on that Day, opines that the replacement here is of the characteristics (al-sifāt), not of the quintessence (al-dhāt).
 [2] Allah’s revenge will be on the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: The Day when the earth will be changed to another earth and so will the heavens[1], and all will appear before Allah, the One, the Subjugator[2].

verses.arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day you will see the wicked bound together in chains[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., their hands and feet will be chained to their necks. See 40:70-72.

verses.translation: On that Day you will see the wicked bound together in chains[1],

verses.arabic: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ

english_rwwad.text: their garments will be of pitch and their faces covered with Fire.

verses.translation: their garments will be of pitch and their faces covered with Fire.

verses.arabic: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ

english_rwwad.text: So that Allah may recompense every soul for what it did. Allah is swift in reckoning.

verses.translation: So that Allah may recompense every soul for what it did. Allah is swift in reckoning.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

english_rwwad.text: This [Qur’an] is a message for all mankind, so that they may be warned thereby and know that He is One God, and so that the people of understanding may take heed.

verses.translation: This [Qur’an] is a message for all mankind, so that they may be warned thereby and know that He is One God, and so that the people of understanding may take heed.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓر تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Alif Lām Ra[1]. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’an.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.

verses.translation: Alif Lām Ra[1]. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’an.

verses.arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: The disbelievers will soon[1] wish that they were Muslims.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] On the Judgment Day or upon their death.

verses.translation: The disbelievers will soon[1] wish that they were Muslims.

verses.arabic: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted with false hope; they will come to know.

verses.translation: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted with false hope; they will come to know.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

english_rwwad.text: We never destroyed any town except that it had a destined time.

verses.translation: We never destroyed any town except that it had a destined time.

verses.arabic: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: No nation can advance its appointed time, nor can they delay it.

verses.translation: No nation can advance its appointed time, nor can they delay it.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ

english_rwwad.text: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder has been sent down, You are surely insane[1]!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] These deriding remarks were very hard on the Prophet (ﷺ), and Allah consoles him in this surah.

verses.translation: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder has been sent down, You are surely insane[1]!

verses.arabic: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are truthful?”

verses.translation: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are truthful?”

verses.arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We do not send down the angels except for a just cause, and then [the disbelievers] would be granted no respite[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., then they would be destroyed on the spot.

verses.translation: We do not send down the angels except for a just cause, and then [the disbelievers] would be granted no respite[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ

english_rwwad.text: It is We Who have sent down the Reminder[1], and it is We Who will preserve it[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] As a reminder for people.
 [2] From distortion, alteration, addition, and omission. More than 1400 years have elapsed and not a single word of this Qur’an has been changed, although enemies have tried their utmost.

verses.translation: It is We Who have sent down the Reminder[1], and it is We Who will preserve it[2].

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We did send messengers before you among the factions of early peoples.

verses.translation: We did send messengers before you among the factions of early peoples.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

english_rwwad.text: No messenger came to them except that they ridiculed him.

verses.translation: No messenger came to them except that they ridiculed him.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is how We let this [denial] enter the hearts of the wicked[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For they rebelled against the Truth and did not submit to it.

verses.translation: This is how We let this [denial] enter the hearts of the wicked[1].

verses.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They will not believe in it, although the examples of the earlier people are well established.

verses.translation: They will not believe in it, although the examples of the earlier people are well established.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Even if We were to open for them a gateway to the heaven, through which they kept ascending,

verses.translation: Even if We were to open for them a gateway to the heaven, through which they kept ascending,

verses.arabic: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ

english_rwwad.text: they would still say, “Our eyes have been dazzled; rather, we have been bewitched.”

verses.translation: they would still say, “Our eyes have been dazzled; rather, we have been bewitched.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We have placed constellations in the heaven and adorned it for the onlookers,

verses.translation: We have placed constellations in the heaven and adorned it for the onlookers,

verses.arabic: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: and We have guarded it from every accursed devil,

verses.translation: and We have guarded it from every accursed devil,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: except the one who manages to eavesdrop, he will then be pursued by a visible burning flame.

verses.translation: except the one who manages to eavesdrop, he will then be pursued by a visible burning flame.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: As for the earth, We have spread it out and placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein everything in due proportion.

verses.translation: As for the earth, We have spread it out and placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein everything in due proportion.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And We have made therein for you means of sustenance and for those[1] whom you do not provide.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the children, servants, and livestock that one is blessed with.

verses.translation: And We have made therein for you means of sustenance and for those[1] whom you do not provide.

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

english_rwwad.text: There is nothing except that We have its treasuries, and We do not send it down except in a determined measure.

verses.translation: There is nothing except that We have its treasuries, and We do not send it down except in a determined measure.

verses.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And We send fertilizing winds[1], and send down rain from the sky for you to drink, and it is not you who could store it.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Causing precipitation in rainclouds or carrying pollen.

verses.translation: And We send fertilizing winds[1], and send down rain from the sky for you to drink, and it is not you who could store it.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, it is We Who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors [of all things].

verses.translation: Indeed, it is We Who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors [of all things].

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We surely know those of you who have gone before and those who are yet to come.

verses.translation: We surely know those of you who have gone before and those who are yet to come.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: It is your Lord Who will gather them together. He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.

verses.translation: It is your Lord Who will gather them together. He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: We have created man from sounding clay, made of aging mud[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Salsāl: clay left to ferment and turn hard so that it clinks when tapped on. Hama’: transformed or blackened clay. Masnūn: the smell of which has turned foul or left for some time.

verses.translation: We have created man from sounding clay, made of aging mud[1].

verses.arabic: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ

english_rwwad.text: And the jinn[1] We created before that, from smokeless fire.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The jinn: They are the creatures of Allah, who are different from humans. There are some among them who are righteous, while others are wicked. They are not humans or a species of humans.

verses.translation: And the jinn[1] We created before that, from smokeless fire.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay, made of aging mud.

verses.translation: And [remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay, made of aging mud.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When I have shaped him and breathed into him of My spirit[1], then fall down before him in prostration.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The spirit which Allah created for that body, not His own Spirit (as some mistakenly believe). Allah attributed it to Himself as a sign of honoring him, as in nāqat Allah (the she-camel of Allah).

verses.translation: When I have shaped him and breathed into him of My spirit[1], then fall down before him in prostration.”

verses.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Thereupon, all of the angels fell down in prostration,

verses.translation: Thereupon, all of the angels fell down in prostration,

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except for Iblīs, who refused to be with those who prostrated[1].

verses.translation: except for Iblīs, who refused to be with those who prostrated[1].

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah said, “O Iblīs, what is the matter with you that you were not with those who prostrated?”

verses.translation: Allah said, “O Iblīs, what is the matter with you that you were not with those who prostrated?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “I would never prostrate before a human whom You created from sounding clay, made of aging mud[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He said: “I am better than him; You created me from fire and created him from clay.” See 7:12.

verses.translation: He said, “I would never prostrate before a human whom You created from sounding clay, made of aging mud[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Then get out of here[1], for you are accursed,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., from the heaven.

verses.translation: He said, “Then get out of here[1], for you are accursed,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: and the curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”

verses.translation: and the curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Iblīs said, “My Lord, then grant me respite until the Day they are resurrected.”

verses.translation: Iblīs said, “My Lord, then grant me respite until the Day they are resurrected.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah said, “You are of those who are granted respite[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As a trial; to sift out His obedient servants from those who obey Iblīs.

verses.translation: Allah said, “You are of those who are granted respite[1],

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

english_rwwad.text: until the Day of the Appointed Time[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: until the Day of the Appointed Time[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “My Lord, since You have sent me astray[1], I will surely make [sins] alluring to them on earth and mislead them all,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Satan set the record for being the first to use predestination (al-qadar) as a pretext for disobeying Allah’s command (al-’amr).

verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, since You have sent me astray[1], I will surely make [sins] alluring to them on earth and mislead them all,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except for Your chosen slaves among them.”

verses.translation: except for Your chosen slaves among them.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Allah said, “This is a straight path leading to Me.

verses.translation: Allah said, “This is a straight path leading to Me.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ

english_rwwad.text: You will have no authority over My slaves, except the deviants who follow you.

verses.translation: You will have no authority over My slaves, except the deviants who follow you.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And Hell is certainly the promised place for them, all together.

verses.translation: And Hell is certainly the promised place for them, all together.

verses.arabic: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ

english_rwwad.text: It has seven gates[1]; each gate will have its allotted share of them.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The doors of Hell are plenty; according to the crime.

verses.translation: It has seven gates[1]; each gate will have its allotted share of them.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: The righteous will be amidst gardens and springs.

verses.translation: The righteous will be amidst gardens and springs.

verses.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: “Enter in peace and safety[1]!”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., safe from all ills, troubles, and all that might put a dent in their happiness.

verses.translation: “Enter in peace and safety[1]!”

verses.arabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We will remove all ill feelings from their hearts[1]; like brothers, seated on couches facing one another.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This is in perfection of their bliss, by having no ill-will whatsoever.

verses.translation: We will remove all ill feelings from their hearts[1]; like brothers, seated on couches facing one another.

verses.arabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ

english_rwwad.text: No fatigue will ever touch them therein[1], nor will they ever be made to leave.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., untainted by drawbacks of toil or uneasiness about the future.

verses.translation: No fatigue will ever touch them therein[1], nor will they ever be made to leave.

verses.arabic: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Inform My slaves that I am indeed the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful,

verses.translation: Inform My slaves that I am indeed the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful,

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: and that My punishment is the most painful punishment.

verses.translation: and that My punishment is the most painful punishment.

verses.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: And inform them about the guests of Abraham.

verses.translation: And inform them about the guests of Abraham.

verses.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: When they entered upon him and said, “Peace!” He said, “We are afraid of you[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] When he saw that their hands did not reach the roasted calf he presented to them.

verses.translation: When they entered upon him and said, “Peace!” He said, “We are afraid of you[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “Do not be afraid; We give you glad tidings of a knowledgeable boy[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Isaac; of great religious knowledge.

verses.translation: They said, “Do not be afraid; We give you glad tidings of a knowledgeable boy[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Do you give me glad tidings despite my old age? What glad tidings are you giving me?”

verses.translation: He said, “Do you give me glad tidings despite my old age? What glad tidings are you giving me?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “We have given you glad tidings in truth, so do not be of those who despair[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Abraham (عليه السلام) might have shown signs of doubt at believing such news.

verses.translation: They said, “We have given you glad tidings in truth, so do not be of those who despair[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Who would despair of his Lord’s mercy except those who are misguided[1]?”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Abraham’s (عليه السلام) reply disproves the assumption that he was despondent of Allah’s Mercy.

verses.translation: He said, “Who would despair of his Lord’s mercy except those who are misguided[1]?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “So, what is your mission, O messengers?”

verses.translation: He said, “So, what is your mission, O messengers?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “We have been sent to a wicked people[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the people of the prophet Lot (عليه السلام).

verses.translation: They said, “We have been sent to a wicked people[1],

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except the household of Lot; we will surely save them all,

verses.translation: except the household of Lot; we will surely save them all,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except his wife[1]; We have decreed that she will be among those who stay behind.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For she has collaborated with the evildoers.

verses.translation: except his wife[1]; We have decreed that she will be among those who stay behind.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: When the messengers came to the household of Lot[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Details of the first three nations destroyed are given in this and the following verses, which were en route of the famous trading journeys of the Qurayshites: the people of Prophet Lot, those of the thicket (the people of Shu‘ayb), and those of Hegra (Madā’in Sālih).

verses.translation: When the messengers came to the household of Lot[1],

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: he said, “You are unfamiliar people.”

verses.translation: he said, “You are unfamiliar people.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “We have come to you with that [punishment][1] which they have doubted.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the divine punishment.

verses.translation: They said, “We have come to you with that [punishment][1] which they have doubted.

verses.arabic: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We have come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.

verses.translation: We have come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.

verses.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So travel with your household in the dark of night and go behind them; none of you should look back[1], and keep going to where you are commanded.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To be more persistent in their walk and strike some distance before dawn, or not to be frightened and traumatized by catching sight of the horrific punishment of their folks.

verses.translation: So travel with your household in the dark of night and go behind them; none of you should look back[1], and keep going to where you are commanded.”

verses.arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We conveyed this decree to him that these [people] will be exterminated by early morning.”

verses.translation: We conveyed this decree to him that these [people] will be exterminated by early morning.”

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: The people of the city came [to Lot] rejoicing[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] At the news of his visitors.

verses.translation: The people of the city came [to Lot] rejoicing[1].

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ

english_rwwad.text: Lot said, “These are my guests, so do not bring shame on me.

verses.translation: Lot said, “These are my guests, so do not bring shame on me.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ

english_rwwad.text: Fear Allah and do not disgrace me.”

verses.translation: Fear Allah and do not disgrace me.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “Did we not forbid you from [protecting] people?”

verses.translation: They said, “Did we not forbid you from [protecting] people?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “These are my daughters [to marry], if you must[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the women of my community or my own daughters in a lawful marriage.

verses.translation: He said, “These are my daughters [to marry], if you must[1].”

verses.arabic: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: By your life [O prophet], they were wandering blindly in their intoxication [of lust][1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Admonition is of no use, no matter how reasonable it is, when someone is drunk in their lust.

verses.translation: By your life [O prophet], they were wandering blindly in their intoxication [of lust][1].

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So they were seized by the blast at sunrise,

verses.translation: So they were seized by the blast at sunrise,

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

english_rwwad.text: and We turned their cities upside down[1] and rained down on them stones of baked clay.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Their nature was twisted, so their punishment was of its like.

verses.translation: and We turned their cities upside down[1] and rained down on them stones of baked clay.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there are signs in this for those who discern[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those who look deeply into signifying signs.

verses.translation: Indeed, there are signs in this for those who discern[1].

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: And their place is located by a known route[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., on the highway to the Levant, where the Dead Sea is now.

verses.translation: And their place is located by a known route[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there are signs in this for the believers.

verses.translation: Indeed, there are signs in this for the believers.

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And the people of the Forest[1] were wrongdoers.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the people of the thicket, i.e. the people of Prophet Shu‘ayb (عليه السلام) who lived in Madian, not far from the people of Lot.

verses.translation: And the people of the Forest[1] were wrongdoers.

verses.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: So We punished them in retribution, and both [places][1] are by a clear highway.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., both the dwellings of the people of Prophet Lot (عليه السلام) and Prophet Shu‘ayb (عليه السلام).

verses.translation: So We punished them in retribution, and both [places][1] are by a clear highway.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Surely the people of Al-Hijr[1] also rejected the messengers.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Thamūd: the people of Prophet Sālih (عليه السلام).

verses.translation: Surely the people of Al-Hijr[1] also rejected the messengers.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We gave them Our signs, but they kept turning away from them.

verses.translation: We gave them Our signs, but they kept turning away from them.

verses.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They carved houses in the mountains, feeling secure[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] These mountainous strongholds gave them a false sense of security against any consequences.

verses.translation: They carved houses in the mountains, feeling secure[1].

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So they were seized by the blast early in the morning.

verses.translation: So they were seized by the blast early in the morning.

verses.arabic: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Nothing of what they earned was of any avail to them.

verses.translation: Nothing of what they earned was of any avail to them.

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ

english_rwwad.text: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them except for a true purpose. The Hour is certainly coming, so bear with them graciously[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This final passage puts things into perspective, addressing the Prophet (ﷺ) - that all people, including those who tormented him, will be justly held accountable for their deeds, and asking him to overlook their taunts and not censure them for it.

verses.translation: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them except for a true purpose. The Hour is certainly coming, so bear with them graciously[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, your Lord is the Absolute Creator, the All-Knowing.

verses.translation: Indeed, your Lord is the Absolute Creator, the All-Knowing.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: We have surely given you the seven oft-repeated verses[1] and the great Qur’an.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Seven of al-Mathāni (seven repeatedly recited verses), referring to Surat al-Fātihah.

verses.translation: We have surely given you the seven oft-repeated verses[1] and the great Qur’an.

verses.arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Do not look longingly at the pleasures We have given certain classes[1] of them[2], nor grieve over them[3], but lower your wing [in humility] to the believers[4].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Azwāj: literally means pairs; here it means those who are alike in prosperity, as not all of them were rich and prosperous.
 [2] So as to test them therein.
 [3] The Prophet (ﷺ) felt sad that they would not believe and save themselves from Hellfire.
 [4] The favor of the Qur’an far surpasses all other favors and worldly gains.

verses.translation: Do not look longingly at the pleasures We have given certain classes[1] of them[2], nor grieve over them[3], but lower your wing [in humility] to the believers[4].

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

english_rwwad.text: And say, “I am indeed a clear warner.” –

verses.translation: And say, “I am indeed a clear warner.” –

verses.arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: just as We sent down [punishment] upon those who divided [their religion][1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the People of the Book, who accepted some portions of the Torah and rejected some.

verses.translation: just as We sent down [punishment] upon those who divided [their religion][1],

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ

english_rwwad.text: those who split the Qur’an into different portions[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., calling it magic, divination, or poetry.

verses.translation: those who split the Qur’an into different portions[1].

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: By your Lord, We will surely question them all

verses.translation: By your Lord, We will surely question them all

verses.arabic: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: concerning what they used to do.

verses.translation: concerning what they used to do.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then proclaim what you are commanded, and turn away from those who associate partners with Allah.

verses.translation: Then proclaim what you are commanded, and turn away from those who associate partners with Allah.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We will surely suffice you against the mockers[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For this command will be tough, Allah gave him assurance.

verses.translation: We will surely suffice you against the mockers[1],

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those who set up beside Allah another god; they will come to know.

verses.translation: those who set up beside Allah another god; they will come to know.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We know that you are distressed by what they say.

verses.translation: We know that you are distressed by what they say.

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So glorify your Lord with praise and be among those who prostrate [to Him][1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The remedy is in resorting to Allah Almighty.

verses.translation: So glorify your Lord with praise and be among those who prostrate [to Him][1],

verses.arabic: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ

english_rwwad.text: and worship your Lord until the certainty [of death] comes to you.

verses.translation: and worship your Lord until the certainty [of death] comes to you.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah’s decree is coming[1], so do not seek to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted is He far above what they associate with Him[2]!
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Allah’s punishment is imminent and certain, as the Hour is approaching.
 [2] Shirk (associating partners with Allah) is the most egregious of all sins, as He warned against it right after mentioning the imminence of the Hour. Allah stresses against Shirk or calls for pure Tawhīd (monotheism) in the two subsequent verses as well.

verses.translation: Allah’s decree is coming[1], so do not seek to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted is He far above what they associate with Him[2]!

verses.arabic: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ

english_rwwad.text: He sends down the angels with revelation by His command to whom He wills of His slaves, [saying], “Warn that none has the right to be worshiped except Me, so fear Me.”

verses.translation: He sends down the angels with revelation by His command to whom He wills of His slaves, [saying], “Warn that none has the right to be worshiped except Me, so fear Me.”

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose. Exalted is He far above what they associate with Him!

verses.translation: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose. Exalted is He far above what they associate with Him!

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: He created man from a sperm-drop, and then he becomes a clear adversary[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As soon as he becomes strong and independent. The ones who are meant here are, especially, the disbelievers who deny resurrection, argue against the Truth, and are ungrateful to Allah’s favors.

verses.translation: He created man from a sperm-drop, and then he becomes a clear adversary[1].

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And He has created the livestock for you as a source of warmth and other benefits[1], and from them you eat.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., in clothing, tents, furnishings, etc.

verses.translation: And He has created the livestock for you as a source of warmth and other benefits[1], and from them you eat.

verses.arabic: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ

english_rwwad.text: There is beauty for you in them when you bring them home to rest and when you take them out to graze[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Their bringing back is mentioned before their setting off to pasture because that is when their udders and waists are full and thus more pleasing to the beholder.

verses.translation: There is beauty for you in them when you bring them home to rest and when you take them out to graze[1].

verses.arabic: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: And they carry your heavy loads to lands that you could not reach without great hardship. Indeed, your Lord is Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

verses.translation: And they carry your heavy loads to lands that you could not reach without great hardship. Indeed, your Lord is Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and for adornment, and He creates other things that you do not know.

verses.translation: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and for adornment, and He creates other things that you do not know.

verses.arabic: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: It is upon Allah to show the straight path, while other ways are deviant. If He had willed, He could have guided you all.

verses.translation: It is upon Allah to show the straight path, while other ways are deviant. If He had willed, He could have guided you all.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who sends down rain from the sky, from it you drink, and by it plants thrive on which you pasture your livestock.

verses.translation: It is He Who sends down rain from the sky, from it you drink, and by it plants thrive on which you pasture your livestock.

verses.arabic: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He causes to grow therewith crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines and all kinds of fruits[1] for you. Indeed, there is a sign in this for people who reflect.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It highlight the great wonder that although all these are irrigated with the same water, yet they come in different kinds, tastes, colors and shapes.

verses.translation: He causes to grow therewith crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines and all kinds of fruits[1] for you. Indeed, there is a sign in this for people who reflect.

verses.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And He has subjected for you the night and day, the sun and moon, and the stars[1] are made subservient by His command. Indeed, there are signs in this for people of understanding.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Stars are crucial for knowing the directions in the darkness of the sea and the land.

verses.translation: And He has subjected for you the night and day, the sun and moon, and the stars[1] are made subservient by His command. Indeed, there are signs in this for people of understanding.

verses.arabic: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And He has created for you various kinds of things on earth[1]. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who take heed.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Such as animals, minerals, plants and inanimate objects.

verses.translation: And He has created for you various kinds of things on earth[1]. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who take heed.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who has subjected the sea, so that you may eat from it tender meat and extract ornaments to wear. And you see the ships cleaving their way through its waves[1], so that you may seek His bounty and so that you may give thanks.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Another great sign of Allah, that heavy ships and vessels run smoothly on the surface of water without sinking.

verses.translation: It is He Who has subjected the sea, so that you may eat from it tender meat and extract ornaments to wear. And you see the ships cleaving their way through its waves[1], so that you may seek His bounty and so that you may give thanks.

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَٰرًا وَسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And He has placed into the earth firm mountains, so it does not tremor with you, and there are rivers[1] and pathways so that you may find your way,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Rivers are like bloodlines spreading life in the land; people drink from them along with their livestock, grow crops, and travel through them.

verses.translation: And He has placed into the earth firm mountains, so it does not tremor with you, and there are rivers[1] and pathways so that you may find your way,

verses.arabic: وَعَلَٰمَٰتٍ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and landmarks and the stars by which they find their way[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] With landmarks to find the way during the daytime and with the stars at night.

verses.translation: and landmarks and the stars by which they find their way[1].

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Is then He Who creates equal to one who cannot create? Will you not then take heed?

verses.translation: Is then He Who creates equal to one who cannot create? Will you not then take heed?

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: If you try to count Allah’s favors, you will not be able to enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.translation: If you try to count Allah’s favors, you will not be able to enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah knows all that you conceal and all that you reveal.

verses.translation: Allah knows all that you conceal and all that you reveal.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But those whom they invoke besides Allah do not create anything; rather, they themselves are created.

verses.translation: But those whom they invoke besides Allah do not create anything; rather, they themselves are created.

verses.arabic: أَمْوَٰتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They are dead, not living[1]; not even knowing when they will be resurrected.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., inanimate or without understanding.

verses.translation: They are dead, not living[1]; not even knowing when they will be resurrected.

verses.arabic: إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Your God is One God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts refuse to know, and they are arrogant[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Arrogance and snobbery are the underlying reasons for denying Allah’s Signs and rejecting the Truth.

verses.translation: Your God is One God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts refuse to know, and they are arrogant[1].

verses.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Undoubtedly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal[1]. Indeed, He does not like those who are arrogant.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He will hold them to account over them.

verses.translation: Undoubtedly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal[1]. Indeed, He does not like those who are arrogant.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “Ancient fables!”

verses.translation: When it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “Ancient fables!”

verses.arabic: لِيَحْمِلُوٓا۟ أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will bear their burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some burdens of those whom they misled without knowledge[1]. How terrible is what they will bear!
