english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Whoever calls to misguidance will incur as much sin as that of whoever follows him.” [Muslim: 2674].

verses.translation: They will bear their burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some burdens of those whom they misled without knowledge[1]. How terrible is what they will bear!

verses.arabic: قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Those who came before them plotted, so Allah uprooted their buildings from their foundations and the roof fell down on top of them[1], and the punishment came on them from where they could not imagine.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Allah caused their plot to fail and exposed their plan.

verses.translation: Those who came before them plotted, so Allah uprooted their buildings from their foundations and the roof fell down on top of them[1], and the punishment came on them from where they could not imagine.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمْ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ إِنَّ ٱلْخِزْىَ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and will say, “Where are My [so-called] partners for whose sake you used to oppose [the truth]?” Those who were given knowledge will say, “Today disgrace and misery will befall the disbelievers.”

verses.translation: Then on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and will say, “Where are My [so-called] partners for whose sake you used to oppose [the truth]?” Those who were given knowledge will say, “Today disgrace and misery will befall the disbelievers.”

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَأَلْقَوُا۟ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوٓءٍۭ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Those whose souls are seized by the angels while they wrong themselves will then offer submission, “We did not do anything evil.” “Yes, indeed you did! Allah knows well what you used to do.

verses.translation: Those whose souls are seized by the angels while they wrong themselves will then offer submission, “We did not do anything evil.” “Yes, indeed you did! Allah knows well what you used to do.

verses.arabic: فَٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So enter the gates of Hell, abiding therein forever. What a terrible abode for those who were arrogant!”

verses.translation: So enter the gates of Hell, abiding therein forever. What a terrible abode for those who were arrogant!”

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And it will be said to those who fear Allah, “What has your Lord sent down?” They will say, “All that is good.” For those who do good in this world, there is a good reward[1]; and the home of the Hereafter is far better. What an excellent home for those who fear Allah!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of a plentiful and satisfying life in this world.

verses.translation: And it will be said to those who fear Allah, “What has your Lord sent down?” They will say, “All that is good.” For those who do good in this world, there is a good reward[1]; and the home of the Hereafter is far better. What an excellent home for those who fear Allah!

verses.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They will enter the Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish[1]. This is how Allah rewards those who fear Him,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Unlike this worldly life.

verses.translation: They will enter the Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish[1]. This is how Allah rewards those who fear Him,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ يَقُولُونَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those whose souls the angels take while they are in a state of purity[1], saying, “Peace be upon you; enter Paradise for what you used to do.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Their souls will be purified from polytheism, sins, and ill feelings.

verses.translation: those whose souls the angels take while they are in a state of purity[1], saying, “Peace be upon you; enter Paradise for what you used to do.”

verses.arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Are [the disbelievers] waiting for the angels to come to them[1] or for the command of your Lord to come[2]? Those who came before them did the same. It was not Allah Who wronged them, but it was they who wronged themselves.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] To take their souls while they are unjust to themselves.
 [2] To punish them in this worldly life.

verses.translation: Are [the disbelievers] waiting for the angels to come to them[1] or for the command of your Lord to come[2]? Those who came before them did the same. It was not Allah Who wronged them, but it was they who wronged themselves.

verses.arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They were afflicted by the evil consequences of their deeds, and they were overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

verses.translation: They were afflicted by the evil consequences of their deeds, and they were overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ نَّحْنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَهَلْ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

english_rwwad.text: Those who associate partners with Allah say, “If Allah had willed, neither we nor our forefathers would have worshiped anything besides Him, nor would we have prohibited anything without His command[1].” Those who came before them did the same. Is the duty of the messengers anything except to convey the message clearly?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They falsely argue citing predestination (al-qadā’ wa al-qadar), while they have been given the ability to choose the path to follow in this life.

verses.translation: Those who associate partners with Allah say, “If Allah had willed, neither we nor our forefathers would have worshiped anything besides Him, nor would we have prohibited anything without His command[1].” Those who came before them did the same. Is the duty of the messengers anything except to convey the message clearly?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We sent to every community a messenger, [saying], “Worship Allah and shun false gods[1].” Among them were some whom Allah guided, while others were destined to stray. So travel through the land and see how was the end of the deniers!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Tāghūt: false objects of worship. See footnote 2:256.

verses.translation: Indeed, We sent to every community a messenger, [saying], “Worship Allah and shun false gods[1].” Among them were some whom Allah guided, while others were destined to stray. So travel through the land and see how was the end of the deniers!

verses.arabic: إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَن يُضِلُّ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Even though you are keen to guide them, Allah does not guide those whom He causes to stray[1], and they will have no helpers.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As a result of their choice to reject guidance.

verses.translation: Even though you are keen to guide them, Allah does not guide those whom He causes to stray[1], and they will have no helpers.

verses.arabic: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَا يَبْعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They swear by Allah their solemn oaths that Allah will not resurrect those who die. Yes, He will! It is a true promise upon Him, but most people do not know –

verses.translation: They swear by Allah their solemn oaths that Allah will not resurrect those who die. Yes, He will! It is a true promise upon Him, but most people do not know –

verses.arabic: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَٰذِبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: so that He may make clear to them that over which they differ, and so that the disbelievers may realize that they were liars.

verses.translation: so that He may make clear to them that over which they differ, and so that the disbelievers may realize that they were liars.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدْنَٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

english_rwwad.text: When We intend something, We only say to it, “Be!”, and it is.

verses.translation: When We intend something, We only say to it, “Be!”, and it is.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَلَأَجْرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Those who migrated for the sake of Allah after being oppressed[1], We will surely give them good in this world. But the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they knew,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Companions who fled persecution to Abyssinia, or the early migrants to Madinah.

verses.translation: Those who migrated for the sake of Allah after being oppressed[1], We will surely give them good in this world. But the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they knew,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those who endured patiently and put their trust in their Lord.

verses.translation: those who endured patiently and put their trust in their Lord.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We did not send before you except men to whom We sent revelation. Ask the people of knowledge[1], if you do not know.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] People of the knowledge (ahl al-dhikr) are the People of the Book, the Jews and Christians. They are mentioned here for the Makkan Arabs because they were generally regarded as possessors of knowledge before the advent of Islam.

verses.translation: We did not send before you except men to whom We sent revelation. Ask the people of knowledge[1], if you do not know.

verses.arabic: بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [We sent them] with clear proofs and scriptures, and We have sent down to you [O Prophet] the Reminder to explain to people what has been sent down to them, and so that they may reflect.

verses.translation: [We sent them] with clear proofs and scriptures, and We have sent down to you [O Prophet] the Reminder to explain to people what has been sent down to them, and so that they may reflect.

verses.arabic: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخْسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do those who devise evil plots feel secure that Allah will not make them sink into the earth or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not expect?

verses.translation: Do those who devise evil plots feel secure that Allah will not make them sink into the earth or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not expect?

verses.arabic: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِى تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Or that He may seize them while they are going about[1], and they will have no escape?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., their recurrent travels through lands and going about their lives.

verses.translation: Or that He may seize them while they are going about[1], and they will have no escape?

verses.arabic: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Or that He will seize them when they are in a state of fear? But your Lord is indeed Ever Gracious, Most Merciful[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Postponing punishment and giving opportunity for repentance.

verses.translation: Or that He will seize them when they are in a state of fear? But your Lord is indeed Ever Gracious, Most Merciful[1].

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ يَتَفَيَّؤُا۟ ظِلَٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do they not see the things that Allah has created, how their shadows incline to the right and left, prostrating[1] to Allah in all humility?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Prostration is the greatest sign of submission to Allah.

verses.translation: Do they not see the things that Allah has created, how their shadows incline to the right and left, prostrating[1] to Allah in all humility?

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: To Allah prostrates[1] all that is in the heavens and on earth of living things, and so do the angels; and they do not show arrogance.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Actual prostration or figurative one, which is full submission.

verses.translation: To Allah prostrates[1] all that is in the heavens and on earth of living things, and so do the angels; and they do not show arrogance.

verses.arabic: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.

verses.translation: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ إِلَٰهَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ

english_rwwad.text: Allah said, “Do not take two gods[1]. He is only One God, so fear Me alone.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., more than one.

verses.translation: Allah said, “Do not take two gods[1]. He is only One God, so fear Me alone.”

verses.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and earth, and constant devotion is to Him alone. Will you then fear anyone other than Allah?

verses.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and earth, and constant devotion is to Him alone. Will you then fear anyone other than Allah?

verses.arabic: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Whatever blessing you have, it is from Allah. Then when you are afflicted with hardship, to Him alone you cry out for help[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The One Who grants favors and removes hardship is to be worshiped alone.

verses.translation: Whatever blessing you have, it is from Allah. Then when you are afflicted with hardship, to Him alone you cry out for help[1].

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then as soon as He removes the hardship from you, some of you associate partners with their Lord,

verses.translation: Then as soon as He removes the hardship from you, some of you associate partners with their Lord,

verses.arabic: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: showing their ingratitude for what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves now, but you will soon come to know.

verses.translation: showing their ingratitude for what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves now, but you will soon come to know.

verses.arabic: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They assign a portion of what We have provided for them to those [idols] who know nothing. By Allah, you will surely be called to account for what you used to fabricate.

verses.translation: They assign a portion of what We have provided for them to those [idols] who know nothing. By Allah, you will surely be called to account for what you used to fabricate.

verses.arabic: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْبَنَٰتِ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: To Allah they ascribe daughters[1] – glory be to Him – but for themselves they choose what they desire [i.e., sons].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The pagans falsely claimed that the angels were Allah’s daughters.

verses.translation: To Allah they ascribe daughters[1] – glory be to Him – but for themselves they choose what they desire [i.e., sons].

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: When one of them is given the good news of a female baby, his face darkens while suppressing his anguish.

verses.translation: When one of them is given the good news of a female baby, his face darkens while suppressing his anguish.

verses.arabic: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓ أَيُمْسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِى ٱلتُّرَابِ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He hides away from people because of the bad news he was given. Should he keep her in disgrace, or bury her in the dust? How terrible is their judgment!

verses.translation: He hides away from people because of the bad news he was given. Should he keep her in disgrace, or bury her in the dust? How terrible is their judgment!

verses.arabic: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter have evil attributes[1], and Allah has the highest attributes[2], for He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] As described in the previous two verses such as the need for children, ignorance, and disbelief.
 [2] Attributes of grandeur, perfection, and knowledge, and is free from all imperfections and need.

verses.translation: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter have evil attributes[1], and Allah has the highest attributes[2], for He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If Allah were to take people to task for their wrongdoing, He would not leave a single living being on earth, but He gives them respite for an appointed time. When their time comes, they cannot delay it for a moment nor can they bring it forward.

verses.translation: If Allah were to take people to task for their wrongdoing, He would not leave a single living being on earth, but He gives them respite for an appointed time. When their time comes, they cannot delay it for a moment nor can they bring it forward.

verses.arabic: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They attribute to Allah[1] what they dislike for themselves, and their tongues make false claim that they will have the best [reward][2]. Without a doubt for them there will be the Fire, and they will be neglected.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] That the angels are Allah’s daughters.
 [2] Both in this life and in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: They attribute to Allah[1] what they dislike for themselves, and their tongues make false claim that they will have the best [reward][2]. Without a doubt for them there will be the Fire, and they will be neglected.

verses.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: By Allah, We sent [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds[1] appealing to them. He is their ally today, and for them there will be a painful punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Such as disbelief, polytheism, rejecting the Messenger, and evil deeds.

verses.translation: By Allah, We sent [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds[1] appealing to them. He is their ally today, and for them there will be a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We have only sent down to you the Book so that you may make clear to them what they differed about[1] and as a guidance and mercy for people who believe.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., worshiping Allah alone, resurrection, and the rules of law.

verses.translation: We have only sent down to you the Book so that you may make clear to them what they differed about[1] and as a guidance and mercy for people who believe.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah sends down rain from the sky and revives thereby the earth after its death. Indeed, there is a sign in this for people who listen[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those who listen and reflect on such evidence of Allah’s ability over the resurrection.

verses.translation: Allah sends down rain from the sky and revives thereby the earth after its death. Indeed, there is a sign in this for people who listen[1].

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَآئِغًا لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And there is surely a lesson for you in livestock. We give you drink from what is in their bellies – produced between excretion and blood – pure and pleasant milk for those who drink[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This pure, palatable and enjoyable milk, comes from between the smelly excretion and colored blood.

verses.translation: And there is surely a lesson for you in livestock. We give you drink from what is in their bellies – produced between excretion and blood – pure and pleasant milk for those who drink[1].

verses.arabic: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلْأَعْنَٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And from the fruits of palm trees and grapevines, you make intoxicants[1] and good provision[2]. Indeed, there is a sign in this for people of understanding.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] This is a Makkan surah that was revealed prior to the prohibition of intoxicants.
 [2] It alludes that there are both evil and good aspects to certain things.

verses.translation: And from the fruits of palm trees and grapevines, you make intoxicants[1] and good provision[2]. Indeed, there is a sign in this for people of understanding.

verses.arabic: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحْلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِى مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord inspired the bees, “Make homes in the mountains, the trees, and in the trellises that people put up,

verses.translation: Your Lord inspired the bees, “Make homes in the mountains, the trees, and in the trellises that people put up,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then feed on every kind of fruit and follow the ways that your Lord made easy for you.” There comes out from their bellies a drink[1] of various colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed, there is a sign in this for people who reflect.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., honey.

verses.translation: Then feed on every kind of fruit and follow the ways that your Lord made easy for you.” There comes out from their bellies a drink[1] of various colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed, there is a sign in this for people who reflect.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَىْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Allah has created you, then He causes you to die. Among you are some who are left to reach the most decrepit age[1], so that they may know nothing after having known much. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, Most Capable.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., old age when both the physical and mental powers of a human diminish.

verses.translation: Allah has created you, then He causes you to die. Among you are some who are left to reach the most decrepit age[1], so that they may know nothing after having known much. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, Most Capable.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِى ٱلرِّزْقِ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا۟ بِرَآدِّى رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. Those who are favored will not share their provision with their slaves, so that they may become equal to them[1]. Do they then deny the favors of Allah?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] If they would not accept to equally share their provision with their slaves, how would then they set up associates with Allah in worship?

verses.translation: Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. Those who are favored will not share their provision with their slaves, so that they may become equal to them[1]. Do they then deny the favors of Allah?

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ أَفَبِٱلْبَٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah has made for you spouses of your own kind[1], and has given you through your spouses children and grandchildren, and has given you provision from good things. Do they still believe in falsehood and deny the favors of Allah?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., humans in general, or the original creation of Eve out of Adam.

verses.translation: Allah has made for you spouses of your own kind[1], and has given you through your spouses children and grandchildren, and has given you provision from good things. Do they still believe in falsehood and deny the favors of Allah?

verses.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They worship besides Allah those who have nothing to provide for them from the heavens and earth[1], nor are they capable of doing so.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., rain from the sky or plants from the earth.

verses.translation: They worship besides Allah those who have nothing to provide for them from the heavens and earth[1], nor are they capable of doing so.

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So do not make comparisons to Allah[1]. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] As there is none comparable to Him.
 [2] Due to not realizing Allah’s Greatness and out of their ignorance, they draw comparisons between Him and their idols.

verses.translation: So do not make comparisons to Allah[1]. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know[2].

verses.arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا هَلْ يَسْتَوُۥنَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah makes a comparison of a bonded slave who has no power over anything and a [free] person whom We granted good provision from Us, and he spends from it secretly and openly. Are they equal? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not know[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] No sane person would equate the two, then how do they equate the Creator of the Possessor of the whole universe and the inanimate idols in worship?!

verses.translation: Allah makes a comparison of a bonded slave who has no power over anything and a [free] person whom We granted good provision from Us, and he spends from it secretly and openly. Are they equal? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not know[1].

verses.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَىٰهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: And Allah makes a comparison of two men, one of them is dumb and unable to do anything, and he is a burden to his master; wherever he directs him, he brings no good[1]. Is he equal to the one who enjoins justice and follows a straight path?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This is the description of their idols who are mute, deaf, mindless, and not able to do anything.

verses.translation: And Allah makes a comparison of two men, one of them is dumb and unable to do anything, and he is a burden to his master; wherever he directs him, he brings no good[1]. Is he equal to the one who enjoins justice and follows a straight path?

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَآ أَمْرُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ ٱلْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: To Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth; and the coming of the Hour is no more than the blink of an eye or even quicker, for Allah is Most Capable of all things.

verses.translation: To Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth; and the coming of the Hour is no more than the blink of an eye or even quicker, for Allah is Most Capable of all things.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah brought you out from your mothers’ wombs not knowing anything, and He gave you hearing, sight and intellect, so that you may be grateful[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Men should use these faculties of hearing, sight, and intellect to ponder over their creation and know their Lord, be grateful to Him, and worship Him alone.

verses.translation: Allah brought you out from your mothers’ wombs not knowing anything, and He gave you hearing, sight and intellect, so that you may be grateful[1].

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍ فِى جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do they not see the birds enabled to fly in the open air? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who believe.

verses.translation: Do they not see the birds enabled to fly in the open air? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who believe.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَآ أَثَٰثًا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Allah has made your houses a place of rest for you, and He has given you tents made from the hides of livestock which you find light to handle when you travel and when you camp. And out of their wool, fur and hair [He has given you] furnishings and enjoyment for a while.

verses.translation: Allah has made your houses a place of rest for you, and He has given you tents made from the hides of livestock which you find light to handle when you travel and when you camp. And out of their wool, fur and hair [He has given you] furnishings and enjoyment for a while.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَٰلًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ أَكْنَٰنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلْحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah has made for you shade out of what He has created and has made for you shelter in the mountains. He has also made for you garments protecting you from heat [and cold], and garments [of armor] protecting you in battle. This is how He perfects His favors upon you, so that you may submit to Him.

verses.translation: Allah has made for you shade out of what He has created and has made for you shelter in the mountains. He has also made for you garments protecting you from heat [and cold], and garments [of armor] protecting you in battle. This is how He perfects His favors upon you, so that you may submit to Him.

verses.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

english_rwwad.text: But if they turn away, your duty is only to convey the message clearly.

verses.translation: But if they turn away, your duty is only to convey the message clearly.

verses.arabic: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They know Allah’s favors, yet they deny them, and most of them are ungrateful.

verses.translation: They know Allah’s favors, yet they deny them, and most of them are ungrateful.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when We raise up a witness[1] from every community, no excuse will be accepted from the disbelievers, nor will they be allowed to make amends.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., their Messenger to bear witness as to how his nation answered his call.

verses.translation: On the Day when We raise up a witness[1] from every community, no excuse will be accepted from the disbelievers, nor will they be allowed to make amends.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: When the wrongdoers face the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be given any respite.

verses.translation: When the wrongdoers face the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be given any respite.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَهُمْ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِكَ فَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: When those who associated partners with Allah see their [so-called] partners, they will say, “Our Lord, these are our partners whom we used to worship besides You.” But they will counter them with the statement, “You are indeed liars.”

verses.translation: When those who associated partners with Allah see their [so-called] partners, they will say, “Our Lord, these are our partners whom we used to worship besides You.” But they will counter them with the statement, “You are indeed liars.”

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلسَّلَمَ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day they will offer submission to Allah[1], and all what they used to fabricate will vanish from them.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They then realize that they deserve the punishment.

verses.translation: On that Day they will offer submission to Allah[1], and all what they used to fabricate will vanish from them.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ زِدْنَٰهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ ٱلْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يُفْسِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Those who disbelieve and prevent others from the way of Allah, We will add punishment to their punishment for the corruption they used to spread.

verses.translation: Those who disbelieve and prevent others from the way of Allah, We will add punishment to their punishment for the corruption they used to spread.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ تِبْيَٰنًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when We raise up against every community a witness from among themselves, We will bring you [O Prophet] as a witness against these [people]. We have sent down to you the Book as an explanation of everything, and as a guidance, mercy, and glad tidings for the Muslims.

verses.translation: On the Day when We raise up against every community a witness from among themselves, We will bring you [O Prophet] as a witness against these [people]. We have sent down to you the Book as an explanation of everything, and as a guidance, mercy, and glad tidings for the Muslims.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ وَإِيتَآئِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْبَغْىِ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah enjoins justice, kindness, and giving relatives[1] [their dues], and He forbids shameful acts, evil deeds and oppression. He exhorts you, so that you may take heed.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Degree of kinship: Parents, then offspring, then brothers and sisters, then paternal uncles and aunts, then maternal uncles and aunts, and then other relatives.

verses.translation: Allah enjoins justice, kindness, and giving relatives[1] [their dues], and He forbids shameful acts, evil deeds and oppression. He exhorts you, so that you may take heed.

verses.arabic: وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا عَٰهَدتُّمْ وَلَا تَنقُضُوا۟ ٱلْأَيْمَٰنَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Fulfill the covenant of Allah when you pledge, and do not break oaths after confirming them, having made Allah your witness, for Allah knows all what you do.

verses.translation: Fulfill the covenant of Allah when you pledge, and do not break oaths after confirming them, having made Allah your witness, for Allah knows all what you do.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّتِى نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَٰثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِىَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do not be like the woman who unravels her yarn after spinning it firmly, by taking your oaths as a means of deceit between yourselves so that one party might gain an advantage over the other[1]. Allah only puts you to the test thereby[2], and on the Day of Resurrection, He will surely make clear to you all that over which you used to differ.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Do not swear falsely or break a treaty merely for worldly gain.
 [2] As to who will honor their binding pledge and who will break it for another alluring pact with a stronger party.

verses.translation: Do not be like the woman who unravels her yarn after spinning it firmly, by taking your oaths as a means of deceit between yourselves so that one party might gain an advantage over the other[1]. Allah only puts you to the test thereby[2], and on the Day of Resurrection, He will surely make clear to you all that over which you used to differ.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ وَلَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If Allah had willed, He would have made all of you a single community [of believers], but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills[1], and you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] According to His infinite knowledge of each soul’s preference.

verses.translation: If Allah had willed, He would have made all of you a single community [of believers], but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills[1], and you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌۢ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Do not take your oaths as a means of deceit between yourselves, lest some feet will slip after they have been firm[1], and you will taste the evil consequences of preventing people from the way of Allah, and for you there will be a great punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., after their feet became firm in Islam.

verses.translation: Do not take your oaths as a means of deceit between yourselves, lest some feet will slip after they have been firm[1], and you will taste the evil consequences of preventing people from the way of Allah, and for you there will be a great punishment.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا إِنَّمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do not trade the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you knew.

verses.translation: Do not trade the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you knew.

verses.arabic: مَا عِندَكُمْ يَنفَدُ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ بَاقٍ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Whatever you have will come to an end, but whatever Allah has will last forever. And We will surely grant those who remain steadfast their reward according to the best of their deeds.

verses.translation: Whatever you have will come to an end, but whatever Allah has will last forever. And We will surely grant those who remain steadfast their reward according to the best of their deeds.

verses.arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةً طَيِّبَةً وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Whoever does righteous deeds, male or female, while being a believer, We will surely grant him a good life[1], and We will surely reward them according to the best of their deeds[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] By the sweetness of faith, comfort in the heart, and satisfaction with the provision given by Allah.
 [2] In the Hereafter.

verses.translation: Whoever does righteous deeds, male or female, while being a believer, We will surely grant him a good life[1], and We will surely reward them according to the best of their deeds[2].

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: When you recite the Qur’an, seek refuge with Allah from the accursed Satan.

verses.translation: When you recite the Qur’an, seek refuge with Allah from the accursed Satan.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, he has no power over those who believe[1] and put their trust in their Lord.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Satan has no authority over them except whisperings.

verses.translation: Indeed, he has no power over those who believe[1] and put their trust in their Lord.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا سُلْطَٰنُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِهِۦ مُشْرِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He only has power over those who take him as their patron[1], and who - under his influence - associate partners with Allah.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Who follow him and obey his commands.

verses.translation: He only has power over those who take him as their patron[1], and who - under his influence - associate partners with Allah.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَآ ءَايَةً مَّكَانَ ءَايَةٍ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُفْتَرٍۭ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: When We replace one verse with another[1] – and Allah knows best what He sends down – they say, “You are just making it up.” In fact, most of them have no knowledge.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By abrogating (naskh) of a ruling altogether with a new one or maintaining its wording in the Qur’an.

verses.translation: When We replace one verse with another[1] – and Allah knows best what He sends down – they say, “You are just making it up.” In fact, most of them have no knowledge.

verses.arabic: قُلْ نَزَّلَهُۥ رُوحُ ٱلْقُدُسِ مِن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “This has been brought down by the Holy Spirit[1] from your Lord with the truth, to strengthen those who believe, and as guidance and glad tidings to the Muslims.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Gabriel (Jibrīl), who is purified from any treachery and defect.

verses.translation: Say, “This has been brought down by the Holy Spirit[1] from your Lord with the truth, to strengthen those who believe, and as guidance and glad tidings to the Muslims.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُۥ بَشَرٌ لِّسَانُ ٱلَّذِى يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِىٌّ وَهَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِىٌّ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: We surely know that they say, “It is only a human being who teaches him[1].” But the language they refer to is foreign, whereas this is eloquent Arabic language.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The pagans of Makkah falsely claimed that a non-Arab teaches Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).

verses.translation: We surely know that they say, “It is only a human being who teaches him[1].” But the language they refer to is foreign, whereas this is eloquent Arabic language.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Those who do not believe in the verses of Allah, Allah will not guide them, and for them there will be a painful punishment.

verses.translation: Those who do not believe in the verses of Allah, Allah will not guide them, and for them there will be a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِى ٱلْكَذِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰذِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: No one fabricates lies except those who do not believe in the verses of Allah; it is they who are the liars.

verses.translation: No one fabricates lies except those who do not believe in the verses of Allah; it is they who are the liars.

verses.arabic: مَن كَفَرَ بِٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِيمَٰنِهِۦٓ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُۥ مُطْمَئِنٌّۢ بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَلَٰكِن مَّن شَرَحَ بِٱلْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after having believed – except one who is compelled while his heart is firm in faith [has incurred Allah’s wrath] – but those who embrace disbelief willingly, upon them will be the wrath of Allah, and for them there will be a great punishment.

verses.translation: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after having believed – except one who is compelled while his heart is firm in faith [has incurred Allah’s wrath] – but those who embrace disbelief willingly, upon them will be the wrath of Allah, and for them there will be a great punishment.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: That is because they prefer the life of this world to the Hereafter, and Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.

verses.translation: That is because they prefer the life of this world to the Hereafter, and Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰفِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: These are the ones whose hearts, hearing and sight are sealed up by Allah[1]; it is they who are the heedless.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Because they did not use their faculties of perception to seek guidance.

verses.translation: These are the ones whose hearts, hearing and sight are sealed up by Allah[1]; it is they who are the heedless.

verses.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: No doubt that it is they who will be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: No doubt that it is they who will be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوا۟ ثُمَّ جَٰهَدُوا۟ وَصَبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who emigrated after being persecuted, then strove [for the cause of Allah], and were patient[1] – indeed, your Lord is after that All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Those emigrants who were forced to utter the word of disbelief, to save their lives, but then emigrated to Madinah and fought against the disbelievers while being steadfast in faith.

verses.translation: As for those who emigrated after being persecuted, then strove [for the cause of Allah], and were patient[1] – indeed, your Lord is after that All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَأْتِى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَٰدِلُ عَن نَّفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when each soul will come pleading for itself, and each soul will be paid in full for what it did, and none will be wronged.

verses.translation: On the Day when each soul will come pleading for itself, and each soul will be paid in full for what it did, and none will be wronged.

verses.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ ءَامِنَةً مُّطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَذَٰقَهَا ٱللَّهُ لِبَاسَ ٱلْجُوعِ وَٱلْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah presents an example of a town[1] that was safe and secure, receiving its provision in abundance from all directions. Yet its people showed ingratitude to Allah’s favors, so Allah made them taste overwhelming hunger and fear for what they used to do.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Makkah.

verses.translation: Allah presents an example of a town[1] that was safe and secure, receiving its provision in abundance from all directions. Yet its people showed ingratitude to Allah’s favors, so Allah made them taste overwhelming hunger and fear for what they used to do.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: There came to them a messenger[1] from among themselves, but they rejected him, so the punishment seized them[2] while they were wrongdoers.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ).
 [2] By adversity and fear.

verses.translation: There came to them a messenger[1] from among themselves, but they rejected him, so the punishment seized them[2] while they were wrongdoers.

verses.arabic: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَٰلًا طَيِّبًا وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So eat from the lawful and good things that Allah has provided for you, and be grateful for Allah’s blessings, if it is Him that you worship.

verses.translation: So eat from the lawful and good things that Allah has provided for you, and be grateful for Allah’s blessings, if it is Him that you worship.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةَ وَٱلدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: He has only forbidden to you carrion, blood[1], flesh of swine, and what is slaughtered to other than Allah. But if one is compelled by necessity – neither driven by desire nor exceeding the need – then Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the flowing blood, not what remains in blood vessels after slaughter.

verses.translation: He has only forbidden to you carrion, blood[1], flesh of swine, and what is slaughtered to other than Allah. But if one is compelled by necessity – neither driven by desire nor exceeding the need – then Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ هَٰذَا حَلَٰلٌ وَهَٰذَا حَرَامٌ لِّتَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do not falsely say what your tongues declare, “This is lawful and this is unlawful,” thus fabricating lies against Allah. Those who fabricate lies against Allah will never succeed.

verses.translation: Do not falsely say what your tongues declare, “This is lawful and this is unlawful,” thus fabricating lies against Allah. Those who fabricate lies against Allah will never succeed.

verses.arabic: مَتَٰعٌ قَلِيلٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: It is only a brief enjoyment, then for them there will be a painful punishment.

verses.translation: It is only a brief enjoyment, then for them there will be a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We have already related to you what We prohibited to the Jews[1]. We did not wrong them, but it was they who wronged themselves.

verses.translation: We have already related to you what We prohibited to the Jews[1]. We did not wrong them, but it was they who wronged themselves.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِجَهَٰلَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who commit evil out of ignorance then repent after that and mend their ways, then your Lord is indeed All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.translation: As for those who commit evil out of ignorance then repent after that and mend their ways, then your Lord is indeed All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيفًا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Abraham was a model of excellence[1], devoted to Allah and inclined to true faith, and he was not one of those who associate partners with Allah.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Having all the excellent qualities which make one a role model for others, or he was a ‘nation’ on his own because he was the only believer on earth.

verses.translation: Abraham was a model of excellence[1], devoted to Allah and inclined to true faith, and he was not one of those who associate partners with Allah.

verses.arabic: شَاكِرًا لِّأَنْعُمِهِ ٱجْتَبَىٰهُ وَهَدَىٰهُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: He was grateful for His favors; He chose him and guided him to a straight path.

verses.translation: He was grateful for His favors; He chose him and guided him to a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We gave him good in this world, and in the Hereafter, he will surely be among the righteous[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Sālihīn (righteous) are the prophets and the messengers.

verses.translation: We gave him good in this world, and in the Hereafter, he will surely be among the righteous[1].

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ أَنِ ٱتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We revealed to you [O Prophet] to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining to true faith[1], and he was not one of those who associate partners with Allah.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Islamic Monotheism.

verses.translation: Then We revealed to you [O Prophet] to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining to true faith[1], and he was not one of those who associate partners with Allah.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ ٱلسَّبْتُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: The Sabbath was only ordained for those who differed about it[1]. Your Lord will surely judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To dedicate Sabbath for worshiping Allah away from their daily livelihood, after they deviated from Friday which was enjoined upon them beforehand.

verses.translation: The Sabbath was only ordained for those who differed about it[1]. Your Lord will surely judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

verses.arabic: ٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ وَجَٰدِلْهُم بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Call to the way of your Lord with wisdom[1] and goodly exhortation[2], and reason with them in the best manner[3]. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His way and knows best those who are rightly guided.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Accordingly, taking into account the circumstance of the addressee.
 [2] That endears good to people.
 [3] Being kind, well-spoken, and tolerant to win hearts.

verses.translation: Call to the way of your Lord with wisdom[1] and goodly exhortation[2], and reason with them in the best manner[3]. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His way and knows best those who are rightly guided.

verses.arabic: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُم بِهِۦ وَلَئِن صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِّلصَّٰبِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: If you retaliate, let your retaliation be the like of what you suffered. But if you bear with patience, it is surely best for those who are steadfast.

verses.translation: If you retaliate, let your retaliation be the like of what you suffered. But if you bear with patience, it is surely best for those who are steadfast.

verses.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِى ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And be patient, for your patience comes only from Allah; do not grieve over them[1], nor be distressed by their evil plots.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) was grieved that they would not believe.

verses.translation: And be patient, for your patience comes only from Allah; do not grieve over them[1], nor be distressed by their evil plots.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who do good.

verses.translation: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who do good.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ

english_rwwad.text: Glory be to the One Who took His slave [Muhammad] by night from the Sacred Mosque [in Makkah] to the Aqsā Mosque [in Jerusalem] whose surroundings We have blessed, so that We may show him some of Our signs. Indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

verses.translation: Glory be to the One Who took His slave [Muhammad] by night from the Sacred Mosque [in Makkah] to the Aqsā Mosque [in Jerusalem] whose surroundings We have blessed, so that We may show him some of Our signs. Indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن دُونِى وَكِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guide for the Children of Israel, “Do not take besides Me anyone as a Disposer of Affairs[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., rely upon none except Allah, for He alone is the Disposer of Affairs of the whole universe.

verses.translation: We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guide for the Children of Israel, “Do not take besides Me anyone as a Disposer of Affairs[1].

verses.arabic: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا

english_rwwad.text: O descendants of those whom We carried [on board] with Noah[1]. He was indeed a grateful slave.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Children of Israel are given the reference of Prophet Noah (عليه السلام); to follow him for being dutiful and thankful to Allah.

verses.translation: O descendants of those whom We carried [on board] with Noah[1]. He was indeed a grateful slave.”

verses.arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: We declared to the Children of Israel in the Scripture, “You will surely spread corruption on earth twice, and you will surely become exceedingly arrogant[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah foretold them out of infinite knowledge about future events.

verses.translation: We declared to the Children of Israel in the Scripture, “You will surely spread corruption on earth twice, and you will surely become exceedingly arrogant[1].

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ أُولَىٰهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًا لَّنَآ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ فَجَاسُوا۟ خِلَٰلَ ٱلدِّيَارِ وَكَانَ وَعْدًا مَّفْعُولًا

english_rwwad.text: When the first of the two warnings came to pass, We sent against you some of Our slaves of great might, and they ravaged through the land[1]; this warning was bound to be fulfilled[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] killing them and plundering.
 [2] i.e., the punishment they were promised for their first transgressions.

verses.translation: When the first of the two warnings came to pass, We sent against you some of Our slaves of great might, and they ravaged through the land[1]; this warning was bound to be fulfilled[2].

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَمْدَدْنَٰكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ أَكْثَرَ نَفِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Then We gave you the upper hand over them and strengthened you with wealth and children, and made you greater in number.

verses.translation: Then We gave you the upper hand over them and strengthened you with wealth and children, and made you greater in number.

verses.arabic: إِنْ أَحْسَنتُمْ أَحْسَنتُمْ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ وَإِنْ أَسَأْتُمْ فَلَهَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لِيَسُـۥٓـُٔوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ وَلِيَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَلِيُتَبِّرُوا۟ مَا عَلَوْا۟ تَتْبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: If you do good, it is for your own good, but if you do evil, it is to your own loss. Then when the second warning came to pass, your enemies would disgrace and suppress you[1], and enter the Temple [of Jerusalem][2] as they entered it the first time, and utterly destroy whatever fell into their power[3].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] By killing, taking hostage, submission and humiliation.
 [2] Bayt al-Maqdis.
 [3] It would be a total wreckage.

verses.translation: If you do good, it is for your own good, but if you do evil, it is to your own loss. Then when the second warning came to pass, your enemies would disgrace and suppress you[1], and enter the Temple [of Jerusalem][2] as they entered it the first time, and utterly destroy whatever fell into their power[3].

verses.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord may bestow mercy upon you, but if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment][1]. And We have made Hell a prison for the disbelievers.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] After this great affliction, Allah would give them back their lost sovereignty, but if they revert back to their old rebellious ways then the way of Allah is never changing.

verses.translation: Your Lord may bestow mercy upon you, but if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment][1]. And We have made Hell a prison for the disbelievers.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَهْدِى لِلَّتِى هِىَ أَقْوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, this Qur’an guides to what is most upright and gives glad tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward.

verses.translation: Indeed, this Qur’an guides to what is most upright and gives glad tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have prepared for them a painful punishment.

verses.translation: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have prepared for them a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: وَيَدْعُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلْخَيْرِ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَجُولًا

english_rwwad.text: Man prays for evil as he prays for good, for man is ever hasty[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., becomes impatient and acts without forethought.

verses.translation: Man prays for evil as he prays for good, for man is ever hasty[1].

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيْنِ فَمَحَوْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةً لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُوا۟ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلْحِسَابَ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَصَّلْنَٰهُ تَفْصِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: We have made the day and night as two signs. We darkened the night and made the day bright, so that you may seek your Lord’s bounty and know the number of years and calculation [of time]. And We have expounded everything in detail.

verses.translation: We have made the day and night as two signs. We darkened the night and made the day bright, so that you may seek your Lord’s bounty and know the number of years and calculation [of time]. And We have expounded everything in detail.

verses.arabic: وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلْزَمْنَٰهُ طَٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِى عُنُقِهِۦ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبًا يَلْقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا

english_rwwad.text: We have bound every man’s deeds to his neck[1]. On the Day of Resurrection, We will bring forth for him a record which he will find spread open.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., after showing guidance for him, he is responsible for his own destiny.

verses.translation: We have bound every man’s deeds to his neck[1]. On the Day of Resurrection, We will bring forth for him a record which he will find spread open.

verses.arabic: ٱقْرَأْ كِتَٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًا

english_rwwad.text: [It will be said,] “Read your record; this Day you are sufficient to take account of yourself[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Everyone will be dealt with justly.

verses.translation: [It will be said,] “Read your record; this Day you are sufficient to take account of yourself[1].”

verses.arabic: مَّنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًا

english_rwwad.text: Whoever accepts guidance, it is only for his own good; and whoever goes astray, it is only for his own loss. No bearer of burden will bear the burden of another, nor do We punish until We have sent a messenger[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The disbelievers will have no excuse whatsoever.

verses.translation: Whoever accepts guidance, it is only for his own good; and whoever goes astray, it is only for his own loss. No bearer of burden will bear the burden of another, nor do We punish until We have sent a messenger[1].

verses.arabic: وَإِذَآ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُوا۟ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَٰهَا تَدْمِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Whenever We decide to destroy a town, We command its affluent ones [to obey Allah] but they defiantly disobey, so the punishment becomes inevitable, and We destroy it completely.

verses.translation: Whenever We decide to destroy a town, We command its affluent ones [to obey Allah] but they defiantly disobey, so the punishment becomes inevitable, and We destroy it completely.

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ نُوحٍ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: How many generations We have destroyed since the time of Noah[1]! Your Lord is sufficient as All-Aware and All-Seeing of the sins of His slaves[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Warning them of the consequences of the previously destroyed nations.
 [2] The address here shifts to Muhammad (ﷺ) to assure him that Allah will bring them to account.

verses.translation: How many generations We have destroyed since the time of Noah[1]! Your Lord is sufficient as All-Aware and All-Seeing of the sins of His slaves[2].

verses.arabic: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُۥ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَىٰهَا مَذْمُومًا مَّدْحُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Whoever desires this fleeting life[1], We hasten therein whatever We will to whoever We please. Then We prepare for him Hell, which he will enter, despised and rejected.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., worldly pleasures.

verses.translation: Whoever desires this fleeting life[1], We hasten therein whatever We will to whoever We please. Then We prepare for him Hell, which he will enter, despised and rejected.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَرَادَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًا

english_rwwad.text: But whoever desires the Hereafter and strives for it as he should, being a believer – it is those whose efforts will be appreciated[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah will accept their good deeds, multiply their reward, and overlook their sins.

verses.translation: But whoever desires the Hereafter and strives for it as he should, being a believer – it is those whose efforts will be appreciated[1].

verses.arabic: كُلًّا نُّمِدُّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مِنْ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحْظُورًا

english_rwwad.text: We give both – the latter and the former – from the bounty of your Lord, and Your Lord’s bounty is not restricted[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah gives provision for all in the life of this world without exception.

verses.translation: We give both – the latter and the former – from the bounty of your Lord, and Your Lord’s bounty is not restricted[1].

verses.arabic: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ دَرَجَٰتٍ وَأَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: See how We have favored some over others [in this world], but the Hereafter has higher ranks and greater degrees of excellence for some over others[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In beauty, wealth, power, knowledge, etc; as a test for them, to see how they react.

verses.translation: See how We have favored some over others [in this world], but the Hereafter has higher ranks and greater degrees of excellence for some over others[1].

verses.arabic: لَّا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًا مَّخْذُولًا

english_rwwad.text: Do not set up with Allah any other god, or else you will be despised and forsaken[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Having none to thank them for it, nor support them in the least.

verses.translation: Do not set up with Allah any other god, or else you will be despised and forsaken[1].

verses.arabic: وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord has ordained that you worship none but Him, and show kindness to parents. If one or both of them reach old age in your care, do not say to them a word of annoyance[1] nor scold them, rather speak to them noble words,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] ’uff: an expression of irritation and disapproval.

verses.translation: Your Lord has ordained that you worship none but Him, and show kindness to parents. If one or both of them reach old age in your care, do not say to them a word of annoyance[1] nor scold them, rather speak to them noble words,

verses.arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: and lower to them the wing of humility[1] out of mercy, and say, “My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small[2].”
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] It is a metaphor; i.e., shows the parents the utmost humbleness like a bird lowering its wing as it hugs its young or so.
 [2] For they are at their weakest phase of life, similar to what he was in his early childhood.

verses.translation: and lower to them the wing of humility[1] out of mercy, and say, “My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small[2].”

verses.arabic: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِى نُفُوسِكُمْ إِن تَكُونُوا۟ صَٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord knows best what is in your hearts. If you are righteous, He is All-Forgiving to those who constantly turn to Him.

verses.translation: Your Lord knows best what is in your hearts. If you are righteous, He is All-Forgiving to those who constantly turn to Him.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Give relatives their due, and the needy and the stranded travelers, and do not spend wastefully.

verses.translation: Give relatives their due, and the needy and the stranded travelers, and do not spend wastefully.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓا۟ إِخْوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the wasteful are Satans’ brothers[1], and Satan is ever ungrateful to his Lord[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Islam is a religion of moderation and good consideration; neither wastefully nor stingily, but moderate.
 [2] Disbelievers are the most ungrateful ones as they rebel against Allah's commands instead of showing obedience to Him, for they follow the way of the devil towards Allah.

verses.translation: Indeed, the wasteful are Satans’ brothers[1], and Satan is ever ungrateful to his Lord[2].

verses.arabic: وَإِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ رَحْمَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّيْسُورًا

english_rwwad.text: But if you must turn away from [those in need] while hoping to receive bounty from your Lord[1], then say to them words of comfort.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., if you have nothing to give them now.

verses.translation: But if you must turn away from [those in need] while hoping to receive bounty from your Lord[1], then say to them words of comfort.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ ٱلْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًا مَّحْسُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Do not be too tight-fisted[1], nor too open-handed[2], for you will end up blameworthy and destitute.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., stingy.
 [2] i.e., extravagant.

verses.translation: Do not be too tight-fisted[1], nor too open-handed[2], for you will end up blameworthy and destitute.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord extends provision to whom He wills or restricts it[1]. He is All-Aware and All-Seeing of His slaves.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He gives or withholds wealth according to what is best for the person concerned and what they would do with it if he is provided with it.

verses.translation: Your Lord extends provision to whom He wills or restricts it[1]. He is All-Aware and All-Seeing of His slaves.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلَٰقٍ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْـًٔا كَبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Do not kill your children for fear of poverty[1], for We provide for them and for you. Indeed, killing them is a great sin.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Abdullāh ibn Mas‘ūd (رضي الله عنه) reported: “I said: “O Messenger of Allah, what is the greatest sin?” He said: “That you set up rivals with Allah, when He is the One Who created you!” Then I said: “What is next?” He said: “That you kill your child because he eats with you!” [Al-Bukhāri: 6811].

verses.translation: Do not kill your children for fear of poverty[1], for We provide for them and for you. Indeed, killing them is a great sin.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَٰحِشَةً وَسَآءَ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Do not go near adultery[1], for it is indeed a shameful act and an evil way.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., avoid all things that might lead to it.

verses.translation: Do not go near adultery[1], for it is indeed a shameful act and an evil way.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًا فَلَا يُسْرِف فِّى ٱلْقَتْلِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مَنصُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Do not kill any soul that Allah has forbidden, except in the course of justice. If anyone is killed wrongfully, We have given his heir authority [of compensation], but he should not exceed the bounds in killing, for he is already supported [by law].

verses.translation: Do not kill any soul that Allah has forbidden, except in the course of justice. If anyone is killed wrongfully, We have given his heir authority [of compensation], but he should not exceed the bounds in killing, for he is already supported [by law].

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعَهْدِ إِنَّ ٱلْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْـُٔولًا

english_rwwad.text: Do not approach the property of an orphan except with good [intent][1], until he reaches maturity; and fulfill the covenant, for you will certainly be questioned about the covenant.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., to improve, increase, or preserve it.

verses.translation: Do not approach the property of an orphan except with good [intent][1], until he reaches maturity; and fulfill the covenant, for you will certainly be questioned about the covenant.
