verses.arabic: وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ إِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Give full measure when you measure, and weigh with accurate scales; that is fair and best in the end[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Fair dealing is best, for it brings blessing, psychological calm, and reward in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: Give full measure when you measure, and weigh with accurate scales; that is fair and best in the end[1].

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًا

english_rwwad.text: Do not follow[1] that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight, and the heart, all of them will be called to account.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., do not say or assume.

verses.translation: Do not follow[1] that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight, and the heart, all of them will be called to account.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا إِنَّكَ لَن تَخْرِقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَن تَبْلُغَ ٱلْجِبَالَ طُولًا

english_rwwad.text: Do not walk on the earth arrogantly; you cannot cleave the earth, nor can you reach the mountains in height[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Man is indeed a weak and small creature, then why arrogance?!

verses.translation: Do not walk on the earth arrogantly; you cannot cleave the earth, nor can you reach the mountains in height[1].

verses.arabic: كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوهًا

english_rwwad.text: The evil of all these actions is hateful to your Lord.

verses.translation: The evil of all these actions is hateful to your Lord.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّآ أَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتُلْقَىٰ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومًا مَّدْحُورًا

english_rwwad.text: This is part of the wisdom that your Lord has revealed to you [O Prophet]. Do not set up any other god with Allah, or you will be thrown into Hell, blameworthy and rejected[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., self-reproached and blamed by others for this miserable end, as well as shut away from all good.

verses.translation: This is part of the wisdom that your Lord has revealed to you [O Prophet]. Do not set up any other god with Allah, or you will be thrown into Hell, blameworthy and rejected[1].

verses.arabic: أَفَأَصْفَىٰكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱتَّخَذَ مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنَٰثًا إِنَّكُمْ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوْلًا عَظِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: Has your Lord favored you with sons and has taken for Himself angels as daughters[1]? You are indeed making a monstrous claim.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Their feeble argument is debunked and refuted concerning the issue of purity of Faith and Monotheism. Although preferring male over female is a heathen way; yet, how would Allah, the Omnipotent Creator, accept for Himself what they do not accept for themselves? (cf. 37:149-155). They worshiped the angels based on the claim that they were Allah’s daughters. (cf. 43:19-20).

verses.translation: Has your Lord favored you with sons and has taken for Himself angels as daughters[1]? You are indeed making a monstrous claim.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ وَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: We have explained things in various ways in this Qur’an, so that they may take heed, but it only increases them in aversion[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] “We send down the Qur’an as a healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.” See below 17:82.

verses.translation: We have explained things in various ways in this Qur’an, so that they may take heed, but it only increases them in aversion[1].

verses.arabic: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَهُۥٓ ءَالِهَةٌ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذًا لَّٱبْتَغَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “If there were other gods besides Him – as they claim – they would have surely sought a way to the Lord of the Throne[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To please Him or take over His Throne.

verses.translation: Say, “If there were other gods besides Him – as they claim – they would have surely sought a way to the Lord of the Throne[1].”

verses.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Glorified and Highly Exalted is He far above what they claim!

verses.translation: Glorified and Highly Exalted is He far above what they claim!

verses.arabic: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبْعُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: The seven heavens and the earth, and all those in them glorify Him. There is not a single thing that does not glorify Him with His praise, but you do not understand their glorification. Indeed, He is Most Forbearing, All-Forgiving.

verses.translation: The seven heavens and the earth, and all those in them glorify Him. There is not a single thing that does not glorify Him with His praise, but you do not understand their glorification. Indeed, He is Most Forbearing, All-Forgiving.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حِجَابًا مَّسْتُورًا

english_rwwad.text: When you recite the Qur’an, We place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter an invisible barrier[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Preventing guidance from them, for their aversion.

verses.translation: When you recite the Qur’an, We place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter an invisible barrier[1].

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا وَإِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَلَّوْا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَٰرِهِمْ نُفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: We have placed covers on their hearts so that they do not understand it, and deafness in their ears[1]. When you mention your Lord alone in the Qur’an, they turn their backs in aversion.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This is in return for their hatred toward the truth and the ingrained disease of doubt in their hearts.

verses.translation: We have placed covers on their hearts so that they do not understand it, and deafness in their ears[1]. When you mention your Lord alone in the Qur’an, they turn their backs in aversion.

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰٓ إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا

english_rwwad.text: We are well aware of what they wish to hear when they listen to you, and what they say when they converse in private, when the wrongdoers say, “You are not following but a bewitched man.”

verses.translation: We are well aware of what they wish to hear when they listen to you, and what they say when they converse in private, when the wrongdoers say, “You are not following but a bewitched man.”

verses.arabic: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: See how they call you names[1]! Thus they have gone astray and cannot find a way.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a poet, a madman, bewitched, etc.

verses.translation: See how they call you names[1]! Thus they have gone astray and cannot find a way.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا

english_rwwad.text: They say, “What! When we are turned into bones and dust, will we really be resurrected as a new creation?”

verses.translation: They say, “What! When we are turned into bones and dust, will we really be resurrected as a new creation?”

verses.arabic: قُلْ كُونُوا۟ حِجَارَةً أَوْ حَدِيدًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Be you stones or iron[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., even if you could be stones or iron in hardness or in power.

verses.translation: Say, “Be you stones or iron[1],

verses.arabic: أَوْ خَلْقًا مِّمَّا يَكْبُرُ فِى صُدُورِكُمْ فَسَيَقُولُونَ مَن يُعِيدُنَا قُلِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ إِلَيْكَ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هُوَ قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَرِيبًا

english_rwwad.text: or any other substance you think is harder[1] to bring back to life.” They will then say, “Who will bring us back [to life]?” Say, “The One Who created you the first time.” They will shake their heads[2] at you and say, “When will that be?” Say, “Perhaps it is soon.”
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Such as the heavens and the earth.
 [2] In ridicule and disbelief.

verses.translation: or any other substance you think is harder[1] to bring back to life.” They will then say, “Who will bring us back [to life]?” Say, “The One Who created you the first time.” They will shake their heads[2] at you and say, “When will that be?” Say, “Perhaps it is soon.”

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when He calls you, you will respond by praising Him, thinking that you had not stayed [on earth] except for a little while.

verses.translation: On the Day when He calls you, you will respond by praising Him, thinking that you had not stayed [on earth] except for a little while.

verses.arabic: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا

english_rwwad.text: Tell My slaves that they should say what is best[1], for Satan sows discord among them. Indeed, Satan is a sworn enemy to mankind.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., they should be considerate and kind, well-spoken, and tolerant to win hearts.

verses.translation: Tell My slaves that they should say what is best[1], for Satan sows discord among them. Indeed, Satan is a sworn enemy to mankind.

verses.arabic: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِن يَشَأْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَوْ إِن يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord knows you best: if He wills, He will have mercy on you; or if He wills, He will punish you. We have not sent you [O Prophet] to be in charge of them[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The mission of the Prophet (ﷺ) was only delivering the Message; their guidance and holding to account is up to Allah Almighty.

verses.translation: Your Lord knows you best: if He wills, He will have mercy on you; or if He wills, He will punish you. We have not sent you [O Prophet] to be in charge of them[1].

verses.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَقَدْ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord knows best all those in the heavens and on earth[1]. We have surely favored some prophets over others, and We gave David the Psalms[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Allah knows all and what they deserve.
 [2] Al-Zabūr is revealed to Prophet David (عليه السلام); al-zabūr (pl. zubūr) originally is every book that contains wisdom. See 3:184.

verses.translation: Your Lord knows best all those in the heavens and on earth[1]. We have surely favored some prophets over others, and We gave David the Psalms[2].

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ ٱلضُّرِّ عَنكُمْ وَلَا تَحْوِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Call upon those whom you claimed [to be gods] besides Him; they have no power to remove harm or avert it from you.”

verses.translation: Say, “Call upon those whom you claimed [to be gods] besides Him; they have no power to remove harm or avert it from you.”

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُۥ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُۥٓ إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحْذُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Those whom they call upon seek means of nearness to their Lord, each trying to become closer, hoping for His Mercy and fearing His punishment[1]. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is fearsome.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Such as angels, prophets, righteous believers, etc.

verses.translation: Those whom they call upon seek means of nearness to their Lord, each trying to become closer, hoping for His Mercy and fearing His punishment[1]. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is fearsome.

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَسْطُورًا

english_rwwad.text: There is no [disbelieving] town except that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it severely[1]. This is written in the Record[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Due to the disbelief and sins of its inhabitants.
 [2] i.e., the Preserved Tablet.

verses.translation: There is no [disbelieving] town except that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it severely[1]. This is written in the Record[2].

verses.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَنَآ أَن نُّرْسِلَ بِٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ إِلَّآ أَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ وَءَاتَيْنَا ثَمُودَ ٱلنَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةً فَظَلَمُوا۟ بِهَا وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ إِلَّا تَخْوِيفًا

english_rwwad.text: Nothing prevents Us from sending signs except that the earlier people denied them[1]. We gave Thamūd the she-camel as a clear sign, but they wrongfully rejected her[2]. We do not send signs except as a warning.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] So that the pagans of Makkah do do not face the consequences of the earlier nations.
 [2] i.e., they committed an injustice by hamstringing the she-camel.

verses.translation: Nothing prevents Us from sending signs except that the earlier people denied them[1]. We gave Thamūd the she-camel as a clear sign, but they wrongfully rejected her[2]. We do not send signs except as a warning.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلرُّءْيَا ٱلَّتِىٓ أَرَيْنَٰكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَٰنًا كَبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: And [remember, O Prophet] when We told you, “Your Lord encompasses all people [with His knowledge and might][1].” We did not make the sight which We showed you[2] except as a test for people, as well as the cursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur’an. We keep threatening them, yet it only increases them to greater transgression.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Allah will protect you (ﷺ) from their harm.
 [2] During the journey of mi‘rāj (ascension) to the heavens.

verses.translation: And [remember, O Prophet] when We told you, “Your Lord encompasses all people [with His knowledge and might][1].” We did not make the sight which We showed you[2] except as a test for people, as well as the cursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur’an. We keep threatening them, yet it only increases them to greater transgression.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ قَالَ ءَأَسْجُدُ لِمَنْ خَلَقْتَ طِينًا

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when We said to the angels, “Prostrate to Adam;” they all prostrated except Iblīs, who said, “Should I prostrate to whom You created from clay?”

verses.translation: And [remember] when We said to the angels, “Prostrate to Adam;” they all prostrated except Iblīs, who said, “Should I prostrate to whom You created from clay?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: He added, “Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If you give me respite until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely overpower his offspring, except for a few[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., tempt and lead them astray.

verses.translation: He added, “Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If you give me respite until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely overpower his offspring, except for a few[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱذْهَبْ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمْ جَزَآءً مَّوْفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Allah said, “Be gone[1]! Whoever among them follows you, Hell will be an ample recompense for you all.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This and the next commands were actually a threat.

verses.translation: Allah said, “Be gone[1]! Whoever among them follows you, Hell will be an ample recompense for you all.

verses.arabic: وَٱسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُم بِصَوْتِكَ وَأَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِم بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ وَعِدْهُمْ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Entice with your voice whoever of them you can; mobilize against them your cavalry and infantry; manipulate them in their wealth[1] and children[2], and make promises to them.” But Satan does not promise them except delusion[3].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., earning and spending them sinfully.
 [2] i.e., having them through fornication, raising them in disbelief, and giving them names implying servitude to other than Allah.
 [3] i.e., deception and fraudulence.

verses.translation: Entice with your voice whoever of them you can; mobilize against them your cavalry and infantry; manipulate them in their wealth[1] and children[2], and make promises to them.” But Satan does not promise them except delusion[3].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: “You will have no authority over My slaves.” And sufficient is your Lord as a Guardian.

verses.translation: “You will have no authority over My slaves.” And sufficient is your Lord as a Guardian.

verses.arabic: رَّبُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُزْجِى لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: It is your Lord Who makes the ships sail for you through the sea, so that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever Merciful to you.

verses.translation: It is your Lord Who makes the ships sail for you through the sea, so that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever Merciful to you.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَن تَدْعُونَ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ أَعْرَضْتُمْ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ كَفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: When hardship strikes you at sea, you forget all those whom you invoke besides Him[1]. Then when He brings you safe to the land, you turn away. Mankind is ever ungrateful.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Upon the conquest of Makkah, ‘Ikrimah ibn Abī Jahl along with his companions fled to the sea. He pledged in the sea that if he was saved from the storm that hit their boat, he would embrace Islam, so he fulfilled his pledge and announced his Islam.

verses.translation: When hardship strikes you at sea, you forget all those whom you invoke besides Him[1]. Then when He brings you safe to the land, you turn away. Mankind is ever ungrateful.

verses.arabic: أَفَأَمِنتُمْ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلْبَرِّ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَكِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Do you feel secure that He will not make some part of the land swallow you up, or send against you a storm of stones? Thereupon you will find none to protect you.

verses.translation: Do you feel secure that He will not make some part of the land swallow you up, or send against you a storm of stones? Thereupon you will find none to protect you.

verses.arabic: أَمْ أَمِنتُمْ أَن يُعِيدَكُمْ فِيهِ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ فَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ قَاصِفًا مِّنَ ٱلرِّيحِ فَيُغْرِقَكُم بِمَا كَفَرْتُمْ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِهِۦ تَبِيعًا

english_rwwad.text: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back [to sea] once again, and send upon you a violent storm to drown you on account of your disbelief? Thereupon you will find none to help you against Us[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To demand restitution.

verses.translation: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back [to sea] once again, and send upon you a violent storm to drown you on account of your disbelief? Thereupon you will find none to help you against Us[1].

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: We have honored the children of Adam, carried them on land and sea, provided for them good things[1] and favored them above many of those whom We have created.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By bestowing them with intellectual abilities and making angels prostrate to their father, Adam. Furthermore, Allah subjected other creatures to them, as they mount with dignity their means of transportation both on land and in the sea. Allah also provided them with good food, drinks, and spouses, etc.

verses.translation: We have honored the children of Adam, carried them on land and sea, provided for them good things[1] and favored them above many of those whom We have created.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَدْعُوا۟ كُلَّ أُنَاسٍۭ بِإِمَٰمِهِمْ فَمَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَقْرَءُونَ كِتَٰبَهُمْ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when We will summon every community with its leader[1]. Those who are given their record in their right hand will read their record [happily]; they will not be wronged even as much as the thread of a date stone.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or what they followed in their worldly life.

verses.translation: On the Day when We will summon every community with its leader[1]. Those who are given their record in their right hand will read their record [happily]; they will not be wronged even as much as the thread of a date stone.

verses.arabic: وَمَن كَانَ فِى هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَعْمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَعْمَىٰ وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: But whoever was blind [from the truth][1] in this life will be even blinder in the Hereafter and further astray from the right way.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., refused to see the truth.

verses.translation: But whoever was blind [from the truth][1] in this life will be even blinder in the Hereafter and further astray from the right way.

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَادُوا۟ لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ لِتَفْتَرِىَ عَلَيْنَا غَيْرَهُۥ وَإِذًا لَّٱتَّخَذُوكَ خَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: They were about to tempt you away from what We have revealed to you [O Prophet] so that you would fabricate something else and attribute it to Us; then they would have surely taken you as a close friend.

verses.translation: They were about to tempt you away from what We have revealed to you [O Prophet] so that you would fabricate something else and attribute it to Us; then they would have surely taken you as a close friend.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَآ أَن ثَبَّتْنَٰكَ لَقَدْ كِدتَّ تَرْكَنُ إِلَيْهِمْ شَيْـًٔا قَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Had We not made you stand firm, you would nearly have inclined to them a little.

verses.translation: Had We not made you stand firm, you would nearly have inclined to them a little.

verses.arabic: إِذًا لَّأَذَقْنَٰكَ ضِعْفَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ وَضِعْفَ ٱلْمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيْنَا نَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: In that case, We would have made you taste double punishment, both in this life and after death. Thereupon you would have found no helper against Us.

verses.translation: In that case, We would have made you taste double punishment, both in this life and after death. Thereupon you would have found no helper against Us.

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَادُوا۟ لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوكَ مِنْهَا وَإِذًا لَّا يَلْبَثُونَ خِلَٰفَكَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: They were about to provoke you so as to drive you out of the land [of Makkah], but then they would not have remained after you, except for a little while[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Makkah was completely cleared of the Prophet's enemies only ten years after his emigration.

verses.translation: They were about to provoke you so as to drive you out of the land [of Makkah], but then they would not have remained after you, except for a little while[1].

verses.arabic: سُنَّةَ مَن قَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Such was Our way with the messengers We sent before you, and you will find no change in Our way.

verses.translation: Such was Our way with the messengers We sent before you, and you will find no change in Our way.

verses.arabic: أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمْسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَقُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ إِنَّ قُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا

english_rwwad.text: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night, and the recitation of dawn [prayer][1], for the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed [by the angels][2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the zuhr, asr, maghrib, and ‘ishā’ prayers.
 [2] i.e., the fajr prayer, in which the recitation of the Qur’an is prolonged, for it is witnessed by angels. This verse alluded to all five obligatory daily prayers.

verses.translation: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night, and the recitation of dawn [prayer][1], for the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed [by the angels][2].

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا

english_rwwad.text: And wake up during the night and pray, as an additional prayer for you [O Prophet], so your Lord may raise you to a praised status[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Al-Maqām al-Mahmūd (the position of the Grand Intercession) is granted to the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).

verses.translation: And wake up during the night and pray, as an additional prayer for you [O Prophet], so your Lord may raise you to a praised status[1].

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَٰنًا نَّصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: And say, “My Lord, make me enter an honorable entrance[1] and make me exit an honorable exit[2], and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.”
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Into Madinah while emigration, all entrances, or into the grave.
 [2] From Makkah, all exits, or at the resurrection.

verses.translation: And say, “My Lord, make me enter an honorable entrance[1] and make me exit an honorable exit[2], and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.”

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ إِنَّ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا

english_rwwad.text: And say, “The truth has come and falsehood has perished. Indeed, falsehood is bound to perish[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Abdullāh Ibn Mas‘ūd (رضي الله عنه) narrated that: “The Prophet (ﷺ) entered Makkah on the day of its conquest, and there were around 360 idols around the Ka‘bah. He went on thrusting them with a stick in his hand making them tumble down and saying: “The Truth has come and falsehood has perished...” [al-Bukhārī: 87; Muslim: 1781]

verses.translation: And say, “The truth has come and falsehood has perished. Indeed, falsehood is bound to perish[1].”

verses.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا

english_rwwad.text: We send down the Qur’an as a healing and mercy[1] for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī (رضي الله عنه) reported that: “Some of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set out on a journey and they passed by an Arabian tribe. The chief of that tribe was bitten by a snake. They went to them and sought their help. A person amongst us said: “I shall treat him with ruqyah (incantation). But I shall not treat him unless you reward us. We asked you for your hospitality and you refused!” They agreed to give us a herd of goats. So he went to him and recited Surat al-Fātihah and blew over him. The chief was invigorated and went on walking with no sign of ailment. They gave them the agreed reward. Some of the Companions said: “Let us divide it!” Others said: “Do not, until you reach the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), tell him what has happened and see what he bids us do”. They went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and told him. He said: “How did you come to know that it can be used as ruqyah? You have done the right thing. Divide it and allocate a share for me” [al-Bukhārī: 5749; Muslim: 2201]. ‘Ā’ishah (رضي الله عنه) narrated that: “When ill, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite al-Mu‘awwidhāt (the Sheltering surahs, al-Falaq and al-Nās) and blow. When his sickness got worse, I used to recite them over him and rub his body with his own hand seeking its blessing” [Al-Bukhārī: 5016; Muslim: 2192].

verses.translation: We send down the Qur’an as a healing and mercy[1] for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوسًا

english_rwwad.text: When We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself, but when evil befalls him, he is in utter despair.

verses.translation: When We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself, but when evil befalls him, he is in utter despair.

verses.arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِۦ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Everyone acts in his own way[1], but your Lord knows best whose way is best guided.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Say to them O Prophet, continue in your way of disbelief, with which you are satisfied; I will continue with my path of guidance.

verses.translation: Say, “Everyone acts in his own way[1], but your Lord knows best whose way is best guided.”

verses.arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: They ask you [O Prophet] about the spirit[1]. Say, “The spirit is of the affair of my Lord, and you have not been given knowledge except a little.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the spirit that sustains life in the body, according to most exegetes; it is also said to be the Archangel Gabriel.

verses.translation: They ask you [O Prophet] about the spirit[1]. Say, “The spirit is of the affair of my Lord, and you have not been given knowledge except a little.”

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِۦ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: If We willed, We could surely take away what We have revealed to you, then you would find no guardian to plead its return from Us;

verses.translation: If We willed, We could surely take away what We have revealed to you, then you would find no guardian to plead its return from Us;

verses.arabic: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُۥ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: nevertheless it is a mercy from your Lord[1], for His favor to you is truly great.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah would not take away the Qur’an, out of mercy to His Prophet and to His servants.

verses.translation: nevertheless it is a mercy from your Lord[1], for His favor to you is truly great.

verses.arabic: قُل لَّئِنِ ٱجْتَمَعَتِ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “If all humans and jinn were to come together to produce something similar to this Qur’an, they would not be able to produce the like of it, even if they collaborated with one another[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The miraculousness of the Qur’an and its inimitability lie in both its word and meaning.

verses.translation: Say, “If all humans and jinn were to come together to produce something similar to this Qur’an, they would not be able to produce the like of it, even if they collaborated with one another[1].”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: We have explained every kind of example[1] for mankind in this Qur’an, yet most people persist in disbelief.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., proofs, admonitions, similitudes, and stories, so that people of sound reason may take heed.

verses.translation: We have explained every kind of example[1] for mankind in this Qur’an, yet most people persist in disbelief.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ يَنۢبُوعًا

english_rwwad.text: They say, “We will never believe in you until you cause a spring to gush forth for us from the earth[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Showing miracles are of no use, even if it is catastrophic to them.

verses.translation: They say, “We will never believe in you until you cause a spring to gush forth for us from the earth[1],

verses.arabic: أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ خِلَٰلَهَا تَفْجِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: or until you have a garden of date palms and grapevines, and you cause rivers to flow abundantly in their midst,

verses.translation: or until you have a garden of date palms and grapevines, and you cause rivers to flow abundantly in their midst,

verses.arabic: أَوْ تُسْقِطَ ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِىَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ قَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: or you make the sky to fall upon us in pieces – as you claim – or bring Allah and the angels before us face to face,

verses.translation: or you make the sky to fall upon us in pieces – as you claim – or bring Allah and the angels before us face to face,

verses.arabic: أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَٰبًا نَّقْرَؤُهُۥ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّى هَلْ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا

english_rwwad.text: or until you have a house of gold, or you ascend to heaven, and even then we will never believe in your ascension unless you bring down to us a book which we can read.” Say, “Glory be to my Lord! Am I anything but a human, sent as a messenger?”

verses.translation: or until you have a house of gold, or you ascend to heaven, and even then we will never believe in your ascension unless you bring down to us a book which we can read.” Say, “Glory be to my Lord! Am I anything but a human, sent as a messenger?”

verses.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا

english_rwwad.text: Nothing prevented people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, “Has Allah sent a human as a messenger?”

verses.translation: Nothing prevented people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, “Has Allah sent a human as a messenger?”

verses.arabic: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَلَكًا رَّسُولًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “If there had been angels walking on earth peacefully, We would have certainly sent down to them from the heaven an angel as a messenger.”

verses.translation: Say, “If there had been angels walking on earth peacefully, We would have certainly sent down to them from the heaven an angel as a messenger.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Allah is Sufficient as a witness between me and you. He is indeed All-Aware, All-Seeing of His slaves.”

verses.translation: Say, “Allah is Sufficient as a witness between me and you. He is indeed All-Aware, All-Seeing of His slaves.”

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِهِۦ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَبُكْمًا وَصُمًّا مَّأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَٰهُمْ سَعِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Whoever Allah guides is truly guided; and whoever He causes to stray, you will find none to protect them besides Him. On the Day of Resurrection, We will gather [and drag] them on their faces – deaf, dumb and blind. Their abode will be Hell; every time it subsides, We will flare it up for them[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As a consequence of his own preference.

verses.translation: Whoever Allah guides is truly guided; and whoever He causes to stray, you will find none to protect them besides Him. On the Day of Resurrection, We will gather [and drag] them on their faces – deaf, dumb and blind. Their abode will be Hell; every time it subsides, We will flare it up for them[1].

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا

english_rwwad.text: That will be their recompense because they rejected Our verses and said, “What! When we are turned into bones and crumbled particles, will we really be raised as a new creation?”

verses.translation: That will be their recompense because they rejected Our verses and said, “What! When we are turned into bones and crumbled particles, will we really be raised as a new creation?”

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَأَبَى ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Do they not see that Allah, Who created the heavens and earth, is able to create the like of them? He has decreed for them an appointed time, about which there is no doubt, yet the wrongdoers persist in denial.

verses.translation: Do they not see that Allah, Who created the heavens and earth, is able to create the like of them? He has decreed for them an appointed time, about which there is no doubt, yet the wrongdoers persist in denial.

verses.arabic: قُل لَّوْ أَنتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَآئِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّىٓ إِذًا لَّأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ ٱلْإِنفَاقِ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ قَتُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “If you were to own the treasuries of my Lord’s mercy, you would surely hold them back for fear of spending, for man is ever miserly.”

verses.translation: Say, “If you were to own the treasuries of my Lord’s mercy, you would surely hold them back for fear of spending, for man is ever miserly.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًا

english_rwwad.text: We gave Moses nine clear signs. Ask the Children of Israel when he came to them, Pharaoh said to him, “O Moses, I certainly think that you are bewitched[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Makkans are warned by his example not to hasten their punishment by asking for miracles that they would not believe.

verses.translation: We gave Moses nine clear signs. Ask the Children of Israel when he came to them, Pharaoh said to him, “O Moses, I certainly think that you are bewitched[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَآ أَنزَلَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ بَصَآئِرَ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Moses said, “You already know that none sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and earth as clear proofs, and I certainly think that you, O Pharaoh, are doomed!”

verses.translation: Moses said, “You already know that none sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and earth as clear proofs, and I certainly think that you, O Pharaoh, are doomed!”

verses.arabic: فَأَرَادَ أَن يَسْتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ جَمِيعًا

english_rwwad.text: So he decided to exile them out of the land, but We drowned him and all those who were with him.

verses.translation: So he decided to exile them out of the land, but We drowned him and all those who were with him.

verses.arabic: وَقُلْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ لِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا

english_rwwad.text: Thereafter[1] We said to the Children of Israel, “Dwell in the land, but when the promise of the Hereafter comes, We will bring you all together.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] After the drowning of Pharaoh and his people.

verses.translation: Thereafter[1] We said to the Children of Israel, “Dwell in the land, but when the promise of the Hereafter comes, We will bring you all together.”

verses.arabic: وَبِٱلْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ وَبِٱلْحَقِّ نَزَلَ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: With the truth We have sent down this [Qur’an] and with the truth it has descended[1], and We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It is repeated twice in the face of the ardent denial of the pagans of Makkah and their demand to provide them with miracles, asserting here that the Qur’an is a revelation from Allah: it contains truthful news and just rulings, as it is sent down by Gabriel (عليه السلام), the strong and trustworthy, to Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ), safeguarded against the devils, free from alteration, additions or omission, throughout all times.

verses.translation: With the truth We have sent down this [Qur’an] and with the truth it has descended[1], and We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.

verses.arabic: وَقُرْءَانًا فَرَقْنَٰهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَٰهُ تَنزِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: This is a Qur’an that We have revealed over stages so that you may recite it to people at a slower pace, and We have sent it down in a successive manner[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In separate segments, one coming after another over the duration of 23 years of his mission.

verses.translation: This is a Qur’an that We have revealed over stages so that you may recite it to people at a slower pace, and We have sent it down in a successive manner[1].

verses.arabic: قُلْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦٓ إِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Believe in it, or do not believe. Those who were given knowledge before it[1], when it is recited to them, they fall on their faces in prostration,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of the People of the Book who recognize the truth.

verses.translation: Say, “Believe in it, or do not believe. Those who were given knowledge before it[1], when it is recited to them, they fall on their faces in prostration,

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا

english_rwwad.text: and they say, “Glory be to our Lord. The promise of our Lord is bound to be fulfilled.”

verses.translation: and they say, “Glory be to our Lord. The promise of our Lord is bound to be fulfilled.”

verses.arabic: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًا

english_rwwad.text: They fall down on their faces weeping, and it increases their humility.”

verses.translation: They fall down on their faces weeping, and it increases their humility.”

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Compassionate[1] – whichever name you call, to Him belong the Most Beautiful Names.” Do not be too loud in your prayer, nor too quiet, but seek a way in between[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] The Makkans heard the Prophet (ﷺ) praying to Allah, once as Allah and on another occasion as Al-Rahmān, and claimed that he was praying to two different gods. [Majmū‘ al-Fatāwā, Ibn Taymiyyah, 14:15] Both are two Names for Allah, the One and Only God.
 [2] Abdullāh ibn Abbās (رضي الله عنهما) reported the reason behind the revelation of this verse: “It came down when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was lying low in Makkah. When he used to lead his Companions in Prayer and raise his voice and the pagans heard him, they would curse the Qur’an and He Who sent it down. So Allah said to His Messenger: “Do not raise your voice is Prayer upon which the pagans would hear you, yet not too quiet that your Companions may not hear you. Make them hear the Qur’an but do not raise your voice to that extent; seeking a middle way between them.” [Al-Bukhārī: 4722; Muslim: 446].

verses.translation: Say, “Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Compassionate[1] – whichever name you call, to Him belong the Most Beautiful Names.” Do not be too loud in your prayer, nor too quiet, but seek a way in between[2].

verses.arabic: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ مِّنَ ٱلذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًۢا

english_rwwad.text: And say, “All praise is for Allah Who has not taken a son, nor does He have any partner in His dominion, nor does He need any protector out of weakness. And proclaim His greatness immensely.”

verses.translation: And say, “All praise is for Allah Who has not taken a son, nor does He have any partner in His dominion, nor does He need any protector out of weakness. And proclaim His greatness immensely.”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَا

english_rwwad.text: All praise be to Allah Who has sent down upon His slave the Book, and has not allowed any crookedness therein[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] From the straight path or from the truth.

verses.translation: All praise be to Allah Who has sent down upon His slave the Book, and has not allowed any crookedness therein[1],

verses.arabic: قَيِّمًا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًا شَدِيدًا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا

english_rwwad.text: an upright Book, to warn of severe punishment from Him[1], and to give glad tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds, that they will have a good reward,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a painful punishment that awaits them in the Hereafter, and in this life such as in the battle at the hands of the believers.

verses.translation: an upright Book, to warn of severe punishment from Him[1], and to give glad tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds, that they will have a good reward,

verses.arabic: مَّٰكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَدًا

english_rwwad.text: wherein they will abide forever;

verses.translation: wherein they will abide forever;

verses.arabic: وَيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًا

english_rwwad.text: and to warn those who say, “Allah has begotten a son[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Such as the Jews and Christians, and the Arab pagans who claimed that angels are Allah’s daughters.

verses.translation: and to warn those who say, “Allah has begotten a son[1].”

verses.arabic: مَّا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ وَلَا لِـَٔابَآئِهِمْ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًا

english_rwwad.text: They have no knowledge of it, nor did their forefathers[1]. What a monstrous word that comes out of their mouths! They say nothing but lies.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of the reality of their false claims about Him.

verses.translation: They have no knowledge of it, nor did their forefathers[1]. What a monstrous word that comes out of their mouths! They say nothing but lies.

verses.arabic: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا

english_rwwad.text: Perhaps you will grieve yourself to death [O Prophet] over them[1] if they do not believe in this message[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] To the extent of almost wasting yourself away.
 [2] i.e., the Qur’an.

verses.translation: Perhaps you will grieve yourself to death [O Prophet] over them[1] if they do not believe in this message[2].

verses.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا

english_rwwad.text: We have made all that is on earth as an adornment for it, so that We may test them as to which of them is best in deeds.

verses.translation: We have made all that is on earth as an adornment for it, so that We may test them as to which of them is best in deeds.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَجَٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًا جُرُزًا

english_rwwad.text: And We will surely turn all that is on it into a barren land[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It shows the transient nature of life in this world, so one should invest in it for what comes after death.

verses.translation: And We will surely turn all that is on it into a barren land[1].

verses.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْكَهْفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا۟ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا عَجَبًا

english_rwwad.text: Do you think that the people of the Cave and the Inscription were of Our only wondrous signs[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Rather, there are many other wonders of Allah such as the creation of heavens and earth.

verses.translation: Do you think that the people of the Cave and the Inscription were of Our only wondrous signs[1]?

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا

english_rwwad.text: When the youths took refuge in the Cave, and said, “Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself, and show us the right way in our ordeal[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The youths have sought refuge in the cave for the sake of their religion, so they asked Allah to keep them firm on the straight path.

verses.translation: When the youths took refuge in the Cave, and said, “Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself, and show us the right way in our ordeal[1].”

verses.arabic: فَضَرَبْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ فِى ٱلْكَهْفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Then We caused them to fall into a deep sleep in the cave for many years.

verses.translation: Then We caused them to fall into a deep sleep in the cave for many years.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ أَىُّ ٱلْحِزْبَيْنِ أَحْصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوٓا۟ أَمَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Then We awakened them so that We may see which of the two parties would be more precise in calculating the length of their stay.

verses.translation: Then We awakened them so that We may see which of the two parties would be more precise in calculating the length of their stay.

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنَٰهُمْ هُدًى

english_rwwad.text: We relate to you their story in truth. They were youths who believed in their Lord, and We gave them more guidance.

verses.translation: We relate to you their story in truth. They were youths who believed in their Lord, and We gave them more guidance.

verses.arabic: وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا۟ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَٰهًا لَّقَدْ قُلْنَآ إِذًا شَطَطًا

english_rwwad.text: We strengthened their hearts when they stood up and proclaimed, “Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and earth. We will never call upon any god other than Him, or we would be uttering an outrageous lie[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., too far away from the Truth.

verses.translation: We strengthened their hearts when they stood up and proclaimed, “Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and earth. We will never call upon any god other than Him, or we would be uttering an outrageous lie[1].”

verses.arabic: هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمُنَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً لَّوْلَا يَأْتُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۭ بَيِّنٍ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا

english_rwwad.text: These people of ours have taken besides Him other gods. Why do they not bring clear proof about them? Who does greater wrong than one who fabricates lies against Allah?

verses.translation: These people of ours have taken besides Him other gods. Why do they not bring clear proof about them? Who does greater wrong than one who fabricates lies against Allah?

verses.arabic: وَإِذِ ٱعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ فَأْوُۥٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُم مِّنْ أَمْرِكُم مِّرْفَقًا

english_rwwad.text: When you have distanced yourselves from them and what they worship other than Allah, take refuge in the cave; your Lord will extend His mercy to you and make for you an easy way out of your ordeal.”

verses.translation: When you have distanced yourselves from them and what they worship other than Allah, take refuge in the cave; your Lord will extend His mercy to you and make for you an easy way out of your ordeal.”

verses.arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِى فَجْوَةٍ مِّنْهُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ وَلِيًّا مُّرْشِدًا

english_rwwad.text: You would have seen the sun when it rose, it would incline away from their Cave to the right; and when it set, it would turn away from them to the left[1], while they were in its open space. That was one of the signs of Allah. Whoever Allah guides is rightly guided, and whoever He causes to stray, you will never find for him a protecting guide.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As such they would get all the air and ventilation they needed to sustain.

verses.translation: You would have seen the sun when it rose, it would incline away from their Cave to the right; and when it set, it would turn away from them to the left[1], while they were in its open space. That was one of the signs of Allah. Whoever Allah guides is rightly guided, and whoever He causes to stray, you will never find for him a protecting guide.

verses.arabic: وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ وَكَلْبُهُم بَٰسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِٱلْوَصِيدِ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًا

english_rwwad.text: You would have thought they were awake, although they were asleep. We turned them over on their right and left sides, when their dog stretched its forelegs at the entrance. If you had seen them, you would have fled away from them, filled with horror[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Should anyone were to see them, he would see a group of awake men with a dog standing guarding them, and would surely be filled with horror, which was a factor in preserving them, so no one would dare to draw close to them.

verses.translation: You would have thought they were awake, although they were asleep. We turned them over on their right and left sides, when their dog stretched its forelegs at the entrance. If you had seen them, you would have fled away from them, filled with horror[1].

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِيَتَسَآءَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمْ قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ فَٱبْعَثُوٓا۟ أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ أَيُّهَآ أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًا فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Similarly, We awakened them so that they might question one another. One of them said, “How long have you been here?” They said, “We have been here for a day or part of a day.” They said, “Your Lord knows best how long you have been here. Send one of you with these silver coins of yours to the city, let him see which food is purest and bring you some provision from it. And let him be cautious and let no one know about you.

verses.translation: Similarly, We awakened them so that they might question one another. One of them said, “How long have you been here?” They said, “We have been here for a day or part of a day.” They said, “Your Lord knows best how long you have been here. Send one of you with these silver coins of yours to the city, let him see which food is purest and bring you some provision from it. And let him be cautious and let no one know about you.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ إِن يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِى مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَن تُفْلِحُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًا

english_rwwad.text: For if they find out about you, they will stone you or force you back to their religion, and then you will never succeed.”

verses.translation: For if they find out about you, they will stone you or force you back to their religion, and then you will never succeed.”

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَآ إِذْ يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ فَقَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ عَلَيْهِم بُنْيَٰنًا رَّبُّهُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ غَلَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِمْ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيْهِم مَّسْجِدًا

english_rwwad.text: This is how We made their case known so that the people might know that the promise of Allah is true and that there is no doubt about the Hour. When they were disputing among themselves[1] concerning their matter [of resurrection], they said, “Build a structure over them. Their Lord knows best about them.” Those who prevailed in their matter said, “We will surely build over them a place of worship.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the inhabitants of the city.

verses.translation: This is how We made their case known so that the people might know that the promise of Allah is true and that there is no doubt about the Hour. When they were disputing among themselves[1] concerning their matter [of resurrection], they said, “Build a structure over them. Their Lord knows best about them.” Those who prevailed in their matter said, “We will surely build over them a place of worship.”

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَٰثَةٌ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًۢا بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيَقُولُونَ سَبْعَةٌ وَثَامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ قُل رَّبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِم مَّا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيهِمْ إِلَّا مِرَآءً ظَٰهِرًا وَلَا تَسْتَفْتِ فِيهِم مِّنْهُمْ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Some will say, “They were three, their dog was the fourth,” while others will say, “They were five, their dog was the sixth,” – merely guessing at the unseen. And others will say, “They were seven, their dog was the eighth.” Say, “My Lord knows best their number; no one knows about them except a few[1]. So do not argue about them except in a brief manner, nor ask anyone about them.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., that which is the sure argument, one in the Qur’an.

verses.translation: Some will say, “They were three, their dog was the fourth,” while others will say, “They were five, their dog was the sixth,” – merely guessing at the unseen. And others will say, “They were seven, their dog was the eighth.” Say, “My Lord knows best their number; no one knows about them except a few[1]. So do not argue about them except in a brief manner, nor ask anyone about them.”

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَا۟ىْءٍ إِنِّى فَاعِلٌ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا

english_rwwad.text: And never say about anything, “I will surely do this tomorrow[1],”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For you do not know whether you will be able to do it or you will be diverted from it.

verses.translation: And never say about anything, “I will surely do this tomorrow[1],”

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّى لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَٰذَا رَشَدًا

english_rwwad.text: without adding, “if Allah wills.” And remember your Lord if you forget, and say, “My Lord will hopefully guide me to something closer to what is right[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As soon as one remembers not saying inshā’ Allah concerning doing something in the future, he should say it. Also when one forgets something, he should mention Allah so as to remember things.

verses.translation: without adding, “if Allah wills.” And remember your Lord if you forget, and say, “My Lord will hopefully guide me to something closer to what is right[1].”

verses.arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًا

english_rwwad.text: They remained in their cave for three hundred years, plus nine[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., 309 years.

verses.translation: They remained in their cave for three hundred years, plus nine[1].

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوا۟ لَهُۥ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَبْصِرْ بِهِۦ وَأَسْمِعْ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِى حُكْمِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Allah knows best how long they remained. To Him belongs [the knowledge of] the unseen of the heavens and earth. How well He sees and how well He hears[1]! They have no protector besides Him, and He shares His command with none.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Nothing can escape Allah’s Sight and Hearing.

verses.translation: Say, “Allah knows best how long they remained. To Him belongs [the knowledge of] the unseen of the heavens and earth. How well He sees and how well He hears[1]! They have no protector besides Him, and He shares His command with none.”

verses.arabic: وَٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن كِتَابِ رَبِّكَ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَلَن تَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Recite what has been revealed to you from the Book of your Lord. None can change His Words, and you will never find any refuge except with Him[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] There is no escape from the punishment of Allah, should the Message not be conveyed, recited, and followed accordingly.

verses.translation: Recite what has been revealed to you from the Book of your Lord. None can change His Words, and you will never find any refuge except with Him[1].

verses.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا تُطِعْ مَنْ أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُۥ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُۥ فُرُطًا

english_rwwad.text: Be patient with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking His Face [pleasure]. Do not turn your eyes away from them, desiring the adornments of the life of this world. And do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance, who follows his desires and whose affairs [deeds] are at loss.

verses.translation: Be patient with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking His Face [pleasure]. Do not turn your eyes away from them, desiring the adornments of the life of this world. And do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance, who follows his desires and whose affairs [deeds] are at loss.

verses.arabic: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيُؤْمِن وَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ نَارًا أَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا وَإِن يَسْتَغِيثُوا۟ يُغَاثُوا۟ بِمَآءٍ كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَشْوِى ٱلْوُجُوهَ بِئْسَ ٱلشَّرَابُ وَسَآءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “The truth is from your Lord. Whoever wills may believe, and whoever wills may disbelieve.” We have prepared for the wrongdoers a Fire which will encompass them like the walls. If they cry for relief, they will be relieved with water like boiling oil that will scald the faces. What a terrible drink, and what a terrible resting place!

verses.translation: Say, “The truth is from your Lord. Whoever wills may believe, and whoever wills may disbelieve.” We have prepared for the wrongdoers a Fire which will encompass them like the walls. If they cry for relief, they will be relieved with water like boiling oil that will scald the faces. What a terrible drink, and what a terrible resting place!

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا

english_rwwad.text: Those who believe and do righteous deeds, We will not let the reward of those who do good deeds to go to waste.

verses.translation: Those who believe and do righteous deeds, We will not let the reward of those who do good deeds to go to waste.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِّن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ نِعْمَ ٱلثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا

english_rwwad.text: It is they who will have Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with golden bracelets and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining on adorned couches. What an excellent reward, and what a pleasant resting place!

verses.translation: It is they who will have Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with golden bracelets and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining on adorned couches. What an excellent reward, and what a pleasant resting place!

verses.arabic: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَعْنَٰبٍ وَحَفَفْنَٰهُمَا بِنَخْلٍ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًا

english_rwwad.text: Give them an example of two men[1]: to one of them We gave two gardens of grapevines and surrounded them with palm trees, and placed between them crops[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., one was a believer and the second a disbeliever; the disbeliever owned two gardens.
 [2] The arrogant and wealthy disbelievers of Makkah looked down upon the poor believers and demanded that the Prophet (ﷺ) expel them should he want them to sit and listen to him.

verses.translation: Give them an example of two men[1]: to one of them We gave two gardens of grapevines and surrounded them with palm trees, and placed between them crops[2].

verses.arabic: كِلْتَا ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ ءَاتَتْ أُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِم مِّنْهُ شَيْـًٔا وَفَجَّرْنَا خِلَٰلَهُمَا نَهَرًا

english_rwwad.text: Each garden yielded its produce and did not fall short in the least, and We caused a stream to flow through them.

verses.translation: Each garden yielded its produce and did not fall short in the least, and We caused a stream to flow through them.

verses.arabic: وَكَانَ لَهُۥ ثَمَرٌ فَقَالَ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَنَا۠ أَكْثَرُ مِنكَ مَالًا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرًا

english_rwwad.text: And he had abundant fruit. He said to his companion, as he was conversing with him, “I am greater than you in wealth and superior in followers.”

verses.translation: And he had abundant fruit. He said to his companion, as he was conversing with him, “I am greater than you in wealth and superior in followers.”

verses.arabic: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ قَالَ مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا

english_rwwad.text: He entered his garden, having wronged himself[1], and said, “I do not think that this will ever perish,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By being proud and disbeliever.

verses.translation: He entered his garden, having wronged himself[1], and said, “I do not think that this will ever perish,

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّدِدتُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا مُنقَلَبًا

english_rwwad.text: nor do I think that the Hour will ever come. Even if I am brought back to my Lord, I will surely find something better than this[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He thought should there be a tiny possibility of resurrection, based on his wrongful calculation that he was honored in this life because Allah loved him. Hence he fell into the fallacy that if he ever return to Him, he should only expect greater honoring, or he might have said that deridingly.

verses.translation: nor do I think that the Hour will ever come. Even if I am brought back to my Lord, I will surely find something better than this[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهُۥ صَاحِبُهُۥ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَكَفَرْتَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰكَ رَجُلًا

english_rwwad.text: His companion said, while conversing with him, “Do you disbelieve in He Who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then fashioned you into a well-proportioned man[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The One Who created such a magnificent creation in the first place is able to recreate the creatures.

verses.translation: His companion said, while conversing with him, “Do you disbelieve in He Who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then fashioned you into a well-proportioned man[1]?

verses.arabic: لَّٰكِنَّا۠ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّىٓ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: As for me: He is Allah, my Lord, and I do not associate anyone with my Lord.

verses.translation: As for me: He is Allah, my Lord, and I do not associate anyone with my Lord.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ إِن تَرَنِ أَنَا۠ أَقَلَّ مِنكَ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا

english_rwwad.text: If only you had said, when you entered your garden, ‘This is by Allah’s Will; there is no power except with Allah.’ Even though you see me as inferior to you in wealth and children,

verses.translation: If only you had said, when you entered your garden, ‘This is by Allah’s Will; there is no power except with Allah.’ Even though you see me as inferior to you in wealth and children,

verses.arabic: فَعَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًا مِّن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًا زَلَقًا

english_rwwad.text: it may well be that my Lord will give me something better than your garden, and send upon your garden a thunderbolt from the heaven, turning it into a barren land.

verses.translation: it may well be that my Lord will give me something better than your garden, and send upon your garden a thunderbolt from the heaven, turning it into a barren land.

verses.arabic: أَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوْرًا فَلَن تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُۥ طَلَبًا

english_rwwad.text: Or its water may sink, so you will never be able to get it back.”

verses.translation: Or its water may sink, so you will never be able to get it back.”

verses.arabic: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِۦ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّىٓ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Eventually, all his produce was destroyed and he started wringing his hands [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, as it had collapsed on its trellises, and he said, “Oh, would that I had not associated anyone with my Lord!”

verses.translation: Eventually, all his produce was destroyed and he started wringing his hands [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, as it had collapsed on its trellises, and he said, “Oh, would that I had not associated anyone with my Lord!”

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُۥ فِئَةٌ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا

english_rwwad.text: He had none to support him against Allah, nor could he support himself.

verses.translation: He had none to support him against Allah, nor could he support himself.

verses.arabic: هُنَالِكَ ٱلْوَلَٰيَةُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْحَقِّ هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًا

english_rwwad.text: In that situation[1], the authority only rests with Allah, the True God. He is best in reward and best in outcome.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., on the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: In that situation[1], the authority only rests with Allah, the True God. He is best in reward and best in outcome.

verses.arabic: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ ٱلرِّيَٰحُ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّقْتَدِرًا

english_rwwad.text: Give them the example of the life of this world: it is like the plants of the earth, thriving when sustained by the rain We send down from the sky, but soon they turn into chaff scattered by the winds. Allah has full power over all things.

verses.translation: Give them the example of the life of this world: it is like the plants of the earth, thriving when sustained by the rain We send down from the sky, but soon they turn into chaff scattered by the winds. Allah has full power over all things.

verses.arabic: ٱلْمَالُ وَٱلْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا

english_rwwad.text: Wealth and children are the adornments of the life of this world, but the lasting righteous deeds are better with your Lord in reward and better in hope.

verses.translation: Wealth and children are the adornments of the life of this world, but the lasting righteous deeds are better with your Lord in reward and better in hope.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ ٱلْجِبَالَ وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ بَارِزَةً وَحَشَرْنَٰهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: And [beware of] the Day when We will move the mountains away, and you will see the earth laid bare[1]; We will gather them all and not leave behind anyone of them.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., flattened.

verses.translation: And [beware of] the Day when We will move the mountains away, and you will see the earth laid bare[1]; We will gather them all and not leave behind anyone of them.

verses.arabic: وَعُرِضُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفًّا لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۭ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَلَّن نَّجْعَلَ لَكُم مَّوْعِدًا

english_rwwad.text: They will be presented before your Lord in rows, “Now you have come to Us as We created you the first time[1], although you claimed that We would never appoint a time for your return.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Nude, uncircumcised, and lonely.

verses.translation: They will be presented before your Lord in rows, “Now you have come to Us as We created you the first time[1], although you claimed that We would never appoint a time for your return.”

verses.arabic: وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ فَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَٰوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّآ أَحْصَىٰهَا وَوَجَدُوا۟ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ حَاضِرًا وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: And the record [of deeds] will be placed before them, and you will see the wicked scared of what it contains. They will say, “Woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing, small or big, except that it has recorded it?” They will find all what they did before them, and your Lord does not wrong anyone.

verses.translation: And the record [of deeds] will be placed before them, and you will see the wicked scared of what it contains. They will say, “Woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing, small or big, except that it has recorded it?” They will find all what they did before them, and your Lord does not wrong anyone.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُۥ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِى وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۢ بِئْسَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَدَلًا

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam,” so they all prostrated except Iblīs, who was one of the jinn, but he disobeyed the command of his Lord. Will you then take him and his progeny as protectors instead of Me[1], even though they are your enemies[2]? What a terrible exchange for the wrongdoers!
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Demons could possess their idols and communicate through them; they also used to seek refuge from the evil of the jinn by appraising them and slaughtering sacrifices for them.
 [2] Satan along with his fellow demons continues to lead people astray from the right Path.

verses.translation: And [remember] when We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam,” so they all prostrated except Iblīs, who was one of the jinn, but he disobeyed the command of his Lord. Will you then take him and his progeny as protectors instead of Me[1], even though they are your enemies[2]? What a terrible exchange for the wrongdoers!

verses.arabic: مَّآ أَشْهَدتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ ٱلْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًا

english_rwwad.text: I did not call them to witness the creation of the heavens and earth, nor even the creation of their own selves, and I would not take those who misguide others as helpers[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah, the source of guidance, would not take false deities who are the main cause of misguidance as helpers.

verses.translation: I did not call them to witness the creation of the heavens and earth, nor even the creation of their own selves, and I would not take those who misguide others as helpers[1].

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوا۟ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّوْبِقًا

english_rwwad.text: And [beware of] the Day when He will say, “Call upon those whom you claimed to be My partners.” So they will call them, but they will not respond to them[1], and We will make them share the same doom.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The false deities they took besides Allah will let them down when they need them most on Judgment Day.

verses.translation: And [beware of] the Day when He will say, “Call upon those whom you claimed to be My partners.” So they will call them, but they will not respond to them[1], and We will make them share the same doom.

verses.arabic: وَرَءَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا

english_rwwad.text: The wicked will see the Fire and realize that they are bound to fall into it, and they will find no escape from it.

verses.translation: The wicked will see the Fire and realize that they are bound to fall into it, and they will find no escape from it.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَكْثَرَ شَىْءٍ جَدَلًا

english_rwwad.text: We have surely diversified in this Qur’an every kind of example for people[1], but man is the most quarrelsome of all beings[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] So that people may become mindful and be guided.
 [2] Humans always defend their position instead of yielding to the truth. It pertains to disbelievers more than anyone else.

verses.translation: We have surely diversified in this Qur’an every kind of example for people[1], but man is the most quarrelsome of all beings[2].

verses.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ قُبُلًا

english_rwwad.text: Nothing prevents people from believing when guidance comes to them and from seeking forgiveness from their Lord except that the fate of the earlier nations should come to them, or that the punishment should come before their eyes.

verses.translation: Nothing prevents people from believing when guidance comes to them and from seeking forgiveness from their Lord except that the fate of the earlier nations should come to them, or that the punishment should come before their eyes.
