verses.arabic: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ وَيُجَٰدِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَمَآ أُنذِرُوا۟ هُزُوًا

english_rwwad.text: We do not send the messengers except as bearers of glad tidings and warners. But those who disbelieve seek to undermine the truth with false arguments, and they take My verses and warnings in ridicule.

verses.translation: We do not send the messengers except as bearers of glad tidings and warners. But those who disbelieve seek to undermine the truth with false arguments, and they take My verses and warnings in ridicule.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا وَإِن تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهْتَدُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Who could be more wrong than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord, but he turns away from them and forgets what his hands have sent forth? We have placed veils on their hearts so that they cannot understand it, and deafness in their ears. Even if you call them to guidance, they will never be guided.

verses.translation: Who could be more wrong than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord, but he turns away from them and forgets what his hands have sent forth? We have placed veils on their hearts so that they cannot understand it, and deafness in their ears. Even if you call them to guidance, they will never be guided.

verses.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ بَل لَّهُم مَّوْعِدٌ لَّن يَجِدُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَوْئِلًا

english_rwwad.text: But your Lord is the All-Forgiving, Lord of Mercy. If He were to take them to task for what they did, He would have hastened their punishment. Yet there is an appointed time for them from which they will find no escape.

verses.translation: But your Lord is the All-Forgiving, Lord of Mercy. If He were to take them to task for what they did, He would have hastened their punishment. Yet there is an appointed time for them from which they will find no escape.

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا۟ وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِم مَّوْعِدًا

english_rwwad.text: Those are the towns We destroyed when they persisted in wrongdoing, and We set an appointed time for their destruction.

verses.translation: Those are the towns We destroyed when they persisted in wrongdoing, and We set an appointed time for their destruction.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِىَ حُقُبًا

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when Moses said to his servant, “I will not give up until I reach the junction of the two seas, or I travel for ages.”

verses.translation: And [remember] when Moses said to his servant, “I will not give up until I reach the junction of the two seas, or I travel for ages.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا

english_rwwad.text: But when they reached the junction of the two seas, they forgot their fish, which made its way into the sea, slipping away.

verses.translation: But when they reached the junction of the two seas, they forgot their fish, which made its way into the sea, slipping away.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا نَصَبًا

english_rwwad.text: When they traveled further, he said to his servant, “Bring us our morning meal; this journey has truly exhausted us.”

verses.translation: When they traveled further, he said to his servant, “Bring us our morning meal; this journey has truly exhausted us.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَآ إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّى نَسِيتُ ٱلْحُوتَ وَمَآ أَنسَىٰنِيهُ إِلَّا ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُۥ وَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “You remember when we rested by the rock, I forgot the fish; it was none who made me forget to mention it except Satan, and it made its way into the sea amazingly.”

verses.translation: He said, “You remember when we rested by the rock, I forgot the fish; it was none who made me forget to mention it except Satan, and it made its way into the sea amazingly.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ فَٱرْتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا

english_rwwad.text: Moses said, “That is exactly what we were looking for.” So they turned back, retracing their footsteps.

verses.translation: Moses said, “That is exactly what we were looking for.” So they turned back, retracing their footsteps.

verses.arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًا

english_rwwad.text: There they found one of Our slaves[1] upon whom We bestowed Our mercy[2] and We taught him from Our Own knowledge[3].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Al-Khidr.
 [2] i.e., Prophethood or being a righteous servant of Allah.
 [3] i.e., the knowledge that Allah gave him such as knowledge of some unseen events, of which others were unaware.

verses.translation: There they found one of Our slaves[1] upon whom We bestowed Our mercy[2] and We taught him from Our Own knowledge[3].

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًا

english_rwwad.text: Moses said to him, “May I follow you so that you may teach me some knowledge that you have been taught?”

verses.translation: Moses said to him, “May I follow you so that you may teach me some knowledge that you have been taught?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “You will never be able to have patience with me.”

verses.translation: He said, “You will never be able to have patience with me.”

verses.arabic: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ خُبْرًا

english_rwwad.text: How can you have patience with that which you have no knowledge about?”

verses.translation: How can you have patience with that which you have no knowledge about?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرًا وَلَآ أَعْصِى لَكَ أَمْرًا

english_rwwad.text: Moses said, “You will find me patient, if Allah wills; and I will not disobey any of your orders.”

verses.translation: Moses said, “You will find me patient, if Allah wills; and I will not disobey any of your orders.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَنِى فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِى عَن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I mention it to you.”

verses.translation: He said, “Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I mention it to you.”

verses.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا إِمْرًا

english_rwwad.text: So they both set out, until when they boarded a ship, he made a hole in it. Moses said, “Did you make a hole in it to drown its people? You have done something terrible!”

verses.translation: So they both set out, until when they boarded a ship, he made a hole in it. Moses said, “Did you make a hole in it to drown its people? You have done something terrible!”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Did I not tell you that you will never be able to have patience with me?”

verses.translation: He said, “Did I not tell you that you will never be able to have patience with me?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِى مِنْ أَمْرِى عُسْرًا

english_rwwad.text: Moses said, “Do not take me to task for what I forgot, and do not make it too difficult for me to follow you.”

verses.translation: Moses said, “Do not take me to task for what I forgot, and do not make it too difficult for me to follow you.”

verses.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَٰمًا فَقَتَلَهُۥ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةًۢ بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ لَّقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا نُّكْرًا

english_rwwad.text: Then they proceeded until they met a boy, and the man killed him. Moses said, “Did you kill an innocent soul who killed none? You have done something monstrous!”

verses.translation: Then they proceeded until they met a boy, and the man killed him. Moses said, “Did you kill an innocent soul who killed none? You have done something monstrous!”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا

english_rwwad.text: The man said, “Did I not tell you that you will never be able to have patience with me?”

verses.translation: The man said, “Did I not tell you that you will never be able to have patience with me?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍۭ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبْنِى قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّى عُذْرًا

english_rwwad.text: Moses said, “If I ask you about anything after this, do not keep me in your company, for then you would be excused concerning me.”

verses.translation: Moses said, “If I ask you about anything after this, do not keep me in your company, for then you would be excused concerning me.”

verses.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ ٱسْتَطْعَمَآ أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا۟ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا

english_rwwad.text: Then they went on until they came to the people of a town[1]. They asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. They found there a wall that was about to collapse, but he repaired it. Moses said, “If you wished, you could have taken some payment for it.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Who were extremely mean folk.

verses.translation: Then they went on until they came to the people of a town[1]. They asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. They found there a wall that was about to collapse, but he repaired it. Moses said, “If you wished, you could have taken some payment for it.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنِكَ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا

english_rwwad.text: The man said, “This is the parting of ways between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that which you could not bear with patience.

verses.translation: The man said, “This is the parting of ways between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that which you could not bear with patience.

verses.arabic: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا

english_rwwad.text: “As for the ship, it belonged to some poor people who worked at sea. I wanted to make it defective because there was a king ahead of them who seized every [good] ship by force.

verses.translation: “As for the ship, it belonged to some poor people who worked at sea. I wanted to make it defective because there was a king ahead of them who seized every [good] ship by force.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَٰنًا وَكُفْرًا

english_rwwad.text: “As for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them with his rebellion and disbelief[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Even though the parents were believers, the son was to become a disbeliever, and it was feared that he would make them fall into disbelief out of their love for him.

verses.translation: “As for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them with his rebellion and disbelief[1].

verses.arabic: فَأَرَدْنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهُ زَكَوٰةً وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًا

english_rwwad.text: So we hoped that their Lord would give them another in his place, more righteous and tender-hearted.

verses.translation: So we hoped that their Lord would give them another in his place, more righteous and tender-hearted.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَٰمَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُۥ كَنزٌ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَٰلِحًا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَآ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُۥ عَنْ أَمْرِى ذَٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا

english_rwwad.text: As for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was a treasure under it that belonged to them. Their father was a righteous man, so your Lord willed that they should reach their maturity and retrieve their treasure[1], as a mercy from your Lord; I did not do it of my own accord. This is the interpretation of that which you could not bear with patience.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Had they not mended the wall, it would have subsequently fallen; they, being young, weak, and surrounded by mean people, would certainly have lost their treasure.

verses.translation: As for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was a treasure under it that belonged to them. Their father was a righteous man, so your Lord willed that they should reach their maturity and retrieve their treasure[1], as a mercy from your Lord; I did not do it of my own accord. This is the interpretation of that which you could not bear with patience.”

verses.arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا

english_rwwad.text: They ask you about Dhul-Qarnayn[1]. Say, “I will tell you something about him.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Two-Horned Sovereign, about whom the Quraysh pagans asked the Prophet (ﷺ), along with that of the Companions of the Cave, testing his prophethood. He was named thus because he reached the rising point and the setting point of the sun; or two generations (qarns) of people passed away during his reign; or he had two long locks of hair; or his crown had two horns.

verses.translation: They ask you about Dhul-Qarnayn[1]. Say, “I will tell you something about him.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ سَبَبًا

english_rwwad.text: We established him on earth and gave him the means to achieve everything[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Such as soldiers, weaponry, etc.

verses.translation: We established him on earth and gave him the means to achieve everything[1].

verses.arabic: فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

english_rwwad.text: He pursued a course[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Utilizing these means.

verses.translation: He pursued a course[1],

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِى عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوْمًا قُلْنَا يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًا

english_rwwad.text: until when he reached the far west, he found the sun setting in a dark body of water, and he found some people nearby. We said, “O Dhul-Qarnayn, either punish them or treat them with kindness.”

verses.translation: until when he reached the far west, he found the sun setting in a dark body of water, and he found some people nearby. We said, “O Dhul-Qarnayn, either punish them or treat them with kindness.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “As for one who does wrong[1], we will punish him, then he will be brought back to his Lord, and He will punish him grievously.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By persisting in disbelief and associating partners with Allah.

verses.translation: He said, “As for one who does wrong[1], we will punish him, then he will be brought back to his Lord, and He will punish him grievously.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًا

english_rwwad.text: But he who believes and does righteous deeds, he will have the best reward[1], and we will enjoin upon him to do what is easy.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Paradise.

verses.translation: But he who believes and does righteous deeds, he will have the best reward[1], and we will enjoin upon him to do what is easy.”

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

english_rwwad.text: Then he pursued another course,

verses.translation: Then he pursued another course,

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًا

english_rwwad.text: until when he reached the far east, he found the sun rising on a people for whom We provided no shelter from it[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They had nothing to shade them from the sun; trees, mountains, or buildings.

verses.translation: until when he reached the far east, he found the sun rising on a people for whom We provided no shelter from it[1].

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًا

english_rwwad.text: So it was, and We had full knowledge about him[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn.

verses.translation: So it was, and We had full knowledge about him[1].

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

english_rwwad.text: Then he pursued another course,

verses.translation: Then he pursued another course,

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا

english_rwwad.text: until when he reached [a valley] between the two mountains, he found beyond them a people who could barely understand a word[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They could not speak except their own language.

verses.translation: until when he reached [a valley] between the two mountains, he found beyond them a people who could barely understand a word[1].

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا

english_rwwad.text: They said, “O Dhul-Qarnayn, Gog and Magog are spreading corruption in the land. Can we give you some payment in return for you to construct a barrier between us and them?”

verses.translation: They said, “O Dhul-Qarnayn, Gog and Magog are spreading corruption in the land. Can we give you some payment in return for you to construct a barrier between us and them?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “What my Lord has given me is better. But help me with manpower, I will construct a barricade between you and them.

verses.translation: He said, “What my Lord has given me is better. But help me with manpower, I will construct a barricade between you and them.

verses.arabic: ءَاتُونِى زُبَرَ ٱلْحَدِيدِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارًا قَالَ ءَاتُونِىٓ أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا

english_rwwad.text: Bring me iron blocks” – until when he leveled between the two mountainsides, he said, “Blow [with bellows],” until when he fired them up to extreme heat, he said, “Bring me molten copper to pour over it.”

verses.translation: Bring me iron blocks” – until when he leveled between the two mountainsides, he said, “Blow [with bellows],” until when he fired them up to extreme heat, he said, “Bring me molten copper to pour over it.”

verses.arabic: فَمَا ٱسْطَٰعُوٓا۟ أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًا

english_rwwad.text: Thus they could not climb over it nor could they pierce it[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They could not climb the dam for its smooth surface as well as it was as high as the mountains, and could not pierce it for its fortitude.

verses.translation: Thus they could not climb over it nor could they pierce it[1].

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّى فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى حَقًّا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass[1], He will raze it to the ground. The promise of my Lord is ever true.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Before the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: He said, “This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass[1], He will raze it to the ground. The promise of my Lord is ever true.”

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَمُوجُ فِى بَعْضٍ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَٰهُمْ جَمْعًا

english_rwwad.text: On that Day[1] We will let some of them surge like waves over others, and the Trumpet will be blown, then We will gather them all together.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] When the dam is destroyed.

verses.translation: On that Day[1] We will let some of them surge like waves over others, and the Trumpet will be blown, then We will gather them all together.

verses.arabic: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَرْضًا

english_rwwad.text: On that Day We will show Hell to the disbelievers clearly[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Before they enter it on the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: On that Day We will show Hell to the disbelievers clearly[1],

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكْرِى وَكَانُوا۟ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا

english_rwwad.text: those whose eyes were blind to My signs[1] and they were unable to hear [the truth][2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Or of the Qur’an.
 [2] To believe in it.

verses.translation: those whose eyes were blind to My signs[1] and they were unable to hear [the truth][2].

verses.arabic: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًا

english_rwwad.text: Do the disbelievers think that they can take My slaves as allies instead of Me? We have prepared Hell as a dwelling place for the disbelievers.

verses.translation: Do the disbelievers think that they can take My slaves as allies instead of Me? We have prepared Hell as a dwelling place for the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَٰلًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Shall we inform you of the greatest losers in terms of their deeds?

verses.translation: Say, “Shall we inform you of the greatest losers in terms of their deeds?

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا

english_rwwad.text: Those whose efforts in the life of this world are wasted, while they think that they are doing good[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For they follow other than their Lord’s path, and justify their deviant actions until they finally believe that they are on the right path.

verses.translation: Those whose efforts in the life of this world are wasted, while they think that they are doing good[1].”

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَزْنًا

english_rwwad.text: It is those who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and their meeting with Him; their deeds will be nullified, and We will give no weight to them on the Day of Resurrection[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It shows the ghastly fate of the disbelievers.

verses.translation: It is those who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and their meeting with Him; their deeds will be nullified, and We will give no weight to them on the Day of Resurrection[1].

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا

english_rwwad.text: That is their recompense: Hell, because of their disbelief and taking My verses and messengers in ridicule.

verses.translation: That is their recompense: Hell, because of their disbelief and taking My verses and messengers in ridicule.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا

english_rwwad.text: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, they will have gardens of Paradise[1] as a dwelling place[2],
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., al-Firdaus: the highest level of Paradise.
 [2] It shows the regal fate of the believers.

verses.translation: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, they will have gardens of Paradise[1] as a dwelling place[2],

verses.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا

english_rwwad.text: abiding therein forever, never desiring to leave.

verses.translation: abiding therein forever, never desiring to leave.

verses.arabic: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّى وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِۦ مَدَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “If the ocean were ink for [writing] the Words of my Lord, the ocean would surely run dry before the Words of my Lord[1] are finished, even if We brought its like to resupply it.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., His unlimited Knowledge, or words describing His Attributes and His Grandeur.

verses.translation: Say, “If the ocean were ink for [writing] the Words of my Lord, the ocean would surely run dry before the Words of my Lord[1] are finished, even if We brought its like to resupply it.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَٰلِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “I am only a man like you; it has been revealed to me that your God is One God. So whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous deeds and associate none in the worship of his Lord.”

verses.translation: Say, “I am only a man like you; it has been revealed to me that your God is One God. So whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous deeds and associate none in the worship of his Lord.”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ كٓهيعٓصٓ

english_rwwad.text: Kāf Ha Ya ‘Ayyn Sād[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1

verses.translation: Kāf Ha Ya ‘Ayyn Sād[1]

verses.arabic: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ

english_rwwad.text: This is a reminder of the mercy of your Lord to His slave Zachariah,

verses.translation: This is a reminder of the mercy of your Lord to His slave Zachariah,

verses.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: When he called upon his Lord in private.

verses.translation: When he called upon his Lord in private.

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “My Lord, my bones have grown feeble, and gray hair has spread across my head,[1] yet never have I been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Lit., "ignited." The spread of white hair across the head is likened to igniting of fire in the bush.

verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, my bones have grown feeble, and gray hair has spread across my head,[1] yet never have I been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord.

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: And I fear my kinsmen after me,[1] and my wife is barren; so grant me from Yourself an heir,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., my successors.

verses.translation: And I fear my kinsmen after me,[1] and my wife is barren; so grant me from Yourself an heir,

verses.arabic: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: who will inherit [prophethood] from me and from the house of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, well pleasing to You.”

verses.translation: who will inherit [prophethood] from me and from the house of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, well pleasing to You.”

verses.arabic: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: [Allah said], “O Zachariah, We give you the glad tidings of a son, whose name will be John – a name that We have not given to anyone before.”

verses.translation: [Allah said], “O Zachariah, We give you the glad tidings of a son, whose name will be John – a name that We have not given to anyone before.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “My Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have reached an extremely old age?”

verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have reached an extremely old age?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًٔا

english_rwwad.text: [The angel] said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; I did create you before when you were nothing.’”

verses.translation: [The angel] said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; I did create you before when you were nothing.’”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Zachariah said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not be able to speak to people for three nights,[1] despite being sound.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., without being ill.

verses.translation: Zachariah said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not be able to speak to people for three nights,[1] despite being sound.”

verses.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Thereupon he came out to his people from the sanctuary and signaled to them to glorify Allah morning and evening.

verses.translation: Thereupon he came out to his people from the sanctuary and signaled to them to glorify Allah morning and evening.

verses.arabic: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: [Allah said], “O John, hold the Scripture with all your strength.” And We gave him wisdom when he was still a child,

verses.translation: [Allah said], “O John, hold the Scripture with all your strength.” And We gave him wisdom when he was still a child,

verses.arabic: وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةً وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: as We made him compassionate and righteous, and he was fearing Allah,

verses.translation: as We made him compassionate and righteous, and he was fearing Allah,

verses.arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: and dutiful to his parents, and he was not an oppressor or disobedient.

verses.translation: and dutiful to his parents, and he was not an oppressor or disobedient.

verses.arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Peace be on him the day he was born, the day he will die, and the day he will be raised up to life again!

verses.translation: Peace be on him the day he was born, the day he will die, and the day he will be raised up to life again!

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place towards the east.

verses.translation: And mention in the Book [the story of] Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place towards the east.

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: She screened herself from them, then We sent to her Our Spirit [Gabriel] and he appeared before her in the form of a perfect human being.

verses.translation: She screened herself from them, then We sent to her Our Spirit [Gabriel] and he appeared before her in the form of a perfect human being.

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: She said, “I seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you; [do not approach me] if you fear Allah.”

verses.translation: She said, “I seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you; [do not approach me] if you fear Allah.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًا زَكِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “I am only a messenger from your Lord to grant you a righteous son.”

verses.translation: He said, “I am only a messenger from your Lord to grant you a righteous son.”

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: She said, “How can I have a son when no man has touched me, nor have I ever been unchaste?”

verses.translation: She said, “How can I have a son when no man has touched me, nor have I ever been unchaste?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; We make him a sign for people and a mercy from Us. This matter has already been decreed.’”

verses.translation: He said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; We make him a sign for people and a mercy from Us. This matter has already been decreed.’”

verses.arabic: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a distant place.[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Bethlehem, around 6 miles (10 km) to the south of Jerusalem.

verses.translation: So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a distant place.[1]

verses.arabic: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: The pains of labor drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, “Oh, would that I had died before this and had been completely forgotten!”

verses.translation: The pains of labor drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, “Oh, would that I had died before this and had been completely forgotten!”

verses.arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Then he[1] called her from beneath her, “Do not grieve; your Lord has provided a stream beneath you.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the archangel Gabriel or the baby.

verses.translation: Then he[1] called her from beneath her, “Do not grieve; your Lord has provided a stream beneath you.

verses.arabic: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Shake the trunk of the palm tree towards yourself; fresh ripe dates will drop upon you.

verses.translation: Shake the trunk of the palm tree towards yourself; fresh ripe dates will drop upon you.

verses.arabic: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًا فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Eat and drink, and be glad. And if you see any human being, say, ‘I have vowed silence[1] to the Most Compassionate, so I will not talk to any human being today.’”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Sawm: literally means to abstain or fast from food, speech, etc.

verses.translation: Eat and drink, and be glad. And if you see any human being, say, ‘I have vowed silence[1] to the Most Compassionate, so I will not talk to any human being today.’”

verses.arabic: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًٔا فَرِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Then she came to her people carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have committed something monstrous!

verses.translation: Then she came to her people carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have committed something monstrous!

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: O sister of Aaron,[1] your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Aaron was a pious man at the time of Mary, or she was from the descendants of Aaron, Moses’ brother.

verses.translation: O sister of Aaron,[1] your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste.”

verses.arabic: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Thereupon she pointed to him. They said, “How can we talk to someone who is still a baby in the cradle?”

verses.translation: Thereupon she pointed to him. They said, “How can we talk to someone who is still a baby in the cradle?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Jesus said, “I am a slave of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

verses.translation: Jesus said, “I am a slave of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا

english_rwwad.text: He has made me blessed wherever I may be, and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I am alive,

verses.translation: He has made me blessed wherever I may be, and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I am alive,

verses.arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: and has made me dutiful to my mother, and has not made me an oppressor or disobedient.

verses.translation: and has made me dutiful to my mother, and has not made me an oppressor or disobedient.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Peace is upon me the day I was born, the day I will die and the day I will be resurrected.”

verses.translation: Peace is upon me the day I was born, the day I will die and the day I will be resurrected.”

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Such was Jesus, son of Mary – a word of truth about which they are in doubt.

verses.translation: Such was Jesus, son of Mary – a word of truth about which they are in doubt.

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

english_rwwad.text: It is not befitting Allah to beget a son. Glory be to Him[1]! When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., far exalted is He above any such need.

verses.translation: It is not befitting Allah to beget a son. Glory be to Him[1]! When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: [Jesus said], “Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path.”

verses.translation: [Jesus said], “Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path.”

verses.arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: But the factions differed among themselves[1] [about him]. So woe to the disbelievers from the scene of a momentous Day!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Some believed that Jesus was God or the son of God, whereas those who truly followed him considered him only as Allah's messenger.

verses.translation: But the factions differed among themselves[1] [about him]. So woe to the disbelievers from the scene of a momentous Day!

verses.arabic: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: How well they will hear and see on the Day they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly misguided.

verses.translation: How well they will hear and see on the Day they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly misguided.

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Warn them of the Day of Remorse when all matters will be decided, but they are heedless and they do not believe.

verses.translation: Warn them of the Day of Remorse when all matters will be decided, but they are heedless and they do not believe.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: It is We Who will inherit the earth and all those who are on it, and to Us they will be returned.

verses.translation: It is We Who will inherit the earth and all those who are on it, and to Us they will be returned.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. He was indeed a man of truth and a prophet.

verses.translation: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. He was indeed a man of truth and a prophet.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا

english_rwwad.text: When he said to his father, “O my dear father, why do you worship something that neither hears nor sees nor benefits you in any way?

verses.translation: When he said to his father, “O my dear father, why do you worship something that neither hears nor sees nor benefits you in any way?

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: O my dear father, there has come to me some knowledge that has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to a straight path.

verses.translation: O my dear father, there has come to me some knowledge that has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to a straight path.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: O my dear father, do not worship Satan. Indeed, Satan is rebellious against the Most Compassionate.

verses.translation: O my dear father, do not worship Satan. Indeed, Satan is rebellious against the Most Compassionate.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: O my dear father, I truly fear that a punishment from the Most Compassionate may afflict you and that you may become a companion of Satan [in Hell].”

verses.translation: O my dear father, I truly fear that a punishment from the Most Compassionate may afflict you and that you may become a companion of Satan [in Hell].”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Are you turning away from my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you. Keep away from me for a long time!”

verses.translation: He said, “Are you turning away from my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you. Keep away from me for a long time!”

verses.arabic: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Abraham said, “Peace be on you[1]. I will seek my Lord’s forgiveness for you. Indeed, He is Most Gracious to me.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., You are secure from me, so I will not harm you in the least.

verses.translation: Abraham said, “Peace be on you[1]. I will seek my Lord’s forgiveness for you. Indeed, He is Most Gracious to me.

verses.arabic: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: I will distance myself from you and from all that you supplicate besides Allah, and I will supplicate to my Lord; perhaps my supplication to my Lord will not go unanswered.”

verses.translation: I will distance myself from you and from all that you supplicate besides Allah, and I will supplicate to my Lord; perhaps my supplication to my Lord will not go unanswered.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: When he distanced himself from them and what they worshiped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made each one of them a prophet.

verses.translation: When he distanced himself from them and what they worshiped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made each one of them a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: We bestowed upon them of Our mercy and blessed them with a highly-esteemed reputation[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As part of the prayer, Muslims invoke Allah’s blessings upon Muhammad (ﷺ) and his family and Abraham (ﷺ) and his family, on a daily basis.

verses.translation: We bestowed upon them of Our mercy and blessed them with a highly-esteemed reputation[1].

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Moses. He was indeed a chosen one and was a messenger and a prophet[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] A messenger (rasūl) is one who was sent by Allah to reform society with a new law, such as Moses, Jesus, Muhammad, etc. A prophet (nabī) is one who is charged by Allah to reform society following the law of the messenger before him, such as Jacob, Isaac, Solomon, etc. Prophets are more numerous than messengers.

verses.translation: And mention in the Book [the story of] Moses. He was indeed a chosen one and was a messenger and a prophet[1].

verses.arabic: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: We called him from the right side of the Mount Tūr [in Sinai] and We brought him near by conversing with him in private.

verses.translation: We called him from the right side of the Mount Tūr [in Sinai] and We brought him near by conversing with him in private.

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: And We granted him, by Our mercy, his brother Aaron, as a prophet.

verses.translation: And We granted him, by Our mercy, his brother Aaron, as a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Ishmael. He was true to his promise and was a messenger and a prophet.

verses.translation: And mention in the Book [the story of] Ishmael. He was true to his promise and was a messenger and a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: He used to command his people to pray and give zakah, and his Lord was well pleased with him.

verses.translation: He used to command his people to pray and give zakah, and his Lord was well pleased with him.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Idrīs[1]. He was a man of truth and a prophet.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Prophet Enoch (عليه السلام).

verses.translation: And mention in the Book [the story of] Idrīs[1]. He was a man of truth and a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: And We raised him to a high status[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) met Prophet Idrīs (ﷺ) in the fourth heaven.

verses.translation: And We raised him to a high status[1].

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: These are the prophets whom Allah has favored from among the descendants of Adam, and from those whom We carried with Noah [in the Ark], and from the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and from those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the verses of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down in prostration, weeping.

verses.translation: These are the prophets whom Allah has favored from among the descendants of Adam, and from those whom We carried with Noah [in the Ark], and from the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and from those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the verses of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down in prostration, weeping.

verses.arabic: فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا

english_rwwad.text: But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and pursued their desires; so they will meet their doom[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a valley in Hell or the consequence of their evil deeds.

verses.translation: But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and pursued their desires; so they will meet their doom[1],

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا

english_rwwad.text: except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds – it is they who will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in the least.

verses.translation: except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds – it is they who will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in the least.

verses.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Gardens of Eternity which the Most Compassionate has promised His slaves who have not seen them. His promise will surely be fulfilled.

verses.translation: Gardens of Eternity which the Most Compassionate has promised His slaves who have not seen them. His promise will surely be fulfilled.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًا وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: They will not hear therein any idle talk, except greetings of peace, and they will have their provision morning and evening[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Whenever they wish in a successive manner, not that there will be days and nights, rather they will know the elapse of time through lights and illuminations.

verses.translation: They will not hear therein any idle talk, except greetings of peace, and they will have their provision morning and evening[1].

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Such is the Paradise which We will give as an inheritance to those of Our slaves who feared Allah.

verses.translation: Such is the Paradise which We will give as an inheritance to those of Our slaves who feared Allah.

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: [Gabriel said][1], “We do not descend except with the command of your Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us, all that is behind us, and all that is in between. Your Lord is never forgetful.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In reply to the Prophet’s wish that Gabriel would visit him more frequently.

verses.translation: [Gabriel said][1], “We do not descend except with the command of your Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us, all that is behind us, and all that is in between. Your Lord is never forgetful.

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. So worship Him and be constant in worshiping Him. Do you know anyone equal to Him?”

verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. So worship Him and be constant in worshiping Him. Do you know anyone equal to Him?”

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Man says, “Once I am dead, will I be raised to life again?”

verses.translation: Man says, “Once I am dead, will I be raised to life again?”

verses.arabic: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا

english_rwwad.text: Does man not remember that We created him beforehand when he was nothing?

verses.translation: Does man not remember that We created him beforehand when he was nothing?

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: By your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils, then We will surely bring them all around Hell on their knees[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., out of terror they will be on their knees or dragged unwillingly while on their knees.

verses.translation: By your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils, then We will surely bring them all around Hell on their knees[1].

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Then We will surely drag out of every group those who were most rebellious against the Most Compassionate.

verses.translation: Then We will surely drag out of every group those who were most rebellious against the Most Compassionate.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: For indeed We know best those who are most deserving to burn therein.

verses.translation: For indeed We know best those who are most deserving to burn therein.

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: There is none among you except that he will pass over it[1]; a decree from your Lord that must be fulfilled.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Referring to the bridge of As-Sirāt, which is placed over Hell. Everyone will pass on it. The believers will cross it easily, each according to their faith, whereas the disbelievers and the hypocrites will fall into the Fire from the bridge.

verses.translation: There is none among you except that he will pass over it[1]; a decree from your Lord that must be fulfilled.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: Then We will save those who fear Allah and will leave the wrongdoers in it on their knees.

verses.translation: Then We will save those who fear Allah and will leave the wrongdoers in it on their knees.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا

english_rwwad.text: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Which of the two parties is better in terms of dwellings and superior in social gatherings?”[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In regard to the life of this world.

verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Which of the two parties is better in terms of dwellings and superior in social gatherings?”[1]

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًا وَرِءْيًا

english_rwwad.text: How many generations We have destroyed before them who were superior in terms of wealth and outward appearance!

verses.translation: How many generations We have destroyed before them who were superior in terms of wealth and outward appearance!

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Whoever is following misguidance, the Most Compassionate will give him respite, until they see what they were warned of – be it the punishment [in this world] or the Hour – only then will they realize who is in a worse abode and who has a smaller following.”

verses.translation: Say, “Whoever is following misguidance, the Most Compassionate will give him respite, until they see what they were warned of – be it the punishment [in this world] or the Hour – only then will they realize who is in a worse abode and who has a smaller following.”

verses.arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا

english_rwwad.text: Allah increases in guidance those who are guided, and the righteous deeds of lasting merit are better with your Lord in reward and better in return.

verses.translation: Allah increases in guidance those who are guided, and the righteous deeds of lasting merit are better with your Lord in reward and better in return.

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Have you seen the one[1] who rejects Our verses and says, “I will surely be given wealth and children [if I am resurrected]?”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Al-‘Ās ibn Wāi’l, a staunch enemy of Islam in Makkah, not only disbelieved in resurrection; rather, he expected that he would be given wealth and children if resurrected.

verses.translation: Have you seen the one[1] who rejects Our verses and says, “I will surely be given wealth and children [if I am resurrected]?”

verses.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا

english_rwwad.text: Has he obtained knowledge of the unseen, or has he taken a pledge with the Most Compassionate?

verses.translation: Has he obtained knowledge of the unseen, or has he taken a pledge with the Most Compassionate?

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا

english_rwwad.text: Never! We will write down what he says and will prolong his punishment extensively.

verses.translation: Never! We will write down what he says and will prolong his punishment extensively.

verses.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا

english_rwwad.text: We will inherit what he boasts of[1], and he will come to Us all alone.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He is falsely aspiring for wealth and children in the Hereafter, not only Allah will not give him anything in the Hereafter; rather, He will seize what he owned in the worldly life at the time of his death.

verses.translation: We will inherit what he boasts of[1], and he will come to Us all alone.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا

english_rwwad.text: They have taken gods other than Allah, in order that they may protect them [from punishment].

verses.translation: They have taken gods other than Allah, in order that they may protect them [from punishment].

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا

english_rwwad.text: Never! They will deny their worship and will become their enemies.

verses.translation: Never! They will deny their worship and will become their enemies.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see that We sent devils against the disbelievers constantly inciting them to sin?

verses.translation: Do you not see that We sent devils against the disbelievers constantly inciting them to sin?

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا

english_rwwad.text: So do not be in haste about them; We are surely counting down their days[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., their breaths or evil deeds.

verses.translation: So do not be in haste about them; We are surely counting down their days[1].

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًا

english_rwwad.text: The Day when We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as honored guests,

verses.translation: The Day when We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as honored guests,

verses.arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا

english_rwwad.text: and We will drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd.

verses.translation: and We will drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا

english_rwwad.text: None will have the power to intercede except those who have taken permission from the Most Compassionate[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Through firmly believing in Him and worshiping Him alone.

verses.translation: None will have the power to intercede except those who have taken permission from the Most Compassionate[1].

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا

english_rwwad.text: They say, “The Most Compassionate has begotten a son.”

verses.translation: They say, “The Most Compassionate has begotten a son.”

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّا

english_rwwad.text: You have made a monstrous statement,

verses.translation: You have made a monstrous statement,

verses.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا

english_rwwad.text: at which the heavens are about to be torn apart, the earth split asunder, and the mountains tumble down.

verses.translation: at which the heavens are about to be torn apart, the earth split asunder, and the mountains tumble down.

verses.arabic: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًا

english_rwwad.text: because they have ascribed to the Most Compassionate a son.

verses.translation: because they have ascribed to the Most Compassionate a son.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا

english_rwwad.text: It is not appropriate for the Most Compassionate to beget a son.

verses.translation: It is not appropriate for the Most Compassionate to beget a son.

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًا

english_rwwad.text: There is none in the heavens and earth except that he will come to the Most Compassionate in full submission.

verses.translation: There is none in the heavens and earth except that he will come to the Most Compassionate in full submission.

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا

english_rwwad.text: He has counted them and numbered them precisely.

verses.translation: He has counted them and numbered them precisely.

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا

english_rwwad.text: Each one of them will come to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.

verses.translation: Each one of them will come to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا

english_rwwad.text: Those who believe and do righteous deeds, the Most Compassionate will endear them [to His creation][1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] And He will love them as well.

verses.translation: Those who believe and do righteous deeds, the Most Compassionate will endear them [to His creation][1].

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا

english_rwwad.text: We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your language so that you may give thereby glad tidings to the righteous and warn people who are contentious.

verses.translation: We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your language so that you may give thereby glad tidings to the righteous and warn people who are contentious.

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا

english_rwwad.text: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you sense a single one of them or even hear from them a whisper?

verses.translation: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you sense a single one of them or even hear from them a whisper?

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طه

english_rwwad.text: Tā Ha[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1

verses.translation: Tā Ha[1]

verses.arabic: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: We have not sent down the Qur’an to you [O Prophet] to cause you distress,

verses.translation: We have not sent down the Qur’an to you [O Prophet] to cause you distress,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: but as a reminder for those who fear Allah.

verses.translation: but as a reminder for those who fear Allah.

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى

english_rwwad.text: A revelation from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens.

verses.translation: A revelation from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens.

verses.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: The Most Compassionate rose over the Throne[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 7:54

verses.translation: The Most Compassionate rose over the Throne[1].

verses.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth, and all that is between them, and all that is beneath the soil.

verses.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth, and all that is between them, and all that is beneath the soil.

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى

english_rwwad.text: Whether you speak loudly [or not], He surely knows what is secret and what is even more hidden.

verses.translation: Whether you speak loudly [or not], He surely knows what is secret and what is even more hidden.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Allah – none has the right to be worshiped except Him. He has the Most Beautiful Names.

verses.translation: Allah – none has the right to be worshiped except Him. He has the Most Beautiful Names.

verses.arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: Has there come to you the story of Moses?

verses.translation: Has there come to you the story of Moses?

verses.arabic: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًى

english_rwwad.text: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Stay here. I have spotted a fire; I may bring you a flaming brand from it, or find some guidance at the fire[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They lost their way in the dark while traveling from Midian to Egypt.

verses.translation: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Stay here. I have spotted a fire; I may bring you a flaming brand from it, or find some guidance at the fire[1].”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: When he came to it, he was called, “O Moses,

verses.translation: When he came to it, he was called, “O Moses,

verses.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, I am your Lord, so take off your shoes; you are in the sacred valley of Tuwā.

verses.translation: Indeed, I am your Lord, so take off your shoes; you are in the sacred valley of Tuwā.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed:

verses.translation: I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed:

verses.arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ

english_rwwad.text: ‘Indeed, I am Allah; none has the right to be worshiped except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer to remember Me.

verses.translation: ‘Indeed, I am Allah; none has the right to be worshiped except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer to remember Me.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: The Hour is certainly coming, but I almost keep it hidden[1], so that every soul will be recompensed for what it strives.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah keeps its knowledge hidden from all except its portents which the believers know through the information provided by the Prophet (ﷺ).

verses.translation: The Hour is certainly coming, but I almost keep it hidden[1], so that every soul will be recompensed for what it strives.

verses.arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: So do not let those who disbelieve in it and follow their desires distract you from it[1], or you will perish.’”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or from preparation for the Hour.

verses.translation: So do not let those who disbelieve in it and follow their desires distract you from it[1], or you will perish.’”

verses.arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: What is that in your right hand, O Moses?”

verses.translation: What is that in your right hand, O Moses?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “It is my staff. I lean on it and beat down leaves with it for my sheep, and I have other uses for it.”[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Moses could only say, “A staff.” But he instead gave details about the staff, for he was interested in prolonging the conversation with Allah.

verses.translation: He said, “It is my staff. I lean on it and beat down leaves with it for my sheep, and I have other uses for it.”[1]

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Allah said, “Throw it down, O Moses!”

verses.translation: Allah said, “Throw it down, O Moses!”

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: He threw it down, and it suddenly became a slithering snake.

verses.translation: He threw it down, and it suddenly became a slithering snake.

verses.arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Allah said, “Pick it up and have no fear. We will restore it to its former state.

verses.translation: Allah said, “Pick it up and have no fear. We will restore it to its former state.

verses.arabic: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Put your hand under your armpit; it will come out shining white without blemish, as another sign[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Moses had dark skin, so putting his hand under his armpit and then taking it out shining white without blemish or disease was a real miraculous sign.

verses.translation: Put your hand under your armpit; it will come out shining white without blemish, as another sign[1],

verses.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى

english_rwwad.text: so that We may show you some of Our greatest signs.

verses.translation: so that We may show you some of Our greatest signs.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed all bounds.”

verses.translation: Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed all bounds.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى

english_rwwad.text: He said, “My Lord, reassure my heart for me,

verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, reassure my heart for me,

verses.arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى

english_rwwad.text: and ease my task for me,

verses.translation: and ease my task for me,

verses.arabic: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى

english_rwwad.text: and loosen the knot from my tongue[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] When Moses (ﷺ) was being tested by Pharaoh, he took an amber and put it in his mouth, which hindered his speech when he grew up. So, he asked Allah to help him overcome this hurdle, and Allah answered his prayer.

verses.translation: and loosen the knot from my tongue[1],

verses.arabic: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى

english_rwwad.text: so that they may understand my speech.

verses.translation: so that they may understand my speech.

verses.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِى

english_rwwad.text: And appoint for me a helper from my family,

verses.translation: And appoint for me a helper from my family,

verses.arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى

english_rwwad.text: Aaron, my brother.

verses.translation: Aaron, my brother.

verses.arabic: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى

english_rwwad.text: Increase my strength through him,

verses.translation: Increase my strength through him,

verses.arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى

english_rwwad.text: and let him share my task,

verses.translation: and let him share my task,

verses.arabic: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: so that we may glorify You much,

verses.translation: so that we may glorify You much,

verses.arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: and remember You much.

verses.translation: and remember You much.

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: For indeed You are All-Watchful over us.”

verses.translation: For indeed You are All-Watchful over us.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Allah said, “You are granted your request, O Moses.

verses.translation: Allah said, “You are granted your request, O Moses.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: And We had already conferred favor upon you before,

verses.translation: And We had already conferred favor upon you before,

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: when We inspired your mother with what was inspired, [saying],

verses.translation: when We inspired your mother with what was inspired, [saying],

verses.arabic: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُۥ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ

english_rwwad.text: ‘Put him into the casket, then cast it into the river. The river will carry it to the shore, and he will be picked up by one who is an enemy to Me and enemy to him.’ I bestowed upon you love from Myself[1] so that you would be brought up under My [watchful] Eye.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah put his love into the hearts of people, so Pharaoh and his wife accepted to keep him or adopt him as a son when he was still a baby.

verses.translation: ‘Put him into the casket, then cast it into the river. The river will carry it to the shore, and he will be picked up by one who is an enemy to Me and enemy to him.’ I bestowed upon you love from Myself[1] so that you would be brought up under My [watchful] Eye.

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًا فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: When your sister was going along and said, ‘Shall I show you someone who will nurse him?’ Thus We brought you back to your mother, so that she may rejoice and not grieve[1]. Then you killed a man [by mistake][2], but We saved you from distress, and We put you through several trials. You stayed among the people of Midian for several years, then you came [here] at a destined time, O Moses.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Because Moses had refused all wet-nurses who were brought to nurse him beforehand.
 [2] The Coptic person died after Moses struck him.

verses.translation: When your sister was going along and said, ‘Shall I show you someone who will nurse him?’ Thus We brought you back to your mother, so that she may rejoice and not grieve[1]. Then you killed a man [by mistake][2], but We saved you from distress, and We put you through several trials. You stayed among the people of Midian for several years, then you came [here] at a destined time, O Moses.

verses.arabic: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى

english_rwwad.text: I have chosen you for Myself.

verses.translation: I have chosen you for Myself.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى

english_rwwad.text: Go forth, you and your brother, with My signs, and do not slacken in remembering Me.

verses.translation: Go forth, you and your brother, with My signs, and do not slacken in remembering Me.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has certainly transgressed all bounds.

verses.translation: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has certainly transgressed all bounds.

verses.arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: But speak to him gently, so that he may take heed or fear Allah.”

verses.translation: But speak to him gently, so that he may take heed or fear Allah.”

verses.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “Our Lord, we fear that he may hasten to punish us or transgress all bounds.”

verses.translation: They said, “Our Lord, we fear that he may hasten to punish us or transgress all bounds.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Do not be afraid; I am with you both, hearing and seeing.

verses.translation: He said, “Do not be afraid; I am with you both, hearing and seeing.

verses.arabic: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: So go to him and say, ‘We are both messengers from your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us and do not oppress them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord, and peace[1] be upon he who follows the true guidance.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., safety from the punishment of Allah.

verses.translation: So go to him and say, ‘We are both messengers from your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us and do not oppress them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord, and peace[1] be upon he who follows the true guidance.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: It has been revealed to us that the punishment awaits those who reject [the truth] and turn away.’”

verses.translation: It has been revealed to us that the punishment awaits those who reject [the truth] and turn away.’”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Pharaoh said, “So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?”

verses.translation: Pharaoh said, “So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Our Lord is the One Who gave everything its form and then guided it.”

verses.translation: He said, “Our Lord is the One Who gave everything its form and then guided it.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
