english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Hereafter.

verses.translation: when the True Promise[1] draws near, the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in horror, [saying], “Woe to us! We were indeed heedless of this; nay, we were wrongdoers.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, you and all that you worship besides Allah will be the fuel for Hell; you will surely enter it.

verses.translation: Indeed, you and all that you worship besides Allah will be the fuel for Hell; you will surely enter it.

verses.arabic: لَوْ كَانَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If these [idols] had truly been gods, they would not have entered it. But they will all abide therein forever.

verses.translation: If these [idols] had truly been gods, they would not have entered it. But they will all abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will groan therein with anguish, and they will not be able to hear anything.

verses.translation: They will groan therein with anguish, and they will not be able to hear anything.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But those for whom We have decreed the finest reward, they will be far away from it.

verses.translation: But those for whom We have decreed the finest reward, they will be far away from it.

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَٰلِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will not hear its slightest hissing, and they will abide forever in whatever their souls desire.

verses.translation: They will not hear its slightest hissing, and they will abide forever in whatever their souls desire.

verses.arabic: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ هَٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will not be grieved by the Greatest Terror[1], and the angels will receive them [saying], “This is your Day that you were promised”.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the events of the Day of Resurrection.

verses.translation: They will not be grieved by the Greatest Terror[1], and the angels will receive them [saying], “This is your Day that you were promised”.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when We roll up the heavens like a scroll of records. Just as We originated the first creation, so We will bring it back. That is Our binding promise, which We will surely do.

verses.translation: On the Day when We roll up the heavens like a scroll of records. Just as We originated the first creation, so We will bring it back. That is Our binding promise, which We will surely do.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We have written in the Psalms[1] after the Preserved Record[2], that the land will be inherited by My righteous slaves.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the Scriptures.
 [2] i.e., after inscribing it in al-Lawh al-Mahfūz.

verses.translation: We have written in the Psalms[1] after the Preserved Record[2], that the land will be inherited by My righteous slaves.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَٰبِدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there is a message in this [Qur’an] for devoted worshipers.

verses.translation: Indeed, there is a message in this [Qur’an] for devoted worshipers.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a mercy to the worlds.

verses.translation: We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a mercy to the worlds.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “It is only revealed to me that your God is only One God; will you then submit to Him?

verses.translation: Say, “It is only revealed to me that your God is only One God; will you then submit to Him?

verses.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But if they turn away, say, “I have proclaimed the message to you all alike[1], and I do not know whether what you are warned of[2] is near or far.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., We and you know that there is no peace between us.
 [2] i.e., the punishment.

verses.translation: But if they turn away, say, “I have proclaimed the message to you all alike[1], and I do not know whether what you are warned of[2] is near or far.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, He knows what is said openly and knows what you conceal.

verses.translation: Indeed, He knows what is said openly and knows what you conceal.

verses.arabic: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: I do not know; perhaps this [delay][1] is a test for you[2] and an enjoyment for a while.”
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., this postponement of punishment.
 [2] To increase sin.

verses.translation: I do not know; perhaps this [delay][1] is a test for you[2] and an enjoyment for a while.”

verses.arabic: قَٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [The Prophet] said, “My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. Our Lord is the Most Compassionate Whose help is to be sought against what you describe[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., of lies and disbelief.

verses.translation: [The Prophet] said, “My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. Our Lord is the Most Compassionate Whose help is to be sought against what you describe[1].”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَىْءٌ عَظِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: O people, fear your Lord; the earthquake of the Hour is something dreadful.

verses.translation: O people, fear your Lord; the earthquake of the Hour is something dreadful.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلنَّاسَ سُكَٰرَىٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَٰرَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ ٱللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when you see it, every nursing mother will abandon her baby, and every pregnant woman will miscarry. You will see people as though they are drunk, while they are not drunk, but the punishment of Allah is severe.

verses.translation: On the Day when you see it, every nursing mother will abandon her baby, and every pregnant woman will miscarry. You will see people as though they are drunk, while they are not drunk, but the punishment of Allah is severe.

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَٰنٍ مَّرِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: There are some people who dispute concerning Allah without knowledge, and they follow every rebellious devil.

verses.translation: There are some people who dispute concerning Allah without knowledge, and they follow every rebellious devil.

verses.arabic: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُۥ يُضِلُّهُۥ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

english_rwwad.text: It has been decreed that whoever takes him as an ally, he will misguide him and lead him to the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

verses.translation: It has been decreed that whoever takes him as an ally, he will misguide him and lead him to the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍ مِّنَ ٱلْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ وَنُقِرُّ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنۢبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ

english_rwwad.text: O people, if you are in doubt concerning the Resurrection, then We surely created you[1] from dust, then from a drop of sperm[2], then from a clot[3], then from a lump of flesh[4] – formed or unformed[5] – so that We may make it clear to you [Our power]. We settle in the wombs whatever We will for an appointed term. Then We bring you out as infants, then [We nurture you] so that you may reach your maturity. Then some of you die, while others are left to reach decrepit old age so that they may know nothing after having knowledge. You see the land lifeless, then as soon as We send down rain on it, it stirs and swells to life and brings forth every type of pleasant plant.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Your father, Adam.
 [2] Nutfah: zygote, which is resulted from the union of male and female gametes (sperm and egg).
 [3] ‘Alaqah: a clinging clot, which resembles a leech.
 [4] Mudghah: a chewed piece of meat.
 [5] i.e., formed ending into a healthy embryo, or defective ending in miscarriage.

verses.translation: O people, if you are in doubt concerning the Resurrection, then We surely created you[1] from dust, then from a drop of sperm[2], then from a clot[3], then from a lump of flesh[4] – formed or unformed[5] – so that We may make it clear to you [Our power]. We settle in the wombs whatever We will for an appointed term. Then We bring you out as infants, then [We nurture you] so that you may reach your maturity. Then some of you die, while others are left to reach decrepit old age so that they may know nothing after having knowledge. You see the land lifeless, then as soon as We send down rain on it, it stirs and swells to life and brings forth every type of pleasant plant.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: That is because Allah is the Truth; He alone gives life to the dead, and He is the Most Capable of all things.

verses.translation: That is because Allah is the Truth; He alone gives life to the dead, and He is the Most Capable of all things.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

english_rwwad.text: The Hour is certainly coming; there is no doubt about it, and Allah will surely resurrect those who are in the graves.

verses.translation: The Hour is certainly coming; there is no doubt about it, and Allah will surely resurrect those who are in the graves.

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَٰبٍ مُّنِيرٍ

english_rwwad.text: There are some people who argue about Allah without knowledge, guidance or an enlightening scripture.

verses.translation: There are some people who argue about Allah without knowledge, guidance or an enlightening scripture.

verses.arabic: ثَانِىَ عِطْفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ

english_rwwad.text: They turn their faces away [in arrogance] to lead people away from Allah’s way. For them there will be disgrace in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection We will make them taste the punishment of the burning fire.

verses.translation: They turn their faces away [in arrogance] to lead people away from Allah’s way. For them there will be disgrace in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection We will make them taste the punishment of the burning fire.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: “This is because of what your hands have sent forth, and Allah is not unjust to His slaves.”

verses.translation: “This is because of what your hands have sent forth, and Allah is not unjust to His slaves.”

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيْرٌ ٱطْمَأَنَّ بِهِۦ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

english_rwwad.text: There are some people who worship Allah on the edge [of faith][1]: if something good comes to them, they are content; but if they are afflicted with a trial, they turn back[2], thus losing both this world and the Hereafter. That is the evident loss.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., with uncertainty, hypocrisy, or heedlessness.
 [2] lit., they tumble on their faces, i.e., turn back to disbelief.

verses.translation: There are some people who worship Allah on the edge [of faith][1]: if something good comes to them, they are content; but if they are afflicted with a trial, they turn back[2], thus losing both this world and the Hereafter. That is the evident loss.

verses.arabic: يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُۥ وَمَا لَا يَنفَعُهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ

english_rwwad.text: They invoke besides Allah what can neither harm nor benefit them. That is the farthest misguidance.

verses.translation: They invoke besides Allah what can neither harm nor benefit them. That is the farthest misguidance.

verses.arabic: يَدْعُوا۟ لَمَن ضَرُّهُۥٓ أَقْرَبُ مِن نَّفْعِهِۦ لَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْعَشِيرُ

english_rwwad.text: They invoke those whose harm is more likely than their benefit. What a terrible protector and what a terrible associate!

verses.translation: They invoke those whose harm is more likely than their benefit. What a terrible protector and what a terrible associate!

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ

english_rwwad.text: Allah will surely admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens under which rivers flow. Allah surely does what He wills.

verses.translation: Allah will surely admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens under which rivers flow. Allah surely does what He wills.

verses.arabic: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُ

english_rwwad.text: Whoever thinks that Allah will never help His Prophet in this world and the Hereafter, let him stretch out a rope to the ceiling and strangle himself, then let him see if his effort can remove what enrages him[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Allah will never stop supporting His Prophet (ﷺ), no matter what the disbelievers do.

verses.translation: Whoever thinks that Allah will never help His Prophet in this world and the Hereafter, let him stretch out a rope to the ceiling and strangle himself, then let him see if his effort can remove what enrages him[1].

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يُرِيدُ

english_rwwad.text: This is how We sent down this [Qur’an] as clear verses, and Allah guides whom He wills.

verses.translation: This is how We sent down this [Qur’an] as clear verses, and Allah guides whom He wills.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلْمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, those who believe, those who are Jews, the Sabians, the Christians, the Magians[1] and those who associate partners with Allah – Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection; Allah is Witness over all things.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Zoroastrians; fire-worshippers.

verses.translation: Indeed, those who believe, those who are Jews, the Sabians, the Christians, the Magians[1] and those who associate partners with Allah – Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection; Allah is Witness over all things.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ وَٱلنُّجُومُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ وَٱلدَّوَآبُّ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَمَن يُهِنِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّكْرِمٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see that to Allah prostrate[1] all those who are in the heavens and all those on earth, as well as the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures, and many humans? But there are many to whom the punishment has become due[2]. Whoever Allah disgraces, none can honor him. Allah surely does what He wills.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., they prostrate to Allah in a real manner befitting each of them, the nature of which is known only to Him.
 [2] Because they refused to worship Allah and submit to His commands.

verses.translation: Do you not see that to Allah prostrate[1] all those who are in the heavens and all those on earth, as well as the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures, and many humans? But there are many to whom the punishment has become due[2]. Whoever Allah disgraces, none can honor him. Allah surely does what He wills.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ ٱخْتَصَمُوا۟ فِى رَبِّهِمْ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِّن نَّارٍ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: These are two opponents[1] who are in dispute about their Lord. As for the disbelievers, garments of Fire will be tailored for them, and scalding water will be poured over their heads,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the believers and the disbelievers.

verses.translation: These are two opponents[1] who are in dispute about their Lord. As for the disbelievers, garments of Fire will be tailored for them, and scalding water will be poured over their heads,

verses.arabic: يُصْهَرُ بِهِۦ مَا فِى بُطُونِهِمْ وَٱلْجُلُودُ

english_rwwad.text: melting all that is in their bellies and their skins.

verses.translation: melting all that is in their bellies and their skins.

verses.arabic: وَلَهُم مَّقَٰمِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: And for [striking] them there will be maces of iron.

verses.translation: And for [striking] them there will be maces of iron.

verses.arabic: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ

english_rwwad.text: Every time, in their anguish, they try to get out of it, they will be forced back into it, “Taste the burning punishment!”

verses.translation: Every time, in their anguish, they try to get out of it, they will be forced back into it, “Taste the burning punishment!”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Allah will surely admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens under which rivers flow. They will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments will be of silk.

verses.translation: Allah will surely admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens under which rivers flow. They will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments will be of silk.

verses.arabic: وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: They were guided to the best of words[1] and they were guided to the praiseworthy path[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the testimony of faith, extolling and praising Allah.
 [2] i.e., Islam.

verses.translation: They were guided to the best of words[1] and they were guided to the praiseworthy path[2].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلْنَٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً ٱلْعَٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَٱلْبَادِ وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who disbelieve and prevent people from Allah’s way and from the Sacred Mosque[1] – which We have made for all people, residents and visitors alike – and whoever intends to deviate therein[2] by evildoing, We will cause him to taste a painful punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] In Makkah.
 [2] As the Sacred Mosque is unique, so mere intention of sin therein is sufficient to bring Allah's punishment.

verses.translation: As for those who disbelieve and prevent people from Allah’s way and from the Sacred Mosque[1] – which We have made for all people, residents and visitors alike – and whoever intends to deviate therein[2] by evildoing, We will cause him to taste a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ ٱلْبَيْتِ أَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِى شَيْـًٔا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْقَآئِمِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when We showed to Abraham the site of the House [Ka‘bah], “Do not associate anything with Me, and purify My House for those who circumambulate it, and those who stand up in prayer, and those who bow and prostrate.

verses.translation: And [remember] when We showed to Abraham the site of the House [Ka‘bah], “Do not associate anything with Me, and purify My House for those who circumambulate it, and those who stand up in prayer, and those who bow and prostrate.

verses.arabic: وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ

english_rwwad.text: And proclaim the pilgrimage to all people; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel from every distant pathway,

verses.translation: And proclaim the pilgrimage to all people; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel from every distant pathway,

verses.arabic: لِّيَشْهَدُوا۟ مَنَٰفِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ مَّعْلُومَٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْبَآئِسَ ٱلْفَقِيرَ

english_rwwad.text: so that they may attain benefits[1], and pronounce Allah’s name during the appointed days over the sacrificial animals[2] that He has provided for them; then eat from it and feed the desperately poor.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Spiritual benefits such as getting rewards and forgiveness of sins, as well as worldly benefits such as witnessing the unity of Muslims, trading and etc.
 [2] An‘ām: such as camels, cattle, sheep and goats.

verses.translation: so that they may attain benefits[1], and pronounce Allah’s name during the appointed days over the sacrificial animals[2] that He has provided for them; then eat from it and feed the desperately poor.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا۟ تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا۟ نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا۟ بِٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ

english_rwwad.text: Then let them complete their rites, fulfill their vows, and circumambulate the Ancient House [Ka‘bah].”

verses.translation: Then let them complete their rites, fulfill their vows, and circumambulate the Ancient House [Ka‘bah].”

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ وَأُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلرِّجْسَ مِنَ ٱلْأَوْثَٰنِ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ قَوْلَ ٱلزُّورِ

english_rwwad.text: Such [is the pilgrimage]; whoever honors the sacred rituals of Allah, it is best for him with his Lord. All sacrificial animals have been made lawful for you except what is recited to you[1]. So shun the impurity of idolatry and shun the words of falsehood.

verses.translation: Such [is the pilgrimage]; whoever honors the sacred rituals of Allah, it is best for him with his Lord. All sacrificial animals have been made lawful for you except what is recited to you[1]. So shun the impurity of idolatry and shun the words of falsehood.

verses.arabic: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِۦ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِى بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ

english_rwwad.text: Be exclusively devoted to Allah, associating no partners with Him. Whoever associates partners with Allah, it is as if he has fallen from the sky and has been snatched away by birds or swept away by the wind to a far-off place.

verses.translation: Be exclusively devoted to Allah, associating no partners with Him. Whoever associates partners with Allah, it is as if he has fallen from the sky and has been snatched away by birds or swept away by the wind to a far-off place.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى ٱلْقُلُوبِ

english_rwwad.text: This is so. And whoever honors the rituals of Allah, it is from the piety of the hearts.

verses.translation: This is so. And whoever honors the rituals of Allah, it is from the piety of the hearts.

verses.arabic: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ

english_rwwad.text: There are benefits for you in these [sacrificial animals] for an appointed term[1], then their place of sacrifice is near the Ancient House[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Such as milking and riding them until the time of sacrifice.
 [2] i.e., within the precincts of the Haram, which includes Mina.

verses.translation: There are benefits for you in these [sacrificial animals] for an appointed term[1], then their place of sacrifice is near the Ancient House[2].

verses.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا لِّيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ فَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلِمُوا۟ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُخْبِتِينَ

english_rwwad.text: For every community We ordained rites of sacrifice[1] so that they may mention the name of Allah over the sacrificial animals that He has provided for them. Your God is One God, so submit to Him alone, and give glad tidings to the humble,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Rites of sacrifice have always been part of Allah's religion.

verses.translation: For every community We ordained rites of sacrifice[1] so that they may mention the name of Allah over the sacrificial animals that He has provided for them. Your God is One God, so submit to Him alone, and give glad tidings to the humble,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ وَٱلْمُقِيمِى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those whose hearts are filled with awe when Allah is mentioned, and those who patiently endure whatever may befall them, and who establish prayer and spend out of what We have provided for them.

verses.translation: those whose hearts are filled with awe when Allah is mentioned, and those who patiently endure whatever may befall them, and who establish prayer and spend out of what We have provided for them.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَآفَّ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْقَانِعَ وَٱلْمُعْتَرَّ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We have ordained the sacrificial camels [and cattle] among the rituals of Allah, in which there is much good for you. So mention the name of Allah over them when they are lined up, then when they fall down on their sides, eat of them and feed those [poor] who do not beg and those who do. Thus We have made them subservient to you, so that you may be grateful.

verses.translation: We have ordained the sacrificial camels [and cattle] among the rituals of Allah, in which there is much good for you. So mention the name of Allah over them when they are lined up, then when they fall down on their sides, eat of them and feed those [poor] who do not beg and those who do. Thus We have made them subservient to you, so that you may be grateful.

verses.arabic: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: It is neither their flesh nor their blood that reaches Allah, but it is your piety that reaches Him. This is how He has subjected them to you, so that you may proclaim Allah’s greatness for having guided you. And give glad tidings to those who do good.

verses.translation: It is neither their flesh nor their blood that reaches Allah, but it is your piety that reaches Him. This is how He has subjected them to you, so that you may proclaim Allah’s greatness for having guided you. And give glad tidings to those who do good.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, Allah defends those who believe, and Allah does not like anyone who is treacherous and ungrateful.

verses.translation: Indeed, Allah defends those who believe, and Allah does not like anyone who is treacherous and ungrateful.

verses.arabic: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا۟ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Permission [to fight] is given to those who are attacked[1] because they were oppressed, and Allah is indeed Most Capable of granting them victory,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] it is referring to the Prophet's Companions.

verses.translation: Permission [to fight] is given to those who are attacked[1] because they were oppressed, and Allah is indeed Most Capable of granting them victory,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوَٰتٌ وَمَسَٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

english_rwwad.text: those who have been driven out of their homes for no reason other than they say, “Our Lord is Allah.” If Allah were not to repel some people by means of others, monasteries, churches, synagogues and mosques wherein the name of Allah is often mentioned, would surely have been demolished. Allah surely helps those who stand up for His cause. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.

verses.translation: those who have been driven out of their homes for no reason other than they say, “Our Lord is Allah.” If Allah were not to repel some people by means of others, monasteries, churches, synagogues and mosques wherein the name of Allah is often mentioned, would surely have been demolished. Allah surely helps those who stand up for His cause. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا۟ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا۟ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ

english_rwwad.text: It is those who, if We give them power in the land, they establish prayer and give zakah, and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allah belongs the outcome of all matters.

verses.translation: It is those who, if We give them power in the land, they establish prayer and give zakah, and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allah belongs the outcome of all matters.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَثَمُودُ

english_rwwad.text: If they reject you [O Prophet], the people of Noah, ‘Ād and Thamūd before them also rejected [their prophets],

verses.translation: If they reject you [O Prophet], the people of Noah, ‘Ād and Thamūd before them also rejected [their prophets],

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ

english_rwwad.text: as did the people of Abraham and the people of Lot,

verses.translation: as did the people of Abraham and the people of Lot,

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ مَدْيَنَ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

english_rwwad.text: and the people of Midian. And Moses was [also] rejected. But I gave respite to the disbelievers, then I seized them. How severe was My response!

verses.translation: and the people of Midian. And Moses was [also] rejected. But I gave respite to the disbelievers, then I seized them. How severe was My response!

verses.arabic: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَّشِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: How many towns We have destroyed for their persistent wrongdoing, leaving them in total ruin[1]; their wells abandoned and their lofty palaces deserted!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Lit., "fallen upon its roofs," i.e., after the roofs of their buildings had caved in, the walls collapsed over them.

verses.translation: How many towns We have destroyed for their persistent wrongdoing, leaving them in total ruin[1]; their wells abandoned and their lofty palaces deserted!

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ

english_rwwad.text: Have they not traveled through the land so that their hearts might understand and their ears might listen? It is not the eyes that turn blind, but it is the hearts within the breasts that turn blind.

verses.translation: Have they not traveled through the land so that their hearts might understand and their ears might listen? It is not the eyes that turn blind, but it is the hearts within the breasts that turn blind.

verses.arabic: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ

english_rwwad.text: They ask you to hasten the punishment, but Allah will not fail in His promise. A single day with your Lord is like one thousand years by your count.

verses.translation: They ask you to hasten the punishment, but Allah will not fail in His promise. A single day with your Lord is like one thousand years by your count.

verses.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

english_rwwad.text: How many towns did I give respite when they were wrongdoers, and then I seized them. And to Me is the final return.

verses.translation: How many towns did I give respite when they were wrongdoers, and then I seized them. And to Me is the final return.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “O people, I am only sent to you as a clear warner.

verses.translation: Say, “O people, I am only sent to you as a clear warner.

verses.arabic: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and a generous provision.

verses.translation: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and a generous provision.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْا۟ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: But those who strive to discredit Our verses[1], they are the people of the Blazing Fire.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In order to defeat the Prophet (ﷺ).

verses.translation: But those who strive to discredit Our verses[1], they are the people of the Blazing Fire.”

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: We did not send any messenger or prophet before you except that when he recited, Satan would cast into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allah would abolish what Satan casts, then Allah would confirm His verses[1], for Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By clarifying those misunderstood issues, thus removing thereby any doubt.

verses.translation: We did not send any messenger or prophet before you except that when he recited, Satan would cast into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allah would abolish what Satan casts, then Allah would confirm His verses[1], for Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.arabic: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: [That is] so that He may make what Satan casts a trial for those [hypocrites] whose hearts are sick[1] and those [disbelievers] whose hearts are hardened, for indeed the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:10.

verses.translation: [That is] so that He may make what Satan casts a trial for those [hypocrites] whose hearts are sick[1] and those [disbelievers] whose hearts are hardened, for indeed the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.

verses.arabic: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: And so that those who were given knowledge may know that this [Qur’an] is the truth from your Lord, so they may believe in it and their hearts may become humbled to it. Allah surely guides those who believe to the straight path.

verses.translation: And so that those who were given knowledge may know that this [Qur’an] is the truth from your Lord, so they may believe in it and their hearts may become humbled to it. Allah surely guides those who believe to the straight path.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Yet the disbelievers will persist in doubt about it until the Hour comes upon them suddenly or there comes upon them the punishment of a barren Day[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Day of Resurrection is described here as ‘aqīm (barren), for it will terminate all forms of life on earth and no new day will be born thereafter.

verses.translation: Yet the disbelievers will persist in doubt about it until the Hour comes upon them suddenly or there comes upon them the punishment of a barren Day[1].

verses.arabic: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: The sovereignty on that Day belongs to Allah[1]; He will judge between them, then those who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Bliss.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah gives authority to some of His slaves in this world, but in the Hereafter none will have any authority except Him.

verses.translation: The sovereignty on that Day belongs to Allah[1]; He will judge between them, then those who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Bliss.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: But those who disbelieve and reject Our verses, for them there will be a humiliating punishment.

verses.translation: But those who disbelieve and reject Our verses, for them there will be a humiliating punishment.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓا۟ أَوْ مَاتُوا۟ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who emigrate in the cause of Allah and are killed or died, Allah will surely give them a goodly provision. Indeed, Allah is the Best of Providers.

verses.translation: As for those who emigrate in the cause of Allah and are killed or died, Allah will surely give them a goodly provision. Indeed, Allah is the Best of Providers.

verses.arabic: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًا يَرْضَوْنَهُۥ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: He will surely admit them to a place that they will be pleased with, and Allah is surely All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.

verses.translation: He will surely admit them to a place that they will be pleased with, and Allah is surely All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ

english_rwwad.text: That is[1] so. Whoever retaliates against an aggressive act with its like and is wronged again, Allah will surely help him. Indeed, Allah is Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Allah's admitting of the Companions into Paradise.
 [2] In spite of His ability to take revenge, the verse contains a suggestion that the believers pardon and forgive as well.

verses.translation: That is[1] so. Whoever retaliates against an aggressive act with its like and is wronged again, Allah will surely help him. Indeed, Allah is Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving[2].

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: That is[1] because it is Allah Who causes the night to merge into the day, and causes the day to merge into the night. And Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Allah's capability to give assistance or victory to the oppressed.

verses.translation: That is[1] because it is Allah Who causes the night to merge into the day, and causes the day to merge into the night. And Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

english_rwwad.text: That is[1] because it is Allah Who is the Truth and whatever they invoke besides Him is falsehood, and it is Allah Who is the Most High, the Most Great.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Allah's merging of the night into the day and the day into the night.

verses.translation: That is[1] because it is Allah Who is the Truth and whatever they invoke besides Him is falsehood, and it is Allah Who is the Most High, the Most Great.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَتُصْبِحُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky whereupon the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allah is Most Subtle, All-Aware[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of His creation and of the needs of His creatures.

verses.translation: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky whereupon the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allah is Most Subtle, All-Aware[1].

verses.arabic: لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

english_rwwad.text: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth, and indeed it is Allah Who is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.

verses.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth, and indeed it is Allah Who is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَيُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see that Allah has subjected to you all that is on the earth and the ships that sail through the sea by His command? He holds the sky from falling down on the earth except by His permission. Indeed, Allah is Ever Gracious and Most Merciful to people.

verses.translation: Do you not see that Allah has subjected to you all that is on the earth and the ships that sail through the sea by His command? He holds the sky from falling down on the earth except by His permission. Indeed, Allah is Ever Gracious and Most Merciful to people.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who gave you life, then will cause you to die, then He will bring you back to life. Indeed, man is ever ungrateful.

verses.translation: It is He Who gave you life, then will cause you to die, then He will bring you back to life. Indeed, man is ever ungrateful.

verses.arabic: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ فَلَا يُنَٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: For every community We ordained ways[1] of worship which they follow, so do not let them dispute with you [O Prophet] in this matter. But call them to your Lord, for you are indeed on the straight guidance.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] All prophets came with the same message of worshiping only One God, doing good and shunning evil; nonetheless, each faith-community had their own law.

verses.translation: For every community We ordained ways[1] of worship which they follow, so do not let them dispute with you [O Prophet] in this matter. But call them to your Lord, for you are indeed on the straight guidance.

verses.arabic: وَإِن جَٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And if they argue with you, say, “Allah knows best what you are doing.”

verses.translation: And if they argue with you, say, “Allah knows best what you are doing.”

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ.

verses.translation: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَٰبٍ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Do you not know that Allah knows all that is in heaven and on earth? That is all [written] in a Record[1]. This is indeed easy for Allah.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Preserved Tablet (al-Lawh al-Mahfūz).

verses.translation: Do you not know that Allah knows all that is in heaven and on earth? That is all [written] in a Record[1]. This is indeed easy for Allah.

verses.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ

english_rwwad.text: Yet they worship other than Allah that for which He has not sent down any authority, and of which they have no knowledge. The wrongdoers will have no helper.

verses.translation: Yet they worship other than Allah that for which He has not sent down any authority, and of which they have no knowledge. The wrongdoers will have no helper.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

english_rwwad.text: When Our verses are recited to them clearly, you notice disgust on the faces of the disbelievers, as if they are about to attack those who recite Our verses to them. Say, “Shall I inform you of something worse than what you feel at present[1]? It is the Fire! Allah has promised it to those who disbelieve; what a terrible destination!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., worse than the rage you feel against the believers who recite Allah's verses or your threats against them.

verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to them clearly, you notice disgust on the faces of the disbelievers, as if they are about to attack those who recite Our verses to them. Say, “Shall I inform you of something worse than what you feel at present[1]? It is the Fire! Allah has promised it to those who disbelieve; what a terrible destination!

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ

english_rwwad.text: O people, a similitude is set forth, so listen to it: those whom you invoke besides Allah can never create even a fly, even if they all come together for that. And if a fly snatches something away from them, they cannot retrieve it. How feeble is the invoker as well as the invoked[1]!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., How feeble are the seekers of the fly and how feeble is the fly!

verses.translation: O people, a similitude is set forth, so listen to it: those whom you invoke besides Allah can never create even a fly, even if they all come together for that. And if a fly snatches something away from them, they cannot retrieve it. How feeble is the invoker as well as the invoked[1]!

verses.arabic: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

english_rwwad.text: They have not revered Allah the reverence He deserves[1]. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Because they worshiped others besides Him Almighty.

verses.translation: They have not revered Allah the reverence He deserves[1]. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Allah chooses messengers from the angels and from mankind. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

verses.translation: Allah chooses messengers from the angels and from mankind. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ

english_rwwad.text: He knows all that is ahead of them and all that is behind them[1], and to Allah returns all matters.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah's knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.

verses.translation: He knows all that is ahead of them and all that is behind them[1], and to Allah returns all matters.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱفْعَلُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, bow down and prostrate, worship Your Lord and do good, so that you may succeed.

verses.translation: O you who believe, bow down and prostrate, worship Your Lord and do good, so that you may succeed.

verses.arabic: وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ

english_rwwad.text: Strive in the cause of Allah in a due manner. He has chosen you and has not imposed upon you any hardship in religion – the faith of your father Abraham. He named you as Muslims earlier and in this [Qur’an] so that the Messenger might be a witness over you and you might be witnesses over mankind. So establish prayer, give zakah, and hold fast to Allah, for He is your Protector; what an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper!

verses.translation: Strive in the cause of Allah in a due manner. He has chosen you and has not imposed upon you any hardship in religion – the faith of your father Abraham. He named you as Muslims earlier and in this [Qur’an] so that the Messenger might be a witness over you and you might be witnesses over mankind. So establish prayer, give zakah, and hold fast to Allah, for He is your Protector; what an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper!

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: The believers have attained true success:

verses.translation: The believers have attained true success:

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَٰشِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those who humble themselves in their prayers,

verses.translation: those who humble themselves in their prayers,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and those who turn away from all that is vain,

verses.translation: and those who turn away from all that is vain,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and those who give zakah[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Zakah (lit.,) purification and growth. Paying alms purifies and increases wealth.

verses.translation: and those who give zakah[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and those who guard their sexual desires[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., illegal sexual acts.

verses.translation: and those who guard their sexual desires[1],

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except with their wives or slave women they may own, for then they are free of blame.

verses.translation: except with their wives or slave women they may own, for then they are free of blame.

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But whoever seeks anything beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.

verses.translation: But whoever seeks anything beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And those who are faithful to their trusts and pledges,

verses.translation: And those who are faithful to their trusts and pledges,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and those who properly observe their prayers.

verses.translation: and those who properly observe their prayers.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Such will be the inheritors,

verses.translation: Such will be the inheritors,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: who will inherit Paradise[1]; they will abide therein forever.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Al-Firdaws: the highest rank in Paradise.

verses.translation: who will inherit Paradise[1]; they will abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: We created man[1] from an extract of clay,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Adam (عليه السلام).

verses.translation: We created man[1] from an extract of clay,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: then We placed him as a sperm-drop[1] in a safe place,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a zygote.

verses.translation: then We placed him as a sperm-drop[1] in a safe place,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: then We made the sperm drop into a clinging clot, then We made the clinging clot into a lump, then We made the lump into bones, and We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We developed it into another creation[1]. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] After breathing the spirit into the embryo.

verses.translation: then We made the sperm drop into a clinging clot, then We made the clinging clot into a lump, then We made the lump into bones, and We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We developed it into another creation[1]. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then after that you will surely die,

verses.translation: Then after that you will surely die,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: then on the Day of Resurrection, you will surely be resurrected.

verses.translation: then on the Day of Resurrection, you will surely be resurrected.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We have created above you seven levels [of heaven], and We have never been unaware of Our creation.

verses.translation: We have created above you seven levels [of heaven], and We have never been unaware of Our creation.

verses.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We send down water from the sky in due measure and cause it to stay in the earth, and We are surely able to take it away.

verses.translation: We send down water from the sky in due measure and cause it to stay in the earth, and We are surely able to take it away.

verses.arabic: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَٰبٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: With this [water] We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are many fruits from which you eat,

verses.translation: With this [water] We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are many fruits from which you eat,

verses.arabic: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْـَٔاكِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and [olive] tree that grows at Mount Sinai, producing oil and condiment for those who eat.

verses.translation: and [olive] tree that grows at Mount Sinai, producing oil and condiment for those who eat.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And there is certainly a lesson for you in livestock animals. We provide you with a drink out of what they have in their bellies, and for you there are many benefits in them, and from their [meat] you eat,

verses.translation: And there is certainly a lesson for you in livestock animals. We provide you with a drink out of what they have in their bellies, and for you there are many benefits in them, and from their [meat] you eat,

verses.arabic: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and on them and on boats you are carried.

verses.translation: and on them and on boats you are carried.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We sent Noah to his people. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”

verses.translation: We sent Noah to his people. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: The disbelieving chiefs of his people said, “This is only a man like yourselves who wants to be superior to you. If Allah had willed, He could have sent down angels. We have not heard such a thing from our forefathers.

verses.translation: The disbelieving chiefs of his people said, “This is only a man like yourselves who wants to be superior to you. If Allah had willed, He could have sent down angels. We have not heard such a thing from our forefathers.

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: He is just a madman, so bear with him for a while[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Perhaps he may recover from his insanity or his affair may become clear to people.

verses.translation: He is just a madman, so bear with him for a while[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

english_rwwad.text: Noah said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”

verses.translation: Noah said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So We inspired him [saying], “Make the Ark under Our Eyes and according to Our directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts with water[1], take on board a pair of each species and your family, except those against whom the decree has already been passed. And do not plead with Me concerning those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or the fountains of the earth gush forth.

verses.translation: So We inspired him [saying], “Make the Ark under Our Eyes and according to Our directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts with water[1], take on board a pair of each species and your family, except those against whom the decree has already been passed. And do not plead with Me concerning those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then when you and those who are with you have embarked on the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”

verses.translation: Then when you and those who are with you have embarked on the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And say: “My Lord, make my landing a blessed landing, for You provide the best landing’”.

verses.translation: And say: “My Lord, make my landing a blessed landing, for You provide the best landing’”.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there are signs in this, and We always put people to the test.

verses.translation: Indeed, there are signs in this, and We always put people to the test.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We raised up after them another generation[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the people of ‘Aad.

verses.translation: Then We raised up after them another generation[1],

verses.arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and We sent to them a messenger[1] from among themselves [saying], “Worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Prophet Hūd, who was sent to the people of ‘Aad.

verses.translation: and We sent to them a messenger[1] from among themselves [saying], “Worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear Him?”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made affluent in the life of this world, said, “He is no more than a man like yourselves; he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.

verses.translation: But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made affluent in the life of this world, said, “He is no more than a man like yourselves; he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If you obey a man like yourselves, you will surely be losers.

verses.translation: If you obey a man like yourselves, you will surely be losers.

verses.arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones, you will be brought forth?

verses.translation: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones, you will be brought forth?

verses.arabic: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Far-fetched, utterly far-fetched is what you are promised![1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., How distant and improbable is the resurrection!

verses.translation: Far-fetched, utterly far-fetched is what you are promised![1]

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ

english_rwwad.text: There is nothing except our life in this world; we die, others are born, and none will be resurrected.

verses.translation: There is nothing except our life in this world; we die, others are born, and none will be resurrected.

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: He is no more than a man who has fabricated lies about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”

verses.translation: He is no more than a man who has fabricated lies about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”

verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah said, “In a little while they will surely be regretful.”

verses.translation: Allah said, “In a little while they will surely be regretful.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءً فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So the huge blast[1] overtook them in all justice, and We swept them away like scum[2]. So away with the wrongdoing people!
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., a piercing cry.
 [2] Ghutha’ literally means the froth thrown out by flood waters on the banks.

verses.translation: So the huge blast[1] overtook them in all justice, and We swept them away like scum[2]. So away with the wrongdoing people!

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We raised after them other generations.

verses.translation: Then We raised after them other generations.

verses.arabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: No nation can bring its appointed time forward, nor can it delay it.

verses.translation: No nation can bring its appointed time forward, nor can it delay it.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: every time a messenger came to his people, they rejected him. So We destroyed them, one after the others, and made them mere tales[1]. Away with the people who refuse to believe[2]!
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., history or lessons for people.
 [2] i.e., those who refuse to believe in the messengers.

verses.translation: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: every time a messenger came to his people, they rejected him. So We destroyed them, one after the others, and made them mere tales[1]. Away with the people who refuse to believe[2]!

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs[1] and compelling proof[2]
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Allah sent them both with nine clear signs or miracles: the staff turning into a snake, the bright hand, famine, shortage of crops, floods, locusts, lice, frogs, and blood.
 [2] i.e., compelling proof that they were Allah’s messengers.

verses.translation: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs[1] and compelling proof[2]

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ

english_rwwad.text: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they showed arrogance and were haughty people.

verses.translation: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they showed arrogance and were haughty people.

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “Should we believe in two men like ourselves when their people are our slaves?”

verses.translation: They said, “Should we believe in two men like ourselves when their people are our slaves?”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So they rejected them both and were among those who were destroyed.

verses.translation: So they rejected them both and were among those who were destroyed.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We gave Moses the Scripture so that they[1] might be guided.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Children of Israel.

verses.translation: We gave Moses the Scripture so that they[1] might be guided.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةً وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign[1] and sheltered them on a hillside – a place of rest and a flowing stream[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] The miraculous birth of Jesus is clear proof of Allah's Omnipotence that Mary gave birth to him without male interference.
 [2] Other Prophets were rejected for being human beings; whereas, people went to two extremes regarding Jesus: some considered him as divine, while some others went to the other extreme by accusing Mary of unchastity, although they were witnesses of the miraculous birth of Jesus and had heard him speak in the cradle.

verses.translation: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign[1] and sheltered them on a hillside – a place of rest and a flowing stream[2].

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: O messengers[1], eat from the lawful things[2] and act righteously, for I am All-Knowing of what you do.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] In this verse, all of the messengers have been addressed together, which indicates that they all belonged to the same community and their message was one.
 [2] They must be wholesome and earned in lawful ways.

verses.translation: O messengers[1], eat from the lawful things[2] and act righteously, for I am All-Knowing of what you do.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, this religion of yours is one religion[1], and I am your Lord, so fear Me.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the religion of Islam, which is submission to the will of Allah.

verses.translation: Indeed, this religion of yours is one religion[1], and I am your Lord, so fear Me.

verses.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But people split up their religion into factions, each faction rejoicing in what it has[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of beliefs, opinions, and customs.

verses.translation: But people split up their religion into factions, each faction rejoicing in what it has[1].

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: So leave them in their heedlessness for a while.

verses.translation: So leave them in their heedlessness for a while.

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Do they think that what We provide them of wealth and children means

verses.translation: Do they think that what We provide them of wealth and children means

verses.arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: that We hasten to them all that is good? No, but they do not perceive it[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They do not perceive that the good things given to them in this world are but a trial for them to increase in sin and disobedience.

verses.translation: that We hasten to them all that is good? No, but they do not perceive it[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Those who are in awe for fear of their Lord[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In spite of their faith and righteousness, they are in awe of their Lord.

verses.translation: Those who are in awe for fear of their Lord[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and those who believe in the verses of their Lord,

verses.translation: and those who believe in the verses of their Lord,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and those who do not associate partners with their Lord,

verses.translation: and those who do not associate partners with their Lord,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and those who do whatever [good] they do with their hearts fearful[1], knowing that they will return to their Lord –
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] That their deeds may not be acceptable.

verses.translation: and those who do whatever [good] they do with their hearts fearful[1], knowing that they will return to their Lord –

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: it is they who hasten to do good deeds, and they are foremost in them.

verses.translation: it is they who hasten to do good deeds, and they are foremost in them.

verses.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We do not burden a soul more than what it can bear. We have a Record [of their deeds][1] that tells the truth, and none will be wronged[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] It records every word he utters and every act he does.
 [2] By wrongfully punishing someone or diminishing the reward of those who did good.

verses.translation: We do not burden a soul more than what it can bear. We have a Record [of their deeds][1] that tells the truth, and none will be wronged[2].

verses.arabic: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But their hearts are oblivious to this[1], and they have other [evil] deeds that they are doing.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They are heedless of the fact that everything they say or do is recorded in a Record, or that they are heedless of the Qur’an.

verses.translation: But their hearts are oblivious to this[1], and they have other [evil] deeds that they are doing.

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But as soon as We seize their affluent ones with punishment[1], they start crying for help.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] On the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: But as soon as We seize their affluent ones with punishment[1], they start crying for help.

verses.arabic: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: “Do not cry for help today, for you will receive no help from Us.

verses.translation: “Do not cry for help today, for you will receive no help from Us.

verses.arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ

english_rwwad.text: My verses were recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels,

verses.translation: My verses were recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels,

verses.arabic: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: feeling proud of this [Sacred House], spending night in evil talks [about the Qur’an].”

verses.translation: feeling proud of this [Sacred House], spending night in evil talks [about the Qur’an].”

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Have they not pondered the Words [of Allah], or has there come to them what did not come to their forefathers?

verses.translation: Have they not pondered the Words [of Allah], or has there come to them what did not come to their forefathers?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or is it that they do not recognize their Messenger, so they deny him?

verses.translation: Or is it that they do not recognize their Messenger, so they deny him?

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they say, “There is madness in him?” Rather, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are averse to the truth.

verses.translation: Or do they say, “There is madness in him?” Rather, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are averse to the truth.

verses.arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Were the Truth to follow their desires, the heavens and earth, and all those who are therein would have been ruined. In fact, We have given them their Reminder, but they are averse to their Reminder.

verses.translation: Were the Truth to follow their desires, the heavens and earth, and all those who are therein would have been ruined. In fact, We have given them their Reminder, but they are averse to their Reminder.

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do you ask them for some reward[1]? But the reward of your Lord is best[2], and He is the Best of Providers.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Which did not actually happen.
 [2] This was another proof of the Prophet’s prophethood, for he was conveying the message without demanding any recompense for it; rather, he staked his peaceful life and relationships with his people for accomplishing his mission.

verses.translation: Or do you ask them for some reward[1]? But the reward of your Lord is best[2], and He is the Best of Providers.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, you are calling them to a straight path,

verses.translation: Indeed, you are calling them to a straight path,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from that path.

verses.translation: but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from that path.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
