verses.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةً وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: Also the people of Noah, when they rejected the messengers[1], We drowned them and made them an example for mankind. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Denial of Noah was equal to denying all of Allah’s messengers.

verses.translation: Also the people of Noah, when they rejected the messengers[1], We drowned them and made them an example for mankind. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Also [We destroyed] ‘Ād and Thamūd, and the people of the Well[1], and many generations between them.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., people of prophet Shuʿayb, or those mentioned in Surah Yā Sīn (36:13-29), or a tribe of Thamūd, etc. Rass (lit., well); for they killed their prophet by throwing him into or hanging him down an old or dry well. (Well)

verses.translation: Also [We destroyed] ‘Ād and Thamūd, and the people of the Well[1], and many generations between them.

verses.arabic: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلَ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: To each We gave examples [of the previous nations], and each We destroyed completely.

verses.translation: To each We gave examples [of the previous nations], and each We destroyed completely.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا

english_rwwad.text: They have surely passed by the town[1] that was destroyed by a terrible rain [of stones]. Have they not seen it? But they do not expect to be resurrected[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the city of Sodom; the people of Prophet Lot.
 [2] So they do not take lessons from the doom of the past nations.

verses.translation: They have surely passed by the town[1] that was destroyed by a terrible rain [of stones]. Have they not seen it? But they do not expect to be resurrected[2].

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا

english_rwwad.text: When they see you [O Prophet], they only ridicule you, “Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?

verses.translation: When they see you [O Prophet], they only ridicule you, “Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?

verses.arabic: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: He would have almost led us astray from our gods if we had not been so devoted to them.” But when they see the punishment, they will come to know who is further astray from the right way.

verses.translation: He would have almost led us astray from our gods if we had not been so devoted to them.” But when they see the punishment, they will come to know who is further astray from the right way.

verses.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Have you [O Prophet] seen the one who takes his desire as his god, will you then be a keeper over him?

verses.translation: Have you [O Prophet] seen the one who takes his desire as his god, will you then be a keeper over him?

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Do you think that most of them hear or understand?[1] They are just like cattle[2], rather they are further astray from the right way.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] They follow others blindly.
 [2] i.e., like livestock or sheep, that follow without asking wherever they are led.

verses.translation: Do you think that most of them hear or understand?[1] They are just like cattle[2], rather they are further astray from the right way.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see how your Lord extends the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it still. Then We made the sun an indication of it[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., indication for its existence or making it apparent.

verses.translation: Do you not see how your Lord extends the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it still. Then We made the sun an indication of it[1].

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Then We gradually draw it towards Us [i.e., Then the sun climbs up]?

verses.translation: Then We gradually draw it towards Us [i.e., Then the sun climbs up]?

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًا

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who has made the night as a garment[1] for you, and made sleep for rest; and has made daytime for returning to life[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] It covers you in darkness and provides rest.
 [2] To return to your livelihood and activity.

verses.translation: It is He Who has made the night as a garment[1] for you, and made sleep for rest; and has made daytime for returning to life[2].

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُورًا

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who sends the winds as harbingers before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water,

verses.translation: It is He Who sends the winds as harbingers before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water,

verses.arabic: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَٰمًا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: so that We may revive therewith a dead land, and quench the thirst of countless beasts and humans We have created.

verses.translation: so that We may revive therewith a dead land, and quench the thirst of countless beasts and humans We have created.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: We distribute it among them so that they may take heed[1], but most people persist in their ingratitude.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Such as Allah’s ability to bring the dead to life.

verses.translation: We distribute it among them so that they may take heed[1], but most people persist in their ingratitude.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: If We had willed, We could have sent to each town a warner[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] But instead, Allah sent Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) as the final messenger for all people.

verses.translation: If We had willed, We could have sent to each town a warner[1].

verses.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: So do not obey the disbelievers, but strive against them with this [Qur’an] a great striving.

verses.translation: So do not obey the disbelievers, but strive against them with this [Qur’an] a great striving.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who merges the two bodies of water: one fresh and palatable and the other salty and bitter, and He has made between them a barrier and an insurmountable partition[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] When salt and fresh waters meet, although both mix together, each still keeps its distinctive qualities, as if a barrier prevents them from mixing completely.

verses.translation: It is He Who merges the two bodies of water: one fresh and palatable and the other salty and bitter, and He has made between them a barrier and an insurmountable partition[1].

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who created human beings from water[1], then made between them bonds of kinship and marriage, for your Lord is Most Capable.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the zygote (the mixture of sperm and egg).

verses.translation: It is He Who created human beings from water[1], then made between them bonds of kinship and marriage, for your Lord is Most Capable.

verses.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Yet they worship besides Allah that which can neither benefit nor harm them; the disbeliever always collaborates against his Lord[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., helping and defending those who rebel against Allah.

verses.translation: Yet they worship besides Allah that which can neither benefit nor harm them; the disbeliever always collaborates against his Lord[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.

verses.translation: We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for it, except that whoever wishes may take a path to his Lord[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., by following the guidance I have brought, which is my only reward; it is also said: by spending in the way of Allah of one’s own free will.

verses.translation: Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for it, except that whoever wishes may take a path to his Lord[1].”

verses.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Put your trust in the Ever-Living Who never dies, and glorify Him with praise. He is Sufficient as All-Aware of the sins of His slaves –

verses.translation: Put your trust in the Ever-Living Who never dies, and glorify Him with praise. He is Sufficient as All-Aware of the sins of His slaves –

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: it is He Who created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six Days[1], then rose over the Throne[2]. He is the Most Compassionate, so ask about Him the One Who is All-Aware.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] The "six Days" does not necessarily mean six 24 hours of time; for a heavenly Day is 1,000 years of our time. (see 22:47), whereas the Day of Judgment will be 50,000 years of our time (see 70:4). Hence, its duration is only known to Allah.
 [2] See footnote 7:54.

verses.translation: it is He Who created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six Days[1], then rose over the Throne[2]. He is the Most Compassionate, so ask about Him the One Who is All-Aware.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they say, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate?’ Shall we prostrate to what you order us?” And it only increases their aversion.

verses.translation: When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they say, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate?’ Shall we prostrate to what you order us?” And it only increases their aversion.

verses.arabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Blessed is He Who placed in the sky constellations and placed therein a radiant lamp[1] and a luminous moon.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the sun.

verses.translation: Blessed is He Who placed in the sky constellations and placed therein a radiant lamp[1] and a luminous moon.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who made the night and the day to follow each other so that everyone who wishes may reflect or become grateful.

verses.translation: It is He Who made the night and the day to follow each other so that everyone who wishes may reflect or become grateful.

verses.arabic: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا

english_rwwad.text: The slaves of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on earth humbly[1], and when the ignorant address them, they only say words of peace[2];
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., without arrogance, but with dignity.
 [2] i.e., words free from evil.

verses.translation: The slaves of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on earth humbly[1], and when the ignorant address them, they only say words of peace[2];

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَٰمًا

english_rwwad.text: and those who spend the night prostrating and standing before their Lord;

verses.translation: and those who spend the night prostrating and standing before their Lord;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا

english_rwwad.text: and those who say, “Our Lord, turn the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is unrelenting[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., ever adhering.

verses.translation: and those who say, “Our Lord, turn the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is unrelenting[1].”

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا

english_rwwad.text: It is an evil place to settle and an evil abode.”

verses.translation: It is an evil place to settle and an evil abode.”

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا

english_rwwad.text: And those who neither spend wastefully nor stingily, but are moderate between them;

verses.translation: And those who neither spend wastefully nor stingily, but are moderate between them;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا

english_rwwad.text: and those who do not invoke besides Allah another god, and who do not kill a soul whom Allah has forbidden, except in the course of justice, and who do not commit adultery, for whoever does any of this will face the penalty,

verses.translation: and those who do not invoke besides Allah another god, and who do not kill a soul whom Allah has forbidden, except in the course of justice, and who do not commit adultery, for whoever does any of this will face the penalty,

verses.arabic: يُضَٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا

english_rwwad.text: the punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, wherein he will remain disgraced forever,

verses.translation: the punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, wherein he will remain disgraced forever,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds; for them Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.translation: except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds; for them Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًا

english_rwwad.text: Whoever repents and does righteous deeds has turned to Allah with sincere repentance.

verses.translation: Whoever repents and does righteous deeds has turned to Allah with sincere repentance.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًا

english_rwwad.text: And those who do not witness falsehood[1], and when they pass by futility, they pass by with dignity;
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., places of sin, evil, and indecency.

verses.translation: And those who do not witness falsehood[1], and when they pass by futility, they pass by with dignity;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا

english_rwwad.text: and those who, when they are reminded of the verses of their Lord, they do not turn a deaf ear or a blind eye to them;

verses.translation: and those who, when they are reminded of the verses of their Lord, they do not turn a deaf ear or a blind eye to them;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

english_rwwad.text: and those who say, “Our Lord, let our spouses and children be a source of joy for us[1], and make us good examples for the righteous.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a source of happiness for their righteousness and adhering to a straight path.

verses.translation: and those who say, “Our Lord, let our spouses and children be a source of joy for us[1], and make us good examples for the righteous.”

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَٰمًا

english_rwwad.text: It is they who will be rewarded with high palaces [in Paradise] for their perseverance, and they will be received therein with salutations and greetings of peace,

verses.translation: It is they who will be rewarded with high palaces [in Paradise] for their perseverance, and they will be received therein with salutations and greetings of peace,

verses.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا

english_rwwad.text: abiding therein forever. What an excellent abode and a resting place!

verses.translation: abiding therein forever. What an excellent abode and a resting place!

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا

english_rwwad.text: Say [O Prophet], “My Lord would not care at all about you, were it not for your supplication[1]. Now since you have rejected [the truth], the inevitable is bound to come[2].”
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., faith and worship.
 [2] Or it will be adhering to you.

verses.translation: Say [O Prophet], “My Lord would not care at all about you, were it not for your supplication[1]. Now since you have rejected [the truth], the inevitable is bound to come[2].”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓمٓ

english_rwwad.text: Tā sīn mīm.[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.

verses.translation: Tā sīn mīm.[1]

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

english_rwwad.text: These are the verses of the clear Book.

verses.translation: These are the verses of the clear Book.

verses.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Perhaps you[1] will grieve yourself to death because they do not believe.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] O Muhammad.

verses.translation: Perhaps you[1] will grieve yourself to death because they do not believe.

verses.arabic: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: If We willed, We could send down upon them a sign from the heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in humility[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., they would be compelled to believe, being humbled.

verses.translation: If We willed, We could send down upon them a sign from the heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in humility[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ

english_rwwad.text: No new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate except that they turn away from it.

verses.translation: No new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate except that they turn away from it.

verses.arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They have rejected [the Truth], soon there will come to them the consequences of their ridicule.

verses.translation: They have rejected [the Truth], soon there will come to them the consequences of their ridicule.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Do they not see the earth, how many fine kinds of plants We grow in it?

verses.translation: Do they not see the earth, how many fine kinds of plants We grow in it?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them will not believe.

verses.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them will not believe.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.translation: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people –

verses.translation: And [remember] when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people –

verses.arabic: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: the people of Pharaoh; will they not fear [the punishment of] Allah?”

verses.translation: the people of Pharaoh; will they not fear [the punishment of] Allah?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “My Lord, I fear that they may reject me,

verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, I fear that they may reject me,

verses.arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and I will feel distressed and my tongue will not be fluent, so send Aaron along [to help me].

verses.translation: and I will feel distressed and my tongue will not be fluent, so send Aaron along [to help me].

verses.arabic: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ

english_rwwad.text: Moreover, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For killing a Coptic Egyptian by mistake before becoming a prophet.

verses.translation: Moreover, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّا فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah said, “Certainly not! Go, both of you, with Our signs[1]; We are with you, listening.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the miracles of the staff and the shining hand, given to Moses.

verses.translation: Allah said, “Certainly not! Go, both of you, with Our signs[1]; We are with you, listening.

verses.arabic: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are the messengers[1] from the Lord of the worlds,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The singular form in Arabic denotes that they both were sent with a single message.

verses.translation: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are the messengers[1] from the Lord of the worlds,

verses.arabic: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

english_rwwad.text: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.’”

verses.translation: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.’”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Pharaoh said, “Did we not bring you up as a child among us, and you stayed with us several years of your life?

verses.translation: Pharaoh said, “Did we not bring you up as a child among us, and you stayed with us several years of your life?

verses.arabic: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Yet you did what you did[1], and you are extremely ungrateful.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., striking the Copt in support of a man from your people, who died as a result.

verses.translation: Yet you did what you did[1], and you are extremely ungrateful.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “I did it when I had no guidance.

verses.translation: He said, “I did it when I had no guidance.

verses.arabic: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So I fled from you in fear. Then my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of the messengers.

verses.translation: So I fled from you in fear. Then my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of the messengers.

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

english_rwwad.text: Is this a favor that you remind me with, that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., If you had not been cruel to the Israelites, I should not have been brought to your house for upbringing.

verses.translation: Is this a favor that you remind me with, that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?[1]

verses.arabic: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Pharaoh said, “What is ‘the Lord of the worlds’?”

verses.translation: Pharaoh said, “What is ‘the Lord of the worlds’?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Moses said, “The Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, if only you had sure faith.”

verses.translation: Moses said, “The Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, if only you had sure faith.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Pharaoh said to those around him, “Did you hear [what he just said]?”

verses.translation: Pharaoh said to those around him, “Did you hear [what he just said]?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Moses said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.”

verses.translation: Moses said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ

english_rwwad.text: Pharaoh said, “Your messenger who has been sent to you is truly insane!”

verses.translation: Pharaoh said, “Your messenger who has been sent to you is truly insane!”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Moses said, “Lord of the east and west and all that is between them, if only you had sense!”

verses.translation: Moses said, “Lord of the east and west and all that is between them, if only you had sense!”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Pharaoh said, “If you take any god other than me, I will throw you into prison.”

verses.translation: Pharaoh said, “If you take any god other than me, I will throw you into prison.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Moses said, “What if I bring you a clear proof?”

verses.translation: Moses said, “What if I bring you a clear proof?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Pharaoh said, “Bring it then if you are truthful!”

verses.translation: Pharaoh said, “Bring it then if you are truthful!”

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: So he threw down his staff, and suddenly it was a real serpent.

verses.translation: So he threw down his staff, and suddenly it was a real serpent.

verses.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And he drew out his hand, and it was glowing white to the beholders.

verses.translation: And he drew out his hand, and it was glowing white to the beholders.

verses.arabic: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him, “This is indeed a learned magician!

verses.translation: Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him, “This is indeed a learned magician!

verses.arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He wants to drive you out of your land with his magic. What do you suggest?”

verses.translation: He wants to drive you out of your land with his magic. What do you suggest?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “Let him and his brother wait and dispatch heralds to the cities

verses.translation: They said, “Let him and his brother wait and dispatch heralds to the cities

verses.arabic: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: to bring you every learned magician.”

verses.translation: to bring you every learned magician.”

verses.arabic: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

english_rwwad.text: So the magicians were assembled at an appointed time on a known day[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the morning of the festival day. See 20:58-59.

verses.translation: So the magicians were assembled at an appointed time on a known day[1].

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And it was said to the people, “Will you join the gathering,

verses.translation: And it was said to the people, “Will you join the gathering,

verses.arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: so that we may follow the magicians, if they are victorious?”

verses.translation: so that we may follow the magicians, if they are victorious?”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh, “Will there be a reward for us if we are victorious?”

verses.translation: When the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh, “Will there be a reward for us if we are victorious?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Yes, and then you will surely be of those who are close to me.”

verses.translation: He said, “Yes, and then you will surely be of those who are close to me.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Moses said to them, “Throw whatever you wish to throw.”

verses.translation: Moses said to them, “Throw whatever you wish to throw.”

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So they threw their ropes and staffs, and said, “By the glory of Pharaoh, it is we who will be the victorious!”

verses.translation: So they threw their ropes and staffs, and said, “By the glory of Pharaoh, it is we who will be the victorious!”

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it swallowed up all objects of their illusion.

verses.translation: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it swallowed up all objects of their illusion.

verses.arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration.

verses.translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration.

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “We believe in the Lord of the worlds,

verses.translation: They said, “We believe in the Lord of the worlds,

verses.arabic: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

verses.translation: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Pharaoh said, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission. Indeed, he is your master who taught you magic, but you will soon come to know. I will surely cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, then I will crucify you all.”

verses.translation: Pharaoh said, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission. Indeed, he is your master who taught you magic, but you will soon come to know. I will surely cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, then I will crucify you all.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “No harm; we will surely return to our Lord.

verses.translation: They said, “No harm; we will surely return to our Lord.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we are the first of the believers.”

verses.translation: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we are the first of the believers.”

verses.arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We inspired Moses, “Leave with My slaves by night; you will surely be pursued.”

verses.translation: We inspired Moses, “Leave with My slaves by night; you will surely be pursued.”

verses.arabic: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In order to prevent the emigration of the Children of Israel.

verses.translation: So Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities[1],

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: saying, “These are but a small band,

verses.translation: saying, “These are but a small band,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and they have enraged us,

verses.translation: and they have enraged us,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: but we are all well-prepared.”

verses.translation: but we are all well-prepared.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: Thus did We drive them[1] out of their gardens and springs,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Pharaoh and his people.

verses.translation: Thus did We drive them[1] out of their gardens and springs,

verses.arabic: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: and their treasures and splendid dwellings.

verses.translation: and their treasures and splendid dwellings.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

english_rwwad.text: So it was, and We made the Children of Israel to inherit them.

verses.translation: So it was, and We made the Children of Israel to inherit them.

verses.arabic: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They pursued them at sunrise.

verses.translation: They pursued them at sunrise.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: When the two groups saw each other, the companions of Moses said, “We are surely overtaken!”

verses.translation: When the two groups saw each other, the companions of Moses said, “We are surely overtaken!”

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

english_rwwad.text: Moses said, “Certainly not! My Lord is with me; He will guide me.”

verses.translation: Moses said, “Certainly not! My Lord is with me; He will guide me.”

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: Then We inspired Moses, “Strike the sea with your staff,” so it parted, and each part became like a huge mountain.

verses.translation: Then We inspired Moses, “Strike the sea with your staff,” so it parted, and each part became like a huge mountain.

verses.arabic: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We brought the others [i.e., the pursuers] close to that place,

verses.translation: Then We brought the others [i.e., the pursuers] close to that place,

verses.arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and We saved Moses and all those who were with him.

verses.translation: and We saved Moses and all those who were with him.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then we drowned the others.

verses.translation: Then we drowned the others.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, your Lord is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.translation: Indeed, your Lord is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: Relate to them the story of Abraham,

verses.translation: Relate to them the story of Abraham,

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: when he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?”

verses.translation: when he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “We worship idols and remain devoted to them.”

verses.translation: They said, “We worship idols and remain devoted to them.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Do they hear you when you call upon them?

verses.translation: He said, “Do they hear you when you call upon them?

verses.arabic: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or can they benefit or harm you?”

verses.translation: Or can they benefit or harm you?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “No, but this is what we found our forefathers doing.”

verses.translation: They said, “No, but this is what we found our forefathers doing.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Do you see what you have been worshiping,

verses.translation: He said, “Do you see what you have been worshiping,

verses.arabic: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: you and your ancestors?

verses.translation: you and your ancestors?

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, they are my enemies, except the Lord of the worlds[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As they worshiped idols in addition to worshiping Allah.

verses.translation: Indeed, they are my enemies, except the Lord of the worlds[1],

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ

english_rwwad.text: Who created me, so He guides me;

verses.translation: Who created me, so He guides me;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ

english_rwwad.text: and it is He Who provides me with food and drink;

verses.translation: and it is He Who provides me with food and drink;

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ

english_rwwad.text: and when I am ill He heals me;

verses.translation: and when I am ill He heals me;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ

english_rwwad.text: and He will cause me to die and then bring me back to life;

verses.translation: and He will cause me to die and then bring me back to life;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: and I hope that He will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgment.”

verses.translation: and I hope that He will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgment.”

verses.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

english_rwwad.text: “My Lord, grant me knowledge, and join me with the righteous,

verses.translation: “My Lord, grant me knowledge, and join me with the righteous,

verses.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and grant me an honorable mention among the later generations[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Muslims invoke Allah’s blessings upon Abraham (ﷺ) along with Muhammad (ﷺ) in their daily prayers.

verses.translation: and grant me an honorable mention among the later generations[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: and make me of those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss;

verses.translation: and make me of those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss;

verses.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

english_rwwad.text: and forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray;

verses.translation: and forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray;

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all will be resurrected –

verses.translation: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all will be resurrected –

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: the Day when neither wealth nor children will be of any avail,

verses.translation: the Day when neither wealth nor children will be of any avail,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: except the one who comes to Allah with a sound heart[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] A heart free from disbelief, polytheism, hypocrisy, arrogance, and show-off.

verses.translation: except the one who comes to Allah with a sound heart[1].”

verses.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Paradise will be brought near to the righteous,

verses.translation: Paradise will be brought near to the righteous,

verses.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and Hellfire will be uncovered to those who went astray,

verses.translation: and Hellfire will be uncovered to those who went astray,

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and they will be told, “Where are those whom you used to worship

verses.translation: and they will be told, “Where are those whom you used to worship

verses.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: other than Allah? Can they help you or even help themselves?”

verses.translation: other than Allah? Can they help you or even help themselves?”

verses.arabic: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ

english_rwwad.text: Then they will be hurled into Hell one upon another, along with those who led them astray,

verses.translation: Then they will be hurled into Hell one upon another, along with those who led them astray,

verses.arabic: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and the followers of Iblīs, all together.

verses.translation: and the followers of Iblīs, all together.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: There the deviants will say while quarreling with their false deities,

verses.translation: There the deviants will say while quarreling with their false deities,

verses.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: “By Allah, we were clearly misguided,

verses.translation: “By Allah, we were clearly misguided,

verses.arabic: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: when we deemed you equal to the Lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: when we deemed you equal to the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: None led us astray except the wicked.

verses.translation: None led us astray except the wicked.

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Now we neither have any intercessors,

verses.translation: Now we neither have any intercessors,

verses.arabic: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: nor a close friend.

verses.translation: nor a close friend.

verses.arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: If only we had a chance to return, we would be among the believers.”

verses.translation: If only we had a chance to return, we would be among the believers.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord is surely the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.translation: Your Lord is surely the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: The people of Noah rejected the messengers[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For denying Noah was equal to denying all of the messengers of Allah.

verses.translation: The people of Noah rejected the messengers[1]

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: when their brother Noah said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

verses.translation: when their brother Noah said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

verses.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.translation: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english_rwwad.text: so fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: I seek of you no reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds;

verses.translation: I seek of you no reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds;

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english_rwwad.text: so fear Allah, and obey me.”

verses.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “Shall we believe in you when you are followed by the lowest people[1]?”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For they were mostly the poor and ordinary people, who enjoyed no position in society.

verses.translation: They said, “Shall we believe in you when you are followed by the lowest people[1]?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “What knowledge do I have of what they do?

verses.translation: He said, “What knowledge do I have of what they do?

verses.arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Their reckoning is only with my Lord if you realize!

verses.translation: Their reckoning is only with my Lord if you realize!

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: I am not going to drive the believers away.

verses.translation: I am not going to drive the believers away.

verses.arabic: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: I am only a clear warner.”

verses.translation: I am only a clear warner.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “O Noah, if you do not desist, you will certainly be stoned.”

verses.translation: They said, “O Noah, if you do not desist, you will certainly be stoned.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “My Lord, my people have rejected me.

verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, my people have rejected me.

verses.arabic: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So judge between me and them decisively, and save me and the believers who are with me.”

verses.translation: So judge between me and them decisively, and save me and the believers who are with me.”

verses.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

english_rwwad.text: So We saved him and those who were with him in the fully laden Ark.

verses.translation: So We saved him and those who were with him in the fully laden Ark.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We drowned thereafter all the rest.

verses.translation: Then We drowned thereafter all the rest.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, your Lord is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.translation: Indeed, your Lord is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: The people of ‘Ād rejected the messengers

verses.translation: The people of ‘Ād rejected the messengers

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: when their brother Hūd said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

verses.translation: when their brother Hūd said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

verses.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.translation: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english_rwwad.text: so fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do you build a landmark[1] on every high place for no purpose?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They used to build lofty structures along the road to be seen by passersby, as a symbol of their wealth and power.

verses.translation: Do you build a landmark[1] on every high place for no purpose?

verses.arabic: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And do you construct for yourselves palaces, hoping that you will live forever?

verses.translation: And do you construct for yourselves palaces, hoping that you will live forever?

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And when you attack [others], do you attack ruthlessly?

verses.translation: And when you attack [others], do you attack ruthlessly?

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english_rwwad.text: So fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And fear the One Who has provided you with everything you know:

verses.translation: And fear the One Who has provided you with everything you know:

verses.arabic: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Who provided you with livestock and children,

verses.translation: Who provided you with livestock and children,

verses.arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: and with gardens and springs.

verses.translation: and with gardens and springs.

verses.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: I fear for you the punishment of a momentous day.”

verses.translation: I fear for you the punishment of a momentous day.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “It is the same to us whether you admonish us or not.

verses.translation: They said, “It is the same to us whether you admonish us or not.

verses.arabic: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is nothing but the custom of the former people,

verses.translation: This is nothing but the custom of the former people,

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and we will never be punished.”

verses.translation: and we will never be punished.”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Thus they rejected him, so We destroyed them. Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe,

verses.translation: Thus they rejected him, so We destroyed them. Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.translation: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: The people of Thamūd rejected the messengers

verses.translation: The people of Thamūd rejected the messengers

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: when their brother Sālih said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

verses.translation: when their brother Sālih said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

verses.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.translation: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english_rwwad.text: so fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Will you be left secure in whatever you have here,

verses.translation: Will you be left secure in whatever you have here,

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: in gardens and springs,

verses.translation: in gardens and springs,

verses.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: and in fields of crops and date palms laden with tender fruit,

verses.translation: and in fields of crops and date palms laden with tender fruit,

verses.arabic: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَٰرِهِينَ

english_rwwad.text: carving out houses in the mountains with great skill?

verses.translation: carving out houses in the mountains with great skill?

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english_rwwad.text: So fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And do not obey the command of the transgressors,

verses.translation: And do not obey the command of the transgressors,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those who spread corruption in the land and never do what is right.”

verses.translation: those who spread corruption in the land and never do what is right.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “You are but one of those who are bewitched!

verses.translation: They said, “You are but one of those who are bewitched!

verses.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: You are but a human like us, so bring a sign if you are one of the truthful.”

verses.translation: You are but a human like us, so bring a sign if you are one of the truthful.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

english_rwwad.text: Sālih said, “This is a she-camel[1]; she will have her share of water and you will have yours, each on a specified day.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] That was miraculously sent to them as a sign by Allah.

verses.translation: Sālih said, “This is a she-camel[1]; she will have her share of water and you will have yours, each on a specified day.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Do not touch her with harm, or you will be seized by the punishment of a horrible day.”

verses.translation: Do not touch her with harm, or you will be seized by the punishment of a horrible day.”

verses.arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَٰدِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: But they hamstrung her, then they became regretful,

verses.translation: But they hamstrung her, then they became regretful,

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So the punishment seized them[1]. Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They were destroyed by a violent earthquake and a blast after Sālih told them: “You have only three days to enjoy yourselves in your houses”. See 11:65. Allah says: “We sent against them a single blast, leaving them like trampled hedge-building twigs”. See 54:31.

verses.translation: So the punishment seized them[1]. Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.translation: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: The people of Lot rejected the messengers,

verses.translation: The people of Lot rejected the messengers,

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: when their brother Lot said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

verses.translation: when their brother Lot said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

verses.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.translation: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english_rwwad.text: so fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Do you approach males with lust among all people[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Are there any creatures besides you who commit this abominable act?

verses.translation: Do you approach males with lust among all people[1],

verses.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ

english_rwwad.text: leaving the wives whom your Lord has created for you? You are but a transgressing people.”

verses.translation: leaving the wives whom your Lord has created for you? You are but a transgressing people.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “O Lot, If you do not desist, you will surely be expelled.”

verses.translation: They said, “O Lot, If you do not desist, you will surely be expelled.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Lot said, “I am one of those who utterly abhor your practice.

verses.translation: Lot said, “I am one of those who utterly abhor your practice.

verses.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَأَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequences of] what they do.”

verses.translation: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequences of] what they do.”

verses.arabic: فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So We saved him and all his family,

verses.translation: So We saved him and all his family,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except an old woman who was among those who remained behind[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Lot's wife, who betrayed him by not believing and remained a disbeliever; thus, she was among those destroyed.

verses.translation: except an old woman who was among those who remained behind[1].

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We destroyed the rest,

verses.translation: Then We destroyed the rest,

verses.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and We poured down upon them a rain [of stones]. How terrible was the rain of those who were warned!

verses.translation: and We poured down upon them a rain [of stones]. How terrible was the rain of those who were warned!

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.translation: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: The people of the Forest[1] rejected the messengers.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the people of Madyan, to whom Shu‘ayb was sent.

verses.translation: The people of the Forest[1] rejected the messengers.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: When Shu‘ayb said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

verses.translation: When Shu‘ayb said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

verses.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.translation: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english_rwwad.text: so fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Give full measure and do not be of those who defraud others,

verses.translation: Give full measure and do not be of those who defraud others,

verses.arabic: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: and weigh with accurate scales,

verses.translation: and weigh with accurate scales,

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and do not defraud people of their goods, nor go about in the land spreading corruption.

verses.translation: and do not defraud people of their goods, nor go about in the land spreading corruption.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And fear the One Who created you and the former peoples[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., generations of the past.

verses.translation: And fear the One Who created you and the former peoples[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “You are truly bewitched!

verses.translation: They said, “You are truly bewitched!

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: You are only a human being like us, and we think you are nothing but a liar.

verses.translation: You are only a human being like us, and we think you are nothing but a liar.

verses.arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So cause pieces of the sky to fall upon us, if you are of the truthful.”

verses.translation: So cause pieces of the sky to fall upon us, if you are of the truthful.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Shu‘ayb said, “My Lord knows best whatever you do.”

verses.translation: Shu‘ayb said, “My Lord knows best whatever you do.”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Thus they rejected him, so they were seized by the punishment of the cloudy day; it was the punishment of a horrible day.

verses.translation: Thus they rejected him, so they were seized by the punishment of the cloudy day; it was the punishment of a horrible day.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.translation: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is indeed a revelation from the Lord of the worlds,

verses.translation: This is indeed a revelation from the Lord of the worlds,

verses.arabic: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ

english_rwwad.text: which the Trustworthy Spirit [Gabriel] has brought down

verses.translation: which the Trustworthy Spirit [Gabriel] has brought down

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: to your heart [O Prophet] so that you may be one of the warners,

verses.translation: to your heart [O Prophet] so that you may be one of the warners,

verses.arabic: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: in a clear Arabic language.

verses.translation: in a clear Arabic language.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And it was indeed [mentioned] in the scriptures of the former peoples.

verses.translation: And it was indeed [mentioned] in the scriptures of the former peoples.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

english_rwwad.text: Was it not a proof for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel recognized it [to be true][1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] e.g., Abdullah ibn Salām, a Jewish scholar, accepted Islam during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ), for he knew that he came with a true message.

verses.translation: Was it not a proof for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel recognized it [to be true][1]?

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: If We had sent it down to any of the non-Arabs,

verses.translation: If We had sent it down to any of the non-Arabs,

verses.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and he had recited it to them[1]; still, they would not have believed in it.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As a miracle from Allah.

verses.translation: and he had recited it to them[1]; still, they would not have believed in it.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is how We made it [i.e., disbelief] enter the hearts of the wicked.

verses.translation: This is how We made it [i.e., disbelief] enter the hearts of the wicked.

verses.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment,

verses.translation: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment,

verses.arabic: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: which will come upon them suddenly when they least expect it.

verses.translation: which will come upon them suddenly when they least expect it.

verses.arabic: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will then say, “Can we be granted some respite?”

verses.translation: They will then say, “Can we be granted some respite?”

verses.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do they really seek to hasten Our punishment?

verses.translation: Do they really seek to hasten Our punishment?

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُمْ سِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Tell me [O Prophet] if We give them a life of ease for years,

verses.translation: Tell me [O Prophet] if We give them a life of ease for years,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: then there came to them what they were warned of,

verses.translation: then there came to them what they were warned of,

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: what would avail them the life of ease that they were given?

verses.translation: what would avail them the life of ease that they were given?

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We never destroyed any town without sending them warners,

verses.translation: We never destroyed any town without sending them warners,

verses.arabic: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: to admonish them, for We are never unjust.

verses.translation: to admonish them, for We are never unjust.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ

english_rwwad.text: This [Qur’an] is not sent down by the devils[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As the disbelievers claim; rather, it is brought down by Gabriel, the Trustworthy Spirit.

verses.translation: This [Qur’an] is not sent down by the devils[1],

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: it is not for them to do this, nor is it within their capability,

verses.translation: it is not for them to do this, nor is it within their capability,

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ

english_rwwad.text: for they are strictly barred from overhearing it[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] So they cannot eavesdrop on heaven. See 72:9.

verses.translation: for they are strictly barred from overhearing it[1].

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So do not call upon any other god besides Allah, lest you become of those who will be punished.

verses.translation: So do not call upon any other god besides Allah, lest you become of those who will be punished.

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And warn [starting with] the nearest kinsfolk,

verses.translation: And warn [starting with] the nearest kinsfolk,

verses.arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and lower your wing [in kindness] to the believers who follow you.

verses.translation: and lower your wing [in kindness] to the believers who follow you.

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But if they disobey you, say, “I disown what you do.”

verses.translation: But if they disobey you, say, “I disown what you do.”

verses.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

verses.translation: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

english_rwwad.text: Who sees you when you stand up [for prayer],

verses.translation: Who sees you when you stand up [for prayer],

verses.arabic: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and your movements among those who prostrate.

verses.translation: and your movements among those who prostrate.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

verses.translation: Indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ

english_rwwad.text: Shall I inform you upon who the devils descend?

verses.translation: Shall I inform you upon who the devils descend?

verses.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: They descend upon every sinful liar,

verses.translation: They descend upon every sinful liar,

verses.arabic: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَٰذِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: who whisper hearsay in the ears, but most of them are liars.

verses.translation: who whisper hearsay in the ears, but most of them are liars.

verses.arabic: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ

english_rwwad.text: As for poets, they are followed by the deviants.

verses.translation: As for poets, they are followed by the deviants.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see that they wander aimlessly in every valley[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Telling lies indiscriminately, praising some, and disparaging others.

verses.translation: Do you not see that they wander aimlessly in every valley[1],

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and that they say what they do not do?

verses.translation: and that they say what they do not do?

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Except those who believe, do righteous deeds, remember Allah much and defend themselves[1] after being wronged. The wrongdoers will come to know what end awaits them.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By replying to the satire of hostile poets through poetry.

verses.translation: Except those who believe, do righteous deeds, remember Allah much and defend themselves[1] after being wronged. The wrongdoers will come to know what end awaits them.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Tā Sīn[1]. These are the verses of the Qur’an and a clear book;
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.

verses.translation: Tā Sīn[1]. These are the verses of the Qur’an and a clear book;

verses.arabic: هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: a guidance and glad tidings for the believers,

verses.translation: a guidance and glad tidings for the believers,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those who establish prayer and give zakah, and who firmly believe in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: those who establish prayer and give zakah, and who firmly believe in the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds appealing to them, so they wander blindly.

verses.translation: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds appealing to them, so they wander blindly.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Such are those who will have a terrible punishment, and it is they who will be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: Such are those who will have a terrible punishment, and it is they who will be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, you are receiving the Qur’an from the All-Wise, All-Knowing.

verses.translation: Indeed, you are receiving the Qur’an from the All-Wise, All-Knowing.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [Remember] when Moses said to his family, “I have spotted a fire. I will bring you some news[1] from there, or bring you a burning brand so that you may warm yourselves.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For they lost their way in the dark while traveling from Midian to Egypt.

verses.translation: [Remember] when Moses said to his family, “I have spotted a fire. I will bring you some news[1] from there, or bring you a burning brand so that you may warm yourselves.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When he came to it, he was called, “Blessed is He Who is at the fire and those who are around it[1]. Glory be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the angels around the fire.

verses.translation: When he came to it, he was called, “Blessed is He Who is at the fire and those who are around it[1]. Glory be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: O Moses, verily this is Me – Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.translation: O Moses, verily this is Me – Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Throw down your staff!” But when he saw it slithering as if it were a snake, he turned and ran away without looking back. “O Moses, do not be afraid! Indeed, the messengers should have no fear in My presence,

verses.translation: Throw down your staff!” But when he saw it slithering as if it were a snake, he turned and ran away without looking back. “O Moses, do not be afraid! Indeed, the messengers should have no fear in My presence,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: except he who does wrong, then substitutes good for evil, then I am indeed All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.translation: except he who does wrong, then substitutes good for evil, then I am indeed All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Put your hand into your garment, it will come out shining white without blemish, as one of nine signs to Pharaoh and his people[1], for they are indeed a rebellious people.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 23:45.

verses.translation: Put your hand into your garment, it will come out shining white without blemish, as one of nine signs to Pharaoh and his people[1], for they are indeed a rebellious people.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
