verses.translation: but to worship Me? This is a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He had already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not then have sense?

verses.translation: He had already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not then have sense?

verses.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: This is the Hell that you were promised.

verses.translation: This is the Hell that you were promised.

verses.arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Burn in it Today for your disbelief[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., because you used to disbelieve.

verses.translation: Burn in it Today for your disbelief[1].”

verses.arabic: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Today We will seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to all what they used to do.

verses.translation: Today We will seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to all what they used to do.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If We willed, We could have taken away their sight, so they would rush to find their way, but then how could they see?

verses.translation: If We willed, We could have taken away their sight, so they would rush to find their way, but then how could they see?

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And if We willed, We could have paralyzed them in their places[1], so they could neither move forward nor backward.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., We could turn them into inanimate objects.

verses.translation: And if We willed, We could have paralyzed them in their places[1], so they could neither move forward nor backward.

verses.arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Whomsoever We give a long life, We cause his strength to decline[1]. Do they not then understand?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Humans are born weak, then they reach their prime when they are young, then they grow physically and mentally weak when they are old.

verses.translation: Whomsoever We give a long life, We cause his strength to decline[1]. Do they not then understand?

verses.arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This is only a Reminder and a clear Qur’an

verses.translation: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This is only a Reminder and a clear Qur’an

verses.arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: so that he may warn those who are truly alive[1] and establish the argument against the disbelievers.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In heart and mind, i.e., those who have faith.

verses.translation: so that he may warn those who are truly alive[1] and establish the argument against the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do they not see that We have created for them livestock made by Our Hands, and then they are their owners?

verses.translation: Do they not see that We have created for them livestock made by Our Hands, and then they are their owners?

verses.arabic: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And We have made them subservient to them; some they ride, and from others they eat,

verses.translation: And We have made them subservient to them; some they ride, and from others they eat,

verses.arabic: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and there are other benefits and drinks therein for them. Will they not then give thanks?

verses.translation: and there are other benefits and drinks therein for them. Will they not then give thanks?

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Yet they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping that they may be helped.

verses.translation: Yet they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping that they may be helped.

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They cannot help them, yet they serve them as their dedicated guards[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or their idols or so-called gods will be assembled to witness the punishment of their worshipers on the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: They cannot help them, yet they serve them as their dedicated guards[1].

verses.arabic: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do not let their words grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they reveal.

verses.translation: Do not let their words grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they reveal.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: Does man not see that We have created him from a sperm-drop, then[1] he becomes a clear adversary,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., as soon as he becomes a self-sufficient being.

verses.translation: Does man not see that We have created him from a sperm-drop, then[1] he becomes a clear adversary,

verses.arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: producing arguments[1] against Us while forgetting his own creation[2]. He says, “Who can give life to the bones after they have crumbled to dust?”
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Trying to prove that there is no life after death.
 [2] That we created him from dead matter to such an extent that he became now a clear disputant before Us.

verses.translation: producing arguments[1] against Us while forgetting his own creation[2]. He says, “Who can give life to the bones after they have crumbled to dust?”

verses.arabic: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “The One Who created them in the first place will give life to them, for He has full knowledge of every created being;

verses.translation: Say, “The One Who created them in the first place will give life to them, for He has full knowledge of every created being;

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: the One Who made for you fire out of the green tree, with which you kindle your fires[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It alludes to the "markh" and "‘afār" trees in Arabia, whose green branches if struck against each other, it produces sparks.

verses.translation: the One Who made for you fire out of the green tree, with which you kindle your fires[1].”

verses.arabic: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Is not the One Who created the heavens and earth able to create the like of these [people]? Yes indeed, for He is the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.

verses.translation: Is not the One Who created the heavens and earth able to create the like of these [people]? Yes indeed, for He is the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

english_rwwad.text: Whenever He wills something to be, He only says to it, “Be”, and it is.

verses.translation: Whenever He wills something to be, He only says to it, “Be”, and it is.

verses.arabic: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So glory be to the One in Whose Hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will all be returned.

verses.translation: So glory be to the One in Whose Hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will all be returned.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّا

english_rwwad.text: By those [angels] lined up in rows,

verses.translation: By those [angels] lined up in rows,

verses.arabic: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا

english_rwwad.text: and those who drive [the clouds],

verses.translation: and those who drive [the clouds],

verses.arabic: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا

english_rwwad.text: and those who recite Allah’s words[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah swears by three kinds of angels in these three above-mentioned verses to emphasize what comes in the next verse.

verses.translation: and those who recite Allah’s words[1],

verses.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ

english_rwwad.text: indeed, your God is One,

verses.translation: indeed, your God is One,

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ

english_rwwad.text: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise.

verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ

english_rwwad.text: We have adorned the sky with the beauty of the stars,

verses.translation: We have adorned the sky with the beauty of the stars,

verses.arabic: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ

english_rwwad.text: and for safeguarding it against every rebellious devil,

verses.translation: and for safeguarding it against every rebellious devil,

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ

english_rwwad.text: so that they cannot eavesdrop on the highest assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By meteors.

verses.translation: so that they cannot eavesdrop on the highest assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side[1]

verses.arabic: دُحُورًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ

english_rwwad.text: to repel them; and for them there will be a perpetual punishment,

verses.translation: to repel them; and for them there will be a perpetual punishment,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ

english_rwwad.text: except for the one who stealthily snatches away some words, and he is then pursued by a piercing flame.

verses.translation: except for the one who stealthily snatches away some words, and he is then pursued by a piercing flame.

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: So ask them, “Are they more difficult to create or other things We created? We created them[1] from sticky clay.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., their father Adam.

verses.translation: So ask them, “Are they more difficult to create or other things We created? We created them[1] from sticky clay.

verses.arabic: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Rather you are astonished, while they ridicule it,

verses.translation: Rather you are astonished, while they ridicule it,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and when they are reminded, they pay no heed,

verses.translation: and when they are reminded, they pay no heed,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and when they see a sign, they ridicule it,

verses.translation: and when they see a sign, they ridicule it,

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: and they say, “This is nothing but clear magic.

verses.translation: and they say, “This is nothing but clear magic.

verses.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Is it that when we are dead and become dust and bones, will we really be raised up again,

verses.translation: Is it that when we are dead and become dust and bones, will we really be raised up again,

verses.arabic: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and our forefathers too?”

verses.translation: and our forefathers too?”

verses.arabic: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Yes, and you will be disgraced.”

verses.translation: Say, “Yes, and you will be disgraced.”

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: It will only be a single Blast[1], and at once they will be looking around.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the second blow of the Trumpet.

verses.translation: It will only be a single Blast[1], and at once they will be looking around.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: They will say, “Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”

verses.translation: They will say, “Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be told], “This is the Day of Decision that you used to deny.”

verses.translation: [They will be told], “This is the Day of Decision that you used to deny.”

verses.arabic: ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [The angels will be told], “Gather all those who did wrong and their fellows[1], and whatever they used to worship
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In wrongdoing or evil deeds.

verses.translation: [The angels will be told], “Gather all those who did wrong and their fellows[1], and whatever they used to worship

verses.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: besides Allah, and lead them to the way of Hell,

verses.translation: besides Allah, and lead them to the way of Hell,

verses.arabic: وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and stop them, for they are to be questioned.”

verses.translation: and stop them, for they are to be questioned.”

verses.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be asked], “What is the matter with you, that you no longer help one another?”

verses.translation: [They will be asked], “What is the matter with you, that you no longer help one another?”

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Rather on that Day they will surrender completely.

verses.translation: Rather on that Day they will surrender completely.

verses.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will turn to one another, reproaching one another.

verses.translation: They will turn to one another, reproaching one another.

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

english_rwwad.text: [The followers] will say, “It was you who used to delude us from the right way[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or you used to pressure us, or deceived us with false oaths, or claimed to have the truth.

verses.translation: [The followers] will say, “It was you who used to delude us from the right way[1].”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: [The misleaders] will say, “Rather, you yourselves were not believers,

verses.translation: [The misleaders] will say, “Rather, you yourselves were not believers,

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَٰغِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and we had no power over you, rather you yourselves were a transgressing people.

verses.translation: and we had no power over you, rather you yourselves were a transgressing people.

verses.arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Now the punishment of our Lord has come true against us; we will surely taste it.

verses.translation: Now the punishment of our Lord has come true against us; we will surely taste it.

verses.arabic: فَأَغْوَيْنَٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We did misguide you, for we ourselves were misguided”.

verses.translation: We did misguide you, for we ourselves were misguided”.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day they will all share in the punishment.

verses.translation: On that Day they will all share in the punishment.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is how We deal with the wicked,

verses.translation: This is how We deal with the wicked,

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: for whenever it was said to them, “None has the right to be worshiped except Allah,” they became arrogant,

verses.translation: for whenever it was said to them, “None has the right to be worshiped except Allah,” they became arrogant,

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: and said, “Are we going to abandon our gods for a mad poet[1]?”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They mean the Prophet (ﷺ).

verses.translation: and said, “Are we going to abandon our gods for a mad poet[1]?”

verses.arabic: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Rather, he came with the truth and confirmed the messengers.

verses.translation: Rather, he came with the truth and confirmed the messengers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: You will surely taste the painful punishment,

verses.translation: You will surely taste the painful punishment,

verses.arabic: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and you will only be recompensed for what you used to do,

verses.translation: and you will only be recompensed for what you used to do,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except the chosen slaves of Allah.

verses.translation: except the chosen slaves of Allah.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

english_rwwad.text: They will have a known provision,

verses.translation: They will have a known provision,

verses.arabic: فَوَٰكِهُ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: fruits[1]; and they will be honored
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., everything delicious that they desire.

verses.translation: fruits[1]; and they will be honored

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: in Gardens of Bliss,

verses.translation: in Gardens of Bliss,

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: facing one another[1] on couches.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It implies that they will not harbor ill feelings toward one another.

verses.translation: facing one another[1] on couches.

verses.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: They will be served with a cup of wine from a flowing stream,

verses.translation: They will be served with a cup of wine from a flowing stream,

verses.arabic: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: white and delicious for those who drink.

verses.translation: white and delicious for those who drink.

verses.arabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: It will cause no harm, nor will they be intoxicated by it,

verses.translation: It will cause no harm, nor will they be intoxicated by it,

verses.arabic: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: and with them will be maidens of modest gaze[1] and beautiful eyes,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., chaste and bashful, looking only at their mates.

verses.translation: and with them will be maidens of modest gaze[1] and beautiful eyes,

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

english_rwwad.text: as if they were well-protected eggs[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or pristine pearls.

verses.translation: as if they were well-protected eggs[1].

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then they will turn to one another asking[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of their lives in the world and what led them to Paradise.

verses.translation: Then they will turn to one another asking[1].

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: One of them will say, “I had a close friend [in the world]

verses.translation: One of them will say, “I had a close friend [in the world]

verses.arabic: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: who used to say[1], ‘Are you one of those who believe
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Mockingly.

verses.translation: who used to say[1], ‘Are you one of those who believe

verses.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

english_rwwad.text: that when we die and become dust and bones, shall we be brought for judgment?’”

verses.translation: that when we die and become dust and bones, shall we be brought for judgment?’”

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He will say[1], “Do you wish to see [his fate]?”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To his companions in Paradise.

verses.translation: He will say[1], “Do you wish to see [his fate]?”

verses.arabic: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: So he will look down and see him[1] in the midst of the Blazing Fire.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] His close friend who tried to dissuade him from faith.

verses.translation: So he will look down and see him[1] in the midst of the Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ

english_rwwad.text: He will say, “By Allah, you were about to ruin me.

verses.translation: He will say, “By Allah, you were about to ruin me.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Were it not for the grace of my Lord, I would have been among those who are brought [to Hell].”

verses.translation: Were it not for the grace of my Lord, I would have been among those who are brought [to Hell].”

verses.arabic: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ

english_rwwad.text: [He will say to his fellow believers], “Are we not going to die anymore,

verses.translation: [He will say to his fellow believers], “Are we not going to die anymore,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except for our first death, nor are we going to be punished?”

verses.translation: except for our first death, nor are we going to be punished?”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: This is indeed the supreme triumph!

verses.translation: This is indeed the supreme triumph!

verses.arabic: لِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَٰمِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: For such [reward] let the workers work.

verses.translation: For such [reward] let the workers work.

verses.arabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

english_rwwad.text: Is this a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqūm[1]?[2]
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] The tree of cactus.
 [2] The disbelievers of Makkah derided the Prophet (ﷺ) when he warned them of this tree. They wondered how a tree could grow in Hellfire. So Allah revealed this verse.

verses.translation: Is this a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqūm[1]?[2]

verses.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We have made it a trial for the wrongdoers.

verses.translation: We have made it a trial for the wrongdoers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: It is a tree that grows in the bottom of the Blazing Fire;

verses.translation: It is a tree that grows in the bottom of the Blazing Fire;

verses.arabic: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ

english_rwwad.text: its fruits are like heads of devils.

verses.translation: its fruits are like heads of devils.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will certainly eat from it, filling their bellies.

verses.translation: They will certainly eat from it, filling their bellies.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture of scalding water,

verses.translation: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture of scalding water,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: then their final return will be to the Blazing Fire.

verses.translation: then their final return will be to the Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ

english_rwwad.text: For they found their forefathers astray,

verses.translation: For they found their forefathers astray,

verses.arabic: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: so they rushed to follow in their footsteps.

verses.translation: so they rushed to follow in their footsteps.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, most of the earlier people went astray before them,

verses.translation: Indeed, most of the earlier people went astray before them,

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: even though We sent among them warners.

verses.translation: even though We sent among them warners.

verses.arabic: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then see how was the end of those who were warned,

verses.translation: Then see how was the end of those who were warned,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except the chosen slaves of Allah.

verses.translation: except the chosen slaves of Allah.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, Noah called upon Us; how excellent are We at responding!

verses.translation: Indeed, Noah called upon Us; how excellent are We at responding!

verses.arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: And We saved him and his household[1] from the great distress,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the believers in his household.

verses.translation: And We saved him and his household[1] from the great distress,

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and made his offspring[1] the only survivors,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Noah’s offspring: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.translation: and made his offspring[1] the only survivors,

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.translation: and We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: “Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.”

verses.translation: “Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.translation: This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: He was one of Our believing slaves.

verses.translation: He was one of Our believing slaves.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then we drowned the others.

verses.translation: Then we drowned the others.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, Abraham was one of those who followed his way.

verses.translation: Indeed, Abraham was one of those who followed his way.

verses.arabic: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart,

verses.translation: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart,

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshiping?

verses.translation: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshiping?

verses.arabic: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Is it false gods that you seek other than Allah?

verses.translation: Is it false gods that you seek other than Allah?

verses.arabic: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then what do you think of the Lord of the worlds?”

verses.translation: Then what do you think of the Lord of the worlds?”

verses.arabic: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ

english_rwwad.text: He then cast a glance at the stars[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] His people had faith in astrology, so Abraham pretended to do the same to show them that he was not able to join them at their pagan feast and to remain in their temple of idols, while he was planning to destroy their idols.

verses.translation: He then cast a glance at the stars[1],

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: and said, “I am sick[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Ibrahim (peace be upon him) did not lie except for three lies: His saying {I am sick} and his saying {Rather, the chief of them did this} and his saying about his wife, “She is my sister.” [Al-Bukhāri, Muslim]. Two of them were for the sake of Allah, and the third one was for the sake of his sister.

verses.translation: and said, “I am sick[1].”

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So they went away from him and left.

verses.translation: So they went away from him and left.

verses.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then he turned to their gods and said, “Why do you not eat[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The offerings placed before you.

verses.translation: Then he turned to their gods and said, “Why do you not eat[1]?

verses.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: What is wrong with you that you do not speak?”

verses.translation: What is wrong with you that you do not speak?”

verses.arabic: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ

english_rwwad.text: Then he turned upon them, striking them with his right hand.

verses.translation: Then he turned upon them, striking them with his right hand.

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then his people came rushing towards him.

verses.translation: Then his people came rushing towards him.

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “Do you worship what you yourselves carve,

verses.translation: He said, “Do you worship what you yourselves carve,

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: when it is Allah Who created you and all what you do?”

verses.translation: when it is Allah Who created you and all what you do?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “Build a pyre for him and throw him into the blazing fire.”

verses.translation: They said, “Build a pyre for him and throw him into the blazing fire.”

verses.arabic: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They contrived a plan against him, but We made them the lowest.

verses.translation: They contrived a plan against him, but We made them the lowest.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.

verses.translation: He said, “I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.

verses.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

english_rwwad.text: My Lord, grant me righteous offspring.”

verses.translation: My Lord, grant me righteous offspring.”

verses.arabic: فَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: So We gave him glad tidings of a forbearing boy[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Ishmael

verses.translation: So We gave him glad tidings of a forbearing boy[1].

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then when he reached the age where he could work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice you. What do you think?” He said, “O my dear father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, one of the steadfast.”

verses.translation: Then when he reached the age where he could work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice you. What do you think?” He said, “O my dear father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, one of the steadfast.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ

english_rwwad.text: When they both submitted [to Allah’s command] and Abraham laid him on his forehead,

verses.translation: When they both submitted [to Allah’s command] and Abraham laid him on his forehead,

verses.arabic: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: and We called out to him, “O Abraham,

verses.translation: and We called out to him, “O Abraham,

verses.arabic: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: You have fulfilled the dream.” This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.translation: You have fulfilled the dream.” This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ

english_rwwad.text: This was indeed a revealing test.

verses.translation: This was indeed a revealing test.

verses.arabic: وَفَدَيْنَٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah Almighty sent a ram to be sacrificed in place of Ishmael.

verses.translation: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice[1],

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.translation: and We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: “Peace be upon Abraham.”

verses.translation: “Peace be upon Abraham.”

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.translation: This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: He was one of Our believing slaves.

verses.translation: He was one of Our believing slaves.

verses.arabic: وَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِإِسْحَٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And We gave him the glad tidings of Isaac[1], a prophet, and one of the righteous.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The birth of Isaac is mentioned after the story of sacrifice, which verifies that the firstborn son who was sacrificed was indeed Ishmael and not Isaac, contrary to what is claimed by the Jews and Christians. This is also supported by 11:71, where Sarah is told that she would give birth to Isaac, who would have a son by the name of Jacob.

verses.translation: And We gave him the glad tidings of Isaac[1], a prophet, and one of the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: We blessed him[1] and Isaac, but among their offspring were some who did good and some who clearly wronged themselves.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Abraham or Ishmael.

verses.translation: We blessed him[1] and Isaac, but among their offspring were some who did good and some who clearly wronged themselves.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We bestowed Our favor upon Moses and Aaron,

verses.translation: Indeed, We bestowed Our favor upon Moses and Aaron,

verses.arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: and We saved them and their people from the great distress[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of enslavement at the hands of Pharaoh and his people, as well as of drowning.

verses.translation: and We saved them and their people from the great distress[1],

verses.arabic: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and We helped them, so they were victorious,

verses.translation: and We helped them, so they were victorious,

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and We gave them both the clear Scripture,

verses.translation: and We gave them both the clear Scripture,

verses.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: and guided them to the straight path;

verses.translation: and guided them to the straight path;

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and We left for them [a favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.translation: and We left for them [a favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”

verses.translation: “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.translation: This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They were truly of Our believing slaves.

verses.translation: They were truly of Our believing slaves.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Elijah was indeed one of the messengers.

verses.translation: Elijah was indeed one of the messengers.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: When he said to his people: “Do you not fear Allah?

verses.translation: When he said to his people: “Do you not fear Allah?

verses.arabic: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Do you call upon Ba‘l[1] and ignore the Best of the Creators,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] A great idol worshiped by the people.

verses.translation: Do you call upon Ba‘l[1] and ignore the Best of the Creators,

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”

verses.translation: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But they rejected him, so they will surely be brought [for punishment],

verses.translation: But they rejected him, so they will surely be brought [for punishment],

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except the chosen slaves of Allah.

verses.translation: except the chosen slaves of Allah.

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.translation: And We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

verses.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ

english_rwwad.text: “Peace be upon Elias.”

verses.translation: “Peace be upon Elias.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.translation: This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: He was one of Our believing slaves.

verses.translation: He was one of Our believing slaves.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Lot was indeed one of the messengers.

verses.translation: Lot was indeed one of the messengers.

verses.arabic: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When We saved him and all of his household,

verses.translation: When We saved him and all of his household,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except an old woman[1] who was among those who stayed behind.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Lot’s wife, who was not a believer.

verses.translation: except an old woman[1] who was among those who stayed behind.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We destroyed the rest.

verses.translation: Then We destroyed the rest.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ

english_rwwad.text: You [Makkans] pass by their ruins by day

verses.translation: You [Makkans] pass by their ruins by day

verses.arabic: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and by night. Do you still not understand?

verses.translation: and by night. Do you still not understand?

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Jonah was indeed one of the messengers.

verses.translation: Jonah was indeed one of the messengers.

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

english_rwwad.text: When he fled to the fully laden ship,

verses.translation: When he fled to the fully laden ship,

verses.arabic: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ

english_rwwad.text: then he cast lots[1] with them, but was among those who lost.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To determine who would be cast overboard in order to save the rest of the passengers; the ship was about to sink, for it was overloaded.

verses.translation: then he cast lots[1] with them, but was among those who lost.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: The whale then swallowed him while he was blameworthy[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For leaving his people without Allah’s permission.

verses.translation: The whale then swallowed him while he was blameworthy[1].

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Were it not for the fact that he was one of those who glorify Allah,

verses.translation: Were it not for the fact that he was one of those who glorify Allah,

verses.arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day of Resurrection[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The belly of the fish would have turned to be his grave.

verses.translation: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day of Resurrection[1].

verses.arabic: فَنَبَذْنَٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: But We cast him ashore on a barren land while he was ill,

verses.translation: But We cast him ashore on a barren land while he was ill,

verses.arabic: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: and caused a gourd vine[1] to grow over him.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For its cooling shade and as food for him.

verses.translation: and caused a gourd vine[1] to grow over him.

verses.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We sent him[1] to one hundred thousand people or more,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., We sent him thereafter to his people.

verses.translation: We sent him[1] to one hundred thousand people or more,

verses.arabic: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: and they believed, so We let them enjoy for a while.

verses.translation: and they believed, so We let them enjoy for a while.

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?”[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The pagans of Makkah claimed that angels were Allah’s daughters, while preferring sons for themselves.

verses.translation: So ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?”[1]

verses.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or did We create the angels as females while they were watching?

verses.translation: Or did We create the angels as females while they were watching?

verses.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed, it is one of their fabrications when they say,

verses.translation: No indeed, it is one of their fabrications when they say,

verses.arabic: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: “Allah has children,” and they are truly liars.

verses.translation: “Allah has children,” and they are truly liars.

verses.arabic: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Did He choose daughters over sons[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., daughters that you hate over sons that you like?

verses.translation: Did He choose daughters over sons[1]?

verses.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

verses.translation: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Will you not then take heed?

verses.translation: Will you not then take heed?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: Do you have any compelling proof?

verses.translation: Do you have any compelling proof?

verses.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then bring your scripture, if you are truthful.

verses.translation: Then bring your scripture, if you are truthful.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They claim that there is a kinship between Him and the jinn[1], when the jinn themselves know that such people will surely be brought [for punishment].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It was claimed by some Arab pagans that angels are daughters of Allah through female jinn.

verses.translation: They claim that there is a kinship between Him and the jinn[1], when the jinn themselves know that such people will surely be brought [for punishment].

verses.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Glorified is Allah far above what they ascribe [to Him].

verses.translation: Glorified is Allah far above what they ascribe [to Him].

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

english_rwwad.text: But not the chosen slaves of Allah[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Who do not ascribe to Allah such false claims.

verses.translation: But not the chosen slaves of Allah[1].

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So you and whatever you worship

verses.translation: So you and whatever you worship

verses.arabic: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: none of you can lure anyone away from Him,

verses.translation: none of you can lure anyone away from Him,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: except those who are destined to burn in the Blazing Fire[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Due to their disbelief and evil deeds.

verses.translation: except those who are destined to burn in the Blazing Fire[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

english_rwwad.text: [The angels say][1], “There is none among us but has a known station[2]:
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Refuting the disbelievers’ false claims about them.
 [2] In worshiping Allah and obeying Him in our assigned tasks.

verses.translation: [The angels say][1], “There is none among us but has a known station[2]:

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ

english_rwwad.text: We are indeed those who stand lined up in rows,

verses.translation: We are indeed those who stand lined up in rows,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and we are indeed those who glorify Allah.”

verses.translation: and we are indeed those who glorify Allah.”

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And [the pagans] used to say[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Before the revelation of the Qur’an.

verses.translation: And [the pagans] used to say[1],

verses.arabic: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: “If only we had a scripture[1] like the previous people,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Such as the Torah and the Gospel.

verses.translation: “If only we had a scripture[1] like the previous people,

verses.arabic: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

english_rwwad.text: we would have surely been true slaves of Allah.”

verses.translation: we would have surely been true slaves of Allah.”

verses.arabic: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But they rejected it[1]; soon they will come to know.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., their own message, the Qur’an.

verses.translation: But they rejected it[1]; soon they will come to know.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Our Word has already been given to Our slaves, the messengers,

verses.translation: Our Word has already been given to Our slaves, the messengers,

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ

english_rwwad.text: that it is surely they who will be given victory,

verses.translation: that it is surely they who will be given victory,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and that Our soldiers will surely be the victors.

verses.translation: and that Our soldiers will surely be the victors.

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: So turn away from them for a while.

verses.translation: So turn away from them for a while.

verses.arabic: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Wait and see; soon they will see [their end].

verses.translation: Wait and see; soon they will see [their end].

verses.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do they really seek to hasten Our punishment?

verses.translation: Do they really seek to hasten Our punishment?

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When it[1] descends on their courtyard, how terrible will be the morning of those who were warned!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah’s punishment.

verses.translation: When it[1] descends on their courtyard, how terrible will be the morning of those who were warned!

verses.arabic: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: And turn away from them for a while.

verses.translation: And turn away from them for a while.

verses.arabic: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Wait and see; soon they will see [their end].

verses.translation: Wait and see; soon they will see [their end].

verses.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, far above what they ascribe [to Him],

verses.translation: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, far above what they ascribe [to Him],

verses.arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and peace be upon the messengers,

verses.translation: and peace be upon the messengers,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: and all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ صٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ

english_rwwad.text: Sād[1]. By the Qur’an, full of reminder[2],
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] See footnote 2:1.
 [2] The oath's completion is that the Qur’an is inimitable and thus Allah's miracle.

verses.translation: Sād[1]. By the Qur’an, full of reminder[2],

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ

english_rwwad.text: yet those who disbelieve are in arrogance and dissension.

verses.translation: yet those who disbelieve are in arrogance and dissension.

verses.arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ

english_rwwad.text: How many generations have We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late for deliverance.

verses.translation: How many generations have We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late for deliverance.

verses.arabic: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ

english_rwwad.text: They wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves[1], and the disbelievers say, “This is a magician and a liar!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The disbelievers demanded that an angel be sent to them to convey the message of Allah, not a human like themselves.

verses.translation: They wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves[1], and the disbelievers say, “This is a magician and a liar!

verses.arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًا وَٰحِدًا إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ

english_rwwad.text: Has he made all gods into one God? Indeed, this is something strange!”

verses.translation: Has he made all gods into one God? Indeed, this is something strange!”

verses.arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ

english_rwwad.text: The leaders among them departed, saying, “Carry on as you are, and stay faithful to your gods. Indeed, there is a motive behind it[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., The Prophet (ﷺ) only wants to gain influence and prestige for himself.

verses.translation: The leaders among them departed, saying, “Carry on as you are, and stay faithful to your gods. Indeed, there is a motive behind it[1].

verses.arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ

english_rwwad.text: We have not heard of this in the last religion[1]. This is nothing but a fabrication.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It refers to Christianity or pagan Arab beliefs.

verses.translation: We have not heard of this in the last religion[1]. This is nothing but a fabrication.

verses.arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ

english_rwwad.text: Has the Reminder been sent down to him from among us?” Rather, they are in doubt about My Reminder[1], for they have not yet tasted My punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They do not question the Prophet's (ﷺ) honesty; rather, they question the Qur’an itself. See 6:33.

verses.translation: Has the Reminder been sent down to him from among us?” Rather, they are in doubt about My Reminder[1], for they have not yet tasted My punishment.

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Bestower?

verses.translation: Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Bestower?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they have the dominion of the heavens and earth and all that is between them? Then let them ascend by any means[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To manage the affairs of their dominion.

verses.translation: Or do they have the dominion of the heavens and earth and all that is between them? Then let them ascend by any means[1].

verses.arabic: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ

english_rwwad.text: This is only a small army[1] among several armies[2] that will soon be defeated.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] It alludes to the defeat of the pagans of Makkah at Badr.
 [2] i.e., the defeated armies of the past who rejected their messengers.

verses.translation: This is only a small army[1] among several armies[2] that will soon be defeated.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ

english_rwwad.text: The people of Noah rejected [their messengers] before them, as did ‘Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes[1];
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It refers to the stakes by which he used to torture people, or the pyramids which are like stakes into the earth.

verses.translation: The people of Noah rejected [their messengers] before them, as did ‘Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes[1];

verses.arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ

english_rwwad.text: and Thamūd and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Forest – such were the [denier] parties.

verses.translation: and Thamūd and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Forest – such were the [denier] parties.

verses.arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ

english_rwwad.text: Each of them rejected their messenger, therefore My punishment became inevitable.

verses.translation: Each of them rejected their messenger, therefore My punishment became inevitable.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ

english_rwwad.text: They are only waiting for a single Blast that cannot be stopped[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Fawāq: "respite", more literally, "a period between two milkings of a she-camel," which also alludes to "return" or "repetition."

verses.translation: They are only waiting for a single Blast that cannot be stopped[1].

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

english_rwwad.text: They say, “Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of punishment] before the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.translation: They say, “Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of punishment] before the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.arabic: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

english_rwwad.text: Bear with patience whatever they say, and remember Our slave David, the man of strength who constantly turned [to Allah].

verses.translation: Bear with patience whatever they say, and remember Our slave David, the man of strength who constantly turned [to Allah].

verses.arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ

english_rwwad.text: We subjected the mountains to join him in glorifying Allah in the evening and the morning,

verses.translation: We subjected the mountains to join him in glorifying Allah in the evening and the morning,

verses.arabic: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

english_rwwad.text: and the birds, in their flocks; they all would echo his praise.

verses.translation: and the birds, in their flocks; they all would echo his praise.

verses.arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ

english_rwwad.text: We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and sound judgment [and speech].

verses.translation: We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and sound judgment [and speech].

verses.arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ

english_rwwad.text: Has there come to you the story of the adversaries, when they climbed the wall of his chamber?

verses.translation: Has there come to you the story of the adversaries, when they climbed the wall of his chamber?

verses.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ

english_rwwad.text: When they entered upon David, he was frightened. They said, “Do not be afraid. We are two adversaries: one of us has wronged the other, so judge between us with fairness, and do not be unjust, and guide us to the straight path.

verses.translation: When they entered upon David, he was frightened. They said, “Do not be afraid. We are two adversaries: one of us has wronged the other, so judge between us with fairness, and do not be unjust, and guide us to the straight path.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ

english_rwwad.text: This is my brother[1]. He has ninety-nine ewes while I have only one. He said, ‘Give her into my charge,’ and he overpowered me in speech.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., brother in faith, business partner, or biological brother.

verses.translation: This is my brother[1]. He has ninety-nine ewes while I have only one. He said, ‘Give her into my charge,’ and he overpowered me in speech.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ

english_rwwad.text: David said, “He has certainly wronged you by demanding that your ewe be added to his flock. Indeed, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous deeds – and how few they are.” Then David realized that We were only testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness[1], fell down in prostration, and turned to Him in repentance.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For fear of the two men or the misjudgment he made.

verses.translation: David said, “He has certainly wronged you by demanding that your ewe be added to his flock. Indeed, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous deeds – and how few they are.” Then David realized that We were only testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness[1], fell down in prostration, and turned to Him in repentance.

verses.arabic: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

english_rwwad.text: So We forgave that for him, and he certainly has a place of nearness to Us and a good place of return.

verses.translation: So We forgave that for him, and he certainly has a place of nearness to Us and a good place of return.

verses.arabic: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ

english_rwwad.text: “O David, We have made you a ruler on earth, so judge between people with justice, and do not follow your desires lest they lead you astray from Allah’s way. Those who go astray from Allah’s way will have a severe punishment because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.translation: “O David, We have made you a ruler on earth, so judge between people with justice, and do not follow your desires lest they lead you astray from Allah’s way. Those who go astray from Allah’s way will have a severe punishment because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًا ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve. So woe to the disbelievers from the Fire!

verses.translation: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve. So woe to the disbelievers from the Fire!

verses.arabic: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: Should We make those who believe and do righteous deeds equal to those who spread corruption on earth? Or should We make the righteous equal to the wicked?

verses.translation: Should We make those who believe and do righteous deeds equal to those who spread corruption on earth? Or should We make the righteous equal to the wicked?

verses.arabic: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

english_rwwad.text: This is a blessed Book that We have sent down to you [O Prophet] so that they may reflect upon its verses, and so that people of understanding may take heed.

verses.translation: This is a blessed Book that We have sent down to you [O Prophet] so that they may reflect upon its verses, and so that people of understanding may take heed.

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

english_rwwad.text: And to David We gave Solomon, an excellent and faithful slave who constantly turned [to Us].

verses.translation: And to David We gave Solomon, an excellent and faithful slave who constantly turned [to Us].

verses.arabic: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ

english_rwwad.text: One evening, well-trained and swift horses of noble breed were presented before him.

verses.translation: One evening, well-trained and swift horses of noble breed were presented before him.

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ

english_rwwad.text: He then said, “I gave preference to the love of fine things over the remembrance of my Lord,” until the sun went out of sight.

verses.translation: He then said, “I gave preference to the love of fine things over the remembrance of my Lord,” until the sun went out of sight.

verses.arabic: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ

english_rwwad.text: [He ordered], “Bring them back to me,” and he began striking [their] shanks and necks[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] With his sword as expiation, for it might have been permissible in their law, especially if it had been for the sake of Allah such as missing prayer or the like; this is a more correct view. However, Ibn Jarīr favored the view that Solomon began to rub down their legs and necks with the hand, not by the sword.

verses.translation: [He ordered], “Bring them back to me,” and he began striking [their] shanks and necks[1].

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We tested Solomon and cast upon his throne a body, then he turned [to Allah][1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) said that one night Solomon said that each one of his wives would conceive a boy who would fight for the sake of Allah. He forgot to say ‘Allah willing,’ so only one of them gave birth to a deformed, dead baby. So Solomon sought Allah’s forgiveness. [Al-Bukhāri]

verses.translation: Indeed, We tested Solomon and cast upon his throne a body, then he turned [to Allah][1].

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom, the like of which will never be granted to anyone after me. You are indeed the Bestower.”

verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom, the like of which will never be granted to anyone after me. You are indeed the Bestower.”

verses.arabic: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ

english_rwwad.text: So We subjected to him the wind blowing gently by his command to wherever he wished,

verses.translation: So We subjected to him the wind blowing gently by his command to wherever he wished,

verses.arabic: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ

english_rwwad.text: And [We subjected to him] the devils, all kinds of builders and divers[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They dived to bring him pearls.

verses.translation: And [We subjected to him] the devils, all kinds of builders and divers[1],

verses.arabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ

english_rwwad.text: and others bound in chains.

verses.translation: and others bound in chains.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

english_rwwad.text: [We said], “This is Our gift, so give freely or withhold, without account[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., you will not be called to account thereby.

verses.translation: [We said], “This is Our gift, so give freely or withhold, without account[1].”

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

english_rwwad.text: And he certainly has a status of nearness to Us and a good place of return.

verses.translation: And he certainly has a status of nearness to Us and a good place of return.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ

english_rwwad.text: And remember Our slave Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Indeed, Satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”

verses.translation: And remember Our slave Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Indeed, Satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”

verses.arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ

english_rwwad.text: [Allah said], “Stamp [the ground] with your foot: here is a cool spring for bathing and drinking.”

verses.translation: [Allah said], “Stamp [the ground] with your foot: here is a cool spring for bathing and drinking.”

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

english_rwwad.text: And We restored his family to him and the like of them[1] as a mercy from Us and as a reminder for people of understanding.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] When Allah granted him health, the whole family returned to him and he was granted even more children.

verses.translation: And We restored his family to him and the like of them[1] as a mercy from Us and as a reminder for people of understanding.

verses.arabic: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًا نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

english_rwwad.text: [We said], “Take a bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [your wife] with it, and do not break your oath[1].” We truly found him patient – an excellent and faithful slave he was. He constantly turned [to Us].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] When Job was afflicted with illness, everyone abandoned him except his wife. Once he became angry with her and vowed to punish her with one hundred lashes if he recovered. According to Allah's instruction, the oath was fulfilled by striking her once with one hundred blades of grass without harming his wife.

verses.translation: [We said], “Take a bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [your wife] with it, and do not break your oath[1].” We truly found him patient – an excellent and faithful slave he was. He constantly turned [to Us].

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ

english_rwwad.text: Remember Our slaves: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob – men of strength and insight.

verses.translation: Remember Our slaves: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob – men of strength and insight.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: We chose them exclusively for the remembrance of the Final Home.

verses.translation: We chose them exclusively for the remembrance of the Final Home.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, they are before us among the chosen and best ones.

verses.translation: Indeed, they are before us among the chosen and best ones.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

english_rwwad.text: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhul-Kifl[1] – all were among the best.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Scholars are of different opinions as to whether Dhul-Kifl was a prophet or only a righteous man.

verses.translation: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhul-Kifl[1] – all were among the best.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

english_rwwad.text: This is a reminder. And the righteous will surely have a good return:

verses.translation: This is a reminder. And the righteous will surely have a good return:

verses.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ

english_rwwad.text: Gardens of Eternity, with gates wide open for them.

verses.translation: Gardens of Eternity, with gates wide open for them.

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ

english_rwwad.text: They will recline therein, calling for abundant fruit and drink.

verses.translation: They will recline therein, calling for abundant fruit and drink.

verses.arabic: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ

english_rwwad.text: And they will have maidens of modest gaze[1] and equal age.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Their gaze will be restricted to their mates alone.

verses.translation: And they will have maidens of modest gaze[1] and equal age.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

english_rwwad.text: This is what you are promised for the Day of Account.

verses.translation: This is what you are promised for the Day of Account.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, this is Our provision [for the righteous] that will never cease.

verses.translation: Indeed, this is Our provision [for the righteous] that will never cease.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ

english_rwwad.text: This [is so]. But the transgressors will surely have the worst return:

verses.translation: This [is so]. But the transgressors will surely have the worst return:

verses.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ

english_rwwad.text: Hell, where they will burn. What a terrible resting place!

verses.translation: Hell, where they will burn. What a terrible resting place!

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ

english_rwwad.text: Let them taste this: scalding water and pus,

verses.translation: Let them taste this: scalding water and pus,

verses.arabic: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ

english_rwwad.text: and other similar [torments] of various kinds.

verses.translation: and other similar [torments] of various kinds.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: [The misleaders will say], “Here is a crowd of people being thrown in with you. They are not welcome! They will surely burn in the Fire.”

verses.translation: [The misleaders will say], “Here is a crowd of people being thrown in with you. They are not welcome! They will surely burn in the Fire.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ

english_rwwad.text: They will say, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this on us. What a terrible place to settle in!”

verses.translation: They will say, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this on us. What a terrible place to settle in!”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this on us, give him double punishment in the Fire.”

verses.translation: They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this on us, give him double punishment in the Fire.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ

english_rwwad.text: They will say, “Why do we not see those whom we considered to be among the wicked[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They are alluding to the believers.

verses.translation: They will say, “Why do we not see those whom we considered to be among the wicked[1]?

verses.arabic: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ

english_rwwad.text: Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them, or do our eyes fail to see them [in the Fire]?”

verses.translation: Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them, or do our eyes fail to see them [in the Fire]?”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: This is certainly true that the people of the Fire will dispute among themselves.

verses.translation: This is certainly true that the people of the Fire will dispute among themselves.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ

english_rwwad.text: Say [O Prophet], “I am only a warner, and none has the right to be worshiped except Allah, the One, the Subjugator,

verses.translation: Say [O Prophet], “I am only a warner, and none has the right to be worshiped except Allah, the One, the Subjugator,

verses.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ

english_rwwad.text: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty[1], Most Forgiving[2].”
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Honored for absolute power, wisdom, and justice.
 [2] Who repeatedly conceals the sins of His slaves.

verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty[1], Most Forgiving[2].”

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “This [Qur’an] is of momentous news

verses.translation: Say, “This [Qur’an] is of momentous news

verses.arabic: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ

english_rwwad.text: from which you are turning away.”

verses.translation: from which you are turning away.”

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [And say], “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [about Adam][1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] When the angels obeyed Allah’s command to prostrate before Adam; whereas, Satan refused to comply, for he considered himself superior to Adam, neglecting the fact that this was a command from Allah Almighty.

verses.translation: [And say], “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [about Adam][1].

verses.arabic: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: I have only received revelation in order to give a clear warning.”

verses.translation: I have only received revelation in order to give a clear warning.”

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: [Remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay.

verses.translation: [Remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When I completed his creation and breathed into him of My spirit[1], fall down in prostration to him.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 15:29.

verses.translation: When I completed his creation and breathed into him of My spirit[1], fall down in prostration to him.”

verses.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then the angels fell down in prostration all together,

verses.translation: Then the angels fell down in prostration all together,

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except Iblīs, who was arrogant and became one of the disbelievers[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This command of Allah to bow down before Adam was a test of obedience. Satan refused to comply out of arrogance for he thought he was better than Adam.

verses.translation: except Iblīs, who was arrogant and became one of the disbelievers[1].

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
