verses.translation: So We took revenge on them; see what was the end of the deniers!

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when Abraham said to his father and his people, “I disown all that you worship,

verses.translation: And [remember] when Abraham said to his father and his people, “I disown all that you worship,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ

english_rwwad.text: except the One Who created me; He will surely guide me.”

verses.translation: except the One Who created me; He will surely guide me.”

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And he made it[1] a lasting word among his descendants, so that they may return [to Allah].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., his testimony of faith that none has the right to be worshiped except Allah.

verses.translation: And he made it[1] a lasting word among his descendants, so that they may return [to Allah].

verses.arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: However, I let these [Makkans] and their forefathers[1] enjoy their lives, until there came to them the truth and a clear messenger[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the descendants of Abraham (ﷺ).
 [2] i.e., Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).

verses.translation: However, I let these [Makkans] and their forefathers[1] enjoy their lives, until there came to them the truth and a clear messenger[2].

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we definitely reject it.”

verses.translation: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we definitely reject it.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: And they said, “Why was this Qur’an not sent down to a great man from one of the two towns[1]?”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Makkah and its neighboring town; Tā’if.

verses.translation: And they said, “Why was this Qur’an not sent down to a great man from one of the two towns[1]?”

verses.arabic: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Is it they who distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We Who have distributed their livelihood among them in the life of this world, and have raised some of them above others in ranks, so that they may serve one another. But the mercy of your Lord is better than what they accumulate.

verses.translation: Is it they who distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We Who have distributed their livelihood among them in the life of this world, and have raised some of them above others in ranks, so that they may serve one another. But the mercy of your Lord is better than what they accumulate.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Were it not that all people might become a single community [of disbelievers][1], We would have given those who disbelieve in the Most Compassionate One houses of sliver roofs and staircases to ascend,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Assuming that Allah’s generosity to them was a sign of His approval.

verses.translation: Were it not that all people might become a single community [of disbelievers][1], We would have given those who disbelieve in the Most Compassionate One houses of sliver roofs and staircases to ascend,

verses.arabic: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ

english_rwwad.text: and their houses having [silver] doors and couches on which they recline,

verses.translation: and their houses having [silver] doors and couches on which they recline,

verses.arabic: وَزُخْرُفًا وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and [golden] ornaments. But all of these are mere enjoyments of the life of this world, and the Hereafter with your Lord is [only] for those who fear Allah.

verses.translation: and [golden] ornaments. But all of these are mere enjoyments of the life of this world, and the Hereafter with your Lord is [only] for those who fear Allah.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: Whoever turns away from the Reminder of the Most Compassionate [i.e., the Qur’an], We assign to him a devil to be his close associate,

verses.translation: Whoever turns away from the Reminder of the Most Compassionate [i.e., the Qur’an], We assign to him a devil to be his close associate,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: who will surely avert them from the [right] way, while they think that they are rightly guided.

verses.translation: who will surely avert them from the [right] way, while they think that they are rightly guided.

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ

english_rwwad.text: Then when he comes to Us, he will say [to his devil associate], “I wish you were as distant from me as the East and West. What a terrible associate [you were]!”

verses.translation: Then when he comes to Us, he will say [to his devil associate], “I wish you were as distant from me as the East and West. What a terrible associate [you were]!”

verses.arabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be told], “As you have done wrong, it will not benefit you Today that you are sharing the punishment[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In the life of this world, it is comforting to many people when they hear that others also went through similar trials. However, this will not be the case on Judgment Day, as everyone will be desperate to save themselves, regardless of what happens to others.

verses.translation: [They will be told], “As you have done wrong, it will not benefit you Today that you are sharing the punishment[1].”

verses.arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or the one who is clearly misguided?

verses.translation: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or the one who is clearly misguided?

verses.arabic: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Whether We take you away [in death], indeed We will exact retribution upon them,

verses.translation: Whether We take you away [in death], indeed We will exact retribution upon them,

verses.arabic: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: or We will show you what We warned them of, for We have full power over them.

verses.translation: or We will show you what We warned them of, for We have full power over them.

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: So hold fast to what is revealed to you. You are indeed on a straight path.

verses.translation: So hold fast to what is revealed to you. You are indeed on a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: This [Qur’an] is surely a glory[1] for you and your people, and you will [all] be questioned.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., an honor or a reminder.

verses.translation: This [Qur’an] is surely a glory[1] for you and your people, and you will [all] be questioned.

verses.arabic: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before you: Did We appoint gods to be worshiped besides the Most Compassionate?

verses.translation: Ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before you: Did We appoint gods to be worshiped besides the Most Compassionate?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his courtiers, so he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of the worlds.”

verses.translation: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his courtiers, so he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of the worlds.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them.

verses.translation: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them.

verses.arabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا وَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Every sign We showed them was greater than the one before it[1], and We seized them with punishment[2] so that they may turn in repentance.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the bright hand and the staff turning into a serpent. See 20:17-22.
 [2] i.e., the famine, scarcity of crops, floods, locusts, lice, frogs, and blood. See 7:130-133.

verses.translation: Every sign We showed them was greater than the one before it[1], and We seized them with punishment[2] so that they may turn in repentance.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “O magician, call upon your Lord for us, by virtue of the covenant He has made with you[1]; we will surely accept guidance.”

verses.translation: They said, “O magician, call upon your Lord for us, by virtue of the covenant He has made with you[1]; we will surely accept guidance.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But as soon We removed the punishment from them, they broke their promise.

verses.translation: But as soon We removed the punishment from them, they broke their promise.

verses.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Pharaoh proclaimed to his people, saying, “O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these streams[1] flowing at my feet? Do you not see?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., branches of the Nile River.

verses.translation: Pharaoh proclaimed to his people, saying, “O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these streams[1] flowing at my feet? Do you not see?

verses.arabic: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ

english_rwwad.text: Or am I not better than this contemptible one who can hardly express himself[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Moses had a speech impediment prior to his mission. However, when he became a prophet he asked Allah to remove his impediment, and his prayer was answered. See 20:25-36.

verses.translation: Or am I not better than this contemptible one who can hardly express himself[1]?

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then why are there not sent down upon him bracelets of gold or come with him angels to support him?”

verses.translation: Then why are there not sent down upon him bracelets of gold or come with him angels to support him?”

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Thus he made a fool of his people and they obeyed him. They were indeed a wicked people.

verses.translation: Thus he made a fool of his people and they obeyed him. They were indeed a wicked people.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When they angered Us, We exacted Our retribution and drowned them all.

verses.translation: When they angered Us, We exacted Our retribution and drowned them all.

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Thus We made them a precedent and a lesson[1] for the later generations.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] A precedent for those who do not learn any lesson from their example, and a lesson for those who are keen to learn a lesson.

verses.translation: Thus We made them a precedent and a lesson[1] for the later generations.

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ

english_rwwad.text: When the example of the son of Mary was given, your people laughed and jeered[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] When 21:98 was revealed, warning the pagans that all what they worship besides Allah will be in Hell, a poet who was a staunch enemy of Islam, Abdullah ibn az-Ziba‘ra, along with other pagans jeered and laughed arguing that Jesus will be in Hell as well! The Prophet (ﷺ) replied that the verse was talking exclusively about idols, adding that Jesus himself did not ask to be worshiped. Verse 21:101 was later revealed in support of the Prophet declaring that they are exempted.

verses.translation: When the example of the son of Mary was given, your people laughed and jeered[1],

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and they said, “Are Our gods better or he[1]?” They only mentioned him to you for the sake of argument. They are indeed a contentious people.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Jesus.

verses.translation: and they said, “Are Our gods better or he[1]?” They only mentioned him to you for the sake of argument. They are indeed a contentious people.

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

english_rwwad.text: He was only a slave whom We[1] favored and made him an example for the Children of Israel.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Allah Almighty.

verses.translation: He was only a slave whom We[1] favored and made him an example for the Children of Israel.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If We willed, We could [destroy you all and] replace you with angels, succeeding you on earth.

verses.translation: If We willed, We could [destroy you all and] replace you with angels, succeeding you on earth.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: And he [i.e., Jesus] will be a sign of the Hour; so do not have doubt about it and follow me[1]. This is a straight path.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ).

verses.translation: And he [i.e., Jesus] will be a sign of the Hour; so do not have doubt about it and follow me[1]. This is a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: Do not let Satan turn you away [from the straight path], for he is your sworn enemy.

verses.translation: Do not let Satan turn you away [from the straight path], for he is your sworn enemy.

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english_rwwad.text: When Jesus came with clear signs, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of that concerning which you differ; so fear Allah and obey me.

verses.translation: When Jesus came with clear signs, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of that concerning which you differ; so fear Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is a straight path.”

verses.translation: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is a straight path.”

verses.arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: But the factions differed among themselves [about Jesus]; so woe to the wrongdoers from the punishment of a painful Day!

verses.translation: But the factions differed among themselves [about Jesus]; so woe to the wrongdoers from the punishment of a painful Day!

verses.arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them by surprise when they least expect it?

verses.translation: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them by surprise when they least expect it?

verses.arabic: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day, close friends will become enemies to one another, except the righteous,

verses.translation: On that Day, close friends will become enemies to one another, except the righteous,

verses.arabic: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [It will be said to them], “O My slaves, there is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve,

verses.translation: [It will be said to them], “O My slaves, there is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: [those] who believed in Our verses and submitted [to Us as Muslims].

verses.translation: [those] who believed in Our verses and submitted [to Us as Muslims].

verses.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Enter Paradise, you and your companions[1], rejoicing in bliss.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., your spouses, children, friends, etc.

verses.translation: Enter Paradise, you and your companions[1], rejoicing in bliss.”

verses.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Golden trays and cups will be passed around among them; there will be all that souls desire and eyes delight in, and you will abide therein forever.

verses.translation: Golden trays and cups will be passed around among them; there will be all that souls desire and eyes delight in, and you will abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: That is Paradise which you will inherit for what you used to do.

verses.translation: That is Paradise which you will inherit for what you used to do.

verses.arabic: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: You will have therein abundant fruit[1] to eat from.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It also means everything delicious.

verses.translation: You will have therein abundant fruit[1] to eat from.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the wicked will be in the punishment of Hell forever.

verses.translation: Indeed, the wicked will be in the punishment of Hell forever.

verses.arabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

english_rwwad.text: It will not be lightened for them, and they will remain therein in utter despair.

verses.translation: It will not be lightened for them, and they will remain therein in utter despair.

verses.arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We did not wrong them, but they themselves were the wrongdoers.

verses.translation: We did not wrong them, but they themselves were the wrongdoers.

verses.arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will cry out, “O Mālik[1], let your Lord put an end to us!” He will say, “You are here to stay.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The chief keeper of Hell.

verses.translation: They will cry out, “O Mālik[1], let your Lord put an end to us!” He will say, “You are here to stay.”

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ جِئْنَٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We surely brought you the truth, but most of you were averse to the truth.

verses.translation: We surely brought you the truth, but most of you were averse to the truth.

verses.arabic: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Have they devised a plan[1]? We too have devised a plan.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Against the Prophet (ﷺ); it is referring to the pagans of Makkah.

verses.translation: Have they devised a plan[1]? We too have devised a plan.

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do they think that We do not hear their secret talks and private counsels? Yes indeed, and Our angel-messengers are with them recording everything.

verses.translation: Do they think that We do not hear their secret talks and private counsels? Yes indeed, and Our angel-messengers are with them recording everything.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَٰبِدِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “If the Most Compassionate truly had a son, I would be the first of [his] worshipers[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or I would be the first to approve it, as I obey Him in everything; whereas I deny that, for He has no offspring.

verses.translation: Say, “If the Most Compassionate truly had a son, I would be the first of [his] worshipers[1].”

verses.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and earth, Lord of the Throne, far above what they ascribe [to Him].

verses.translation: Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and earth, Lord of the Throne, far above what they ascribe [to Him].

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So leave them to indulge in falsehood and amuse themselves until they meet their Day that they are promised.

verses.translation: So leave them to indulge in falsehood and amuse themselves until they meet their Day that they are promised.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٌ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَٰهٌ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who is God in the heaven and God on earth, and He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.

verses.translation: It is He Who is God in the heaven and God on earth, and He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.

verses.arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you will be returned.

verses.translation: Blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you will be returned.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Those whom they supplicate[1] besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., worship.
 [2] i.e., except those who testify knowingly that none is worthy of worship except Allah, such as Jesus, Ezra, the angels, etc.

verses.translation: Those whom they supplicate[1] besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly[2].

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If you ask them who created them[1], they will surely say, “Allah.” How are they then deluded?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those who associate partners with Allah.

verses.translation: If you ask them who created them[1], they will surely say, “Allah.” How are they then deluded?

verses.arabic: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying[1], “O my Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Allah knows the complaint of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) about his people.

verses.translation: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying[1], “O my Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”

verses.arabic: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So turn away from them and say, “Peace[1].” They will come to know.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Safety and security, i.e., “I will not harm you.” This was before granting permission to the Prophet (ﷺ) for armed struggle.

verses.translation: So turn away from them and say, “Peace[1].” They will come to know.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ

english_rwwad.text: Hā Mīm[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.

verses.translation: Hā Mīm[1].

verses.arabic: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

english_rwwad.text: By the clear Book.

verses.translation: By the clear Book.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We sent it[1] down on a blessed night. We have always sent warners.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The revelation of the Qur’an started on the Night of Decree (al-Qadr) in the month of Ramadān, the 9th month of the lunar calendar. The Night of Decree is better than one thousand months. See (97:1-3 and 2:185).

verses.translation: Indeed, We sent it[1] down on a blessed night. We have always sent warners.

verses.arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: On that night, every matter of wisdom is determined[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The angels record and descend with whatever Allah has decreed for the coming year, according to what is inscribed in the Preserved Tablet.

verses.translation: On that night, every matter of wisdom is determined[1]

verses.arabic: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: by Our command. We have always sent messengers.

verses.translation: by Our command. We have always sent messengers.

verses.arabic: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: as a mercy from your Lord. He is indeed the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing,

verses.translation: as a mercy from your Lord. He is indeed the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing,

verses.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, if only you had sure faith.

verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, if only you had sure faith.

verses.arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: None has the right to be worshiped except Him, Who gives life and causes death – your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers.

verses.translation: None has the right to be worshiped except Him, Who gives life and causes death – your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers.

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

verses.translation: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

verses.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: So wait for a day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Referring to the drought that affected the pagans of Makkah severely, so they came to the Prophet (ﷺ), begging him to supplicate Allah to remove the affliction from them.

verses.translation: So wait for a day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke[1],

verses.arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: that will overwhelm the people. This is a painful punishment!

verses.translation: that will overwhelm the people. This is a painful punishment!

verses.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [They will cry,] “Our Lord, remove the punishment from us; we will surely believe!”

verses.translation: [They will cry,] “Our Lord, remove the punishment from us; we will surely believe!”

verses.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: How will they take heed, when a messenger who explained things clearly has already come to them?

verses.translation: How will they take heed, when a messenger who explained things clearly has already come to them?

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ

english_rwwad.text: Then they turned away from him and said, “[He is] a madman, taught by others.”

verses.translation: Then they turned away from him and said, “[He is] a madman, taught by others.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We shall hold the punishment back for a while, but you will surely return [to disbelief].

verses.translation: We shall hold the punishment back for a while, but you will surely return [to disbelief].

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when We seize [them] with the greatest assault, We will surely exact retribution.

verses.translation: On the Day when We seize [them] with the greatest assault, We will surely exact retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We tested the people of Pharaoh before them, when a noble messenger came to them,

verses.translation: Indeed, We tested the people of Pharaoh before them, when a noble messenger came to them,

verses.arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: [saying], “Hand over to me the slaves of Allah[1]. I am indeed a trustworthy messenger to you,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Children of Israel.

verses.translation: [saying], “Hand over to me the slaves of Allah[1]. I am indeed a trustworthy messenger to you,

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: and do not be arrogant towards Allah. I have certainly come to you with clear proof.

verses.translation: and do not be arrogant towards Allah. I have certainly come to you with clear proof.

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

english_rwwad.text: And I certainly seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or assault me with your tongues.

verses.translation: And I certainly seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death[1].

verses.arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ

english_rwwad.text: If you do not believe me, then leave me alone.”

verses.translation: If you do not believe me, then leave me alone.”

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then he called upon his Lord, “These are wicked people”.

verses.translation: Then he called upon his Lord, “These are wicked people”.

verses.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [Allah said], “Leave along with My slaves by night; you will surely be pursued.

verses.translation: [Allah said], “Leave along with My slaves by night; you will surely be pursued.

verses.arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And leave the sea parted[1]; for they are surely an army destined to drown.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., calm and still, in order that Pharaoh and his soldiers would follow you and be drowned.

verses.translation: And leave the sea parted[1]; for they are surely an army destined to drown.”

verses.arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: [Imagine] how many gardens and springs they left behind,

verses.translation: [Imagine] how many gardens and springs they left behind,

verses.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: and crops and splendid mansions,

verses.translation: and crops and splendid mansions,

verses.arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and luxuries they used to rejoice therein.

verses.translation: and luxuries they used to rejoice therein.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So it was; and We made another people inherit all that.

verses.translation: So it was; and We made another people inherit all that.

verses.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Neither the heaven nor earth wept for them, nor were they given any respite.

verses.translation: Neither the heaven nor earth wept for them, nor were they given any respite.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

english_rwwad.text: Thus did We save the Children of Israel from the humiliating punishment,

verses.translation: Thus did We save the Children of Israel from the humiliating punishment,

verses.arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

english_rwwad.text: from Pharaoh. He was indeed arrogant who transgressed all bounds.

verses.translation: from Pharaoh. He was indeed arrogant who transgressed all bounds.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We chose them[1] knowingly over all other peoples.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] We chose the Children of Israel over all other peoples of their time for their numerous prophets.

verses.translation: We chose them[1] knowingly over all other peoples.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: And We gave them signs in which there was a clear test.

verses.translation: And We gave them signs in which there was a clear test.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, these [Makkans] say,

verses.translation: Indeed, these [Makkans] say,

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: “There is nothing after our first death, and we will not be resurrected,

verses.translation: “There is nothing after our first death, and we will not be resurrected,

verses.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: then bring back our forefathers if you are truthful.”

verses.translation: then bring back our forefathers if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Are they better [in power] or the people of Tubba‘[1] and those who were before them? We destroyed them, for they were truly wicked[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the people of Sheba.
 [2] Tubba’ al-Himyari was a righteous Yemeni king of ancient times whose people persisted in disbelief and were destroyed; nonetheless, they were more powerful and superior to the pagans of Makkah.

verses.translation: Are they better [in power] or the people of Tubba‘[1] and those who were before them? We destroyed them, for they were truly wicked[2].

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them for amusement.

verses.translation: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them for amusement.

verses.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We have not created them except for a true purpose, but most of them do not know.

verses.translation: We have not created them except for a true purpose, but most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgment is the time appointed for them all,

verses.translation: Indeed, the Day of Judgment is the time appointed for them all,

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: the Day when no patron[1] will avail another in the least, nor will they be helped,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., protector, close associate, kith and kin, etc.

verses.translation: the Day when no patron[1] will avail another in the least, nor will they be helped,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.translation: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the tree of Zaqqūm

verses.translation: Indeed, the tree of Zaqqūm

verses.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: will be the food of the sinful,

verses.translation: will be the food of the sinful,

verses.arabic: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ

english_rwwad.text: like molten metal that will boil in their bellies

verses.translation: like molten metal that will boil in their bellies

verses.arabic: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: like the boiling of scalding water.

verses.translation: like the boiling of scalding water.

verses.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: [It will be said], “Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire.

verses.translation: [It will be said], “Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: Then pour over his head the torment of scalding water.”

verses.translation: Then pour over his head the torment of scalding water.”

verses.arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: “Taste this. You are surely the mighty and honorable![1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Abu Jahl, the chief of pagans in Makkah, replied to the warning of punishment in the Hereafter by saying, “How can I be punished when I am the mighty and honorable one!” So Allah killed him in the Battle of Badr and humiliated him, and revealed this verse. He will be taunted with these words in Hell as a reminder of his own words and additional torment.

verses.translation: “Taste this. You are surely the mighty and honorable![1]

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: This is what you [all] used to doubt.”

verses.translation: This is what you [all] used to doubt.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in a safe place,

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in a safe place,

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: in gardens and springs,

verses.translation: in gardens and springs,

verses.arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: wearing fine silk and heavy brocade, facing one another.

verses.translation: wearing fine silk and heavy brocade, facing one another.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: So it will be, and We will marry them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.

verses.translation: So it will be, and We will marry them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.

verses.arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They will call therein for every kind of fruit, safe and secure.

verses.translation: They will call therein for every kind of fruit, safe and secure.

verses.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will protect them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire,

verses.translation: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will protect them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire,

verses.arabic: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: as a grace from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.translation: as a grace from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your own language, so that they may take heed.

verses.translation: We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your own language, so that they may take heed.

verses.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then wait; they too are waiting.

verses.translation: Then wait; they too are waiting.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ

english_rwwad.text: Hā Mīm[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.

verses.translation: Hā Mīm[1].

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.translation: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there are signs in the heavens and earth for the believers;

verses.translation: Indeed, there are signs in the heavens and earth for the believers;

verses.arabic: وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and in your creation and the living creatures that He spreads out, there are signs for people who are certain in faith.

verses.translation: and in your creation and the living creatures that He spreads out, there are signs for people who are certain in faith.

verses.arabic: وَٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And in the alternation of the night and day, the provision that Allah sends down from the sky[1], reviving thereby the earth after its death, and directing of the winds, there are signs for people of understanding.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the rain.

verses.translation: And in the alternation of the night and day, the provision that Allah sends down from the sky[1], reviving thereby the earth after its death, and directing of the winds, there are signs for people of understanding.

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: These are the verses of Allah that We recite to you in truth. What message will they believe in after Allah and His verses?

verses.translation: These are the verses of Allah that We recite to you in truth. What message will they believe in after Allah and His verses?

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Woe to every sinful liar,

verses.translation: Woe to every sinful liar,

verses.arabic: يَسْمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: who hears the verses of Allah being recited to him, yet he persists in his arrogance, as if he did not hear them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

verses.translation: who hears the verses of Allah being recited to him, yet he persists in his arrogance, as if he did not hear them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: When he comes to know anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. For them there will be a humiliating punishment.

verses.translation: When he comes to know anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. For them there will be a humiliating punishment.

verses.arabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Ahead of them is Hell; neither their gains nor those whom they took besides Allah as protectors will avail them anything, and for them there will be a great punishment.

verses.translation: Ahead of them is Hell; neither their gains nor those whom they took besides Allah as protectors will avail them anything, and for them there will be a great punishment.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا هُدًى وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: This [Qur’an] is guidance, and for those who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord there will be a scourge of painful torment.

verses.translation: This [Qur’an] is guidance, and for those who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord there will be a scourge of painful torment.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: It is Allah Who has subjected for you the sea, so that the ships may sail on it by His command, and so that you may seek His bounty, and so that you may be grateful.

verses.translation: It is Allah Who has subjected for you the sea, so that the ships may sail on it by His command, and so that you may seek His bounty, and so that you may be grateful.

verses.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِّنْهُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And He has subjected for you all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth; all is from Him. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who reflect.

verses.translation: And He has subjected for you all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth; all is from Him. Indeed, there are signs in this for people who reflect.

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Tell those who believe to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days [of retribution], so that He may recompense each people for what they used to do[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In the Hereafter, those who forgive will be rewarded, and who earned evil will be punished. This was at the outset of the Prophet’s mission before the permission of Jihad.

verses.translation: Tell those who believe to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days [of retribution], so that He may recompense each people for what they used to do[1].

verses.arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Whoever does a righteous deed, it is for his own benefit; and whoever does an evil deed, it is to his own loss. Then to your Lord you will be returned.

verses.translation: Whoever does a righteous deed, it is for his own benefit; and whoever does an evil deed, it is to his own loss. Then to your Lord you will be returned.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; provided them with good things; and favored them above all others[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By sending them numerous prophets from among the descendants of Abraham.

verses.translation: Indeed, We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; provided them with good things; and favored them above all others[1].

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We gave them clear directions in matters [of religion]. They did not differ except after the knowledge had come to them out of transgression against one another[1]. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their differences.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] No community split into factions until there came to them a prophet with divine knowledge; some of them believed and most of them disbelieved out of arrogance and pursuit of worldly benefits.

verses.translation: We gave them clear directions in matters [of religion]. They did not differ except after the knowledge had come to them out of transgression against one another[1]. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their differences.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We put you [O Prophet] on a clear way of the religion; so follow it and do not follow the desires of those who have no knowledge.

verses.translation: Then We put you [O Prophet] on a clear way of the religion; so follow it and do not follow the desires of those who have no knowledge.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا۟ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They cannot avail you at all against Allah. Indeed, the wrongdoers are protectors of one another, whereas Allah is the Protector of the righteous.

verses.translation: They cannot avail you at all against Allah. Indeed, the wrongdoers are protectors of one another, whereas Allah is the Protector of the righteous.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: This [Qur’an] is an insight for people; a guidance and mercy for people who are certain in faith.

verses.translation: This [Qur’an] is an insight for people; a guidance and mercy for people who are certain in faith.

verses.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do those who commit evil deeds think that We will make them equal to those who believe and do righteous deeds, in this life and after their death? How poorly they judge!

verses.translation: Do those who commit evil deeds think that We will make them equal to those who believe and do righteous deeds, in this life and after their death? How poorly they judge!

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah created the heavens and earth for a true purpose, and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

verses.translation: Allah created the heavens and earth for a true purpose, and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةً فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Have you seen the one who took his whims as his god, and Allah caused him to stray despite having knowledge[1], and sealed up his hearing and heart, and put a cover over his sight? Who can guide him after Allah? Will you not then take heed?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or Allah’s eternal knowledge of that person's preference for his own inclinations over divine guidance.

verses.translation: Have you seen the one who took his whims as his god, and Allah caused him to stray despite having knowledge[1], and sealed up his hearing and heart, and put a cover over his sight? Who can guide him after Allah? Will you not then take heed?

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ

english_rwwad.text: And they say, “There is nothing but our life of this world: we die and we live[1], and nothing causes us to die except time.” They have no knowledge of that; they only speculate.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., some of us die without return, and others are born replacing them.

verses.translation: And they say, “There is nothing but our life of this world: we die and we live[1], and nothing causes us to die except time.” They have no knowledge of that; they only speculate.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When Our clear verses are recited to them, their only argument is to say: “Bring our forefathers back, if you are truthful.”

verses.translation: When Our clear verses are recited to them, their only argument is to say: “Bring our forefathers back, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “It is Allah Who gives you life then causes you to die, then He will gather you on the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt, but most people do not know.”

verses.translation: Say, “It is Allah Who gives you life then causes you to die, then He will gather you on the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt, but most people do not know.”

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth. On the day when the Hour will take place, the people of falsehood will be in total loss.

verses.translation: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth. On the day when the Hour will take place, the people of falsehood will be in total loss.

verses.arabic: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: You will see every community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its book [of deeds], “Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.

verses.translation: You will see every community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its book [of deeds], “Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: This is Our Record that tells the truth about you, for We[1] used to record all what you used to do.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By Our angel scribes.

verses.translation: This is Our Record that tells the truth about you, for We[1] used to record all what you used to do.”

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is indeed the clear triumph.

verses.translation: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is indeed the clear triumph.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: But those who disbelieved [will be asked], “When My verses were recited to you, did you not show arrogance and were a wicked people?

verses.translation: But those who disbelieved [will be asked], “When My verses were recited to you, did you not show arrogance and were a wicked people?

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِى مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Whenever it was said, ‘Allah’s promise is certainly true and there is no doubt about the Hour,’ you said, ‘We do not know what the Hour is; We think it is just an assumption, and we are not convinced.’”

verses.translation: Whenever it was said, ‘Allah’s promise is certainly true and there is no doubt about the Hour,’ you said, ‘We do not know what the Hour is; We think it is just an assumption, and we are not convinced.’”

verses.arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

english_rwwad.text: The evil consequences of their deeds will become apparent to them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

verses.translation: The evil consequences of their deeds will become apparent to them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: It will be said, “Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. Your abode will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers.

verses.translation: It will be said, “Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. Your abode will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذْتُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: That is because you took Allah’s verses in ridicule, and were deluded by the life of this world.” So Today they will not be taken out of it, nor will they be asked to make amends.

verses.translation: That is because you took Allah’s verses in ridicule, and were deluded by the life of this world.” So Today they will not be taken out of it, nor will they be asked to make amends.

verses.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So all praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: So all praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and earth, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.translation: To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and earth, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ

english_rwwad.text: Hā Mīm[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.

verses.translation: Hā Mīm[1].

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.translation: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُوا۟ مُعْرِضُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them except for a true purpose and for a set term, yet those who disbelieve turn away from what they have been warned of.

verses.translation: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them except for a true purpose and for a set term, yet those who disbelieve turn away from what they have been warned of.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱئْتُونِى بِكِتَٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ هَٰذَآ أَوْ أَثَٰرَةٍ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Tell me about those whom you invoke besides Allah; show me what they have created on the earth, or do they have a share in the heavens? Bring me a scripture revealed before this, or some remnant of knowledge, if you are truthful.”

verses.translation: Say, “Tell me about those whom you invoke besides Allah; show me what they have created on the earth, or do they have a share in the heavens? Bring me a scripture revealed before this, or some remnant of knowledge, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَآئِهِمْ غَٰفِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Who is more astray than one who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and are in fact unaware of their invocations?

verses.translation: Who is more astray than one who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and are in fact unaware of their invocations?

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَعْدَآءً وَكَانُوا۟ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَٰفِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When such people are gathered, they will become their enemies and will reject their worship.

verses.translation: When such people are gathered, they will become their enemies and will reject their worship.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: When Our clear verses are recited to them, those who disbelieve say about the truth when it comes to them, “This is clear magic.”

verses.translation: When Our clear verses are recited to them, those who disbelieve say about the truth when it comes to them, “This is clear magic.”

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ كَفَىٰ بِهِۦ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they say, “He has fabricated it”? Say, “If I did fabricate it, there is nothing you can do to protect me against Allah. He knows best that in which you indulge[1]. He is Sufficient as a witness between me and you, and He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of false accusations and slander about Qu’ran and Prophet (ﷺ).

verses.translation: Or do they say, “He has fabricated it”? Say, “If I did fabricate it, there is nothing you can do to protect me against Allah. He knows best that in which you indulge[1]. He is Sufficient as a witness between me and you, and He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدْرِى مَا يُفْعَلُ بِى وَلَا بِكُمْ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “I am not the first of the messengers[1], nor do I know what will happen to me or to you. I only follow what is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To be surprised at my message, nor have I brought something different from the previous messengers.

verses.translation: Say, “I am not the first of the messengers[1], nor do I know what will happen to me or to you. I only follow what is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “What do you think, if this [Qur’an] is really from Allah and yet you reject it, and a witness[1] from the Children of Israel has testified in its favor and believed[2], whereas you persist in arrogance[3]? Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.”
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Such as Abdullah ibn Salām, a Jewish scholar, who accepted Islam when the Prophet (ﷺ) emigrated from Makkah to Medina.
 [2] Based on information in the Torah testifying his message.
 [3] The estimated conclusion could be "...would you not then be unjust and wrongdoer people?"

verses.translation: Say, “What do you think, if this [Qur’an] is really from Allah and yet you reject it, and a witness[1] from the Children of Israel has testified in its favor and believed[2], whereas you persist in arrogance[3]? Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيْهِ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: The disbelievers say about the believers, “If this [faith] were something good, they[1] would not have believed in it before us.” Now since they are not guided by it, they will say, “This is an old fabrication.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] These poor and powerless individuals and slaves who embraced Islam.

verses.translation: The disbelievers say about the believers, “If this [faith] were something good, they[1] would not have believed in it before us.” Now since they are not guided by it, they will say, “This is an old fabrication.”

verses.arabic: وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And before it was the Scripture of Moses a guide and a mercy. This Book is a confirmation of it, in the Arabic language, in order to warn those who do wrong and give glad tidings to those who do good.

verses.translation: And before it was the Scripture of Moses a guide and a mercy. This Book is a confirmation of it, in the Arabic language, in order to warn those who do wrong and give glad tidings to those who do good.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, those who say, “Our Lord is Allah”, then remain steadfast, they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

verses.translation: Indeed, those who say, “Our Lord is Allah”, then remain steadfast, they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They are the people of Paradise; abiding therein forever, as a reward for what they used to do.

verses.translation: They are the people of Paradise; abiding therein forever, as a reward for what they used to do.

verses.arabic: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ إِحْسَٰنًا حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا وَحَمْلُهُۥ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ ثَلَٰثُونَ شَهْرًا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents. His mother bore him in hardship and gave birth to him in hardship, and his bearing and weaning take thirty months, until when he reaches full maturity and reaches forty years, he says, “My Lord, inspire me to be grateful to Your favors which You blessed me and my parents with, and to do righteous deeds that will make You pleased; and make my offspring righteous. Indeed, I repent to you, and I am one of the Muslims [submitting to You].”

verses.translation: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents. His mother bore him in hardship and gave birth to him in hardship, and his bearing and weaning take thirty months, until when he reaches full maturity and reaches forty years, he says, “My Lord, inspire me to be grateful to Your favors which You blessed me and my parents with, and to do righteous deeds that will make You pleased; and make my offspring righteous. Indeed, I repent to you, and I am one of the Muslims [submitting to You].”

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَعْدَ ٱلصِّدْقِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Such are those from whom We will accept their best deeds and overlook their misdeeds. They will be among the people of Paradise – a true promise that they were given.

verses.translation: Such are those from whom We will accept their best deeds and overlook their misdeeds. They will be among the people of Paradise – a true promise that they were given.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَّكُمَآ أَتَعِدَانِنِىٓ أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلْقُرُونُ مِن قَبْلِى وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ ٱللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: But some say to their parents, “Fie upon you both! Are you warning me that I will be resurrected, even though many generations have passed before me [yet none was resurrected]?” His parents cry seeking Allah’s help, “Woe to you! Believe! The promise of Allah is true.” But he says, “This is nothing but ancient fables.”

verses.translation: But some say to their parents, “Fie upon you both! Are you warning me that I will be resurrected, even though many generations have passed before me [yet none was resurrected]?” His parents cry seeking Allah’s help, “Woe to you! Believe! The promise of Allah is true.” But he says, “This is nothing but ancient fables.”

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Such are those upon whom the punishment has become binding, as happened to communities of Jinn and men before them, for they were truly losers.

verses.translation: Such are those upon whom the punishment has become binding, as happened to communities of Jinn and men before them, for they were truly losers.

verses.arabic: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Everyone will be ranked according to what they did, so that He may recompense them in full for their deeds, and none will be wronged.

verses.translation: Everyone will be ranked according to what they did, so that He may recompense them in full for their deeds, and none will be wronged.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ فِى حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا فَٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when the disbelievers will be brought to the Fire, [they will be told], “You have exhausted your share of pleasures in the life of the world, and you have enjoyed them. Today you will be recompensed with a disgracing punishment for your arrogance in the land without any right and for your rebellion.

verses.translation: On the Day when the disbelievers will be brought to the Fire, [they will be told], “You have exhausted your share of pleasures in the life of the world, and you have enjoyed them. Today you will be recompensed with a disgracing punishment for your arrogance in the land without any right and for your rebellion.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنذَرَ قَوْمَهُۥ بِٱلْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلنُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦٓ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Remember [Hūd][1] the brother of ‘Ād, when he warned his people in the [land of] sand dunes[2] – and indeed there came warners before him and after him – [saying], “Worship none but Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a horrible day.”
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Prophet Hūd.
 [2] The people of ‘Ād were the inhabitants of the sand dunes (sand hills) in the southern part of Arabia.

verses.translation: Remember [Hūd][1] the brother of ‘Ād, when he warned his people in the [land of] sand dunes[2] – and indeed there came warners before him and after him – [saying], “Worship none but Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a horrible day.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “Have you come to turn us away from our gods? Then bring us what you are threatening us with, if you are truthful.”

verses.translation: They said, “Have you come to turn us away from our gods? Then bring us what you are threatening us with, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He said, “The knowledge [of its coming] is with Allah alone. I only convey to you the message that I have been sent with, but I see that you are an ignorant people.”

verses.translation: He said, “The knowledge [of its coming] is with Allah alone. I only convey to you the message that I have been sent with, but I see that you are an ignorant people.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا عَارِضٌ مُّمْطِرُنَا بَلْ هُوَ مَا ٱسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِۦ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: When they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, “This is a cloud bringing us rain.” [Hūd said,] No, it is what you sought to hasten[1] – a wind bearing a painful punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] When you challenged me by saying, “Then bring us what you are threatening us with”. (See 46:22 of this chapter).

verses.translation: When they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, “This is a cloud bringing us rain.” [Hūd said,] No, it is what you sought to hasten[1] – a wind bearing a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَٰكِنُهُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: It will destroy everything by the command of its Lord. And they became such that there was nothing left visible except [ruins of] their dwellings. This is how We recompense the wicked people.

verses.translation: It will destroy everything by the command of its Lord. And they became such that there was nothing left visible except [ruins of] their dwellings. This is how We recompense the wicked people.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِيمَآ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰكُمْ فِيهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَأَبْصَٰرًا وَأَفْـِٔدَةً فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ وَلَآ أَفْـِٔدَتُهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوا۟ يَجْحَدُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We had given them the power to an extent that We have not given you [O Makkans], and We gave them[1] hearing, sight, and hearts. But neither their hearing, nor their sight, nor their hearts availed them in the least, for they used to reject the signs of Allah. And they were overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the people of Prophet Hūd.

verses.translation: We had given them the power to an extent that We have not given you [O Makkans], and We gave them[1] hearing, sight, and hearts. But neither their hearing, nor their sight, nor their hearts availed them in the least, for they used to reject the signs of Allah. And they were overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We have certainly destroyed some towns around you and had given them numerous signs, so that they might return [from disbelief].

verses.translation: We have certainly destroyed some towns around you and had given them numerous signs, so that they might return [from disbelief].

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا ءَالِهَةًۢ بَلْ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنْهُمْ وَذَٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Why is it that they were not helped by those [idols] whom they took as gods besides Allah so that they might bring them closer to Him[1]? Rather, they were lost from them. Such was [the outcome of] their falsehood and the lies they used to fabricate.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As they used to claim.

verses.translation: Why is it that they were not helped by those [idols] whom they took as gods besides Allah so that they might bring them closer to Him[1]? Rather, they were lost from them. Such was [the outcome of] their falsehood and the lies they used to fabricate.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَآ إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنصِتُوا۟ فَلَمَّا قُضِىَ وَلَّوْا۟ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And [remember] when We sent to you a group of jinn to listen to the Qur’an. When they heard it, they said [to one another], “Listen attentively.” Then when it was over, they returned to their people as warners.

verses.translation: And [remember] when We sent to you a group of jinn to listen to the Qur’an. When they heard it, they said [to one another], “Listen attentively.” Then when it was over, they returned to their people as warners.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰقَوْمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “O our people, we have heard a scripture that has been sent down after Moses, confirming what came before it; it guides to the truth and to a straight path.

verses.translation: They said, “O our people, we have heard a scripture that has been sent down after Moses, confirming what came before it; it guides to the truth and to a straight path.

verses.arabic: يَٰقَوْمَنَآ أَجِيبُوا۟ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: O our people, respond to the one[1] who is calling to Allah, and believe in him; He will forgive some of your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).

verses.translation: O our people, respond to the one[1] who is calling to Allah, and believe in him; He will forgive some of your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءُ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: And whoever does not respond to the one who is calling to Allah will have no escape on earth, nor will he have any protectors against Him; such people are clearly misguided.”

verses.translation: And whoever does not respond to the one who is calling to Allah will have no escape on earth, nor will he have any protectors against Him; such people are clearly misguided.”
