verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْىَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Do they not see that Allah, Who created the heavens and earth, and was not wearied by creating them[1], is able to bring the dead to life? Yes indeed! He is the Most Capable of all things.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or did not fail in creating them.

verses.translation: Do they not see that Allah, Who created the heavens and earth, and was not wearied by creating them[1], is able to bring the dead to life? Yes indeed! He is the Most Capable of all things.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when the disbelievers are exposed to the Fire, [they will be asked], “Is this not the truth?” They will say, “Yes indeed, by our Lord.” He will say, “Then taste the punishment for your disbelief.”

verses.translation: On the Day when the disbelievers are exposed to the Fire, [they will be asked], “Is this not the truth?” They will say, “Yes indeed, by our Lord.” He will say, “Then taste the punishment for your disbelief.”

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعَزْمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِل لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّن نَّهَارٍۭ بَلَٰغٌ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So be patient, as the Messengers of Firm Resolve[1] were patient, and do not seek to hasten [punishment] for them. On the Day when they see what they were warned of, it will be as if they had only stayed [in this world] for an hour of a day[2]. This is a warning. Will anyone be destroyed except the rebellious people?
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] They are Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus, and Muhammad (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon them all).
 [2] i.e., for a short period of time.

verses.translation: So be patient, as the Messengers of Firm Resolve[1] were patient, and do not seek to hasten [punishment] for them. On the Day when they see what they were warned of, it will be as if they had only stayed [in this world] for an hour of a day[2]. This is a warning. Will anyone be destroyed except the rebellious people?

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Those who disbelieve and prevent others from Allah’s way, He will render their deeds void.

verses.translation: Those who disbelieve and prevent others from Allah’s way, He will render their deeds void.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَءَامَنُوا۟ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who believe, do righteous deeds, and believe in what has been sent down to Muhammad – which is the truth from their Lord – He will absolve them of their sins and set their condition right.

verses.translation: As for those who believe, do righteous deeds, and believe in what has been sent down to Muhammad – which is the truth from their Lord – He will absolve them of their sins and set their condition right.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: That is because the disbelievers follow falsehood, whereas the believers follow the truth from their Lord. This is how Allah explains to people their comparisons[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] So that each party may know the outcome of its choice.

verses.translation: That is because the disbelievers follow falsehood, whereas the believers follow the truth from their Lord. This is how Allah explains to people their comparisons[1].

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَضَرْبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثْخَنتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوا۟ ٱلْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّۢا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ذَٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَا۟ بَعْضَكُم بِبَعْضٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: When you encounter the disbelievers [in battle], strike [their] necks until you have thoroughly subdued them, then bind the captives firmly[1]. Later [you may free them] as a favor[2] or for ransom until the war comes to an end[3]. That [is Our command], if Allah had willed, He could have subjected them to punishment, but [He ordered you to fight] to test some of you by means of others. Those who are killed in the way of Allah, He will never render their deeds void.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., seize those remaining fighters as captives.
 [2] i.e., release them without taking any ransom.
 [3] lit., until the war lays down its burdens, its armor.

verses.translation: When you encounter the disbelievers [in battle], strike [their] necks until you have thoroughly subdued them, then bind the captives firmly[1]. Later [you may free them] as a favor[2] or for ransom until the war comes to an end[3]. That [is Our command], if Allah had willed, He could have subjected them to punishment, but [He ordered you to fight] to test some of you by means of others. Those who are killed in the way of Allah, He will never render their deeds void.

verses.arabic: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: He will guide them, and will set their condition right,

verses.translation: He will guide them, and will set their condition right,

verses.arabic: وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: and He will admit them to Paradise, which He has already made known to them[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The believers will recognize their mansions in Paradise just like they recognize their homes in the life of this world.

verses.translation: and He will admit them to Paradise, which He has already made known to them[1].

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَنصُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, if you stand up for Allah, He will help you and make your steps firm[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., if you stand up for Allah’s cause, His religion, and for His Prophet with your life and wealth, He will make your feet firm on the battlefield and grant you victory.

verses.translation: O you who believe, if you stand up for Allah, He will help you and make your steps firm[1].

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَتَعْسًا لَّهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who disbelieve, how wretched will be their state! And He will render their deeds void.

verses.translation: As for those who disbelieve, how wretched will be their state! And He will render their deeds void.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: That is because they detest what Allah has sent down, so He rendered their deeds worthless.

verses.translation: That is because they detest what Allah has sent down, so He rendered their deeds worthless.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ دَمَّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْثَٰلُهَا

english_rwwad.text: Have they not traveled through the land to see what was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed them utterly[1], and a similar end awaits the disbelievers.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Allah destroyed them and all their belongings of wealth, property, and offspring.

verses.translation: Have they not traveled through the land to see what was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed them utterly[1], and a similar end awaits the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَأَنَّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: That is because Allah is the Protector of the believers whereas the disbelievers have no protector.

verses.translation: That is because Allah is the Protector of the believers whereas the disbelievers have no protector.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Allah will surely admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens under which rivers flow. As for those who disbelieve, they enjoy themselves [in this world] and they eat as cattle eat[1]; their final abode is the Fire.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The disbelievers enjoy their life while they are oblivious of their consequences in the Hereafter, just like the cattle that graze in the pasture not knowing that they will probably be slaughtered soon.

verses.translation: Allah will surely admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens under which rivers flow. As for those who disbelieve, they enjoy themselves [in this world] and they eat as cattle eat[1]; their final abode is the Fire.

verses.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ هِىَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّن قَرْيَتِكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: How many towns We destroyed that were more powerful than your town that expelled you, and there was none to help them!

verses.translation: How many towns We destroyed that were more powerful than your town that expelled you, and there was none to help them!

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم

english_rwwad.text: Are those who possess clear proof from their Lord like those whose evil deeds are made appealing to them and who follow their own desires?

verses.translation: Are those who possess clear proof from their Lord like those whose evil deeds are made appealing to them and who follow their own desires?

verses.arabic: مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ فِيهَآ أَنْهَٰرٌ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍ وَأَنْهَٰرٌ مِّن لَّبَنٍ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُۥ وَأَنْهَٰرٌ مِّنْ خَمْرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ وَأَنْهَٰرٌ مِّنْ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّى وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَٰلِدٌ فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُوا۟ مَآءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَآءَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: The likeness of Paradise promised to the righteous is that of a [garden which has] rivers of fresh water[1]; rivers of milk the taste of which never changes; rivers of wine delicious to drink; and rivers of pure honey. They will have therein all kinds of fruit and forgiveness from their Lord. Can they be like those who will abide in the Fire forever, and will be given boiling water to drink that tears apart their intestines?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Neither stagnant nor polluted.

verses.translation: The likeness of Paradise promised to the righteous is that of a [garden which has] rivers of fresh water[1]; rivers of milk the taste of which never changes; rivers of wine delicious to drink; and rivers of pure honey. They will have therein all kinds of fruit and forgiveness from their Lord. Can they be like those who will abide in the Fire forever, and will be given boiling water to drink that tears apart their intestines?

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُوا۟ مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Among these [hypocrites] are some who listen to you [O Prophet], but when they leave your presence, they say to those who were given knowledge[1], “What did he just say[2]?” It is they whose hearts Allah has sealed up and who follow their desires.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] From among the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ).
 [2] In an ignoring and indifferent manner.

verses.translation: Among these [hypocrites] are some who listen to you [O Prophet], but when they leave your presence, they say to those who were given knowledge[1], “What did he just say[2]?” It is they whose hearts Allah has sealed up and who follow their desires.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَءَاتَىٰهُمْ تَقْوَىٰهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who follow guidance, He increases them in guidance and blesses them with righteousness[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Taqwā: It means piety, fear and consciousness of Allah, and care to avoid displeasing Him.

verses.translation: As for those who follow guidance, He increases them in guidance and blesses them with righteousness[1].

verses.arabic: فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً فَقَدْ جَآءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمْ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَىٰهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Are they but waiting for the Hour to come upon them by surprise? Already [some of] its signs have appeared[1]. What good will it do them to take heed when it actually befalls them?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Such as the coming of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ), and the splitting of the moon after the pagans of Makkah challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) which was fulfilled before their eyes, yet they denied that miracle.

verses.translation: Are they but waiting for the Hour to come upon them by surprise? Already [some of] its signs have appeared[1]. What good will it do them to take heed when it actually befalls them?

verses.arabic: فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَىٰكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Then know [O Prophet] that none has the right to be worshiped except Allah, and seek forgiveness for your sins[1] and for the [sins of the] believing men and women, for Allah knows your movements and your places of rest.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] If the Prophet (ﷺ) himself is urged to seek forgiveness, the believers are in far greater need of seeking Allah’s forgiveness.

verses.translation: Then know [O Prophet] that none has the right to be worshiped except Allah, and seek forgiveness for your sins[1] and for the [sins of the] believing men and women, for Allah knows your movements and your places of rest.

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُّحْكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلْقِتَالُ رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ ٱلْمَغْشِىِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ فَأَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Those who believe say, “If only a Chapter were sent down [about fighting]?” But when a precise Chapter is sent down and fighting[1] is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is sickness looking at you like someone who is about to die. It would have been better for them[2]
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] The believers longed for a Qur’anic revelation that would give them permission to fight their enemies.
 [2] It could also mean “Woe to them!” if disconnected from the next verse.

verses.translation: Those who believe say, “If only a Chapter were sent down [about fighting]?” But when a precise Chapter is sent down and fighting[1] is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is sickness looking at you like someone who is about to die. It would have been better for them[2]

verses.arabic: طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ ٱلْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: to obey and say good words. Once the fighting was ordained, it would be better for them to be truthful to Allah.

verses.translation: to obey and say good words. Once the fighting was ordained, it would be better for them to be truthful to Allah.

verses.arabic: فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَن تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓا۟ أَرْحَامَكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Then if you turn away[1], what else can be expected but that you will spread corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship[2]?
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] From Islam or from struggling in the way of Allah.
 [2] As you used to do in the pre-Islamic period of ignorance.

verses.translation: Then if you turn away[1], what else can be expected but that you will spread corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship[2]?

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَىٰٓ أَبْصَٰرَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: These are the ones whom Allah has cursed and has made them deaf and blinded their sight.

verses.translation: These are the ones whom Allah has cursed and has made them deaf and blinded their sight.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَآ

english_rwwad.text: Do they not reflect upon the Qur’an, or are there locks upon their hearts?

verses.translation: Do they not reflect upon the Qur’an, or are there locks upon their hearts?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَىٰ لَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, those who turn back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them, it is Satan who has tempted them and deceived them with false hopes of a long life.

verses.translation: Indeed, those who turn back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them, it is Satan who has tempted them and deceived them with false hopes of a long life.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوا۟ مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِى بَعْضِ ٱلْأَمْرِ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: That is because they say to those[1] who hate what Allah has sent down, “We will obey you in some matters[2].” But Allah knows their secret schemes.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the Jews of Madīnah.
 [2] i.e., your hostility to the Prophet (ﷺ) and hindering people from participation in Jihad.

verses.translation: That is because they say to those[1] who hate what Allah has sent down, “We will obey you in some matters[2].” But Allah knows their secret schemes.

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَٰرَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: How will they feel when the angels take their souls, striking their faces and their backs?

verses.translation: How will they feel when the angels take their souls, striking their faces and their backs?

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَآ أَسْخَطَ ٱللَّهَ وَكَرِهُوا۟ رِضْوَٰنَهُۥ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: That is because they follow what incurs Allah’s wrath and they hate what pleases Him, so He will render their deeds worthless.

verses.translation: That is because they follow what incurs Allah’s wrath and they hate what pleases Him, so He will render their deeds worthless.

verses.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخْرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضْغَٰنَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Do those in whose hearts is sickness think that Allah will never expose their malice?

verses.translation: Do those in whose hearts is sickness think that Allah will never expose their malice?

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَأَرَيْنَٰكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُم بِسِيمَٰهُمْ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِى لَحْنِ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: If We willed, We could show them to you [O Prophet], so you would recognize them by their faces, but you will surely recognize them by the manner of their speech. And Allah knows all what you do.

verses.translation: If We willed, We could show them to you [O Prophet], so you would recognize them by their faces, but you will surely recognize them by the manner of their speech. And Allah knows all what you do.

verses.arabic: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ ٱلْمُجَٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا۟ أَخْبَارَكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: We will certainly test you so as to reveal those of you who struggle [in Allah’s way] and remain patient, and We will test the sincerity of your assertions.

verses.translation: We will certainly test you so as to reveal those of you who struggle [in Allah’s way] and remain patient, and We will test the sincerity of your assertions.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَشَآقُّوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًٔا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Those who disbelieve and prevent others from Allah’s way, and oppose the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them, they will never harm Allah in the least, and He will render their deeds worthless.

verses.translation: Those who disbelieve and prevent others from Allah’s way, and oppose the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them, they will never harm Allah in the least, and He will render their deeds worthless.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوٓا۟ أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and do not cause your deeds to be nullified.

verses.translation: O you who believe, obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and do not cause your deeds to be nullified.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Those who disbelieve and prevent others from Allah’s way, and then die as disbelievers, Allah will never forgive them.

verses.translation: Those who disbelieve and prevent others from Allah’s way, and then die as disbelievers, Allah will never forgive them.

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَتَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّلْمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Do not lose heart or call for peace, for you will have the upper hand and Allah is with you. And He will never detract [the reward of] your deeds.

verses.translation: Do not lose heart or call for peace, for you will have the upper hand and Allah is with you. And He will never detract [the reward of] your deeds.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَإِن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمْ أُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْـَٔلْكُمْ أَمْوَٰلَكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: The life of this world is only play and amusement. But if you believe and fear Allah, He will give you your rewards, and He does not ask you for all your wealth[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He only asks you for zakah (obligatory charity).

verses.translation: The life of this world is only play and amusement. But if you believe and fear Allah, He will give you your rewards, and He does not ask you for all your wealth[1].

verses.arabic: إِن يَسْـَٔلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوا۟ وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَٰنَكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: If He were to ask you for it[1] and insist that you give it, you would greedily withhold, and He would expose your resentment [for spending].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., all your wealth.

verses.translation: If He were to ask you for it[1] and insist that you give it, you would greedily withhold, and He would expose your resentment [for spending].

verses.arabic: هَٰٓأَنتُمْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبْخَلُ وَمَن يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْغَنِىُّ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓا۟ أَمْثَٰلَكُم

english_rwwad.text: O you who are being called to spend in Allah’s way; among you are some who greedily withhold, but whoever withholds, he in fact withholds against himself, for Allah is the Self-Sufficient, whereas you are in need [of Him]. If you turn away, He will replace you with other people, then they will not be like you.

verses.translation: O you who are being called to spend in Allah’s way; among you are some who greedily withhold, but whoever withholds, he in fact withholds against himself, for Allah is the Self-Sufficient, whereas you are in need [of Him]. If you turn away, He will replace you with other people, then they will not be like you.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We have given you [O Prophet] a clear conquest[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This surah takes its name "Surah al-Fath" (Surah of Conquest) from the clear conquest mentioned in this verse. This treaty was signed in 6 A.H./628 C.E. Ibn Mas‘ūd said, "You [people] consider the conquest to be that of Makkah, but we consider it to be the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyyah." Al-Barā’ bin ‘Āzib said something similar to this as reported by Al-Bukhāri. Although the companions initially regarded this treaty as a setback, yet in effect, it helped promote the spread of Islam, as thousands of people from different tribes accepted Islam during that truce. This treaty was in fact a precursor to the conquest of Makkah two years later.

verses.translation: Indeed, We have given you [O Prophet] a clear conquest[1],

verses.arabic: لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: so that Allah may forgive you your previous and future sins[1], complete His favor upon you, and guide you to a straight path,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., sins before this conquest and sins after it. See footnote 40:55, 47:19.

verses.translation: so that Allah may forgive you your previous and future sins[1], complete His favor upon you, and guide you to a straight path,

verses.arabic: وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا

english_rwwad.text: and so that Allah may help you with a mighty victory.

verses.translation: and so that Allah may help you with a mighty victory.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمْ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers so that they may increase in faith along with their faith. To Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and earth. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.translation: It is He Who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers so that they may increase in faith along with their faith. To Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and earth. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.arabic: لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: So that He may admit the believing men and women to gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever, and absolve them of their sins; that is a supreme triumph before Allah.

verses.translation: So that He may admit the believing men and women to gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever, and absolve them of their sins; that is a supreme triumph before Allah.

verses.arabic: وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: And so that He may punish hypocrite men and women and polytheist men and women, who harbor about Allah evil thoughts[1]. An evil fate will befall them. Allah is angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell. What a terrible destination!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., that Allah will not support His religion and His Prophet (ﷺ) and that the believers will end up with misfortune and defeat.

verses.translation: And so that He may punish hypocrite men and women and polytheist men and women, who harbor about Allah evil thoughts[1]. An evil fate will befall them. Allah is angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell. What a terrible destination!

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: To Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and earth, and Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

verses.translation: To Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and earth, and Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ شَٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We have sent you [O prophet] as a witness, a bearer of glad tidings, and a warner,

verses.translation: Indeed, We have sent you [O prophet] as a witness, a bearer of glad tidings, and a warner,

verses.arabic: لِّتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: so that you may believe in Allah and His Messenger, support and revere him, and glorify Him morning and evening.

verses.translation: so that you may believe in Allah and His Messenger, support and revere him, and glorify Him morning and evening.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: Those who pledge allegiance to you [O Prophet] are indeed pledging allegiance to Allah; Allah’s Hand is over their hands[1]. Whoever breaks his pledge, he only breaks it to his own detriment, but whoever fulfills his covenant with Allah, He will give him a great reward.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Allah Almighty approved their pledge.

verses.translation: Those who pledge allegiance to you [O Prophet] are indeed pledging allegiance to Allah; Allah’s Hand is over their hands[1]. Whoever breaks his pledge, he only breaks it to his own detriment, but whoever fulfills his covenant with Allah, He will give him a great reward.

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَآ أَمْوَٰلُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًۢا بَلْ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۢا

english_rwwad.text: Those of the Bedouins who lagged behind will say to you, “We were preoccupied with our wealth and our families, so ask for forgiveness for us.” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, “Then who can prevent Allah if He intends to harm or benefit you? Indeed, Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

verses.translation: Those of the Bedouins who lagged behind will say to you, “We were preoccupied with our wealth and our families, so ask for forgiveness for us.” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, “Then who can prevent Allah if He intends to harm or benefit you? Indeed, Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

verses.arabic: بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا

english_rwwad.text: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families ever, and that was made appealing in your hearts. You harbored evil thoughts, for you are a doomed people.”

verses.translation: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families ever, and that was made appealing in your hearts. You harbored evil thoughts, for you are a doomed people.”

verses.arabic: وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ فَإِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Whoever does not believe in Allah and His Messenger, We have certainly prepared for the disbelievers a Blazing Fire.

verses.translation: Whoever does not believe in Allah and His Messenger, We have certainly prepared for the disbelievers a Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills, and Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.translation: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills, and Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُوا۟ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Those who lagged behind will say when you set out to collect the spoils of war, “Let us follow you.” They wish to change the word of Allah[1]. Say, “You will never follow us; this is what Allah has already decreed.” They will then say, “Rather, you are jealous of us[2].” Rather, they do not understand but a little[3].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Allah promised those of the believers who pledged allegiance at Hudaybiyah that the spoils of war obtained from the Jews of Khaybar be exclusively for them.
 [2] i.e., you only ask us not to go with you to the spoils of Khsybar to deprive us of our share.
 [3] i.e., they do not understand but the material aspects of life.

verses.translation: Those who lagged behind will say when you set out to collect the spoils of war, “Let us follow you.” They wish to change the word of Allah[1]. Say, “You will never follow us; this is what Allah has already decreed.” They will then say, “Rather, you are jealous of us[2].” Rather, they do not understand but a little[3].

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ فَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: Say to the Bedouins who lagged behind, “You will be called against a people of great might[1], whom you will fight unless they submit[2]. Then if you obey, Allah will give you a goodly reward, but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will afflict you with a painful punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Referring to the two pagan Arab tribes: Hawāzin and Thaqīf.
 [2] i.e., accept Islam.

verses.translation: Say to the Bedouins who lagged behind, “You will be called against a people of great might[1], whom you will fight unless they submit[2]. Then if you obey, Allah will give you a goodly reward, but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will afflict you with a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: There is no blame on the blind, nor on the lame, nor on the sick [for remaining behind]. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, He will admit him into gardens under which rivers flow. But whoever turns away, He will afflict him with a painful punishment.

verses.translation: There is no blame on the blind, nor on the lame, nor on the sick [for remaining behind]. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, He will admit him into gardens under which rivers flow. But whoever turns away, He will afflict him with a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَٰبَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا

english_rwwad.text: Allah was much pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you [O Prophet] under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The conquest of Khaybar occurred in 7 A.H./628 C.E, which preceded that of Makkah.

verses.translation: Allah was much pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you [O Prophet] under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest[1],

verses.arabic: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: and abundant spoils of war they will gain. And Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

verses.translation: and abundant spoils of war they will gain. And Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

verses.arabic: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِىَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: Allah has promised you abundant spoils of war that you will gain, and He has hastened for you this [conquest][1], and He has restrained people’s hands from you, so that it may be a sign for the believers, and so that He may guide you to a straight path.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the spoils of Khaybar.

verses.translation: Allah has promised you abundant spoils of war that you will gain, and He has hastened for you this [conquest][1], and He has restrained people’s hands from you, so that it may be a sign for the believers, and so that He may guide you to a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: And there are other [spoils] that you have not yet been able to gain, but Allah has full control over them[1], for Allah is Most Capable of all things.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Allah has prepared or decreed them for you.

verses.translation: And there are other [spoils] that you have not yet been able to gain, but Allah has full control over them[1], for Allah is Most Capable of all things.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوَلَّوُا۟ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: If the disbelievers were to fight you, they would surely turn their backs, then they would not have any protector or helper.

verses.translation: If the disbelievers were to fight you, they would surely turn their backs, then they would not have any protector or helper.

verses.arabic: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Such was the way of Allah in the past, and you will not find any change in Allah’s way.

verses.translation: Such was the way of Allah in the past, and you will not find any change in Allah’s way.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who restrained their hands from you and your hands from them near Makkah[1], after giving you the upper hand over them. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] A group of pagans of Makkah who were around eighty people came to attack the Muslims in Hudaybiyyah on their way to Makkah, but Muslims were able to take them as captives, then released them.

verses.translation: It is He Who restrained their hands from you and your hands from them near Makkah[1], after giving you the upper hand over them. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.

verses.arabic: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٌ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: It is they who disbelieved and prevented you from the Sacred Mosque and detained the sacrificial animals[1] from reaching their place of sacrifice. If it had not been for the believing men and women whom you could not identify, you might have trampled them, thus incurring guilt unknowingly, [We would have let you march to Makkah]. [This was] so that Allah may admit to His mercy whom He wills[2]. If they had been distinct [from the disbelievers], We would have surely inflicted on those who disbelieved among them a painful punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., The Prophet (ﷺ) had brought along with him seventy camels to be sacrificed after completing the rituals of ‘Umrah (the minor pilgrimage).
 [2] Thus, not only the Muslims in Makkah who were not known to their fellow believers were safe, but also those pagans who later embraced Islam were safe too.

verses.translation: It is they who disbelieved and prevented you from the Sacred Mosque and detained the sacrificial animals[1] from reaching their place of sacrifice. If it had not been for the believing men and women whom you could not identify, you might have trampled them, thus incurring guilt unknowingly, [We would have let you march to Makkah]. [This was] so that Allah may admit to His mercy whom He wills[2]. If they had been distinct [from the disbelievers], We would have surely inflicted on those who disbelieved among them a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: When the disbelievers harbored pride in their hearts – the pride of ignorance[1] – then Allah sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers, and caused them to adhere to the word of piety[2], for they were more deserving and worthy of it. And Allah is All-Knowing of everything.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] This was when the pagans of Makkah prevented the Prophet (ﷺ) and the believers from entering the Sacred House to perform ‘Umrah for fear that Arabs would consider this a shame and insult to the pagans for allowing Muslims to enter Makkah.
 [2] That none has the right to be worshiped except Allan, and that Muhammad is His messenger (declaration of faith).

verses.translation: When the disbelievers harbored pride in their hearts – the pride of ignorance[1] – then Allah sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers, and caused them to adhere to the word of piety[2], for they were more deserving and worthy of it. And Allah is All-Knowing of everything.

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, Allah has fulfilled His Messenger’s dream in truth: that you will surely enter the Sacred Mosque if Allah wills, in peace and safety, and you will have your heads shaved or shortened[1], without any fear. He knew what you did not know, and He granted you prior to that an imminent conquest[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Shaving or trimming hair is from the requirements upon completing the rites of pilgrimage.
 [2] Referring to the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah and subsequently the conquest of Khaybar prior to the fulfillment of the Prophet’s dream regarding entering Makkah for pilgrimage.

verses.translation: Indeed, Allah has fulfilled His Messenger’s dream in truth: that you will surely enter the Sacred Mosque if Allah wills, in peace and safety, and you will have your heads shaved or shortened[1], without any fear. He knew what you did not know, and He granted you prior to that an imminent conquest[2].

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًا

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all religions, and sufficient is Allah as a Witness.

verses.translation: It is He Who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all religions, and sufficient is Allah as a Witness.

verses.arabic: مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًا سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا

english_rwwad.text: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and those who are with him are firm against the disbelievers[1] and compassionate among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking Allah’s grace and pleasure. Their distinguishing sign is on their faces from the effects of prostration. Such is their description in the Torah[2]. And their description in the Gospel is like that of a seed that sprouts its shoot, then makes it strong; then it grows thick and stands straight on its stem[3], which delights the sowers – so that He may enrage thereby the disbelievers. Allah has promised those among them who believe and do righteous deeds forgiveness and a great reward.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] It should be understood in its historical context. Muslims are urged here to be firm with the Arab disbelievers who were at war with Muslims. However, Muslims are encouraged to treat peaceful and non-combatant disbelievers with kindness and fairness. See 60:8-9.
 [2] The description of the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions is mentioned in the previous scriptures. See Deuteronomy 33:1-3.
 [3] See Matthew 13:3-9, Mark 4:26-28.

verses.translation: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and those who are with him are firm against the disbelievers[1] and compassionate among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking Allah’s grace and pleasure. Their distinguishing sign is on their faces from the effects of prostration. Such is their description in the Torah[2]. And their description in the Gospel is like that of a seed that sprouts its shoot, then makes it strong; then it grows thick and stands straight on its stem[3], which delights the sowers – so that He may enrage thereby the disbelievers. Allah has promised those among them who believe and do righteous deeds forgiveness and a great reward.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, do not decide [any matter of importance] before Allah and His Messenger[1], and fear Allah, for Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Show complete obedience to Allah and the Prophet (ﷺ).

verses.translation: O you who believe, do not decide [any matter of importance] before Allah and His Messenger[1], and fear Allah, for Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor speak loudly to him as you speak loudly to one another[1], lest your deeds become worthless without you realizing it.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or do not call him by his name as you call one another; do not call him, ‘O Muhammad.’ rather, call him, ‘O Prophet.’

verses.translation: O you who believe, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor speak loudly to him as you speak loudly to one another[1], lest your deeds become worthless without you realizing it.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, those who lower their voices in the presence of the Messenger of Allah are those whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness; for them there is forgiveness and a great reward[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was taking a nap in the afternoon when a group of people from the tribe of Bani Tamīm came to see him. They started calling him out loud while standing outside the chambers of his wives.

verses.translation: Indeed, those who lower their voices in the presence of the Messenger of Allah are those whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness; for them there is forgiveness and a great reward[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who call out to you [O Prophet] from behind the chambers, most of them have no understanding.

verses.translation: As for those who call out to you [O Prophet] from behind the chambers, most of them have no understanding.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: If they had been patient until you came out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.translation: If they had been patient until you came out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَٰدِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, if an evildoer brings you some news, verify it, lest you harm a people unknowingly, then you become regretful for what you did[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) sent Al-Walīd ibn ‘Uqbah ibn Abi Mu‘ait to collect zakah (alms-tax) from the tribe of Bani Al-Mustaliq. They went out to receive Al-Walīd but he thought that they wanted to harm him. So, he quickly came back to the Prophet (ﷺ) with the bad news, so he wanted to punish them. After a while, a delegation from Bani Al-Mustaliq came to clear the misunderstanding.

verses.translation: O you who believe, if an evildoer brings you some news, verify it, lest you harm a people unknowingly, then you become regretful for what you did[1].

verses.arabic: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Know that the Messenger of Allah is among you. If he were to obey you in many matters, you would surely suffer[1]. But Allah has endeared faith to you and made it pleasing to your hearts, and has made disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience hateful to you. Such are the rightly guided,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Things would be difficult for you.

verses.translation: Know that the Messenger of Allah is among you. If he were to obey you in many matters, you would surely suffer[1]. But Allah has endeared faith to you and made it pleasing to your hearts, and has made disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience hateful to you. Such are the rightly guided,

verses.arabic: فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: by Allah’s grace and favor. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.translation: by Allah’s grace and favor. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.arabic: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ

english_rwwad.text: If two groups of the believers fight one another, make peace between them. If one of them transgresses against the other, fight against the transgressing group until they submit to the rule of Allah. Then if they submit, make peace between them with fairness, and be just, for Allah loves those who are just.

verses.translation: If two groups of the believers fight one another, make peace between them. If one of them transgresses against the other, fight against the transgressing group until they submit to the rule of Allah. Then if they submit, make peace between them with fairness, and be just, for Allah loves those who are just.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: The believers are but brothers, so make peace between your brothers. And fear Allah, so that you may be shown mercy.

verses.translation: The believers are but brothers, so make peace between your brothers. And fear Allah, so that you may be shown mercy.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُنَّ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَٰبِ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, let not some men ridicule others, for it may be that they are better than them; nor let some women ridicule others, for it may be that they are better than them. Do not speak ill of one another, nor call one another by [offensive] nicknames. How evil is the name of wickedness after having faith! And whoever does not repent, it is they who are the wrongdoers.

verses.translation: O you who believe, let not some men ridicule others, for it may be that they are better than them; nor let some women ridicule others, for it may be that they are better than them. Do not speak ill of one another, nor call one another by [offensive] nicknames. How evil is the name of wickedness after having faith! And whoever does not repent, it is they who are the wrongdoers.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, avoid much of the suspicion, for some suspicions are sin. Do not spy on one another, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother[1]? You would surely abhor it. So fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Accepting of Repentance, Most Merciful.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Backbiting people is likened to eating their dead bodies, for the dead do not feel the pain if their flesh is eaten; likewise, the one who is absent does not feel the pain of backbiting. So, backbiting someone is like eating his flesh while he is dead.

verses.translation: O you who believe, avoid much of the suspicion, for some suspicions are sin. Do not spy on one another, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother[1]? You would surely abhor it. So fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Accepting of Repentance, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: O people, We have created you from a male and a female and made you into nations and tribes so that you may recognize one another. Indeed, the most noble of you before Allah is the most righteous[1] among you. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Lit., "the one who has the most taqwā among you," i.e., consciousness, piety, and fear of Allah.

verses.translation: O people, We have created you from a male and a female and made you into nations and tribes so that you may recognize one another. Indeed, the most noble of you before Allah is the most righteous[1] among you. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.

verses.arabic: قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: The Bedouins say, “We have believed.” Say, “You have not believed, but say, ‘We have submitted,’ for faith has not yet entered your hearts[1]. But if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not detract anything from the reward of your deeds. Indeed, Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] There is a distinction between Islam and Imān (faith). Imān is a higher degree than Islam. This distinction is mentioned in an authentic Hadīth of the Prophet (ﷺ), known as the Hadīth of Gabriel.

verses.translation: The Bedouins say, “We have believed.” Say, “You have not believed, but say, ‘We have submitted,’ for faith has not yet entered your hearts[1]. But if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not detract anything from the reward of your deeds. Indeed, Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the believers are those who believe in Allah and His Messenger, then they do not have doubt, but fight with their wealth and their lives in the way of Allah. It is they who are the truthful.

verses.translation: Indeed, the believers are those who believe in Allah and His Messenger, then they do not have doubt, but fight with their wealth and their lives in the way of Allah. It is they who are the truthful.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Do you inform Allah of your faith, when Allah knows all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth? And Allah is All-Knowing of everything.”

verses.translation: Say, “Do you inform Allah of your faith, when Allah knows all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth? And Allah is All-Knowing of everything.”

verses.arabic: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَٰمَكُم بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They think that they have done you a favor by embracing Islam. Say, “Do not consider your Islam as a favor to me. Rather, it is Allah Who has done you a favor by guiding you to faith, if you are truthful.

verses.translation: They think that they have done you a favor by embracing Islam. Say, “Do not consider your Islam as a favor to me. Rather, it is Allah Who has done you a favor by guiding you to faith, if you are truthful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, Allah knows all that is unseen of the heavens and earth, and Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.”

verses.translation: Indeed, Allah knows all that is unseen of the heavens and earth, and Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: Qāf[1]. By the Glorious Qur’an!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 2:1.

verses.translation: Qāf[1]. By the Glorious Qur’an!

verses.arabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

english_rwwad.text: But they wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves, so the disbelievers say, “This is something strange!

verses.translation: But they wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves, so the disbelievers say, “This is something strange!

verses.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: What! Is it when we die and become dust [will we return to life]? That is a far-fetched return.”

verses.translation: What! Is it when we die and become dust [will we return to life]? That is a far-fetched return.”

verses.arabic: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ

english_rwwad.text: We certainly know what the earth consumes of them [after their death], and with Us is a Preserved Record[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or a Record that preserves everything.

verses.translation: We certainly know what the earth consumes of them [after their death], and with Us is a Preserved Record[1].

verses.arabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ

english_rwwad.text: Rather they rejected the truth when it came to them, so they are in a state of confusion[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They are in confusion concerning the Qur’an, claiming that it is poetry, magic, or ancient fables. They are also in confusion concerning the Prophet (ﷺ), claiming that he is a poet, a fabricator, or insane.

verses.translation: Rather they rejected the truth when it came to them, so they are in a state of confusion[1].

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ

english_rwwad.text: Have they not then looked at the sky above them – how We built it and adorned it [with stars], and it has no rifts?

verses.translation: Have they not then looked at the sky above them – how We built it and adorned it [with stars], and it has no rifts?

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ

english_rwwad.text: And We have spread out the earth and set therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein plants of every pleasant kind,

verses.translation: And We have spread out the earth and set therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein plants of every pleasant kind,

verses.arabic: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ

english_rwwad.text: as a source of insight and a reminder to every slave who turns [to Allah].

verses.translation: as a source of insight and a reminder to every slave who turns [to Allah].

verses.arabic: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: And We send down from the sky blessed rain, with which We cause to grow gardens and grain for harvest,

verses.translation: And We send down from the sky blessed rain, with which We cause to grow gardens and grain for harvest,

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: and towering palm trees having clustered fruit,

verses.translation: and towering palm trees having clustered fruit,

verses.arabic: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ

english_rwwad.text: as a provision for people, and We revive thereby a dead land; likewise will be the resurrection.

verses.translation: as a provision for people, and We revive thereby a dead land; likewise will be the resurrection.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ

english_rwwad.text: The people of Noah rejected [the truth] before them[1], as well as the companions of the Well[2] and Thamūd,
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., before the pagans of Makkah.
 [2] i.e., people of prophet Shu‘ayb or other people. See footnote 25:38.

verses.translation: The people of Noah rejected [the truth] before them[1], as well as the companions of the Well[2] and Thamūd,

verses.arabic: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ

english_rwwad.text: and so did ‘Ād, Pharaoh, the people of Lot,

verses.translation: and so did ‘Ād, Pharaoh, the people of Lot,

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: and the dwellers of the Forest[1], and the people of Tubba‘[2]. All of them rejected the messengers, so My warning was fulfilled.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the people of Shu‘ayb (عليه السلام).
 [2] Tubba‘ al-Himyari, an ancient righteous Yemeni king. See 44:37.

verses.translation: and the dwellers of the Forest[1], and the people of Tubba‘[2]. All of them rejected the messengers, so My warning was fulfilled.

verses.arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: Were We wearied by their first creation? No indeed, yet they are in confusion concerning the second creation.

verses.translation: Were We wearied by their first creation? No indeed, yet they are in confusion concerning the second creation.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: We have created man and know what his soul whispers within him, for We are closer to him than his jugular vein[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., We have absolute knowledge of everything about him, or Our angels are closer to him, as mentioned in the next verse.

verses.translation: We have created man and know what his soul whispers within him, for We are closer to him than his jugular vein[1].

verses.arabic: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: When the two angel scribes, constantly accompanying him[1], one on the right, and the other on the left[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Recording each word and deed.
 [2] There are two angle scribes: one on the right of each person, recording the good deeds, while the other on the left, recording evil deeds. They accompany humans all the time, except when one is intimate with their spouse or uses the bathroom.

verses.translation: When the two angel scribes, constantly accompanying him[1], one on the right, and the other on the left[2].

verses.arabic: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: Not a single word he utters but there is with him a vigilant watcher, ready [to record it].

verses.translation: Not a single word he utters but there is with him a vigilant watcher, ready [to record it].

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ

english_rwwad.text: The throes of death will come with the truth[1]. This is what you were trying to avoid.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] When a disbeliever or a heedless person is in death throes, he will realize that resurrection and reckoning are true.

verses.translation: The throes of death will come with the truth[1]. This is what you were trying to avoid.

verses.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: And the Trumpet will be blown[1]; that is the Day of [the given] warning.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the second blow that will bring all back to life for judgment.

verses.translation: And the Trumpet will be blown[1]; that is the Day of [the given] warning.

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: Everyone will come, accompanied by an angel to drive him and another to testify[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., one driving him for Judgment and another as a witness for his deeds.

verses.translation: Everyone will come, accompanied by an angel to drive him and another to testify[1].

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: “You were heedless of this; now We have removed your veil[1], so your vision is sharp Today.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of heedlessness by seeing the punishment and hardships.

verses.translation: “You were heedless of this; now We have removed your veil[1], so your vision is sharp Today.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: His angel-companion will say, “Here is the record ready with me.”

verses.translation: His angel-companion will say, “Here is the record ready with me.”

verses.arabic: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: [It will be said to the two angels], “Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

verses.translation: [It will be said to the two angels], “Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

verses.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ

english_rwwad.text: every withholder of good, transgressor, and doubter,

verses.translation: every withholder of good, transgressor, and doubter,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: who set up with Allah another god. Throw him into the severe punishment.”

verses.translation: who set up with Allah another god. Throw him into the severe punishment.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: His [devil] companion will say, “Our Lord, I did not mislead him, but he himself was far astray.”

verses.translation: His [devil] companion will say, “Our Lord, I did not mislead him, but he himself was far astray.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: Allah will say, “Do not argue in My presence, for I had already given you the warning.

verses.translation: Allah will say, “Do not argue in My presence, for I had already given you the warning.

verses.arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to My slaves.”

verses.translation: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to My slaves.”

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: [Beware of] the Day when We will say to Hell, “Have you reached your fill?” It will say, “Are there any more?”

verses.translation: [Beware of] the Day when We will say to Hell, “Have you reached your fill?” It will say, “Are there any more?”

verses.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ

english_rwwad.text: Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off.

verses.translation: Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ

english_rwwad.text: [It will be said], “This is what you were promised; this is for everyone who constantly turned [to Allah] and was dutiful,

verses.translation: [It will be said], “This is what you were promised; this is for everyone who constantly turned [to Allah] and was dutiful,

verses.arabic: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ

english_rwwad.text: who feared the Most Compassionate unseen[1], and came with a devoted heart.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or while he is in private.

verses.translation: who feared the Most Compassionate unseen[1], and came with a devoted heart.

verses.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ

english_rwwad.text: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternity.”

verses.translation: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternity.”

verses.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: They will have therein all what they wish for, and We have yet more[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of unimaginable pleasures such as looking at the Face of Allah Almighty. See 10:26 and 75:22-23.

verses.translation: They will have therein all what they wish for, and We have yet more[1].

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

english_rwwad.text: How many nations We destroyed before these [Makkans] who were stronger than them in might! They sought refuge in the land. Did they find any escape?

verses.translation: How many nations We destroyed before these [Makkans] who were stronger than them in might! They sought refuge in the land. Did they find any escape?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, in that is a reminder for anyone who has a [mindful] heart or lends an attentive ear.

verses.translation: Indeed, in that is a reminder for anyone who has a [mindful] heart or lends an attentive ear.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six days, and no weariness touched Us[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It is believed that this verse came in response to the Jews who claimed that after the Lord made the heavens and the earth in six days, He rested on the seventh day. See Exodus 31:17.

verses.translation: Indeed, We created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six days, and no weariness touched Us[1].

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ

english_rwwad.text: So bear patiently [O Prophet] what they say, and glorify the praise of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This and the following verse refer to the times of the five daily prayers; before the sun rises and sets (i.e., the Fajr, Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers).

verses.translation: So bear patiently [O Prophet] what they say, and glorify the praise of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset[1].

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ

english_rwwad.text: And glorify Him in the night[1] and after the prayers.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The night (the Maghrib, ‘Isha’ prayers).

verses.translation: And glorify Him in the night[1] and after the prayers.

verses.arabic: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ

english_rwwad.text: And listen! On the Day when the Caller will call out from a nearby place[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The angel who will blow the second trumpet for the Resurrection.

verses.translation: And listen! On the Day when the Caller will call out from a nearby place[1],

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ

english_rwwad.text: the Day when they will hear the Blast [of the second Trumpet] in truth[1]. That is the Day of Resurrection.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote below 50:20.

verses.translation: the Day when they will hear the Blast [of the second Trumpet] in truth[1]. That is the Day of Resurrection.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, it is We Who give life and cause death, and to Us is the final return.

verses.translation: Indeed, it is We Who give life and cause death, and to Us is the final return.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when the earth will be rent asunder for them as they hasten forth [from their graves]; that is an easy gathering for Us.

verses.translation: On the Day when the earth will be rent asunder for them as they hasten forth [from their graves]; that is an easy gathering for Us.

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: We know best what they say, and you are not there to compel them to believe. But remind with the Qur’an those who fear My warning.

verses.translation: We know best what they say, and you are not there to compel them to believe. But remind with the Qur’an those who fear My warning.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًا

english_rwwad.text: By the winds that scatter [dust],

verses.translation: By the winds that scatter [dust],

verses.arabic: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًا

english_rwwad.text: and by the clouds carrying loads of water,

verses.translation: and by the clouds carrying loads of water,

verses.arabic: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًا

english_rwwad.text: and by the ships that sail with ease,

verses.translation: and by the ships that sail with ease,

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا

english_rwwad.text: and by the angels who distribute [blessings] by His command.

verses.translation: and by the angels who distribute [blessings] by His command.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, what you are promised is true,

verses.translation: Indeed, what you are promised is true,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

english_rwwad.text: and the Judgment will surely come to pass.

verses.translation: and the Judgment will surely come to pass.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ

english_rwwad.text: By the heaven with its pathways[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., tracks or orbits.

verses.translation: By the heaven with its pathways[1],

verses.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, you [Makkans] have conflicting views[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Concerning the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Qur’an.

verses.translation: Indeed, you [Makkans] have conflicting views[1].

verses.arabic: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ

english_rwwad.text: He who is diverted from it is destined to be diverted.

verses.translation: He who is diverted from it is destined to be diverted.

verses.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Doomed[1] are those who base their beliefs on conjecture.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] May they be destroyed.

verses.translation: Doomed[1] are those who base their beliefs on conjecture.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those who are steeped in ignorance heedlessly.

verses.translation: those who are steeped in ignorance heedlessly.

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: They ask [mockingly], “When is the Day of Judgment?”

verses.translation: They ask [mockingly], “When is the Day of Judgment?”

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: It is the Day when they will be punished by the Fire.

verses.translation: It is the Day when they will be punished by the Fire.

verses.arabic: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [It will be said], “Taste your punishment! This is what you were seeking to hasten.”

verses.translation: [It will be said], “Taste your punishment! This is what you were seeking to hasten.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and springs,

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and springs,

verses.arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: receiving what their Lord will give them, for they were indeed doers of good beforehand.
