verses.translation: receiving what their Lord will give them, for they were indeed doers of good beforehand.

verses.arabic: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They used to sleep only a little at night[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., spending most of the night in prayer, reciting the Qur’an, and in supplication.

verses.translation: They used to sleep only a little at night[1],

verses.arabic: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and before dawn they would seek forgiveness[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Supererogatory prayers and supplications are recommended before dawn.

verses.translation: and before dawn they would seek forgiveness[1],

verses.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

english_rwwad.text: and in their wealth, there was a share for the beggar and the destitute.

verses.translation: and in their wealth, there was a share for the beggar and the destitute.

verses.arabic: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: On earth there are signs for those who are certain in faith,

verses.translation: On earth there are signs for those who are certain in faith,

verses.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?

verses.translation: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?

verses.arabic: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And in the heaven is your provision and all that you are promised.

verses.translation: And in the heaven is your provision and all that you are promised.

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: By the Lord of the heaven and earth, this [resurrection] is certainly as true as the fact that you can speak.

verses.translation: By the Lord of the heaven and earth, this [resurrection] is certainly as true as the fact that you can speak.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Has there come to you the story of Abraham’s honored guests[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Honorable angels with Allah.

verses.translation: Has there come to you the story of Abraham’s honored guests[1]?

verses.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: When they came to him and said, “Peace.” He said, “Upon you be peace.” [saying to himself] “Unknown people!”

verses.translation: When they came to him and said, “Peace.” He said, “Upon you be peace.” [saying to himself] “Unknown people!”

verses.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Then he went quickly to his household, and came with a fat [roasted] calf,

verses.translation: Then he went quickly to his household, and came with a fat [roasted] calf,

verses.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and placed it before them and said, “Will you not eat?”

verses.translation: and placed it before them and said, “Will you not eat?”

verses.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: He perceived a fear of them[1]. They said, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him glad tidings of a knowledgeable son.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In their culture, if a guest refused to eat the food provided, it was considered a sign of ill will. See footnote 11:70.

verses.translation: He perceived a fear of them[1]. They said, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him glad tidings of a knowledgeable son.

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: His wife cried out loud, and struck her face [in astonishment] and said, “[I am] a barren old woman!”

verses.translation: His wife cried out loud, and struck her face [in astonishment] and said, “[I am] a barren old woman!”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “This is what your Lord said. Indeed, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.”

verses.translation: They said, “This is what your Lord said. Indeed, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Abraham said, “Then what is your mission, O messengers?”

verses.translation: Abraham said, “Then what is your mission, O messengers?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “We have been sent to a wicked people,

verses.translation: They said, “We have been sent to a wicked people,

verses.arabic: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: to send down upon them stones of clay,

verses.translation: to send down upon them stones of clay,

verses.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ

english_rwwad.text: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

verses.translation: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We brought out those believers who were there,

verses.translation: We brought out those believers who were there,

verses.arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: but We only found in it one Muslim household[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Lot's family except his wife.

verses.translation: but We only found in it one Muslim household[1].

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: And We left there a sign[1] for those who fear the painful punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the ruins of Sodom or the Dead Sea in Palestine, as a lesson for people.

verses.translation: And We left there a sign[1] for those who fear the painful punishment.

verses.arabic: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: And [there is a sign in the story of] Moses when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proofs,

verses.translation: And [there is a sign in the story of] Moses when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proofs,

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

english_rwwad.text: But he and his supporters turned away, and he said about [Moses], “A magician or a madman!”

verses.translation: But he and his supporters turned away, and he said about [Moses], “A magician or a madman!”

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: So We seized him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea while he was blameworthy[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For his disbelief and arrogance.

verses.translation: So We seized him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea while he was blameworthy[1].

verses.arabic: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: And [there is a sign in the story of] ‘Ād, when We sent against them the devastating barren wind[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Devoid of all goodness such as carrying rain or fertilizing trees.

verses.translation: And [there is a sign in the story of] ‘Ād, when We sent against them the devastating barren wind[1].

verses.arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: It spared nothing it came upon except that it reduced it to ruin and decay.

verses.translation: It spared nothing it came upon except that it reduced it to ruin and decay.

verses.arabic: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: And [there is a sign in the story of] Thamūd, when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves for a while[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., only three days. See 11:65.

verses.translation: And [there is a sign in the story of] Thamūd, when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves for a while[1].”

verses.arabic: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But they rebelled against the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them, while they were looking on.

verses.translation: But they rebelled against the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them, while they were looking on.

verses.arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They could not withstand it, nor could they ward it off.

verses.translation: They could not withstand it, nor could they ward it off.

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And the people of Noah [were also destroyed] before them. They were indeed a rebellious people.

verses.translation: And the people of Noah [were also destroyed] before them. They were indeed a rebellious people.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We built the heaven with might[1], and We are indeed expanding it.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] ’Ayd does not mean "hands" here. This is not from the verses of Allah's attributes, for Allah Almighty did not add it to Himself, i.e., He did not say, "My ’ayd, or Our ’ayd".

verses.translation: We built the heaven with might[1], and We are indeed expanding it.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And We spread out the earth. How well did We smooth it out[1]!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The earth was spread out to accommodate the creatures. Its spherical shape is mentioned in 39:5.

verses.translation: And We spread out the earth. How well did We smooth it out[1]!

verses.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And We have created everything in pairs[1], so that you may take heed.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Such as day and night, male and female, light and darkness, sweet and bitter, hot and cold, etc.

verses.translation: And We have created everything in pairs[1], so that you may take heed.

verses.arabic: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: So flee to Allah[1]. Indeed, I am a clear warner to you from Him.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] From His punishment to His reward by shunning disbelief and sin and by obeying Him.

verses.translation: So flee to Allah[1]. Indeed, I am a clear warner to you from Him.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: And do not set up another god with Allah. Indeed, I am a clear warner to you from Him.”

verses.translation: And do not set up another god with Allah. Indeed, I am a clear warner to you from Him.”

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

english_rwwad.text: Likewise, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician, or a madman!”

verses.translation: Likewise, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician, or a madman!”

verses.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Did they suggest this to one another[1]? Rather they are transgressing people.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Did the previous disbelievers pass on these false allegations to the pagans of Makkah so they repeat their words?

verses.translation: Did they suggest this to one another[1]? Rather they are transgressing people.

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ

english_rwwad.text: So turn away from them [O Prophet], for you are not to blame[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] After you have delivered the message.

verses.translation: So turn away from them [O Prophet], for you are not to blame[1].

verses.arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: But keep reminding them, for reminder benefits the believers.

verses.translation: But keep reminding them, for reminder benefits the believers.

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

english_rwwad.text: I have not created the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

verses.translation: I have not created the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

verses.arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

english_rwwad.text: I seek no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me.

verses.translation: I seek no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, it is Allah Who is the All-Provider[1], Lord of Power, the Mighty.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He Provides His creatures with everything they need. Among His provisions is guidance.

verses.translation: Indeed, it is Allah Who is the All-Provider[1], Lord of Power, the Mighty.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, those who do wrong will have a share [of punishment] like that of their predecessors, so let them not ask Me to hasten it.

verses.translation: Indeed, those who do wrong will have a share [of punishment] like that of their predecessors, so let them not ask Me to hasten it.

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So woe to those who disbelieve from [the punishment of] the Day which they are promised.

verses.translation: So woe to those who disbelieve from [the punishment of] the Day which they are promised.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلطُّورِ

english_rwwad.text: By the mount of Tūr[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Where Allah Almighty communicated with Moses (عليه السلام).

verses.translation: By the mount of Tūr[1],

verses.arabic: وَكِتَٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ

english_rwwad.text: and by the Book inscribed[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Qur’an.

verses.translation: and by the Book inscribed[1]

verses.arabic: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ

english_rwwad.text: on an unrolled parchment[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a spread-out scroll.

verses.translation: on an unrolled parchment[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ

english_rwwad.text: and by the much-frequented House[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Which is frequented by angels or the Ka‘bah in Makkah which is frequented by pilgrims.

verses.translation: and by the much-frequented House[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ

english_rwwad.text: and by the canopy raised high,

verses.translation: and by the canopy raised high,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ

english_rwwad.text: and by the sea set on fire[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] On the Day of Resurrection, or "by the overflowed sea."

verses.translation: and by the sea set on fire[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

english_rwwad.text: The punishment of your Lord will surely come to pass;

verses.translation: The punishment of your Lord will surely come to pass;

verses.arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ

english_rwwad.text: there is none who can avert it.

verses.translation: there is none who can avert it.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when the heaven will convulse violently[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The heavens will be shaken violently, indicating the occurrence of the Hour. The word "maur" originally means turning round, rotating, swinging, swaying, etc.

verses.translation: On the Day when the heaven will convulse violently[1],

verses.arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا

english_rwwad.text: and the mountains will move a horrible movement[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They will turn into dust, moving as clouds.

verses.translation: and the mountains will move a horrible movement[1].

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then woe to the deniers on that Day,

verses.translation: Then woe to the deniers on that Day,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those who amuse themselves in falsehood.

verses.translation: those who amuse themselves in falsehood.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when they will be shoved into the Fire forcefully,

verses.translation: On the Day when they will be shoved into the Fire forcefully,

verses.arabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be told,] “This is the Fire which you used to deny.

verses.translation: [They will be told,] “This is the Fire which you used to deny.

verses.arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Is this [punishment] magic, or do you not see?

verses.translation: Is this [punishment] magic, or do you not see?

verses.arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Burn in it, whether you bear it patiently or impatiently, it makes no difference to you[1]; you are recompensed only for what you used to do.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He who is patient during afflictions in the life of this world will be rewarded. As for the Hereafter, suffering patiently in Hell will not bring any reward or benefit.

verses.translation: Burn in it, whether you bear it patiently or impatiently, it makes no difference to you[1]; you are recompensed only for what you used to do.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and bliss,

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and bliss,

verses.arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

verses.translation: enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of the Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: “Eat and drink pleasantly for what you used to do,

verses.translation: “Eat and drink pleasantly for what you used to do,

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: reclining on lined up couches”. And We will marry them to houris with wide beautiful eyes.

verses.translation: reclining on lined up couches”. And We will marry them to houris with wide beautiful eyes.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who believe and their offspring follow them in faith, We will cause their offspring to join them, and will not detract anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Everyone will be accountable for what he earned[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., None will be held responsible for the burden of another.

verses.translation: As for those who believe and their offspring follow them in faith, We will cause their offspring to join them, and will not detract anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Everyone will be accountable for what he earned[1].

verses.arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And We will provide them with whatever fruit and meat they desire.

verses.translation: And We will provide them with whatever fruit and meat they desire.

verses.arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: They will pass around to one another a glass [of pure wine] which does not lead to idle talk or sin.

verses.translation: They will pass around to one another a glass [of pure wine] which does not lead to idle talk or sin.

verses.arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

english_rwwad.text: They will be served by their servant boys, as if they were well-protected pearls.

verses.translation: They will be served by their servant boys, as if they were well-protected pearls.

verses.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will turn to one another with questions[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They will probably ask one another about their worldly lives and what led them to Paradise.

verses.translation: They will turn to one another with questions[1].

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They will say, “Before this, we used to be in awe [of Allah] when we were living among our people.

verses.translation: They will say, “Before this, we used to be in awe [of Allah] when we were living among our people.

verses.arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ

english_rwwad.text: Therefore Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

verses.translation: Therefore Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, we used to call upon Him before. He is indeed the Most Kind, the Most Merciful.”

verses.translation: Indeed, we used to call upon Him before. He is indeed the Most Kind, the Most Merciful.”

verses.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: So keep exhorting [O Prophet], for you are not, by the grace of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

verses.translation: So keep exhorting [O Prophet], for you are not, by the grace of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they say: “He is a poet for whom we await a misfortune[1]”?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., inevitable death or so.

verses.translation: Or do they say: “He is a poet for whom we await a misfortune[1]”?

verses.arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “Wait, I too am waiting with you.”

verses.translation: Say, “Wait, I too am waiting with you.”

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do their minds[1] prompt them to say such things, or are they transgressing people?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The leaders of pagans in Makkah claimed to be of great minds. Here it questions their intelligence, arguing that a man cannot be a madman and a poet at the same time.

verses.translation: Do their minds[1] prompt them to say such things, or are they transgressing people?

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they say, “He has made this [Qur’an] up”? Rather, they are not willing to believe.

verses.translation: Or do they say, “He has made this [Qur’an] up”? Rather, they are not willing to believe.

verses.arabic: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then let them produce a discourse like this, if they are truthful[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Arab pagans were challenged to produce the like of this Quran, ten surahs, or one surah, but the challenge has never been met until the present day. See 2:23, 11:13, 52:34.

verses.translation: Then let them produce a discourse like this, if they are truthful[1].

verses.arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Were they created by none, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

verses.translation: Were they created by none, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

verses.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or did they create the heavens and earth? Rather, they are not certain in faith.

verses.translation: Or did they create the heavens and earth? Rather, they are not certain in faith.

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they possess the treasures of your Lord, or do they have full control [of everything]?

verses.translation: Or do they possess the treasures of your Lord, or do they have full control [of everything]?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they have a stairway [to the heaven] by which they eavesdrop? Then let those who eavesdrop produce a compelling proof.

verses.translation: Or do they have a stairway [to the heaven] by which they eavesdrop? Then let those who eavesdrop produce a compelling proof.

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or does He have daughters while you have sons[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 37:149.

verses.translation: Or does He have daughters while you have sons[1]?

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or are you asking them [O Prophet] for a reward so they are overburdened by debt?

verses.translation: Or are you asking them [O Prophet] for a reward so they are overburdened by debt?

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they have [the knowledge of] the unseen so they are writing it down?

verses.translation: Or do they have [the knowledge of] the unseen so they are writing it down?

verses.arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they intend a plot [against the Prophet]? But the plot of the disbelievers will rebound against themselves.

verses.translation: Or do they intend a plot [against the Prophet]? But the plot of the disbelievers will rebound against themselves.

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glory be to Allah far above what they associate with Him.

verses.translation: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glory be to Allah far above what they associate with Him.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ

english_rwwad.text: If they were to see pieces of the sky falling down[1], they would still say, “[This is only] a mass of clouds.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As a sign of the punishment that they requested.

verses.translation: If they were to see pieces of the sky falling down[1], they would still say, “[This is only] a mass of clouds.”

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So leave them alone until they encounter their Day in which they will be struck down[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., they will be punished on the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: So leave them alone until they encounter their Day in which they will be struck down[1],

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: the Day their plots will not avail them in the least, nor will they be helped.

verses.translation: the Day their plots will not avail them in the least, nor will they be helped.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And for the wrongdoers, there will be another punishment before that[1], but most of them do not know.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In this world such as famine, droughts, or defeat at the battle, or punishment in the grave.

verses.translation: And for the wrongdoers, there will be another punishment before that[1], but most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

english_rwwad.text: Be patient [O Prophet] with your Lord’s decree, for indeed you are under Our [Watchful] Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.

verses.translation: Be patient [O Prophet] with your Lord’s decree, for indeed you are under Our [Watchful] Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ

english_rwwad.text: And glorify Him at night and when the stars fade away[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the early hours of the morning when the stars set; the time of the Fajr Prayer.

verses.translation: And glorify Him at night and when the stars fade away[1].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: By the star when it sets,

verses.translation: By the star when it sets,

verses.arabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Your companion [i.e., the Prophet] has neither strayed nor is he deluded.

verses.translation: Your companion [i.e., the Prophet] has neither strayed nor is he deluded.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: Nor does he speak out of his own desire.

verses.translation: Nor does he speak out of his own desire.

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: It is but a revelation sent down [to him].

verses.translation: It is but a revelation sent down [to him].

verses.arabic: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: He was taught by [an angel of] mighty power[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the angel Gabriel.

verses.translation: He was taught by [an angel of] mighty power[1],

verses.arabic: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and of great perfection[1], who manifested himself [in his true form][2]
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the strength of body and mind.
 [2] Archangel Gabriel appeared to the Prophet (ﷺ) only twice in his angelic form: once at the outset of the Prophet’s mission (as he manifested himself, filling the horizon, so the Prophet (ﷺ) lost his consciousness), and another time during the Prophet’s ascension to the seventh heaven where he directly received from Allah the order to pray five times a day. See 17:1.

verses.translation: and of great perfection[1], who manifested himself [in his true form][2]

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: when he was on the higher horizon[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., above the eastern horizon in the sky where the sun rises.

verses.translation: when he was on the higher horizon[1].

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Then he approached [the Prophet] and descended,

verses.translation: Then he approached [the Prophet] and descended,

verses.arabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: until he was only two bow-lengths away or even closer.

verses.translation: until he was only two bow-lengths away or even closer.

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Then he revealed to His slave[1] what he had to reveal.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).

verses.translation: Then he revealed to His slave[1] what he had to reveal.

verses.arabic: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: The [Prophet’s] heart[1] did not deny what he saw.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., his mind or perception.

verses.translation: The [Prophet’s] heart[1] did not deny what he saw.

verses.arabic: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Do you dispute with him concerning what he saw?

verses.translation: Do you dispute with him concerning what he saw?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: He certainly saw him a second time[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., During his ascent (al-Mi‘rāj) to the heavens, he saw Gabriel in his true angelic form.

verses.translation: He certainly saw him a second time[1]

verses.arabic: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: at the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary [in the seventh heaven]

verses.translation: at the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary [in the seventh heaven]

verses.arabic: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: near which is the Garden of Abode,

verses.translation: near which is the Garden of Abode,

verses.arabic: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: when the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with [divine] splendors.

verses.translation: when the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with [divine] splendors.

verses.arabic: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: His gaze did not wander, nor did it look beyond the limit.

verses.translation: His gaze did not wander, nor did it look beyond the limit.

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: He certainly saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.

verses.translation: He certainly saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Have you [O disbelievers] thought about [the idols of] Lāt and ‘Uzzā,

verses.translation: Have you [O disbelievers] thought about [the idols of] Lāt and ‘Uzzā,

verses.arabic: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: and Manāt, the third one as well[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] These were three well-known idols or goddesses worshiped by Arab pagans before the advent of Islam.

verses.translation: and Manāt, the third one as well[1]?

verses.arabic: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Do you choose for yourselves males and for Him females?

verses.translation: Do you choose for yourselves males and for Him females?

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: That is then an unfair division!

verses.translation: That is then an unfair division!

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: These [idols] are no more than names you and your forefathers have made up[1], for which Allah has not sent down any authority. They follow nothing but conjecture and what their souls desire, although there has come to them guidance from their Lord.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., You have considered them gods while in fact, they are not.

verses.translation: These [idols] are no more than names you and your forefathers have made up[1], for which Allah has not sent down any authority. They follow nothing but conjecture and what their souls desire, although there has come to them guidance from their Lord.

verses.arabic: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Is it that man can get whatever he wishes for[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The pagans worshiped these idols wishing that they would intercede for them on the Day of Resurrection. See 39:3.

verses.translation: Is it that man can get whatever he wishes for[1]?

verses.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and this world.

verses.translation: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and this world.

verses.arabic: وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: How many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will be of no avail except after Allah’s permission to whom He wills and pleases.

verses.translation: How many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will be of no avail except after Allah’s permission to whom He wills and pleases.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels female names.

verses.translation: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels female names.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا

english_rwwad.text: They have no knowledge about it. They only follow conjecture, but conjecture is of no avail against the truth.

verses.translation: They have no knowledge about it. They only follow conjecture, but conjecture is of no avail against the truth.

verses.arabic: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

english_rwwad.text: So pay no heed to those who turn away from Our message[1] and who only seek the life of this world.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Qur’an.

verses.translation: So pay no heed to those who turn away from Our message[1] and who only seek the life of this world.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: That is the limit of their knowledge. Indeed, your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way, and He knows best who is guided.

verses.translation: That is the limit of their knowledge. Indeed, your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way, and He knows best who is guided.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى

english_rwwad.text: To Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth, so that He may recompense the evildoers for what they did, and reward those who do good with the best reward[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Paradise.

verses.translation: To Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth, so that He may recompense the evildoers for what they did, and reward those who do good with the best reward[1],

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: those who avoid major sins and shameful acts, except for minor lapses. Indeed, your Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you best, as He created you from the earth[1] and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers[2]. So do not claim purity for yourselves, for He knows best who is truly righteous.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., created your father, Adam.
 [2] See footnote 31:34.

verses.translation: those who avoid major sins and shameful acts, except for minor lapses. Indeed, your Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you best, as He created you from the earth[1] and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers[2]. So do not claim purity for yourselves, for He knows best who is truly righteous.

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Have you seen the one who turned away [from Islam],

verses.translation: Have you seen the one who turned away [from Islam],

verses.arabic: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: who gave a little, and then stopped?

verses.translation: who gave a little, and then stopped?

verses.arabic: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he has insight[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the knowledge that his wealth will be exhausted if he spends on the poor, while Allah has promised that it nourishes wealth.

verses.translation: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he has insight[1]?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scriptures of Moses,

verses.translation: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scriptures of Moses,

verses.arabic: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: and of Abraham, who fulfilled his duty?

verses.translation: and of Abraham, who fulfilled his duty?

verses.arabic: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: That no bearer of burden will bear the burden of another,

verses.translation: That no bearer of burden will bear the burden of another,

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and that man will not receive except what he strives for,

verses.translation: and that man will not receive except what he strives for,

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and that his efforts will be examined,

verses.translation: and that his efforts will be examined,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: then he will be recompensed in full,

verses.translation: then he will be recompensed in full,

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and that to your Lord is the final return,

verses.translation: and that to your Lord is the final return,

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and that He is the One Who makes people laugh and weep[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., brings happiness or sadness to people.

verses.translation: and that He is the One Who makes people laugh and weep[1],

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا

english_rwwad.text: and that He is the One Who causes death and gives life,

verses.translation: and that He is the One Who causes death and gives life,

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and that He created the pairs, male and female,

verses.translation: and that He created the pairs, male and female,

verses.arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: from a drop of sperm when it is emitted,

verses.translation: from a drop of sperm when it is emitted,

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and it is upon Him to bring about the second creation.

verses.translation: and it is upon Him to bring about the second creation.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: And He is the One Who enriches and bestows wealth,

verses.translation: And He is the One Who enriches and bestows wealth,

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and that He is the Lord of Sirius[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a star worshiped by some pagans before Islam.

verses.translation: and that He is the Lord of Sirius[1].

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: And that He destroyed the earlier ‘Ād[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the people of Prophet Hūd.

verses.translation: And that He destroyed the earlier ‘Ād[1],

verses.arabic: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and Thamūd[1], sparing none,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the people of Prophet Sālih, who are called second Ād.

verses.translation: and Thamūd[1], sparing none,

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and [He destroyed] the people of Noah before them; they were indeed more wicked and more rebellious.

verses.translation: and [He destroyed] the people of Noah before them; they were indeed more wicked and more rebellious.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: And He toppled the cities[1] upside down,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of Sodom and Gomorrah whose dwellers defied Prophet Lot (عليه السلام).

verses.translation: And He toppled the cities[1] upside down,

verses.arabic: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and they were utterly covered [by stones][1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They were rained by stones.

verses.translation: and they were utterly covered [by stones][1].

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: This [Prophet] is a warner like the earlier warners.

verses.translation: This [Prophet] is a warner like the earlier warners.

verses.arabic: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ

english_rwwad.text: The imminent Hour has drawn near,

verses.translation: The imminent Hour has drawn near,

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: none but Allah can disclose it.

verses.translation: none but Allah can disclose it.

verses.arabic: أَفَمِنْ هَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do you find this discourse astonishing,

verses.translation: Do you find this discourse astonishing,

verses.arabic: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and you laugh [at it] and not weep,

verses.translation: and you laugh [at it] and not weep,

verses.arabic: وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: while heedlessly lost in amusement?

verses.translation: while heedlessly lost in amusement?

verses.arabic: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟

english_rwwad.text: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].

verses.translation: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ

english_rwwad.text: The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split asunder[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Quraysh pagans challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) to split the moon in two so that they believe in him. The moon was split as they requested and then re-joined, and the incident was reported by several eyewitnesses in different parts of the land; however, they still refused to believe, considering it magic.

verses.translation: The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split asunder[1].

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ

english_rwwad.text: Whenever they see a sign[1], they turn away and say, “Same old magic!”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The prophets were given signs or miracles as a proof that they were commissioned by Allah. Moses (عليه السلام) was given the miracles of staff and a bright hand. Jesus (عليه السلام) would give life to the dead and heal the blind and the leper. Muhammad (ﷺ) was given the Qur’an, a literary miracle, challenging the masters of Arabic eloquence. Nonetheless, he (ﷺ) performed other miracles such as splitting the moon, increasing food and water, and healing some ailments.

verses.translation: Whenever they see a sign[1], they turn away and say, “Same old magic!”

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

english_rwwad.text: They deny [the truth] and follow their desires, but every matter will reach its inevitable end.

verses.translation: They deny [the truth] and follow their desires, but every matter will reach its inevitable end.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

english_rwwad.text: There have already come to them stories [of destroyed nations] that are sufficient to deter them,

verses.translation: There have already come to them stories [of destroyed nations] that are sufficient to deter them,

verses.arabic: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ

english_rwwad.text: which contain extensive wisdom, but the warnings are of no avail.

verses.translation: which contain extensive wisdom, but the warnings are of no avail.

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ

english_rwwad.text: So turn away from them [O Prophet]. On the Day when the caller[1] will summon them to a horrific event[2],
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Isrāfīl, the angel assigned to blow the Trumpet and call all for resurrection.
 [2] i.e., Judgment Day.

verses.translation: So turn away from them [O Prophet]. On the Day when the caller[1] will summon them to a horrific event[2],

verses.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ

english_rwwad.text: with eyes downcast, they will come out of the graves like scattered locusts,

verses.translation: with eyes downcast, they will come out of the graves like scattered locusts,

verses.arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ

english_rwwad.text: rushing headlong towards the caller. The disbelievers will say, “This is a hard Day!”

verses.translation: rushing headlong towards the caller. The disbelievers will say, “This is a hard Day!”

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ

english_rwwad.text: The people of Noah rejected [the truth] before them; they rejected Our slave and said, “He is a madman,” and he was intimidated.

verses.translation: The people of Noah rejected [the truth] before them; they rejected Our slave and said, “He is a madman,” and he was intimidated.

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ

english_rwwad.text: So he called upon his Lord, “I am overpowered, so help me!”

verses.translation: So he called upon his Lord, “I am overpowered, so help me!”

verses.arabic: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring down in torrents,

verses.translation: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring down in torrents,

verses.arabic: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ

english_rwwad.text: and We caused the earth to burst forth with springs, then the waters met for a preordained purpose.

verses.translation: and We caused the earth to burst forth with springs, then the waters met for a preordained purpose.

verses.arabic: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ

english_rwwad.text: We carried him on an [Ark made] of planks and nails,

verses.translation: We carried him on an [Ark made] of planks and nails,

verses.arabic: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

english_rwwad.text: sailing under Our [Watchful] Eyes; as a reward for the one [they] denied.

verses.translation: sailing under Our [Watchful] Eyes; as a reward for the one [they] denied.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: We have certainly left it[1] as a sign; is there anyone to take heed?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the punishment, the Flood, or the Ark.

verses.translation: We have certainly left it[1] as a sign; is there anyone to take heed?

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

english_rwwad.text: Then how were My punishment and My warnings[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As a warning to those who came after them.

verses.translation: Then how were My punishment and My warnings[1]?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

verses.translation: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

english_rwwad.text: ‘Ād disbelieved. Then how were My punishment and My warnings?

verses.translation: ‘Ād disbelieved. Then how were My punishment and My warnings?

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ

english_rwwad.text: We sent against them a furious wind[1] on a day of continuous misfortune,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a tumultuous and screaming wind.

verses.translation: We sent against them a furious wind[1] on a day of continuous misfortune,

verses.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: sweeping people away[1], as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., extracting them from the earth.

verses.translation: sweeping people away[1], as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

english_rwwad.text: Then how were My punishment and My warnings?

verses.translation: Then how were My punishment and My warnings?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

verses.translation: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

english_rwwad.text: Thamūd rejected the warnings,

verses.translation: Thamūd rejected the warnings,

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “Shall we follow a single human being[1] from among us? Then we would surely be in error and insanity!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Prophet Sālih (عليه السلام).

verses.translation: They said, “Shall we follow a single human being[1] from among us? Then we would surely be in error and insanity!

verses.arabic: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Has the revelation been sent down upon him out of all of us? Rather, he is an insolent liar.”

verses.translation: Has the revelation been sent down upon him out of all of us? Rather, he is an insolent liar.”

verses.arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ

english_rwwad.text: Tomorrow they will know who the insolent liar is.

verses.translation: Tomorrow they will know who the insolent liar is.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ

english_rwwad.text: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them, so watch them [O Sālih] and be patient,

verses.translation: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them, so watch them [O Sālih] and be patient,

verses.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ

english_rwwad.text: and tell them that the water is to be shared between them[1]; each should take its drink in turn.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., one day for the tribe of Thamūd and one day for the she-camel.

verses.translation: and tell them that the water is to be shared between them[1]; each should take its drink in turn.

verses.arabic: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

english_rwwad.text: But they called their companion[1], and he undertook the task[2] and hamstrung her.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the worst among them.
 [2] Or took his sword.

verses.translation: But they called their companion[1], and he undertook the task[2] and hamstrung her.

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

english_rwwad.text: Then how [terrible] My punishment and My warnings were!

verses.translation: Then how [terrible] My punishment and My warnings were!

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ

english_rwwad.text: We sent against them a single blast, leaving them like trampled hedge-building twigs[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The people of Thamūd were crushed like trampled and trodden twigs and pieces of bush lying around an enclosure for cattle.

verses.translation: We sent against them a single blast, leaving them like trampled hedge-building twigs[1].

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

verses.translation: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

english_rwwad.text: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.

verses.translation: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ

english_rwwad.text: We sent against them a storm of pebbles, except the family of Lot whom We saved before dawn,

verses.translation: We sent against them a storm of pebbles, except the family of Lot whom We saved before dawn,

verses.arabic: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ

english_rwwad.text: as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.

verses.translation: as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

english_rwwad.text: He had already warned them of Our punishing assault, but they doubted the warnings.

verses.translation: He had already warned them of Our punishing assault, but they doubted the warnings.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

english_rwwad.text: They even demanded that he let them have their way with his angel-guests[1], so We blinded their eyes, [saying], “Taste My punishment and My warnings!”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Whom Allah sent in the form of handsome young men.

verses.translation: They even demanded that he let them have their way with his angel-guests[1], so We blinded their eyes, [saying], “Taste My punishment and My warnings!”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

english_rwwad.text: By the early morning a lasting torment overtook them.

verses.translation: By the early morning a lasting torment overtook them.

verses.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

english_rwwad.text: Taste My punishment and My warnings!

verses.translation: Taste My punishment and My warnings!

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

verses.translation: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, warnings came to the people of Pharaoh.

verses.translation: Indeed, warnings came to the people of Pharaoh.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: But they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the grip of the All-Mighty, Most Powerful.

verses.translation: But they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the grip of the All-Mighty, Most Powerful.

verses.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

english_rwwad.text: Are your disbelievers [O Makkans] superior to those[1] or have you been granted immunity in divine Scriptures?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those destroyed peoples.

verses.translation: Are your disbelievers [O Makkans] superior to those[1] or have you been granted immunity in divine Scriptures?

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they say, “We are a united front, bound to prevail.”?

verses.translation: Or do they say, “We are a united front, bound to prevail.”?

verses.arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

english_rwwad.text: Soon their united front will be defeated, and they will flee[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This foretold event was fulfilled in the Battle of Badr.

verses.translation: Soon their united front will be defeated, and they will flee[1].

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

english_rwwad.text: But the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more catastrophic and more bitter.

verses.translation: But the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more catastrophic and more bitter.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the wicked are in error and blazes[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., will burn in the Hellfire.

verses.translation: Indeed, the wicked are in error and blazes[1].

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, [they will be told], “Taste the agony of Hell[1]!”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] "Saqar" is one of the names of Hell.

verses.translation: On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, [they will be told], “Taste the agony of Hell[1]!”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ

english_rwwad.text: We have surely created everything in a determined measure[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or perfectly preordained.

verses.translation: We have surely created everything in a determined measure[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ

english_rwwad.text: Our command is but a single word[1], which is fulfilled in the blink of an eye.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Our command when We want something, We only say, "Be," and it is.

verses.translation: Our command is but a single word[1], which is fulfilled in the blink of an eye.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: We have destroyed many like you [O Makkans][1]; is there anyone to take heed?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In rejecting Allah's messengers.

verses.translation: We have destroyed many like you [O Makkans][1]; is there anyone to take heed?

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

english_rwwad.text: Everything they did is in the written records,

verses.translation: Everything they did is in the written records,

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

english_rwwad.text: and everything, small or big, is written down.

verses.translation: and everything, small or big, is written down.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and rivers[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Rivers of water, honey, milk, and wine. See 47:15.

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and rivers[1],

verses.arabic: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: seated in honor in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.

verses.translation: seated in honor in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ

english_rwwad.text: The Most Compassionate,

verses.translation: The Most Compassionate,

verses.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ

english_rwwad.text: has taught the Qur’an,

verses.translation: has taught the Qur’an,

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ

english_rwwad.text: He created man,

verses.translation: He created man,

verses.arabic: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ

english_rwwad.text: and taught him speech.

verses.translation: and taught him speech.

verses.arabic: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ

english_rwwad.text: The sun and the moon follow their precise courses,

verses.translation: The sun and the moon follow their precise courses,

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ

english_rwwad.text: and the stars[1] and trees prostrate [to Allah][2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] "Najm" is also a vegetation without a trunk, stalk, or stem.
 [2] i.e., they obediently submit to the laws of Allah. See 22:18.

verses.translation: and the stars[1] and trees prostrate [to Allah][2].

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ

english_rwwad.text: He raised the sky and enjoined justice

verses.translation: He raised the sky and enjoined justice

verses.arabic: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ

english_rwwad.text: so that you may not transgress the limits of justice.

verses.translation: so that you may not transgress the limits of justice.

verses.arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ

english_rwwad.text: Therefore establish weights in justice, and do not give short measure.

verses.translation: Therefore establish weights in justice, and do not give short measure.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ

english_rwwad.text: He has spread out the earth for all creatures,

verses.translation: He has spread out the earth for all creatures,

verses.arabic: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ

english_rwwad.text: in which there are fruits and palm trees with date stalks,

verses.translation: in which there are fruits and palm trees with date stalks,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ

english_rwwad.text: and grain having chaff, and fragrant plants.

verses.translation: and grain having chaff, and fragrant plants.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you[1] deny?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., men and jinn.

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you[1] deny?

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: He created man from dry clay like pottery,

verses.translation: He created man from dry clay like pottery,

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ

english_rwwad.text: and He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

verses.translation: and He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ

english_rwwad.text: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the points of sunrise in the east and sunset in the west in both summer and winter.

verses.translation: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets[1].

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ

english_rwwad.text: He merges the two seas meeting together[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Two bodies of water or two sea waters of fresh and salty water.

verses.translation: He merges the two seas meeting together[1],

verses.arabic: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ

english_rwwad.text: yet between them is a barrier so that they do not cross[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 25:53.

verses.translation: yet between them is a barrier so that they do not cross[1].

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ

english_rwwad.text: Out of both of them emerge pearls and coral.

verses.translation: Out of both of them emerge pearls and coral.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ

english_rwwad.text: To Him belong the sailing ships raised up in the sea like mountains.

verses.translation: To Him belong the sailing ships raised up in the sea like mountains.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ

english_rwwad.text: Everyone on earth will perish,

verses.translation: Everyone on earth will perish,

verses.arabic: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

english_rwwad.text: but there will remain the Face of your Lord[1], full of Majesty and Honor.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., your Lord Himself.

verses.translation: but there will remain the Face of your Lord[1], full of Majesty and Honor.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ

english_rwwad.text: All those in the heavens and earth ask of Him; every day He is engaged in some matters[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Such as giving life and causing death, enriching some and impoverishing others, elevating some and debasing others, etc.

verses.translation: All those in the heavens and earth ask of Him; every day He is engaged in some matters[1].

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ

english_rwwad.text: We will attend to you, O two multitudes [of men and jinn].

verses.translation: We will attend to you, O two multitudes [of men and jinn].

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍ

english_rwwad.text: O assembly of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the realms of the heavens and earth, then pass; you cannot pass without [Our] authority.

verses.translation: O assembly of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the realms of the heavens and earth, then pass; you cannot pass without [Our] authority.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ

english_rwwad.text: There will be sent against you a flame of fire and smoke[1], and you will not be able to defend yourselves.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It could also mean liquefied brass or copper.

verses.translation: There will be sent against you a flame of fire and smoke[1], and you will not be able to defend yourselves.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ

english_rwwad.text: When the heaven is split asunder and becomes crimson like [burnt] oil[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or like tanned skin or molten brass.

verses.translation: When the heaven is split asunder and becomes crimson like [burnt] oil[1].

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day no human or jinn will be asked about his sin[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For Allah knows their sins; they will only be interrogated as a form of punishment.

verses.translation: On that Day no human or jinn will be asked about his sin[1].

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ

english_rwwad.text: The wicked will be known by their marks and will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

verses.translation: The wicked will be known by their marks and will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be told] “This is the Hell that the wicked used to deny.”

verses.translation: [They will be told] “This is the Hell that the wicked used to deny.”

verses.arabic: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍ

english_rwwad.text: They will go round between it and scalding water.

verses.translation: They will go round between it and scalding water.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Warning of the punishment in Hell is listed here as a favor as a reminder that the believers should be cautious of it and be saved of it on the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny[1]?

verses.arabic: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ

english_rwwad.text: For those who fear of standing before their Lord[1] will be two Gardens.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] On the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: For those who fear of standing before their Lord[1] will be two Gardens.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍ

english_rwwad.text: Shaded by spreading branches.

verses.translation: Shaded by spreading branches.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ

english_rwwad.text: In each there are two flowing springs.

verses.translation: In each there are two flowing springs.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ زَوْجَانِ

english_rwwad.text: In each there are two kinds of every fruit.

verses.translation: In each there are two kinds of every fruit.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ

english_rwwad.text: They will recline on couches lined with rich brocade, with the fruits of both gardens within reach.

verses.translation: They will recline on couches lined with rich brocade, with the fruits of both gardens within reach.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

english_rwwad.text: In them there will be maidens of restrained gaze[1], untouched[2] before them by any man or jinn.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] To their own mates, being chaste and modest.
 [2] Lit., the maidens have not been caused to bleed by loss of virginity.

verses.translation: In them there will be maidens of restrained gaze[1], untouched[2] before them by any man or jinn.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ

english_rwwad.text: As if they were rubies and pearls[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In purity and beauty.

verses.translation: As if they were rubies and pearls[1].

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ

english_rwwad.text: Is the reward for goodness anything but goodness?

verses.translation: Is the reward for goodness anything but goodness?

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ

english_rwwad.text: And besides these two there will be two other gardens.

verses.translation: And besides these two there will be two other gardens.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Both of the deepest green.

verses.translation: Both of the deepest green.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ

english_rwwad.text: In each there are two gushing springs.

verses.translation: In each there are two gushing springs.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٌ وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ

english_rwwad.text: In each there are fruits, palm trees, and pomegranates.

verses.translation: In each there are fruits, palm trees, and pomegranates.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌ

english_rwwad.text: In them there are beautiful noble women.

verses.translation: In them there are beautiful noble women.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: حُورٌ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ

english_rwwad.text: Maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions.

verses.translation: Maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

english_rwwad.text: No human or jinn has ever touched them before.

verses.translation: No human or jinn has ever touched them before.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
