verses.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be] reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.

verses.translation: [They will be] reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

english_rwwad.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

verses.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

english_rwwad.text: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, the Lord of Majesty and Honor.

verses.translation: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, the Lord of Majesty and Honor.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ

english_rwwad.text: When the Inevitable Event comes to pass,

verses.translation: When the Inevitable Event comes to pass,

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: there will be none to deny its occurrence;

verses.translation: there will be none to deny its occurrence;

verses.arabic: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: it will bring some low and raise others up[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] According to their deeds rather than wealth and social position, as is the case in this world. The righteous will be elevated in Paradise and the wicked will be debased in Hell.

verses.translation: it will bring some low and raise others up[1].

verses.arabic: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا

english_rwwad.text: When the earth is shaken violently,

verses.translation: When the earth is shaken violently,

verses.arabic: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا

english_rwwad.text: and the mountains crushed to pieces,

verses.translation: and the mountains crushed to pieces,

verses.arabic: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا

english_rwwad.text: and turn to scattered dust,

verses.translation: and turn to scattered dust,

verses.arabic: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَٰثَةً

english_rwwad.text: then you are sorted into three groups:

verses.translation: then you are sorted into three groups:

verses.arabic: فَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ

english_rwwad.text: the people of the right – how blessed will be the people of the right[1]!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those who receive their record of deeds in the right hand and are destined for Paradise.

verses.translation: the people of the right – how blessed will be the people of the right[1]!

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

english_rwwad.text: The people of the left – how miserable will be the people of the left[1]!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those who receive their record of deeds in the left hand and are destined for Hell.

verses.translation: The people of the left – how miserable will be the people of the left[1]!

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And the forerunners [in faith] are the forerunners [in Paradise].

verses.translation: And the forerunners [in faith] are the forerunners [in Paradise].

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They are the nearest ones [to Allah],

verses.translation: They are the nearest ones [to Allah],

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: in Gardens of Bliss,

verses.translation: in Gardens of Bliss,

verses.arabic: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: many from the early generations,

verses.translation: many from the early generations,

verses.arabic: وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and a few from the later generations.

verses.translation: and a few from the later generations.

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّوْضُونَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be seated] on jeweled couches,

verses.translation: [They will be seated] on jeweled couches,

verses.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: reclining on them, facing one another.

verses.translation: reclining on them, facing one another.

verses.arabic: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will be served by immortal youths

verses.translation: They will be served by immortal youths

verses.arabic: بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: with cups, pitchers, and glasses [of wine] from a flowing spring,

verses.translation: with cups, pitchers, and glasses [of wine] from a flowing spring,

verses.arabic: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: which will neither cause any headache nor intoxication,

verses.translation: which will neither cause any headache nor intoxication,

verses.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٍ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: along with fruits of their choice,

verses.translation: along with fruits of their choice,

verses.arabic: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and flesh of birds that they may desire.

verses.translation: and flesh of birds that they may desire.

verses.arabic: وَحُورٌ عِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: And [they will have] maidens with wide gorgeous eyes,

verses.translation: And [they will have] maidens with wide gorgeous eyes,

verses.arabic: كَأَمْثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ

english_rwwad.text: like pristine pearls,

verses.translation: like pristine pearls,

verses.arabic: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: as a reward for what they used to do.

verses.translation: as a reward for what they used to do.

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: They will not hear therein any idle talk or sinful speech,

verses.translation: They will not hear therein any idle talk or sinful speech,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَٰمًا سَلَٰمًا

english_rwwad.text: except the words of peace, peace[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., only exchanging greetings of peace.

verses.translation: except the words of peace, peace[1].

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ

english_rwwad.text: The people of the right – how blessed will be the people of the right!

verses.translation: The people of the right – how blessed will be the people of the right!

verses.arabic: فِى سِدْرٍ مَّخْضُودٍ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be] in the midst of thornless lote trees,

verses.translation: [They will be] in the midst of thornless lote trees,

verses.arabic: وَطَلْحٍ مَّنضُودٍ

english_rwwad.text: and clusters of bananas,

verses.translation: and clusters of bananas,

verses.arabic: وَظِلٍّ مَّمْدُودٍ

english_rwwad.text: and extended shade,

verses.translation: and extended shade,

verses.arabic: وَمَآءٍ مَّسْكُوبٍ

english_rwwad.text: and flowing water,

verses.translation: and flowing water,

verses.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: and abundant fruit –

verses.translation: and abundant fruit –

verses.arabic: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: neither ceasing nor restricted –

verses.translation: neither ceasing nor restricted –

verses.arabic: وَفُرُشٍ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: and elevated mattresses [on beds].

verses.translation: and elevated mattresses [on beds].

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءً

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We have perfectly created them [i.e., their spouses],

verses.translation: Indeed, We have perfectly created them [i.e., their spouses],

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا

english_rwwad.text: and have made them virgins,

verses.translation: and have made them virgins,

verses.arabic: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا

english_rwwad.text: loving and of equal age,

verses.translation: loving and of equal age,

verses.arabic: لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

english_rwwad.text: for the people of the right,

verses.translation: for the people of the right,

verses.arabic: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: many from the earlier generations,

verses.translation: many from the earlier generations,

verses.arabic: وَثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and many from the later generations.

verses.translation: and many from the later generations.

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ

english_rwwad.text: And the people of the left – how wretched will be the people of the left!

verses.translation: And the people of the left – how wretched will be the people of the left!

verses.arabic: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be] in scorching wind and scalding water,

verses.translation: [They will be] in scorching wind and scalding water,

verses.arabic: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ

english_rwwad.text: in the shade of black smoke,

verses.translation: in the shade of black smoke,

verses.arabic: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: neither cool nor refreshing.

verses.translation: neither cool nor refreshing.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, they used to be in luxuries before,

verses.translation: Indeed, they used to be in luxuries before,

verses.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: and persisted in the gravest sin[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Shirk (associating partners with Allah) or disbelief.

verses.translation: and persisted in the gravest sin[1].

verses.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, will we really be raised again?

verses.translation: They used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, will we really be raised again?

verses.arabic: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: And our forefathers as well?”

verses.translation: And our forefathers as well?”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Say, [O Prophet], “Indeed, the former and later generations

verses.translation: Say, [O Prophet], “Indeed, the former and later generations

verses.arabic: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

english_rwwad.text: will be gathered on a predetermined Day.

verses.translation: will be gathered on a predetermined Day.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then you, O misguided deniers,

verses.translation: Then you, O misguided deniers,

verses.arabic: لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍ مِّن زَقُّومٍ

english_rwwad.text: will surely eat from the tree of zaqqūm[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 37:62.

verses.translation: will surely eat from the tree of zaqqūm[1],

verses.arabic: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ

english_rwwad.text: filling your bellies with it,

verses.translation: filling your bellies with it,

verses.arabic: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: and drinking scalding water on top of it,

verses.translation: and drinking scalding water on top of it,

verses.arabic: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: drinking like thirsty camels do.”

verses.translation: drinking like thirsty camels do.”

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.

verses.arabic: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: It is We Who created you; why do you not then believe [in resurrection]?

verses.translation: It is We Who created you; why do you not then believe [in resurrection]?

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Have you thought about the semen that you emit?

verses.translation: Have you thought about the semen that you emit?

verses.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Is it you who create it, or is it We Who are the Creators?

verses.translation: Is it you who create it, or is it We Who are the Creators?

verses.arabic: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We have ordained death among you, and nothing can overcome us

verses.translation: We have ordained death among you, and nothing can overcome us

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: from transforming you and recreating you in forms that you do not know[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or "from replacing you by others like yourselves [in this life] and creating you [in the Hereafter] in that which you do not know."

verses.translation: from transforming you and recreating you in forms that you do not know[1].

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: You are well aware of the first creation; why do you not then take heed?

verses.translation: You are well aware of the first creation; why do you not then take heed?

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Have you thought about what you sow?

verses.translation: Have you thought about what you sow?

verses.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Is it you who cause it to grow, or is it We Who make it grow?

verses.translation: Is it you who cause it to grow, or is it We Who make it grow?

verses.arabic: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If We willed, We could reduce your harvest to rubble, leaving you to wonder and lament,

verses.translation: If We willed, We could reduce your harvest to rubble, leaving you to wonder and lament,

verses.arabic: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: “We suffered loss,

verses.translation: “We suffered loss,

verses.arabic: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

english_rwwad.text: rather, we are deprived.”

verses.translation: rather, we are deprived.”

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Have you thought about the water that you drink?

verses.translation: Have you thought about the water that you drink?

verses.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Is it you who bring it down from the clouds, or is it We Who bring it down?

verses.translation: Is it you who bring it down from the clouds, or is it We Who bring it down?

verses.arabic: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If We willed, We could make it salty; will you not then give thanks?

verses.translation: If We willed, We could make it salty; will you not then give thanks?

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى تُورُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Have you thought about the fire that you kindle?

verses.translation: Have you thought about the fire that you kindle?

verses.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ

english_rwwad.text: Is it you who produced its trees[1], or is it We Who produced it?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Referring to Arabian trees, markh and ‘afār, which produce fire when their green branches are rubbed against each other.

verses.translation: Is it you who produced its trees[1], or is it We Who produced it?

verses.arabic: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَٰهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَمَتَٰعًا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ

english_rwwad.text: We made it a reminder [of the Hellfire] and a benefit for the travelers[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By which they ignite fire. Travelers are mentioned in particular because it is of special convenience to them, although it is of use for all people in general.

verses.translation: We made it a reminder [of the Hellfire] and a benefit for the travelers[1].

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

verses.translation: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

verses.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ

english_rwwad.text: I do swear[1] by the positions of the stars –
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The negative article "la" (nay) means: The truth is not what is said or thought by disbelievers or others. The oath refutes certain objections of the disbelievers with regard to the Qur’an.

verses.translation: I do swear[1] by the positions of the stars –

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٌ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: and this is indeed a great oath, if only you knew –

verses.translation: and this is indeed a great oath, if only you knew –

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرْءَانٌ كَرِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: that this is indeed a noble Qur’an,

verses.translation: that this is indeed a noble Qur’an,

verses.arabic: فِى كِتَٰبٍ مَّكْنُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: in a well-preserved Record[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Preserved Tablet.

verses.translation: in a well-preserved Record[1],

verses.arabic: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: that none can touch except the purified ones[1] –
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., angels. It refutes the claim of the pagans that the Qur’an was sent down by devils. (See 26:210-212). Based on this verse, many Muslim jurists held that one should perform ablution prior to reading the Qur’an.

verses.translation: that none can touch except the purified ones[1] –

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do you take this discourse lightly,

verses.translation: Do you take this discourse lightly,

verses.arabic: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and instead [of thanking Allah] for the provision you are given, you show ingratitude?

verses.translation: and instead [of thanking Allah] for the provision you are given, you show ingratitude?

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ

english_rwwad.text: Then why [are you helpless] when the soul reaches the throat,

verses.translation: Then why [are you helpless] when the soul reaches the throat,

verses.arabic: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: while you are looking on,

verses.translation: while you are looking on,

verses.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: when We are closer[1] to him than you, but you do not see?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] We are closer to him in terms of Knowledge and Power; Our angels are closer in person.

verses.translation: when We are closer[1] to him than you, but you do not see?

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ

english_rwwad.text: If you are not subject to retribution, then why do you not

verses.translation: If you are not subject to retribution, then why do you not

verses.arabic: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: bring that [soul] back, if you are truthful?

verses.translation: bring that [soul] back, if you are truthful?

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: If that dying person is one of those who will be brought near to Allah,

verses.translation: If that dying person is one of those who will be brought near to Allah,

verses.arabic: فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: then [he will have] comfort, fragrance[1], and a Garden of Bliss.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] lit., fragrant basil. Paradise is described in the Qur’an as being pleasant to the eye, the heart, and the ear. Here it also emphasizes the scent.

verses.translation: then [he will have] comfort, fragrance[1], and a Garden of Bliss.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

english_rwwad.text: If he is one of the people of the right,

verses.translation: If he is one of the people of the right,

verses.arabic: فَسَلَٰمٌ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

english_rwwad.text: [He will be told], “Peace be to you, for being one of the people of the right.”

verses.translation: [He will be told], “Peace be to you, for being one of the people of the right.”

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

english_rwwad.text: But if he is one of the misguided deniers,

verses.translation: But if he is one of the misguided deniers,

verses.arabic: فَنُزُلٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: then he will be welcomed with scalding water,

verses.translation: then he will be welcomed with scalding water,

verses.arabic: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: and he will burn in Blazing Fire.

verses.translation: and he will burn in Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ

english_rwwad.text: This is indeed the absolute truth.

verses.translation: This is indeed the absolute truth.

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

verses.translation: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: All that is in the heavens and earth glorifies[1] Allah, for He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By praising and exalting Him far above any deficiency or imperfection.

verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and earth glorifies[1] Allah, for He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.arabic: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth; He gives life and causes death, and He is Most Capable of all things.

verses.translation: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth; He gives life and causes death, and He is Most Capable of all things.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: He is the First[1] and the Last[2], the Manifest[3] and the Hidden[4], and He is All-Knowing of everything.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Before Whom nothing existed; the foremost; the uppermost.
 [2] Eternal after Whom nothing remains.
 [3] High, nothing is above Him.
 [4] Nothing is nearer than Him by way of His knowledge; concealed from our physical senses.

verses.translation: He is the First[1] and the Last[2], the Manifest[3] and the Hidden[4], and He is All-Knowing of everything.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who created the heavens and earth in six days, and then rose over the Throne. He knows all that goes into the earth and all that comes out of it, and all that descends from the heaven and all that ascends to it. He is with you[1] wherever you are, and Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By His Knowledge - observing and witnessing all.

verses.translation: It is He Who created the heavens and earth in six days, and then rose over the Throne. He knows all that goes into the earth and all that comes out of it, and all that descends from the heaven and all that ascends to it. He is with you[1] wherever you are, and Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.

verses.arabic: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ

english_rwwad.text: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and to Allah will return all matters.

verses.translation: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and to Allah will return all matters.

verses.arabic: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

english_rwwad.text: He causes the night to merge into the day and the day to merge into the night, and He is All-Knowing of what is in the hearts.

verses.translation: He causes the night to merge into the day and the day to merge into the night, and He is All-Knowing of what is in the hearts.

verses.arabic: ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend [in Allah’s cause] out of what He has entrusted you with. For those among you who believe and spend[1], there will be a great reward.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In the way of Allah.

verses.translation: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend [in Allah’s cause] out of what He has entrusted you with. For those among you who believe and spend[1], there will be a great reward.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Why is it that you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger is calling you to believe in your Lord, and He has already taken a covenant from you[1], if you will ever believe?

verses.translation: Why is it that you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger is calling you to believe in your Lord, and He has already taken a covenant from you[1], if you will ever believe?

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who sends down clear verses to His slave to bring you out of the depths of darkness into the light. Indeed, Allah is Ever Gracious and Most Merciful to you.

verses.translation: It is He Who sends down clear verses to His slave to bring you out of the depths of darkness into the light. Indeed, Allah is Ever Gracious and Most Merciful to you.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَٰتَلَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَٰتَلُوا۟ وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Why is it that you do not spend in the cause of Allah, when Allah alone will inherit the heavens and earth? Those of you who spent and fought before the conquest [of Makkah and those who did not] are not equal. They are much greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterward[1]. Yet Allah has promised each a fine reward, and Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Muslims were perceived as weak before the conquest of Makkah. Therefore, those believers who donated and fought in times of weakness and hardship deserve more rewards than those who did so when Muslims were victors and had an upper hand against the enemies.

verses.translation: Why is it that you do not spend in the cause of Allah, when Allah alone will inherit the heavens and earth? Those of you who spent and fought before the conquest [of Makkah and those who did not] are not equal. They are much greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterward[1]. Yet Allah has promised each a fine reward, and Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

verses.arabic: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Who is there to lend Allah a goodly loan, so He will multiply it for him, and for him there will be a generous reward[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Paradise.

verses.translation: Who is there to lend Allah a goodly loan, so He will multiply it for him, and for him there will be a generous reward[1]?

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: [Remember] the Day when you will see the believing men and women, with their light streaming ahead of them and on their right. [They will be told], “Glad tidings for you Today: gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever.” That is the supreme triumph.

verses.translation: [Remember] the Day when you will see the believing men and women, with their light streaming ahead of them and on their right. [They will be told], “Glad tidings for you Today: gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever.” That is the supreme triumph.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day the hypocrite men and women will say to those who believe, “Wait for us, so that we may have some of your light.” It will be said, “Go back and seek light elsewhere[1].” Then a wall will be placed between them, which will have a gate[2], on the inside of which there will be mercy and on the outside there will be punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the worldly life from where the light was acquired.
 [2] This wall is said to be the barrier between Paradise and Hell, which is called Al-A‘rāf (the heights). See 7:46-49.

verses.translation: On that Day the hypocrite men and women will say to those who believe, “Wait for us, so that we may have some of your light.” It will be said, “Go back and seek light elsewhere[1].” Then a wall will be placed between them, which will have a gate[2], on the inside of which there will be mercy and on the outside there will be punishment.

verses.arabic: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ

english_rwwad.text: The hypocrites will call out to the believers, “Were we not with you?” They will say, “Yes, but you allowed yourselves[1] to succumb to temptations, you awaited [some misfortune to befall us], you doubted, and you were deceived by false hopes, until Allah’s decree came to pass. Thus the deceiver [i.e., Satan] deceived you concerning Allah.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By hypocrisy.

verses.translation: The hypocrites will call out to the believers, “Were we not with you?” They will say, “Yes, but you allowed yourselves[1] to succumb to temptations, you awaited [some misfortune to befall us], you doubted, and you were deceived by false hopes, until Allah’s decree came to pass. Thus the deceiver [i.e., Satan] deceived you concerning Allah.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

english_rwwad.text: So this Day no ransom will be accepted from you or from the disbelievers. Your abode is the Fire; it is a fitting place for you – what a wretched destination!”

verses.translation: So this Day no ransom will be accepted from you or from the disbelievers. Your abode is the Fire; it is a fitting place for you – what a wretched destination!”

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Has the time not yet come for those who believe that their hearts should be humbled at the remembrance of Allah and the truth that has been revealed? And that they should not be like those who were given the Scripture before, whose hearts grew hard after the passage of a long time, and many of them were evildoers.

verses.translation: Has the time not yet come for those who believe that their hearts should be humbled at the remembrance of Allah and the truth that has been revealed? And that they should not be like those who were given the Scripture before, whose hearts grew hard after the passage of a long time, and many of them were evildoers.

verses.arabic: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Know that Allah revives the earth after its death[1]. We have made the signs clear to you so that you may understand.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Similarly, it is easy for Allah to soften the hearts and guide after misguidance.

verses.translation: Know that Allah revives the earth after its death[1]. We have made the signs clear to you so that you may understand.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, those men and women who give in charity and lend to Allah a goodly loan, it will be multiplied for them, and for them there will be a generous reward[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Paradise.

verses.translation: Indeed, those men and women who give in charity and lend to Allah a goodly loan, it will be multiplied for them, and for them there will be a generous reward[1].

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: Those who believe in Allah and His messengers, it is they who are the people of the truth. And the martyrs will have their reward and their light with their Lord. As for those who disbelieve and reject Our verses, they are the people of the Blazing Fire.

verses.translation: Those who believe in Allah and His messengers, it is they who are the people of the truth. And the martyrs will have their reward and their light with their Lord. As for those who disbelieve and reject Our verses, they are the people of the Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَٰمًا وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ

english_rwwad.text: Know that the life of this world is no more than play, amusement, adornment, boasting among yourselves, and competition in wealth and children. It is like plants that flourish after rain, pleasing the sowers, then they wither and you see them turning yellow, and then they crumble. And in the Hereafter there will be severe punishment, or forgiveness from Allah and His pleasure. For the life of this world is no more than a fleeting enjoyment.

verses.translation: Know that the life of this world is no more than play, amusement, adornment, boasting among yourselves, and competition in wealth and children. It is like plants that flourish after rain, pleasing the sowers, then they wither and you see them turning yellow, and then they crumble. And in the Hereafter there will be severe punishment, or forgiveness from Allah and His pleasure. For the life of this world is no more than a fleeting enjoyment.

verses.arabic: سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: Race one another towards forgiveness from your Lord and Paradise the width of which is like the width of the heaven and earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, for Allah is the Lord of great bounty.

verses.translation: Race one another towards forgiveness from your Lord and Paradise the width of which is like the width of the heaven and earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, for Allah is the Lord of great bounty.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: No calamity befalls the earth or yourselves but it is already written in a Record[1] before We bring it into existence. That is indeed easy for Allah –
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Preserved Tablet.

verses.translation: No calamity befalls the earth or yourselves but it is already written in a Record[1] before We bring it into existence. That is indeed easy for Allah –

verses.arabic: لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ

english_rwwad.text: so that you may not grieve over what you have missed, nor exult over what He has given you, for Allah does not love anyone who is conceited and boastful –

verses.translation: so that you may not grieve over what you have missed, nor exult over what He has given you, for Allah does not love anyone who is conceited and boastful –

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبُخْلِ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

english_rwwad.text: those who are stingy and promote stinginess among people. And those who turn away[1], then Allah is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Refuse to spend in the way of Allah or refuse obedience to Him.

verses.translation: those who are stingy and promote stinginess among people. And those who turn away[1], then Allah is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

english_rwwad.text: We have sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and sent down with them the Scripture and the criteria of justice, so that the people may uphold justice. And We sent down iron, in which there is great might and benefits for people, so that Allah may make known those who help His cause and His messengers without seeing Him. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.

verses.translation: We have sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and sent down with them the Scripture and the criteria of justice, so that the people may uphold justice. And We sent down iron, in which there is great might and benefits for people, so that Allah may make known those who help His cause and His messengers without seeing Him. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: We sent Noah and Abraham, and gave prophethood and Scripture to their offspring: some among them are guided, but most of them are evildoers.

verses.translation: We sent Noah and Abraham, and gave prophethood and Scripture to their offspring: some among them are guided, but most of them are evildoers.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ٱبْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَٰهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا فَـَٔاتَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We sent Our messengers in their footsteps, and We sent after them Jesus, son of Mary; We gave him the Gospel and instilled kindness and mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. As for monasticism, they invented it – We did not prescribe it for them – seeking thereby Allah’s pleasure, yet they did not observe it faithfully. So We gave those who believed among them their reward, but most of them are evildoers.

verses.translation: Then We sent Our messengers in their footsteps, and We sent after them Jesus, son of Mary; We gave him the Gospel and instilled kindness and mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. As for monasticism, they invented it – We did not prescribe it for them – seeking thereby Allah’s pleasure, yet they did not observe it faithfully. So We gave those who believed among them their reward, but most of them are evildoers.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will give you a double share of His mercy and will give you a light by which you walk, and forgive you, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.translation: O you who believe, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will give you a double share of His mercy and will give you a light by which you walk, and forgive you, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ مِّن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: [This is] so that the People of the Book may know that they have no power over anything of Allah’s bounty and that all bounty is in the Hand of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills, for Allah is the Lord of great bounty.

verses.translation: [This is] so that the People of the Book may know that they have no power over anything of Allah’s bounty and that all bounty is in the Hand of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills, for Allah is the Lord of great bounty.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, Allah has heard the words of the woman who was arguing with you [O Prophet] concerning her husband and was complaining to Allah. Allah has heard the discussion between the two of you, for Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Khawlah bint Tha‘labah and her husband Aws ibn As-Sāmit had a disagreement. She came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said that her husband made her unlawful to himself as the zahr (back) of his mother, which was a famous type of divorce in Arabia, called zihār. He (ﷺ) told her that he had not received any revelation in this regard. Finally, this Madinian surah was revealed, and abolished this ancient practice.

verses.translation: Indeed, Allah has heard the words of the woman who was arguing with you [O Prophet] concerning her husband and was complaining to Allah. Allah has heard the discussion between the two of you, for Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing[1].

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمْ إِنْ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱلَّٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ

english_rwwad.text: As for those among you who divorce their wives by likening them to their mothers[1], they are not their mothers; their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. They utter words that are abhorrent and false, but Allah is Most Pardoning, Most Forgiving.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By saying to one's wife, "You are to me like the back of my mother," meaning unlawful to approach, which was abolished by the revelation of these verses.

verses.translation: As for those among you who divorce their wives by likening them to their mothers[1], they are not their mothers; their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. They utter words that are abhorrent and false, but Allah is Most Pardoning, Most Forgiving.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا۟ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: But those who divorce their wives by likening them to their mothers then retract what they said, they must free a slave before they are intimate with each other. This is what you are admonished, and Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

verses.translation: But those who divorce their wives by likening them to their mothers then retract what they said, they must free a slave before they are intimate with each other. This is what you are admonished, and Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

verses.arabic: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: But whoever cannot afford this must fast for two consecutive months[1] before the couple have intimate relation with each other. But if he is unable to do that, he must feed sixty needy people. This is so that you may truly believe in Allah and His Messenger. These are the limits ordained by Allah, and for the disbelievers there will be a painful punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See footnote 4:92.

verses.translation: But whoever cannot afford this must fast for two consecutive months[1] before the couple have intimate relation with each other. But if he is unable to do that, he must feed sixty needy people. This is so that you may truly believe in Allah and His Messenger. These are the limits ordained by Allah, and for the disbelievers there will be a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُوا۟ كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger will be debased, just as those who came before them were debased, for We have surely sent down clear signs. And for the disbelievers there will be a humiliating punishment.

verses.translation: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger will be debased, just as those who came before them were debased, for We have surely sent down clear signs. And for the disbelievers there will be a humiliating punishment.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ أَحْصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all together and will inform them of what they did; Allah has kept their complete record, while they have forgotten it. For Allah is a Witness over all things.

verses.translation: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all together and will inform them of what they did; Allah has kept their complete record, while they have forgotten it. For Allah is a Witness over all things.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ ثَلَٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَآ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see that Allah knows all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth? No secret consultation takes place between three, but He is their fourth, or between five, but He is their sixth, or between fewer or more than that, but He is with them wherever they may be[1]. Then He will inform them of what they did on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing of everything.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He is with them by His knowledge.

verses.translation: Do you not see that Allah knows all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth? No secret consultation takes place between three, but He is their fourth, or between five, but He is their sixth, or between fewer or more than that, but He is with them wherever they may be[1]. Then He will inform them of what they did on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing of everything.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نُهُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَٰجَوْنَ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَإِذَا جَآءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا ٱللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

english_rwwad.text: Have you not seen those who were forbidden from holding secret talks, yet they go back to do what they were forbidden from, conspiring in sin and aggression, and in disobedience to the Messenger? When they come to you, they greet you[1] other than the way Allah greets you, and they say to one another, “Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?” Sufficient is Hell for them; they will enter it. What a terrible destination!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This is referring to the Jews who used to play with words while addressing the Prophet (ﷺ) to ridicule him, saying "Asāmu ‘alaikum" (death be upon you) instead of "Asalamu ‘alaikum" (peace be upon you).

verses.translation: Have you not seen those who were forbidden from holding secret talks, yet they go back to do what they were forbidden from, conspiring in sin and aggression, and in disobedience to the Messenger? When they come to you, they greet you[1] other than the way Allah greets you, and they say to one another, “Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?” Sufficient is Hell for them; they will enter it. What a terrible destination!

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَنَٰجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَٰجَوْا۟ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَتَنَٰجَوْا۟ بِٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, when you hold secret talk, do not do so in sin and aggression, and in disobedience to the Messenger, rather do so in righteousness and piety. And fear Allah, to Whom you will be gathered.

verses.translation: O you who believe, when you hold secret talk, do not do so in sin and aggression, and in disobedience to the Messenger, rather do so in righteousness and piety. And fear Allah, to Whom you will be gathered.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ لِيَحْزُنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيْسَ بِضَآرِّهِمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Secret talks are only prompted by Satan to grieve the believers, but he cannot harm them[1] in the least except with Allah’s permission. So let the believers put their trust in Allah.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Referring to the sinful type of secret talks, as mentioned in the previous verses, or two persons speaking in private in the presence of a third, leading him to assume that he is the subject of their talk.

verses.translation: Secret talks are only prompted by Satan to grieve the believers, but he cannot harm them[1] in the least except with Allah’s permission. So let the believers put their trust in Allah.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْمَجَٰلِسِ فَٱفْسَحُوا۟ يَفْسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُوا۟ فَٱنشُزُوا۟ يَرْفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ دَرَجَٰتٍ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, when you are told to make room in your gatherings, then make room; Allah will give you abundance[1]. And when you are told to rise, then rise; Allah will raise in ranks those who believed from among you and those who are given knowledge. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In this life or in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: O you who believe, when you are told to make room in your gatherings, then make room; Allah will give you abundance[1]. And when you are told to rise, then rise; Allah will raise in ranks those who believed from among you and those who are given knowledge. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نَٰجَيْتُمُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ نَجْوَىٰكُمْ صَدَقَةً ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, when you consult the Messenger in private, give something in charity before your consultation; that is better for you and more conducive to purity. But if you do not have the means, then Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.translation: O you who believe, when you consult the Messenger in private, give something in charity before your consultation; that is better for you and more conducive to purity. But if you do not have the means, then Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: ءَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَن تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ نَجْوَىٰكُمْ صَدَقَٰتٍ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَتَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Are you afraid of giving charities before your consultations with him? If you are unable to do so, and Allah has pardoned you, then establish prayer and give zakah, and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

verses.translation: Are you afraid of giving charities before your consultations with him? If you are unable to do so, and Allah has pardoned you, then establish prayer and give zakah, and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا۟ قَوْمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى ٱلْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see those [hypocrites] who take as allies people who have incurred Allah’s wrath? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear falsely while they know.

verses.translation: Do you not see those [hypocrites] who take as allies people who have incurred Allah’s wrath? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear falsely while they know.

verses.arabic: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. Evil is indeed what they do.

verses.translation: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. Evil is indeed what they do.

verses.arabic: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: They have taken their oaths as a shield, in order to hinder people from the way of Allah. For them there will be a humiliating punishment.

verses.translation: They have taken their oaths as a shield, in order to hinder people from the way of Allah. For them there will be a humiliating punishment.

verses.arabic: لَّن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Neither their wealth nor their children will avail them anything against Allah. They are the people of the Fire; they will abide therein forever.

verses.translation: Neither their wealth nor their children will avail them anything against Allah. They are the people of the Fire; they will abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُۥ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰذِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when Allah will raise them all, they will swear to Him as they swear to you, thinking that they have something to stand on[1]. Indeed, it is they who are the liars.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Thinking that their lies will be believed and that they will escape punishment.

verses.translation: On the Day when Allah will raise them all, they will swear to Him as they swear to you, thinking that they have something to stand on[1]. Indeed, it is they who are the liars.

verses.arabic: ٱسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ ذِكْرَ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Satan has taken hold of them and has thus caused them to forget the remembrance of Allah. They are the party of Satan. Indeed, the party of Satan will be the losers.

verses.translation: Satan has taken hold of them and has thus caused them to forget the remembrance of Allah. They are the party of Satan. Indeed, the party of Satan will be the losers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْأَذَلِّينَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, they are among the most debased.

verses.translation: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, they are among the most debased.

verses.arabic: كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا۠ وَرُسُلِىٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

english_rwwad.text: Allah has decreed, “I and My messengers will surely prevail.” Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.

verses.translation: Allah has decreed, “I and My messengers will surely prevail.” Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.

verses.arabic: لَّا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ يُوَآدُّونَ مَنْ حَآدَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَوْ كَانُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ أَوْ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ أَوْ إِخْوَٰنَهُمْ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْإِيمَٰنَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحٍ مِّنْهُ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ ٱللَّهِ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

english_rwwad.text: You will not find any people who believe in Allah and the Last Day taking as allies those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even if they were their parents, their children, their brothers, or their kindred. It is they in whose hearts Allah has instilled faith and strengthened them with a spirit[1] from Him. He will admit them to gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Allah. They are the party of Allah. Indeed, it is the party of Allah that will be successful.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Spirit here means His revelation, light, or His help.

verses.translation: You will not find any people who believe in Allah and the Last Day taking as allies those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even if they were their parents, their children, their brothers, or their kindred. It is they in whose hearts Allah has instilled faith and strengthened them with a spirit[1] from Him. He will admit them to gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Allah. They are the party of Allah. Indeed, it is the party of Allah that will be successful.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: All that is in the heavens and all that is on earth glorifies Allah, for He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and all that is on earth glorifies Allah, for He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ ٱلْحَشْرِ مَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُم مَّانِعَتُهُمْ حُصُونُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُوا۟ وَقَذَفَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعْبَ يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم بِأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَيْدِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَٱعْتَبِرُوا۟ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ

english_rwwad.text: It is He Who expelled the disbelievers of the People of the Book[1] from their homes as the first banishment[2]. You did not think that they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allah. But [the punishment of] Allah came upon them from where they did not expect and He cast dread in their hearts, destroying their homes with their own hands[3] and the hands of the believers. So take a lesson, O you people of insight.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] It refers to the Jews of Banū Nadīr, who broke their pact with the Prophet (ﷺ).
 [2] This was the first time ever that they were gathered and expelled from Madinah to the Levant.
 [3] In order that the believers do not benefit from their homes.

verses.translation: It is He Who expelled the disbelievers of the People of the Book[1] from their homes as the first banishment[2]. You did not think that they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allah. But [the punishment of] Allah came upon them from where they did not expect and He cast dread in their hearts, destroying their homes with their own hands[3] and the hands of the believers. So take a lesson, O you people of insight.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَآ أَن كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْجَلَآءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابُ ٱلنَّارِ

english_rwwad.text: Had Allah not decreed exile for them, He would have surely punished them in this world. And in the Hereafter, there will be for them the punishment of the Fire.

verses.translation: Had Allah not decreed exile for them, He would have surely punished them in this world. And in the Hereafter, there will be for them the punishment of the Fire.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَمَن يُشَآقِّ ٱللَّهَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ

english_rwwad.text: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah, Allah is truly severe in punishment.

verses.translation: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah, Allah is truly severe in punishment.

verses.arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Whatever palm trees you cut down[1] or left standing on their trunks[2], it was by Allah’s Will, so that He might disgrace the evildoers[3].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] To enrage the enemies of Allah.
 [2] To benefit from them.
 [3] When the Muslim army was about to enter the fort of Banū Nadīr, they cut down some of their palm trees, so the Jews were terrified and alleged that this was corruption. So the Muslims disagreed about it; some of them said not to cut the trees, for these are gains that Allah has bestowed upon us, while some others said that we cut them off to enrage them. Hence, this verse was revealed to appease both parties of the Muslims, proclaiming that all this happened by the will of Allah. They were treated as such for their betrayal as they broke their pact with the Prophet (ﷺ).

verses.translation: Whatever palm trees you cut down[1] or left standing on their trunks[2], it was by Allah’s Will, so that He might disgrace the evildoers[3].

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ مِنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Whatever gains Allah has bestowed upon His Messenger from them, you did not spur on any horses or camels for that[1], but Allah gives authority to His messengers over whom He wills, and Allah is Most Capable of all things.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., they went through no hardship (i.e., war) to gain it.

verses.translation: Whatever gains Allah has bestowed upon His Messenger from them, you did not spur on any horses or camels for that[1], but Allah gives authority to His messengers over whom He wills, and Allah is Most Capable of all things.

verses.arabic: مَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْقُرَىٰ فَلِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ كَىْ لَا يَكُونَ دُولَةًۢ بَيْنَ ٱلْأَغْنِيَآءِ مِنكُمْ وَمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ فَٱنتَهُوا۟ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ

english_rwwad.text: Whatever gains Allah has bestowed upon His Messenger from the people of the towns belongs to Allah and the Messenger, and to his close relatives[1], orphans, the needy, and stranded wayfarers[2], so that wealth should not circulate only among those of you who are rich. Whatever the Messenger gives you, accept it, and whatever he forbids you, refrain from it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is severe in punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Those of Banū Hāshim and Banū Muttalib, the close relatives of the Prophet (ﷺ), as compensation for them being prohibited from accepting zakah.
 [2] This ruling concerning properties abandoned by disbelievers without engaging in war varies from that in Surat al-Anfāl, verse 41, which refers to spoils of war in which four-fifths is distributed among those believers who participated in the war.

verses.translation: Whatever gains Allah has bestowed upon His Messenger from the people of the towns belongs to Allah and the Messenger, and to his close relatives[1], orphans, the needy, and stranded wayfarers[2], so that wealth should not circulate only among those of you who are rich. Whatever the Messenger gives you, accept it, and whatever he forbids you, refrain from it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is severe in punishment.

verses.arabic: لِلْفُقَرَآءِ ٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمْ وَأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًا وَيَنصُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: For the poor emigrants [there is a due share] who were driven out of their homes and their properties, seeking Allah’s bounty and pleasure, and helping the cause of Allah and His Messenger. It is they who are the truthful.

verses.translation: For the poor emigrants [there is a due share] who were driven out of their homes and their properties, seeking Allah’s bounty and pleasure, and helping the cause of Allah and His Messenger. It is they who are the truthful.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُو ٱلدَّارَ وَٱلْإِيمَٰنَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِى صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةً مِّمَّآ أُوتُوا۟ وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who were settled in the city [of Madinah][1] and embraced Islam before them, they love those who migrated to them and find no covetous desire in their hearts for what they were given. Rather they give them preference over themselves even though they may be in dire need. Whoever is protected from the covetousness of their souls, it is they who are successful.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Referring to the dwellers of Madinah, the Ansār (the Helpers), who embraced Islam and supported the believers and the Islamic cause even before the Prophet’s (ﷺ) emigration to Madinah.

verses.translation: As for those who were settled in the city [of Madinah][1] and embraced Islam before them, they love those who migrated to them and find no covetous desire in their hearts for what they were given. Rather they give them preference over themselves even though they may be in dire need. Whoever is protected from the covetousness of their souls, it is they who are successful.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: And those who came after them say, “Our Lord, forgive us and our brethren who preceded us in faith, and do not let there be any ill feelings in our hearts towards those who believe. Our Lord, indeed, You are All-Gracious, Most Merciful.”

verses.translation: And those who came after them say, “Our Lord, forgive us and our brethren who preceded us in faith, and do not let there be any ill feelings in our hearts towards those who believe. Our Lord, indeed, You are All-Gracious, Most Merciful.”

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَئِنْ أُخْرِجْتُمْ لَنَخْرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمْ وَلَا نُطِيعُ فِيكُمْ أَحَدًا أَبَدًا وَإِن قُوتِلْتُمْ لَنَنصُرَنَّكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Have you not seen the hypocrites who say to their fellow disbelievers from the People of the Book[1], “If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will never obey anyone concerning you, and if you are attacked, we will surely come to your aid.” But Allah bears witness that they are truly liars.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Jews of Banu Nadīr.

verses.translation: Have you not seen the hypocrites who say to their fellow disbelievers from the People of the Book[1], “If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will never obey anyone concerning you, and if you are attacked, we will surely come to your aid.” But Allah bears witness that they are truly liars.

verses.arabic: لَئِنْ أُخْرِجُوا۟ لَا يَخْرُجُونَ مَعَهُمْ وَلَئِن قُوتِلُوا۟ لَا يَنصُرُونَهُمْ وَلَئِن نَّصَرُوهُمْ لَيُوَلُّنَّ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and if they are attacked, they will not come to their aid. Even if they come to their help, they will certainly turn and flee, then they will not be helped.

verses.translation: If they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and if they are attacked, they will not come to their aid. Even if they come to their help, they will certainly turn and flee, then they will not be helped.

verses.arabic: لَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ رَهْبَةً فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, your fear in their hearts is greater than their fear of Allah. That is because they are a people devoid of understanding.

verses.translation: Indeed, your fear in their hearts is greater than their fear of Allah. That is because they are a people devoid of understanding.

verses.arabic: لَا يُقَٰتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِى قُرًى مُّحَصَّنَةٍ أَوْ مِن وَرَآءِ جُدُرٍۭ بَأْسُهُم بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدٌ تَحْسَبُهُمْ جَمِيعًا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّىٰ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: They will not fight you all together but in fortified towns or from behind walls. Their hostility towards one another is fierce; you think they are united, but their hearts are divided. That is because they are people who do not use their reason.

verses.translation: They will not fight you all together but in fortified towns or from behind walls. Their hostility towards one another is fierce; you think they are united, but their hearts are divided. That is because they are people who do not use their reason.

verses.arabic: كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَرِيبًا ذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: They are like those who were shortly before them[1], who tasted the evil consequence of their deeds, and for them there will be a painful punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Referring to the defeat of the pagans of Makkah at the Battle of Badr or the exile of the Jews of Banu Qaynuqā‘.

verses.translation: They are like those who were shortly before them[1], who tasted the evil consequence of their deeds, and for them there will be a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: كَمَثَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ ٱكْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنكَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They are like Satan when he says to man, “Disbelieve,” then when he disbelieves, he says, “I have nothing to do with you. I surely fear Allah, the Lord of the worlds.”

verses.translation: They are like Satan when he says to man, “Disbelieve,” then when he disbelieves, he says, “I have nothing to do with you. I surely fear Allah, the Lord of the worlds.”

verses.arabic: فَكَانَ عَٰقِبَتَهُمَآ أَنَّهُمَا فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدَيْنِ فِيهَا وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So they will both end up in the Fire, abiding therein forever. That is the recompense of the wrongdoers.

verses.translation: So they will both end up in the Fire, abiding therein forever. That is the recompense of the wrongdoers.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, fear Allah, and let every soul consider what it has sent forth for tomorrow[1]. And fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., for the Hereafter.

verses.translation: O you who believe, fear Allah, and let every soul consider what it has sent forth for tomorrow[1]. And fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do not be like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget themselves. It is they who are the evildoers.

verses.translation: Do not be like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget themselves. It is they who are the evildoers.

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْتَوِىٓ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ

english_rwwad.text: The people of Hell and the people of Paradise are not equal. It is the people of Paradise who will triumph.

verses.translation: The people of Hell and the people of Paradise are not equal. It is the people of Paradise who will triumph.

verses.arabic: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُۥ خَٰشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Had We sent down this Qur’an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and break asunder out of awe of Allah[1]. Such are the similitudes We set forth for people so that they may reflect.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., The disbelievers’ hearts are harder than the mountains in regard to the Qur’an.

verses.translation: Had We sent down this Qur’an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and break asunder out of awe of Allah[1]. Such are the similitudes We set forth for people so that they may reflect.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: He is Allah; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, Knower of the unseen and the seen; He is the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

verses.translation: He is Allah; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, Knower of the unseen and the seen; He is the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He is Allah; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, the Sovereign[1], the Most Holy[2], the Most Perfect[3], the Granter of Security[4], the Watcher over all, the All-Mighty, the Compeller[5], the Supreme[6]. Glory be to Allah far above what they associate with Him.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the Owner of everything in existence.
 [2] i.e., Transcendent above any imperfection and attributes related to His creation.
 [3] Lit., "Free" from any fault. It also means, "Peace" or "Soundness."
 [4] And grants safety; reassurance; bestows faith.
 [5] Who compels the creation according to His will. Also, "the Amender" or "the Rectifier" Who restores, or sets something right once again.
 [6] i.e., the Complete and Perfect in His essence, attributes, and actions.

verses.translation: He is Allah; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, the Sovereign[1], the Most Holy[2], the Most Perfect[3], the Granter of Security[4], the Watcher over all, the All-Mighty, the Compeller[5], the Supreme[6]. Glory be to Allah far above what they associate with Him.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

english_rwwad.text: He is Allah, the Creator[1], the Maker[2], the Fashioner[3]. He has the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and earth glorifies Him, for He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the Creator of everything.
 [2] i.e., the Inventor of everything.
 [3] i.e., He Who gave everything its form.

verses.translation: He is Allah, the Creator[1], the Maker[2], the Fashioner[3]. He has the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and earth glorifies Him, for He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ عَدُوِّى وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِم بِٱلْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا جَآءَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْحَقِّ يُخْرِجُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ أَن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَٰدًا فِى سَبِيلِى وَٱبْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِى تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِم بِٱلْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا۠ أَعْلَمُ بِمَآ أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَآ أَعْلَنتُمْ وَمَن يَفْعَلْهُ مِنكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ

english_rwwad.text: O you who believe, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, offering them friendship even though they rejected the truth that has come to you, and they have driven out the Messenger and yourselves [from Makkah] simply because you believe in Allah, your Lord – if you have emigrated[1] to struggle in My cause and seek My pleasure. How can you disclose secrets [of the believers], showing them friendship, when I know best all that you conceal and all that you reveal? Whoever among you does that has truly strayed from the straight path.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] From Makkah.

verses.translation: O you who believe, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, offering them friendship even though they rejected the truth that has come to you, and they have driven out the Messenger and yourselves [from Makkah] simply because you believe in Allah, your Lord – if you have emigrated[1] to struggle in My cause and seek My pleasure. How can you disclose secrets [of the believers], showing them friendship, when I know best all that you conceal and all that you reveal? Whoever among you does that has truly strayed from the straight path.

verses.arabic: إِن يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا۟ لَكُمْ أَعْدَآءً وَيَبْسُطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلسُّوٓءِ وَوَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: If they gain the upper hand over you, they would be your [open] enemies and would stretch their hands and tongues towards you to harm you, and they wish that you too would disbelieve.

verses.translation: If they gain the upper hand over you, they would be your [open] enemies and would stretch their hands and tongues towards you to harm you, and they wish that you too would disbelieve.

verses.arabic: لَن تَنفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
