english_rwwad.text: They said, “Glory be to our Lord! We were truly wrongdoers.”

verses.translation: They said, “Glory be to our Lord! We were truly wrongdoers.”

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then they turned to one another, throwing blame.

verses.translation: Then they turned to one another, throwing blame.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ

english_rwwad.text: They said, “Woe to us! We were surely transgressors.

verses.translation: They said, “Woe to us! We were surely transgressors.

verses.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Our Lord may give us something better than this. We certainly turn to our Lord in hope[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of His forgiveness and bounty.

verses.translation: Our Lord may give us something better than this. We certainly turn to our Lord in hope[1].”

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Such is the punishment [in this world]; but the punishment of the Hereafter is far worse, if only they knew.

verses.translation: Such is the punishment [in this world]; but the punishment of the Hereafter is far worse, if only they knew.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the righteous will have gardens of bliss with their Lord.

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will have gardens of bliss with their Lord.

verses.arabic: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Should We then treat Muslims like the wicked?

verses.translation: Should We then treat Muslims like the wicked?

verses.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: What is the matter with you that you make such a judgment?

verses.translation: What is the matter with you that you make such a judgment?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do you have a scripture in which you read

verses.translation: Or do you have a scripture in which you read

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: that you will be given whatever you choose?

verses.translation: that you will be given whatever you choose?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do you have a solemn promise binding upon Us until the Day of Resurrection, that you will have whatever you decide for yourselves?

verses.translation: Or do you have a solemn promise binding upon Us until the Day of Resurrection, that you will have whatever you decide for yourselves?

verses.arabic: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Ask them which of them can guarantee that.

verses.translation: Ask them which of them can guarantee that.

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they have associate-gods? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods[1], if they are truthful.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] whom they took as partners with Allah.

verses.translation: Or do they have associate-gods? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods[1], if they are truthful.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when the Shin [of Allah] will be uncovered[1], and they are invited to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., It is a Day that everyone will find before him great difficulty. According to a long and authentic Hadīth of Abu Sa‘īd al-Khudrī, "the Shin" refers to that of Allah Almighty, before which every believer will prostrate on the Day of Judgment when the disbelievers and hypocrites will not be able to prostrate. The text of the Hadith is as follows: "... Then the Lord will uncover His Shank, so they will prostrate to Him...".

verses.translation: On the Day when the Shin [of Allah] will be uncovered[1], and they are invited to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so.

verses.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Their eyes will be downcast, overwhelmed with humiliation, for they were invited to prostrate when they were capable[1] [but they refused].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] During the life of this world.

verses.translation: Their eyes will be downcast, overwhelmed with humiliation, for they were invited to prostrate when they were capable[1] [but they refused].

verses.arabic: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So leave to Me those who reject this message [O Prophet]. We will gradually lead them to their ruin in ways that they do not perceive[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah will increase favors upon them in this life as a trial, so they will increase sin, which will lead to their destruction.

verses.translation: So leave to Me those who reject this message [O Prophet]. We will gradually lead them to their ruin in ways that they do not perceive[1].

verses.arabic: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: I will give them respite, but My plan is firm.

verses.translation: I will give them respite, but My plan is firm.

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or are you asking them for a reward, so they find it too burdensome?

verses.translation: Or are you asking them for a reward, so they find it too burdensome?

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Or do they have knowledge of the unseen, so they write it down?

verses.translation: Or do they have knowledge of the unseen, so they write it down?

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ

english_rwwad.text: So be patient with the decree of your Lord, and do not be like the man of the Whale [i.e., Jonah], when he cried out in anguish[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] While inside the belly of the whale. See 21:87 and 37:139-148.

verses.translation: So be patient with the decree of your Lord, and do not be like the man of the Whale [i.e., Jonah], when he cried out in anguish[1].

verses.arabic: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ

english_rwwad.text: Had it not been for the grace that he received from his Lord, he would have surely been thrown onto the barren shore, blameworthy[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Instead, Allah accepted his repentance and provided for him means of recovery. See 37:139-148.

verses.translation: Had it not been for the grace that he received from his Lord, he would have surely been thrown onto the barren shore, blameworthy[1].

verses.arabic: فَٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

english_rwwad.text: But his Lord chose him and made him one of the righteous.

verses.translation: But his Lord chose him and made him one of the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ

english_rwwad.text: The disbelievers would almost strike you down with their malicious gazes when they hear the Reminder, and they say, “He is certainly mad.”

verses.translation: The disbelievers would almost strike you down with their malicious gazes when they hear the Reminder, and they say, “He is certainly mad.”

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: But it is nothing other than a reminder to the whole world.

verses.translation: But it is nothing other than a reminder to the whole world.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَآقَّةُ

english_rwwad.text: The Inevitable Hour!

verses.translation: The Inevitable Hour!

verses.arabic: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ

english_rwwad.text: What is the Inevitable Hour?

verses.translation: What is the Inevitable Hour?

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ

english_rwwad.text: How do you know what the Inevitable Hour is?

verses.translation: How do you know what the Inevitable Hour is?

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ

english_rwwad.text: Thamūd and ‘Ād denied the Striking Calamity of the Hour[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Striking Calamity is one of the names of the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: Thamūd and ‘Ād denied the Striking Calamity of the Hour[1].

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ

english_rwwad.text: As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by a dreadful blast.

verses.translation: As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by a dreadful blast.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a furious windstorm[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or by a cold windstorm.

verses.translation: And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a furious windstorm[1]

verses.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: which He unleashed against them for seven successive nights and eight days, so you would see the people lying dead as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

verses.translation: which He unleashed against them for seven successive nights and eight days, so you would see the people lying dead as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

verses.arabic: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: Do you see any trace of them now?

verses.translation: Do you see any trace of them now?

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ

english_rwwad.text: Also, Pharaoh and those who came before him, and the overturned cities [of Lot] committed the grave sin,

verses.translation: Also, Pharaoh and those who came before him, and the overturned cities [of Lot] committed the grave sin,

verses.arabic: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً

english_rwwad.text: each disobeying the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a severe punishment.

verses.translation: each disobeying the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a severe punishment.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, when the floodwater overflowed, We carried you [O humans] in the sailing Ark[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Which was made by Noah with Allah's command.

verses.translation: Indeed, when the floodwater overflowed, We carried you [O humans] in the sailing Ark[1],

verses.arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: so that We might make it a reminder for you, and that attentive ears may take heed.

verses.translation: so that We might make it a reminder for you, and that attentive ears may take heed.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: Then when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast,

verses.translation: Then when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast,

verses.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً

english_rwwad.text: and the earth and mountains are lifted up and crushed with a single blow,

verses.translation: and the earth and mountains are lifted up and crushed with a single blow,

verses.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ

english_rwwad.text: on that Day the Inevitable Event will occur.

verses.translation: on that Day the Inevitable Event will occur.

verses.arabic: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: And the sky will split asunder and will be frail[1] on that day,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., weak and unstable.

verses.translation: And the sky will split asunder and will be frail[1] on that day,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: with the angels on all its sides, and on that Day, eight [mighty angels] will bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

verses.translation: with the angels on all its sides, and on that Day, eight [mighty angels] will bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: On that day, you will be brought forth [before Allah], and none of your secrets will remain hidden.

verses.translation: On that day, you will be brought forth [before Allah], and none of your secrets will remain hidden.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ

english_rwwad.text: As for the one who is given his Record in his right hand, he will say, “Here is my Record, read it!

verses.translation: As for the one who is given his Record in his right hand, he will say, “Here is my Record, read it!

verses.arabic: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ

english_rwwad.text: I was sure that I would meet my reckoning.”

verses.translation: I was sure that I would meet my reckoning.”

verses.arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: So he will be in a pleasant life,

verses.translation: So he will be in a pleasant life,

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: in a lofty garden,

verses.translation: in a lofty garden,

verses.arabic: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: with clustered fruit within his reach.

verses.translation: with clustered fruit within his reach.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be told,] “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did[1] in the days gone by.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Lit., "advanced" anticipating the reward in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: [They will be told,] “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did[1] in the days gone by.”

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ

english_rwwad.text: As for the one who is given his Record in his left hand, he will say, “Would that I had not been given my Record,

verses.translation: As for the one who is given his Record in his left hand, he will say, “Would that I had not been given my Record,

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ

english_rwwad.text: nor had I known anything of my reckoning!

verses.translation: nor had I known anything of my reckoning!

verses.arabic: يَٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ

english_rwwad.text: Would that it [i.e., death] had been the end of me[1]!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Rather than a gateway to eternal life.

verses.translation: Would that it [i.e., death] had been the end of me[1]!

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ

english_rwwad.text: My wealth has been of no avail to me.

verses.translation: My wealth has been of no avail to me.

verses.arabic: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَٰنِيَهْ

english_rwwad.text: My authority has vanished[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., I have no valid argument or authority today.

verses.translation: My authority has vanished[1].”

verses.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ

english_rwwad.text: [It will be said,] “Seize him and shackle him,

verses.translation: [It will be said,] “Seize him and shackle him,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ

english_rwwad.text: then make him burn in the Blazing Fire,

verses.translation: then make him burn in the Blazing Fire,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ

english_rwwad.text: then tie him up with a chain of seventy cubits long.

verses.translation: then tie him up with a chain of seventy cubits long.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: For he did not believe in Allah, the Most Great,

verses.translation: For he did not believe in Allah, the Most Great,

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

english_rwwad.text: nor did he encourage feeding the needy.

verses.translation: nor did he encourage feeding the needy.

verses.arabic: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: So Today he will have no close friend here,

verses.translation: So Today he will have no close friend here,

verses.arabic: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: nor any food except the discharge of wounds,

verses.translation: nor any food except the discharge of wounds,

verses.arabic: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَٰطِـُٔونَ

english_rwwad.text: none will eat it except the sinners.”

verses.translation: none will eat it except the sinners.”

verses.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: I swear by what you can see.

verses.translation: I swear by what you can see.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and what you cannot see!

verses.translation: and what you cannot see!

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, this is the word of a noble Messenger[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., recited by Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).

verses.translation: Indeed, this is the word of a noble Messenger[1],

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe!

verses.translation: and it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe!

verses.arabic: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer; little do you take heed!

verses.translation: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer; little do you take heed!

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ

english_rwwad.text: If he had falsely attributed something to Us,

verses.translation: If he had falsely attributed something to Us,

verses.arabic: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ

english_rwwad.text: We would have surely seized him by the right hand[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or "by [Our] Right Hand," i.e., Allah would have surely exacted revenge with might and power.

verses.translation: We would have surely seized him by the right hand[1],

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ

english_rwwad.text: then severed his aorta[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., his life artery of the heart; causing immediate death.

verses.translation: then severed his aorta[1],

verses.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and none of you could have rescued him.

verses.translation: and none of you could have rescued him.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This [Qur’an] is indeed a reminder for those who are righteous.

verses.translation: This [Qur’an] is indeed a reminder for those who are righteous.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: And We surely know that some of you will be deniers,

verses.translation: And We surely know that some of you will be deniers,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and it[1] will certainly be a source of regret for the disbelievers.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., denying this Qur’an.

verses.translation: and it[1] will certainly be a source of regret for the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ

english_rwwad.text: And this[1] is indeed the absolute truth.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., this Qur’an.

verses.translation: And this[1] is indeed the absolute truth.

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

verses.translation: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ

english_rwwad.text: A challenger asked for a punishment bound to come[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In the Hereafter. The pagans of Makkah had challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) in ridicule by asking Allah to bring upon them His punishment. See 8:32.

verses.translation: A challenger asked for a punishment bound to come[1]

verses.arabic: لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ

english_rwwad.text: upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,

verses.translation: upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,

verses.arabic: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ

english_rwwad.text: from Allah, Lord of the pathways of ascent,

verses.translation: from Allah, Lord of the pathways of ascent,

verses.arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: by which the angels and the Spirit[1] will ascend to Him on a Day[2] the length of which is fifty thousand years.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., the angel Gabriel.
 [2] The Day of Judgment will be an extremely long day.

verses.translation: by which the angels and the Spirit[1] will ascend to Him on a Day[2] the length of which is fifty thousand years.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: So be patient [O Prophet] with beautiful patience.

verses.translation: So be patient [O Prophet] with beautiful patience.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, they see this [punishment] far off,

verses.translation: Indeed, they see this [punishment] far off,

verses.arabic: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًا

english_rwwad.text: but We see it to be close at hand.

verses.translation: but We see it to be close at hand.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when the sky will be like molten brass[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or "murky oil."

verses.translation: On the Day when the sky will be like molten brass[1]

verses.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ

english_rwwad.text: and the mountains will be like dyed wool[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] While disintegrating.

verses.translation: and the mountains will be like dyed wool[1],

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: and no close friend will ask about another,

verses.translation: and no close friend will ask about another,

verses.arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ

english_rwwad.text: even though they will see one another. The wicked will wish he could ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by offering his children,

verses.translation: even though they will see one another. The wicked will wish he could ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by offering his children,

verses.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ

english_rwwad.text: and his wife and his brother,

verses.translation: and his wife and his brother,

verses.arabic: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ

english_rwwad.text: and his kindred who stood by him,

verses.translation: and his kindred who stood by him,

verses.arabic: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ

english_rwwad.text: and everyone on earth, just to save himself.

verses.translation: and everyone on earth, just to save himself.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: By no means![1] It is a raging Flame,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] An emphatic denial, meaning "It will never be."

verses.translation: By no means![1] It is a raging Flame,

verses.arabic: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: that will strip off the scalps[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Referring to the skin of the head or of the body extremities, which will be burned away by severe heat and flames.

verses.translation: that will strip off the scalps[1].

verses.arabic: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: It will call everyone who turned their backs and disobeyed,

verses.translation: It will call everyone who turned their backs and disobeyed,

verses.arabic: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: and amassed and hoarded wealth.

verses.translation: and amassed and hoarded wealth.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, man was created impatient:

verses.translation: Indeed, man was created impatient:

verses.arabic: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا

english_rwwad.text: when evil befalls him, he bewails,

verses.translation: when evil befalls him, he bewails,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا

english_rwwad.text: but when good fortune comes his way, he becomes tight-fisted –

verses.translation: but when good fortune comes his way, he becomes tight-fisted –

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ

english_rwwad.text: except those who pray,

verses.translation: except those who pray,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: who are steadfast in their prayers;

verses.translation: who are steadfast in their prayers;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ

english_rwwad.text: and who give a due share[1] of their wealth
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., obligatory charity; zakah.

verses.translation: and who give a due share[1] of their wealth

verses.arabic: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

english_rwwad.text: to the beggar and the dispossessed;

verses.translation: to the beggar and the dispossessed;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: and who firmly believe in the Day of Judgment;

verses.translation: and who firmly believe in the Day of Judgment;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord –

verses.translation: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord –

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: for none can feel secure from their Lord’s punishment –

verses.translation: for none can feel secure from their Lord’s punishment –

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and those who guard their private parts[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., their chastity and honor from immoralities.

verses.translation: and those who guard their private parts[1],

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

english_rwwad.text: except from their wives or bondwomen[1] whom they own, for then they are not to be blamed.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., female slaves or slave-girls.

verses.translation: except from their wives or bondwomen[1] whom they own, for then they are not to be blamed.

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ

english_rwwad.text: But whoever seeks beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.

verses.translation: But whoever seeks beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and those who fulfill their trusts and pledges;

verses.translation: and those who fulfill their trusts and pledges;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and who are upright in their testimonies;

verses.translation: and who are upright in their testimonies;

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and who take due care of their prayers;

verses.translation: and who take due care of their prayers;

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: they will be honored in gardens[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of Paradise.

verses.translation: they will be honored in gardens[1].

verses.arabic: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: What is the matter with the disbelievers that they are rushing towards you [O Prophet][1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., rushing to deny you.

verses.translation: What is the matter with the disbelievers that they are rushing towards you [O Prophet][1],

verses.arabic: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ

english_rwwad.text: from the right and from the left, in crowds[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Some pagans of Makkah gathered around the Prophet (ﷺ) mocking and opposing him, claiming that if there is in fact a Hereafter, they would enter Paradise before the believers.

verses.translation: from the right and from the left, in crowds[1]?

verses.arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Does everyone of them aspire to enter a garden of bliss?

verses.translation: Does everyone of them aspire to enter a garden of bliss?

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: By no means! We have created them from what they know[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., from a disdained fluid.

verses.translation: By no means! We have created them from what they know[1].

verses.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: I swear by the Lord of the sunrises and sunsets[1] that We are surely Capable
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Allah is the One Who determines the daily points of sunrise and sunset according to each season by the rotation of the earth around the sun.

verses.translation: I swear by the Lord of the sunrises and sunsets[1] that We are surely Capable

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

english_rwwad.text: to replace them with others better than them, and none can escape Our decree.

verses.translation: to replace them with others better than them, and none can escape Our decree.

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So leave them to engage in their falsehood and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised;

verses.translation: So leave them to engage in their falsehood and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised;

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ

english_rwwad.text: the Day when they will rush out of their graves as if they are racing towards an idol[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., just as they used to race towards a newly appointed idol, to be among the first of its worshipers.

verses.translation: the Day when they will rush out of their graves as if they are racing towards an idol[1],

verses.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: with their eyes downcast and overwhelmed with disgrace. That is the Day that they were promised.

verses.translation: with their eyes downcast and overwhelmed with disgrace. That is the Day that they were promised.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, “Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment.”

verses.translation: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, “Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

english_rwwad.text: He said: “O my people, indeed I am a clear warner to you,

verses.translation: He said: “O my people, indeed I am a clear warner to you,

verses.arabic: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

english_rwwad.text: that you worship Allah and fear Him, and obey me;

verses.translation: that you worship Allah and fear Him, and obey me;

verses.arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: He will forgive you some of your sins and grant you respite until an appointed term[1]. Indeed, when Allah’s appointed term comes, it cannot be delayed, if you only knew!”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., until the time your life comes to an end.

verses.translation: He will forgive you some of your sins and grant you respite until an appointed term[1]. Indeed, when Allah’s appointed term comes, it cannot be delayed, if you only knew!”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا

english_rwwad.text: He said, “My Lord, I have surely called my people night and day,

verses.translation: He said, “My Lord, I have surely called my people night and day,

verses.arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا

english_rwwad.text: but my call only drove them further away.

verses.translation: but my call only drove them further away.

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا

english_rwwad.text: Every time I call them so that You may forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears and cover their faces with their garments[1], and persist in obstinacy and grow extremely arrogant.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Refusing to see me or listen to my call.

verses.translation: Every time I call them so that You may forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears and cover their faces with their garments[1], and persist in obstinacy and grow extremely arrogant.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا

english_rwwad.text: Then I called them openly,

verses.translation: Then I called them openly,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا

english_rwwad.text: then I addressed them in public and in private,

verses.translation: then I addressed them in public and in private,

verses.arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا

english_rwwad.text: I said, ‘Seek forgiveness from your Lord. Indeed, He is Most Forgiving.

verses.translation: I said, ‘Seek forgiveness from your Lord. Indeed, He is Most Forgiving.

verses.arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا

english_rwwad.text: He will shower you with abundant rain from the sky,

verses.translation: He will shower you with abundant rain from the sky,

verses.arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًا

english_rwwad.text: and He will give you wealth and children, and bestow upon you gardens and rivers.

verses.translation: and He will give you wealth and children, and bestow upon you gardens and rivers.

verses.arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا

english_rwwad.text: What is the matter with you that you do not fear the Majesty of Allah[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] While disobeying Him carelessly.

verses.translation: What is the matter with you that you do not fear the Majesty of Allah[1],

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا

english_rwwad.text: when He has created you in stages[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] See 22:5 and 23:12-14 for the stages of the embryo.

verses.translation: when He has created you in stages[1]?

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا

english_rwwad.text: Do you not see how Allah has created seven heavens, one above another,

verses.translation: Do you not see how Allah has created seven heavens, one above another,

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا

english_rwwad.text: and has placed the moon therein as a light and the sun as a burning lamp?

verses.translation: and has placed the moon therein as a light and the sun as a burning lamp?

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا

english_rwwad.text: Allah has produced you from the earth like a plant[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., your father Adam, whom Allah created from clay.

verses.translation: Allah has produced you from the earth like a plant[1],

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا

english_rwwad.text: then He will return you into it and then will bring you out again.

verses.translation: then He will return you into it and then will bring you out again.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا

english_rwwad.text: Allah has made the earth widespread for you

verses.translation: Allah has made the earth widespread for you

verses.arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا

english_rwwad.text: so that you may tread its spacious paths[1].’”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In the pursuit of a lawful livelihood.

verses.translation: so that you may tread its spacious paths[1].’”

verses.arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا

english_rwwad.text: Noah said, “My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose wealth and children did not increase them except in loss[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the lowly people among them followed their wealthy chiefs.

verses.translation: Noah said, “My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose wealth and children did not increase them except in loss[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا

english_rwwad.text: They have contrived a mighty plot,

verses.translation: They have contrived a mighty plot,

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا

english_rwwad.text: They said, ‘Do not abandon your gods; and do not abandon Wadd, Suwā‘, Yaghūth, Ya‘ūq, and Nasr[1].’
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] These were the names of idols named after pious men of past generations before the time of Noah, to commemorate them. In later generations, people started worshiping these idols.

verses.translation: They said, ‘Do not abandon your gods; and do not abandon Wadd, Suwā‘, Yaghūth, Ya‘ūq, and Nasr[1].’

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًا

english_rwwad.text: They have led many astray. So [O Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error.”

verses.translation: They have led many astray. So [O Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error.”

verses.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا

english_rwwad.text: Because of their sins, they were drowned and then were cast into the Fire, and they did not find any helpers against Allah.

verses.translation: Because of their sins, they were drowned and then were cast into the Fire, and they did not find any helpers against Allah.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

english_rwwad.text: Noah said, “My Lord, do not leave on earth a single disbeliever.

verses.translation: Noah said, “My Lord, do not leave on earth a single disbeliever.

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا

english_rwwad.text: For if You leave them, they will surely lead Your slaves astray and beget none but wicked disbelievers.

verses.translation: For if You leave them, they will surely lead Your slaves astray and beget none but wicked disbelievers.

verses.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا

english_rwwad.text: My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer, and all the believing men and women, and do not increase the wrongdoers except in ruin.”

verses.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer, and all the believing men and women, and do not increase the wrongdoers except in ruin.”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened [to the Qur’an,] and they said, ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation

verses.translation: Say, “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened [to the Qur’an,] and they said, ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation

verses.arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.

verses.translation: that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا

english_rwwad.text: And that He – our exalted and glorified Lord[1] – has neither taken a wife nor offspring;
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] “Jadd” of Our Lord means His Glory, Grandeur, and Command.

verses.translation: And that He – our exalted and glorified Lord[1] – has neither taken a wife nor offspring;

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا

english_rwwad.text: and that the fool among us [i.e., Satan] used to say outrageous things about Allah[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Satan tempted humans to believe that Allah has a wife and children, and that the angels are Allah's daughters.

verses.translation: and that the fool among us [i.e., Satan] used to say outrageous things about Allah[1],

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا

english_rwwad.text: although we thought that humans and jinn would never tell lies about Allah.

verses.translation: although we thought that humans and jinn would never tell lies about Allah.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا

english_rwwad.text: And there were some men who used to seek refuge with some jinn, but they only increased them in burden.

verses.translation: And there were some men who used to seek refuge with some jinn, but they only increased them in burden.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: They thought, just like you [jinn] thought that Allah would never send any messenger.

verses.translation: They thought, just like you [jinn] thought that Allah would never send any messenger.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا

english_rwwad.text: We have sought to reach heaven but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fire.

verses.translation: We have sought to reach heaven but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fire.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا

english_rwwad.text: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but now anyone who eavesdrops will find a flaming fire waiting for him[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] After the Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) was sent as a messenger, the heavens were guarded more strictly. The devils among the jinn could no longer eavesdrop as they would previously, and whoever of them attempted was pursued by blazing meteors. Yet a fragment of information might occasionally be snatched; it would be mixed with many falsehoods before reaching the fortune-tellers.

verses.translation: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but now anyone who eavesdrops will find a flaming fire waiting for him[1].

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا

english_rwwad.text: We do not know whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends good for them.

verses.translation: We do not know whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends good for them.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Among us are some who are righteous and some who are otherwise, for we follow divergent ways[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In beliefs and religious duties.

verses.translation: Among us are some who are righteous and some who are otherwise, for we follow divergent ways[1].

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا

english_rwwad.text: We have realized that we can never escape Allah on earth, nor can we ever escape Him by fleeing.

verses.translation: We have realized that we can never escape Allah on earth, nor can we ever escape Him by fleeing.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا

english_rwwad.text: When we heard the guidance [of the Qur’an], we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord will have no fear of curtailment [from his reward] or injustice[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., nor will the sins of another be placed upon him.

verses.translation: When we heard the guidance [of the Qur’an], we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord will have no fear of curtailment [from his reward] or injustice[1].

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Among us are some who are Muslims and some who are deviant[1]. Those who accepted Islam have sought the true guidance,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., deviant from the right way.

verses.translation: Among us are some who are Muslims and some who are deviant[1]. Those who accepted Islam have sought the true guidance,

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا

english_rwwad.text: but those who are deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”

verses.translation: but those who are deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”

verses.arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا

english_rwwad.text: “If they had remained steadfast on the right way, We would have given them abundant rain,

verses.translation: “If they had remained steadfast on the right way, We would have given them abundant rain,

verses.arabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا

english_rwwad.text: as a test for them[1]. But whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord[2], He will make him suffer an arduous punishment.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] As to whether they will be grateful for Allah's provisions or not.
 [2] i.e., the Qur’an and obedience to Him.

verses.translation: as a test for them[1]. But whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord[2], He will make him suffer an arduous punishment.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: The mosques[1] are for Allah alone, so do not supplicate to anyone along with Allah.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] "Masjid" here means every place of worship on earth.

verses.translation: The mosques[1] are for Allah alone, so do not supplicate to anyone along with Allah.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Yet when the slave of Allah stood up supplicating to Him, they swarmed around him[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Crowding in the manner of locusts on top of one another in order to hear him (ﷺ). It refers to the jinn or to the Arabs pagans.

verses.translation: Yet when the slave of Allah stood up supplicating to Him, they swarmed around him[1].”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Say [O Prophet], “I only supplicate to my Lord and I do not associate anyone with Him.”

verses.translation: Say [O Prophet], “I only supplicate to my Lord and I do not associate anyone with Him.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “I have no power to harm or guide you aright[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) is commanded to declare that he does not have independent power to harm people or guide them aright. Both harm and guidance ultimately rest in the Hands of Allah alone. The Prophet’s role is only to convey the message, whereas guidance itself comes from Allah.

verses.translation: Say, “I have no power to harm or guide you aright[1].”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “None can ever protect me from Allah [if I should disobey Him], nor can I ever find refuge except in Him.

verses.translation: Say, “None can ever protect me from Allah [if I should disobey Him], nor can I ever find refuge except in Him.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا

english_rwwad.text: I only convey what I receive from Allah and His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, abiding therein forever.

verses.translation: I only convey what I receive from Allah and His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, abiding therein forever.

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Until when they see what they were promised, they will realize who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number.

verses.translation: Until when they see what they were promised, they will realize who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا

english_rwwad.text: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has appointed a distant time for it.

verses.translation: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has appointed a distant time for it.

verses.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

english_rwwad.text: [He is] the Knower of the unseen, He does not reveal His unseen to anyone,

verses.translation: [He is] the Knower of the unseen, He does not reveal His unseen to anyone,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا

english_rwwad.text: except the messenger whom He chooses, then He appoints angel-guards before him and behind him[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Protecting him so that others do not know what he was informed of the unseen.

verses.translation: except the messenger whom He chooses, then He appoints angel-guards before him and behind him[1]

verses.arabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا

english_rwwad.text: to ensure[1] that the messengers fully conveyed the messages of their Lord. He encompasses in His knowledge all about them, and keeps count of all things.”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or "So He may make evident."

verses.translation: to ensure[1] that the messengers fully conveyed the messages of their Lord. He encompasses in His knowledge all about them, and keeps count of all things.”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ

english_rwwad.text: O you the enwrapped one[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah is addressing the Messenger (ﷺ), who was wrapped in his garments.

verses.translation: O you the enwrapped one[1],

verses.arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Stand up in prayer at night except a little,

verses.translation: Stand up in prayer at night except a little,

verses.arabic: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: half of it, or a little less,

verses.translation: half of it, or a little less,

verses.arabic: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: or a little more, and recite the Qur’an at a measured pace.

verses.translation: or a little more, and recite the Qur’an at a measured pace.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: We will send down upon you a weighty Word[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a revelation of immense significance and weighty responsibility, it carries profound moral, spiritual, and practical dimensions for its recipients. The Prophet (ﷺ) would feel its great weight when descending upon him, due to the intensity of the revelation itself and the magnitude of its content, encompassing ordinances, rulings, punishments, ethics, etc. It required faithful transmission, deep contemplation, and unwavering commitment both in word and deed.

verses.translation: We will send down upon you a weighty Word[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, worship at night is more effective[1] and more conducive to proper recitation[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] Or "getting up at night is more difficult...," meaning that it can only be done by sincere believers.
 [2] i.e., for reciting, hearing, and understanding of the Qur’an.

verses.translation: Indeed, worship at night is more effective[1] and more conducive to proper recitation[2].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: In the daytime, you have a lengthy work to do.

verses.translation: In the daytime, you have a lengthy work to do.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: And remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself completely to Him.

verses.translation: And remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself completely to Him.

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: [He is] Lord of the east and the west; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, so take Him as the Disposer of your affairs[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., trust in Allah and rely upon Him in all your matters.

verses.translation: [He is] Lord of the east and the west; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, so take Him as the Disposer of your affairs[1].

verses.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Bear patiently what they say, and avoid them in a gracious manner.

verses.translation: Bear patiently what they say, and avoid them in a gracious manner.

verses.arabic: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Leave to Me the deniers who are having a life of luxury, and bear with them for a little while.

verses.translation: Leave to Me the deniers who are having a life of luxury, and bear with them for a little while.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We have heavy shackles and a Blazing Fire,

verses.translation: Indeed, We have heavy shackles and a Blazing Fire,

verses.arabic: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: and food that chokes, and a painful punishment,

verses.translation: and food that chokes, and a painful punishment,

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will convulse, and the mountains will be like dunes of loose sand.

verses.translation: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will convulse, and the mountains will be like dunes of loose sand.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger to be a witness over you, just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

verses.translation: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger to be a witness over you, just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

verses.arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a severe punishment.

verses.translation: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a severe punishment.

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا

english_rwwad.text: If you disbelieve, then how will you protect yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair gray?

verses.translation: If you disbelieve, then how will you protect yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair gray?

verses.arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا

english_rwwad.text: It will cause the sky to break asunder[1]. His promise will certainly be fulfilled.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Out of the terror of that Day.

verses.translation: It will cause the sky to break asunder[1]. His promise will certainly be fulfilled.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, this is a reminder; so whoever wills may take a way to his Lord.

verses.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder; so whoever wills may take a way to his Lord.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, your Lord knows that you [O Prophet] stand up in prayer for nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, as do others among your companions. Allah determines the night and the day; He knows that you [Muslims] cannot keep an accurate count of it, so He pardoned you[1]. Recite then as much of the Qur’an as is easy for you [in the night prayers]. He knows that there are some among you who will be ill, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and others fighting in Allah’s way. So recite as much of it as is easy for you; establish prayer and give zakah; and lend to Allah a goodly loan[2]. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah, much better in condition and much greater in reward[3]. And seek forgiveness of Allah, for indeed Allah is All-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] The ruling mentioned at the beginning of this surah is lightened here. So from now on, the believers do not have to stick to any of the portions specified there; rather, they can pray whatever they can at night. It is out of the mercy of Allah upon His servants that He does not want hardship for them.
 [2] i.e., giving in charity and for His causes.
 [3] It will be rewarded tenfold, or 700-fold, and Allah gives even more to whoever He wills. See 2:261.

verses.translation: Indeed, your Lord knows that you [O Prophet] stand up in prayer for nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, as do others among your companions. Allah determines the night and the day; He knows that you [Muslims] cannot keep an accurate count of it, so He pardoned you[1]. Recite then as much of the Qur’an as is easy for you [in the night prayers]. He knows that there are some among you who will be ill, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and others fighting in Allah’s way. So recite as much of it as is easy for you; establish prayer and give zakah; and lend to Allah a goodly loan[2]. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah, much better in condition and much greater in reward[3]. And seek forgiveness of Allah, for indeed Allah is All-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ

english_rwwad.text: O you covered [in your cloak][1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It refers to the Prophet (ﷺ).

verses.translation: O you covered [in your cloak][1],

verses.arabic: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ

english_rwwad.text: arise and warn,

verses.translation: arise and warn,

verses.arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ

english_rwwad.text: and proclaim the greatness of your Lord,

verses.translation: and proclaim the greatness of your Lord,

verses.arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ

english_rwwad.text: and purify your garments,

verses.translation: and purify your garments,

verses.arabic: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ

english_rwwad.text: and shun idol worshiping[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] And other sins and bad conducts and morals.

verses.translation: and shun idol worshiping[1],

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ

english_rwwad.text: and do not do a favor for a greater return[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or: do not consider your good deeds as a favor to Allah, thinking of your little deeds as abundant.

verses.translation: and do not do a favor for a greater return[1],

verses.arabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ

english_rwwad.text: and be patient for the sake of your Lord.

verses.translation: and be patient for the sake of your Lord.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ

english_rwwad.text: When the Trumpet is sounded[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] For the second time, causing all to rise from the dead for resurrection. See 39:68.

verses.translation: When the Trumpet is sounded[1],

verses.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ

english_rwwad.text: that Day will be a difficult day,

verses.translation: that Day will be a difficult day,

verses.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ

english_rwwad.text: not easy for the disbelievers.

verses.translation: not easy for the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا

english_rwwad.text: Leave me to deal with the one whom I created lonely[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., having no wealth or children. It refers to al-Walīd bin al-Mughīrah, who was impressed by the Qur’an, yet he publicly denied it to win the approval of the pagans of Makkah.

verses.translation: Leave me to deal with the one whom I created lonely[1],

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا

english_rwwad.text: and gave him abundant wealth,

verses.translation: and gave him abundant wealth,

verses.arabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا

english_rwwad.text: and sons by his side,

verses.translation: and sons by his side,

verses.arabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا

english_rwwad.text: and gave him a life of comfort and power,

verses.translation: and gave him a life of comfort and power,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ

english_rwwad.text: yet he aspires that I should give him more.

verses.translation: yet he aspires that I should give him more.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا

english_rwwad.text: By no means! For he has been stubborn against Our verses.

verses.translation: By no means! For he has been stubborn against Our verses.

verses.arabic: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا

english_rwwad.text: I will subject him to an unbearable punishment.

verses.translation: I will subject him to an unbearable punishment.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ

english_rwwad.text: For he reflected and plotted [against the Qur’an][1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In order to discredit it.

verses.translation: For he reflected and plotted [against the Qur’an][1].

verses.arabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

english_rwwad.text: May he perish, how he plotted!

verses.translation: May he perish, how he plotted!

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

english_rwwad.text: Again, may he perish, how he plotted!

verses.translation: Again, may he perish, how he plotted!

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ

english_rwwad.text: Then he looked around,

verses.translation: Then he looked around,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ

english_rwwad.text: then he frowned and scowled,

verses.translation: then he frowned and scowled,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ

english_rwwad.text: then turned away with arrogance,

verses.translation: then turned away with arrogance,

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ

english_rwwad.text: then said, “This is nothing but magic from the past.

verses.translation: then said, “This is nothing but magic from the past.

verses.arabic: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ

english_rwwad.text: This is nothing but the words of a man.”

verses.translation: This is nothing but the words of a man.”

verses.arabic: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ

english_rwwad.text: Soon I will make him burn in the Scorching Fire[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] "Saqar" is one of the names of Hell.

verses.translation: Soon I will make him burn in the Scorching Fire[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ

english_rwwad.text: How do you know what Scorching Fire is?

verses.translation: How do you know what Scorching Fire is?

verses.arabic: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ

english_rwwad.text: It leaves nothing and spares no one,

verses.translation: It leaves nothing and spares no one,

verses.arabic: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ

english_rwwad.text: scorching the skin.

verses.translation: scorching the skin.

verses.arabic: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ

english_rwwad.text: It is overseen by nineteen [angels].

verses.translation: It is overseen by nineteen [angels].

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةً وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًا وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًا كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ

english_rwwad.text: We have only appointed angels as keepers of the Fire, and We have only made their number as a test for the disbelievers[1], so that those who were given the Scripture may have certainty and the believers may increase in faith; and neither those who were given the Scripture nor the believers may have any doubts; and so that those [hypocrites] in whose hearts is sickness and the disbelievers may say, “What does Allah mean by this number?” Thus Allah causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills, and none knows the soldiers of your Lord but He. This is but a reminder to mankind.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To say what they want to say, so their punishment will be multiplied for them. Abu Jahl, one of the chief pagans in Makkah, made fun of the Prophet (ﷺ) when they came to know that the keepers of Hell are nineteen angels, so he ridiculed this number and said that it is an easy number to overcome.

verses.translation: We have only appointed angels as keepers of the Fire, and We have only made their number as a test for the disbelievers[1], so that those who were given the Scripture may have certainty and the believers may increase in faith; and neither those who were given the Scripture nor the believers may have any doubts; and so that those [hypocrites] in whose hearts is sickness and the disbelievers may say, “What does Allah mean by this number?” Thus Allah causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills, and none knows the soldiers of your Lord but He. This is but a reminder to mankind.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! By the moon,

verses.translation: No indeed! By the moon,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ

english_rwwad.text: and by the night when it departs,

verses.translation: and by the night when it departs,

verses.arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ

english_rwwad.text: and by the dawn when it brightens,

verses.translation: and by the dawn when it brightens,

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ

english_rwwad.text: Hellfire is indeed one of the greatest matters,

verses.translation: Hellfire is indeed one of the greatest matters,

verses.arabic: نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ

english_rwwad.text: a warning to mankind,

verses.translation: a warning to mankind,

verses.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ

english_rwwad.text: to whoever among you chooses to advance or regress.

verses.translation: to whoever among you chooses to advance or regress.

verses.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: Every soul is held in pledge[1] for its deeds,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., held responsible.

verses.translation: Every soul is held in pledge[1] for its deeds,

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ

english_rwwad.text: except the People of the Right[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the believers who receive their records of deeds in their right hands.

verses.translation: except the People of the Right[1],

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: who will be in gardens, asking one another

verses.translation: who will be in gardens, asking one another

verses.arabic: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: about the wicked:

verses.translation: about the wicked:

verses.arabic: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ

english_rwwad.text: “What brought you to Hell?”

verses.translation: “What brought you to Hell?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ

english_rwwad.text: They will say, “We were not among those who prayed,

verses.translation: They will say, “We were not among those who prayed,

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ

english_rwwad.text: nor did we feed the poor,

verses.translation: nor did we feed the poor,

verses.arabic: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and we indulged in falsehood along with those who indulged in it,

verses.translation: and we indulged in falsehood along with those who indulged in it,

verses.arabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: and we denied the Day of Judgment,

verses.translation: and we denied the Day of Judgment,

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ

english_rwwad.text: until the certainty [of death] came to us.”

verses.translation: until the certainty [of death] came to us.”

verses.arabic: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ

english_rwwad.text: So the intercession of intercessors will not benefit them.

verses.translation: So the intercession of intercessors will not benefit them.

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from the Reminder,

verses.translation: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from the Reminder,

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: as if they were terrified wild asses,

verses.translation: as if they were terrified wild asses,

verses.arabic: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: fleeing from a lion?

verses.translation: fleeing from a lion?

verses.arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً

english_rwwad.text: In fact, each one of them desires that open [divine] letters be sent to each of them[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Instead of Muhammad (ﷺ), not due to the lack of proofs or signs presented to them but out of obstinacy and arrogance.

verses.translation: In fact, each one of them desires that open [divine] letters be sent to each of them[1].

verses.arabic: كَلَّا بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ

english_rwwad.text: By no means! They rather do not fear the Hereafter.

verses.translation: By no means! They rather do not fear the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! This [Qur’an] is a reminder.

verses.translation: No indeed! This [Qur’an] is a reminder.

verses.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: So whoever wills may take heed.

verses.translation: So whoever wills may take heed.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ

english_rwwad.text: But they will not take heed unless Allah so wills. He is most worthy to be feared and most worthy to forgive.

verses.translation: But they will not take heed unless Allah so wills. He is most worthy to be feared and most worthy to forgive.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ

english_rwwad.text: I swear by the Day of Resurrection,

verses.translation: I swear by the Day of Resurrection,

verses.arabic: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ

english_rwwad.text: and I swear by the self-reproaching soul[1]!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of the believer, which blames oneself whenever falls into sin or error.

verses.translation: and I swear by the self-reproaching soul[1]!

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: Does man think that We cannot reassemble his bones?

verses.translation: Does man think that We cannot reassemble his bones?

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: In fact, We are able to restore even his very fingertips.

verses.translation: In fact, We are able to restore even his very fingertips.

verses.arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: But man desires to persist in sin[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] While denying the coming of the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: But man desires to persist in sin[1],

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ

english_rwwad.text: and asks [mockingly], “When is the Day of Resurrection?”

verses.translation: and asks [mockingly], “When is the Day of Resurrection?”

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ

english_rwwad.text: But when the sight is dazzled,

verses.translation: But when the sight is dazzled,

verses.arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ

english_rwwad.text: and the moon is darkened,

verses.translation: and the moon is darkened,

verses.arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ

english_rwwad.text: and the sun and the moon are brought together[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They both have never been together since they were created. On this Day they will be brought together, darkened, and both will be thrown into the Hell; so that all should know that they were subservient created beings, especially those who worshiped them.

verses.translation: and the sun and the moon are brought together[1],

verses.arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ

english_rwwad.text: on that Day man will say, “Where is the escape?”

verses.translation: on that Day man will say, “Where is the escape?”

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! There will be no refuge.

verses.translation: No indeed! There will be no refuge.

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day all will end up before your Lord.

verses.translation: On that Day all will end up before your Lord.

verses.arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day man will be informed of what he has sent forth[1] and left behind[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., of his deeds for the Hereafter.
 [2] i.e., that which he failed to do.

verses.translation: On that Day man will be informed of what he has sent forth[1] and left behind[2].

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: In fact, man will be a witness against himself[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] His organs will testify against him, as mentioned in 36:65 and 41:20-23.

verses.translation: In fact, man will be a witness against himself[1],

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: despite the excuses he may put forward.

verses.translation: despite the excuses he may put forward.

verses.arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ

english_rwwad.text: Do not move your tongue [O Prophet] in haste trying to memorize it.

verses.translation: Do not move your tongue [O Prophet] in haste trying to memorize it.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: It is upon Us to make you memorize and recite it.

verses.translation: It is upon Us to make you memorize and recite it.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: Then when We recite it [through Gabriel], follow its recitation attentively;

verses.translation: Then when We recite it [through Gabriel], follow its recitation attentively;

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: then it is upon Us to explain its meanings.

verses.translation: then it is upon Us to explain its meanings.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! You [people] love this fleeting world,

verses.translation: No indeed! You [people] love this fleeting world,

verses.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ

english_rwwad.text: and neglect the Hereafter.

verses.translation: and neglect the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day some faces will be bright,

verses.translation: On that Day some faces will be bright,

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: looking at their Lord[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The dwellers of Paradise will be granted the honor of actually seeing their Lord in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: looking at their Lord[1].

verses.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: And on that Day, some faces will be gloomy,

verses.translation: And on that Day, some faces will be gloomy,

verses.arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: knowing that a crushing calamity will befall them.

verses.translation: knowing that a crushing calamity will befall them.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, when the soul reaches the throat[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Upon death.

verses.translation: Indeed, when the soul reaches the throat[1],

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ

english_rwwad.text: and it is said, “Is there any healer?”

verses.translation: and it is said, “Is there any healer?”

verses.arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ

english_rwwad.text: And he realizes that it is time to depart,

verses.translation: And he realizes that it is time to depart,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ

english_rwwad.text: when legs are brought together [in a shroud][1];
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The difficulties the person faces while leaving this world and moving on to the Hereafter; or the people arrange for the departure of his body, while angels arrange for the departure of his soul.

verses.translation: when legs are brought together [in a shroud][1];

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ

english_rwwad.text: on that Day, he will be driven to your Lord.

verses.translation: on that Day, he will be driven to your Lord.

verses.arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: He neither believed nor prayed;

verses.translation: He neither believed nor prayed;
