verses.arabic: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: rather he denied and turned away,

verses.translation: rather he denied and turned away,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: then he went to his people, elated with pride,

verses.translation: then he went to his people, elated with pride,

verses.arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Woe to you, and woe!

verses.translation: Woe to you, and woe!

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: Again, woe to you, and woe!

verses.translation: Again, woe to you, and woe!

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى

english_rwwad.text: Does man think that he will be left neglected[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., without purpose and responsibility, or without returning to Allah for account.

verses.translation: Does man think that he will be left neglected[1]?

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Was he not once a drop of semen emitted,

verses.translation: Was he not once a drop of semen emitted,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: then he became a clinging clot[1], then He created him and perfected his form,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] "‘Alaqah": an embryo that resembles a leech.

verses.translation: then he became a clinging clot[1], then He created him and perfected his form,

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: and made from him both genders, male and female?

verses.translation: and made from him both genders, male and female?

verses.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Is not He able to bring the dead back to life?

verses.translation: Is not He able to bring the dead back to life?

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Was there not a period of time when man was not a thing [even] mentioned[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Before coming into being.

verses.translation: Was there not a period of time when man was not a thing [even] mentioned[1]?

verses.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We created man from a drop of mixed fluids[1], in order to test him. So We gave him hearing and sight.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] A combination of male and female gametes (sperm and egg) which form the zygote after fertilization in the womb.

verses.translation: Indeed, We created man from a drop of mixed fluids[1], in order to test him. So We gave him hearing and sight.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We showed him the way, whether he is grateful or ungrateful.

verses.translation: Indeed, We showed him the way, whether he is grateful or ungrateful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: We have surely prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a Blazing Fire.

verses.translation: We have surely prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] flavored with camphor[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] "Kāfoor": a sweet-scent spring in Paradise.

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] flavored with camphor[1],

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: a spring from which Allah’s slaves will drink, which will flow as they wish.

verses.translation: a spring from which Allah’s slaves will drink, which will flow as they wish.

verses.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: They fulfill their vows and fear a Day whose evil will spread far and wide,

verses.translation: They fulfill their vows and fear a Day whose evil will spread far and wide,

verses.arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: and they give food, despite their love for it[1], to the needy, the orphans, and the captives,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or "out of love for Him (Allah)".

verses.translation: and they give food, despite their love for it[1], to the needy, the orphans, and the captives,

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا

english_rwwad.text: [saying to themselves] “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we seek from you neither reward nor gratitude.

verses.translation: [saying to themselves] “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we seek from you neither reward nor gratitude.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: We fear from our Lord a grim and distressful Day.”

verses.translation: We fear from our Lord a grim and distressful Day.”

verses.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا

english_rwwad.text: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day, and will grant them radiance and delight,

verses.translation: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day, and will grant them radiance and delight,

verses.arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: and will reward them for their perseverance with Paradise and garments of silk.

verses.translation: and will reward them for their perseverance with Paradise and garments of silk.

verses.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: They will recline therein on adorned couches; neither feeling scorching heat[1] nor freezing cold.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the sun.

verses.translation: They will recline therein on adorned couches; neither feeling scorching heat[1] nor freezing cold.

verses.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: with shady branches spread above them, and clusters of fruit will be made within their reach.

verses.translation: with shady branches spread above them, and clusters of fruit will be made within their reach.

verses.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠

english_rwwad.text: They will be served frequently with silver vessels and crystal cups,

verses.translation: They will be served frequently with silver vessels and crystal cups,

verses.arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: crystalline goblets of silver, filled precisely as desired.

verses.translation: crystalline goblets of silver, filled precisely as desired.

verses.arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: They will be given a glass [of wine] flavored with ginger

verses.translation: They will be given a glass [of wine] flavored with ginger

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: from a spring therein called Salsabīl.

verses.translation: from a spring therein called Salsabīl.

verses.arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا

english_rwwad.text: They will be served by eternal young boys; if you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.

verses.translation: They will be served by eternal young boys; if you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: If you were to look around, you would see bliss and a vast dominion.

verses.translation: If you were to look around, you would see bliss and a vast dominion.

verses.arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا

english_rwwad.text: They will be dressed in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.

verses.translation: They will be dressed in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا

english_rwwad.text: [And they will be told,] “Indeed, this is your reward, and your efforts have been appreciated.”

verses.translation: [And they will be told,] “Indeed, this is your reward, and your efforts have been appreciated.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’an to you in stages.

verses.translation: Indeed, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’an to you in stages.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا

english_rwwad.text: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not obey any sinner or disbeliever from among them.

verses.translation: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not obey any sinner or disbeliever from among them.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: And remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This and the next verse refer to the five daily prayers: here it refers to the dawn prayer, then the noon and afternoon prayers.

verses.translation: And remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening[1],

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: and prostrate to Him at night, and glorify Him at length by night[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It refers to the sunset and night prayers.

verses.translation: and prostrate to Him at night, and glorify Him at length by night[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, these [pagans] love this fleeting life and pay no heed to a heavy Day ahead of them.

verses.translation: Indeed, these [pagans] love this fleeting life and pay no heed to a heavy Day ahead of them.

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: It is We Who created them and strengthened their build. If We will, We can replace them with others like them.

verses.translation: It is We Who created them and strengthened their build. If We will, We can replace them with others like them.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, this is a reminder; so whoever wills may take a way to his Lord.

verses.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder; so whoever wills may take a way to his Lord.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا

english_rwwad.text: But you cannot will unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.translation: But you cannot will unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا

english_rwwad.text: He admits whom He wills into His mercy, but for the wrongdoers He has prepared a painful punishment.

verses.translation: He admits whom He wills into His mercy, but for the wrongdoers He has prepared a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًا

english_rwwad.text: By those [winds] sent forth in succession,

verses.translation: By those [winds] sent forth in succession,

verses.arabic: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًا

english_rwwad.text: those that blow violently,

verses.translation: those that blow violently,

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا

english_rwwad.text: and scatter [rainclouds] far and wide,

verses.translation: and scatter [rainclouds] far and wide,

verses.arabic: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًا

english_rwwad.text: And by those [angels] who bring criterion[1];
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To Allah's messengers to distinguish between truth and falsehood.

verses.translation: And by those [angels] who bring criterion[1];

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا

english_rwwad.text: and those who deliver revelation,

verses.translation: and those who deliver revelation,

verses.arabic: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا

english_rwwad.text: leaving no excuse or giving warning –

verses.translation: leaving no excuse or giving warning –

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

english_rwwad.text: what you are promised will surely come to pass.

verses.translation: what you are promised will surely come to pass.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ

english_rwwad.text: So when the stars are effaced,

verses.translation: So when the stars are effaced,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the sky is split apart,

verses.translation: and when the sky is split apart,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the mountains are blown away,

verses.translation: and when the mountains are blown away,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the messengers are summoned[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To testify concerning their nations.

verses.translation: and when the messengers are summoned[1],

verses.arabic: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ

english_rwwad.text: until which Day has all this been postponed?

verses.translation: until which Day has all this been postponed?

verses.arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ

english_rwwad.text: Until the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: Until the Day of Judgment.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ

english_rwwad.text: How do you know what the Day of Judgment is?

verses.translation: How do you know what the Day of Judgment is?

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers[1]!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Death and destruction be upon them.

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers[1]!

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Did We not destroy the earlier nations?

verses.translation: Did We not destroy the earlier nations?

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Then We will do likewise to the later ones.

verses.translation: Then We will do likewise to the later ones.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is how We deal with the wicked.

verses.translation: This is how We deal with the wicked.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: Did We not create you from a lowly fluid,

verses.translation: Did We not create you from a lowly fluid,

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: then We placed it in a secure repository

verses.translation: then We placed it in a secure repository

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

english_rwwad.text: for a determined period[1]?

verses.translation: for a determined period[1]?

verses.arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: For We determined it; How excellently We determine!

verses.translation: For We determined it; How excellently We determine!

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا

english_rwwad.text: Have We not made the earth a receptacle[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a lodging, a container that contains all people.

verses.translation: Have We not made the earth a receptacle[1]

verses.arabic: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوَٰتًا

english_rwwad.text: for the living and the dead,

verses.translation: for the living and the dead,

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا

english_rwwad.text: and placed therein firm towering mountains, and given you fresh water to drink?

verses.translation: and placed therein firm towering mountains, and given you fresh water to drink?

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be told,] “Proceed to that [Fire] which you used to deny!

verses.translation: [They will be told,] “Proceed to that [Fire] which you used to deny!

verses.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍ

english_rwwad.text: Proceed to the shadow [of smoke] ascending in three columns,

verses.translation: Proceed to the shadow [of smoke] ascending in three columns,

verses.arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ

english_rwwad.text: that provides neither shade nor protection from the flames.

verses.translation: that provides neither shade nor protection from the flames.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, it [i.e., Hell] throws up sparks as big as castles,

verses.translation: Indeed, it [i.e., Hell] throws up sparks as big as castles,

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ

english_rwwad.text: as if they were tawny camels[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., huge and black camels.

verses.translation: as if they were tawny camels[1].

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day they won’t speak,

verses.translation: On that Day they won’t speak,

verses.arabic: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: nor will they be allowed to make excuses.

verses.translation: nor will they be allowed to make excuses.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be told,] “This is the Day of Judgment: We have gathered you along with the earlier generations.

verses.translation: [They will be told,] “This is the Day of Judgment: We have gathered you along with the earlier generations.

verses.arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ

english_rwwad.text: So if you have any scheme, then plot it against Me.”

verses.translation: So if you have any scheme, then plot it against Me.”

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the righteous will be amid shades and springs

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be amid shades and springs

verses.arabic: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and will have whatever fruit they desire.

verses.translation: and will have whatever fruit they desire.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: [They will be told,] “Eat and drink joyfully, as a reward for what you used to do.”

verses.translation: [They will be told,] “Eat and drink joyfully, as a reward for what you used to do.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

english_rwwad.text: This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.translation: This is how We reward those who do good.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a while; you are truly wicked.”

verses.translation: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a while; you are truly wicked.”

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: When it is said to them, “Bow [in prayer],” they do not bow.

verses.translation: When it is said to them, “Bow [in prayer],” they do not bow.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

verses.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: In which message after this [Qur’an] will they believe?

verses.translation: In which message after this [Qur’an] will they believe?

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: About what are they asking one another?

verses.translation: About what are they asking one another?

verses.arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: About the momentous news[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Resurrection.

verses.translation: About the momentous news[1],

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: that which they differ about[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The pagans of Makkah denied the Qur’an, resurrection, and judgment. They differed as to whether the Qur’an was magic, fortune-telling, or poetry.

verses.translation: that which they differ about[1].

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed; they will come to know.

verses.translation: No indeed; they will come to know.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Again no; they will come to know.

verses.translation: Again no; they will come to know.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًا

english_rwwad.text: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

verses.translation: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

verses.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا

english_rwwad.text: And the mountains as stakes[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Mountains go deep below the surface like pegs and icebergs, stabilizing the earth and slowing tectonic movement.

verses.translation: And the mountains as stakes[1],

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا

english_rwwad.text: and created you in pairs,

verses.translation: and created you in pairs,

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا

english_rwwad.text: and made your sleep for rest,

verses.translation: and made your sleep for rest,

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا

english_rwwad.text: and made the night a covering[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Covering you in its darkness as garments cover you.

verses.translation: and made the night a covering[1],

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا

english_rwwad.text: and made the day for seeking a livelihood,

verses.translation: and made the day for seeking a livelihood,

verses.arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا

english_rwwad.text: and built above you seven mighty heavens,

verses.translation: and built above you seven mighty heavens,

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا

english_rwwad.text: and made therein a blazing lamp,

verses.translation: and made therein a blazing lamp,

verses.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجًا

english_rwwad.text: and sent down from the rainclouds abundant water,

verses.translation: and sent down from the rainclouds abundant water,

verses.arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا

english_rwwad.text: so that We may produce thereby grains and vegetation,

verses.translation: so that We may produce thereby grains and vegetation,

verses.arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا

english_rwwad.text: and gardens with dense foliage?

verses.translation: and gardens with dense foliage?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgment is a time appointed,

verses.translation: Indeed, the Day of Judgment is a time appointed,

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا

english_rwwad.text: the Day when the Trumpet will be blown, you will come forth in crowds,

verses.translation: the Day when the Trumpet will be blown, you will come forth in crowds,

verses.arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًا

english_rwwad.text: and the sky will be opened up and will become gateways,

verses.translation: and the sky will be opened up and will become gateways,

verses.arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا

english_rwwad.text: and the mountains will be leveled, becoming like a mirage.

verses.translation: and the mountains will be leveled, becoming like a mirage.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, Hell is lying in wait,

verses.translation: Indeed, Hell is lying in wait,

verses.arabic: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًا

english_rwwad.text: a dwelling for the transgressors,

verses.translation: a dwelling for the transgressors,

verses.arabic: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًا

english_rwwad.text: wherein they will remain for endless ages.

verses.translation: wherein they will remain for endless ages.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا

english_rwwad.text: They will neither taste therein any coolness nor any drink,

verses.translation: They will neither taste therein any coolness nor any drink,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا

english_rwwad.text: except scalding water and discharge of wounds,

verses.translation: except scalding water and discharge of wounds,

verses.arabic: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا

english_rwwad.text: a fitting recompense[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To their disbelief and evil deeds.

verses.translation: a fitting recompense[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, they did not expect a reckoning,

verses.translation: Indeed, they did not expect a reckoning,

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا

english_rwwad.text: and utterly rejected Our verses.

verses.translation: and utterly rejected Our verses.

verses.arabic: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًا

english_rwwad.text: But We have enumerated everything in a record[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., a record of deeds.

verses.translation: But We have enumerated everything in a record[1].

verses.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا

english_rwwad.text: So taste [the punishment], for We will not increase you except in torment[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The addressees are the dwellers of Hell.

verses.translation: So taste [the punishment], for We will not increase you except in torment[1].”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., safety from Hell and winning Paradise.

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation[1],

verses.arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًا

english_rwwad.text: gardens and vineyards,

verses.translation: gardens and vineyards,

verses.arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا

english_rwwad.text: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age,

verses.translation: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age,

verses.arabic: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا

english_rwwad.text: and a full cup [of wine][1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., tasteful wine which neither intoxicates nor causes headache.

verses.translation: and a full cup [of wine][1].

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا

english_rwwad.text: They will not hear therein vain talk or lies –

verses.translation: They will not hear therein vain talk or lies –

verses.arabic: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا

english_rwwad.text: a reward and a generous gift from your Lord[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or "a gift adequately calculated"; as a result of their righteous deeds as well as the ample generosity of Allah.

verses.translation: a reward and a generous gift from your Lord[1],

verses.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا

english_rwwad.text: [from] the Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, the Most Compassionate; none will dare to speak to Him[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] None can ask or plead on the Day of Judgment except by Allah's permission.

verses.translation: [from] the Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, the Most Compassionate; none will dare to speak to Him[1].

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows; none will dare to speak, except those to whom the Most Compassionate granted permission, and they will only speak the truth.

verses.translation: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows; none will dare to speak, except those to whom the Most Compassionate granted permission, and they will only speak the truth.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا

english_rwwad.text: That Day is sure to come. So whoever wills may seek a path leading to his Lord[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the path of guidance and righteous deeds.

verses.translation: That Day is sure to come. So whoever wills may seek a path leading to his Lord[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment on the Day when everyone will see what his hands have sent forth[1], and the disbeliever will say, “Oh, I wish that I were dust!”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the deeds he did in this world.

verses.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment on the Day when everyone will see what his hands have sent forth[1], and the disbeliever will say, “Oh, I wish that I were dust!”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًا

english_rwwad.text: By those who pull out [evil souls][1] harshly,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of the disbelievers.

verses.translation: By those who pull out [evil souls][1] harshly,

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًا

english_rwwad.text: and by those who draw out [good souls][1] gently,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of the believers.

verses.translation: and by those who draw out [good souls][1] gently,

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًا

english_rwwad.text: and by those who glide swiftly[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., angels glide swiftly through the heavens and earth with Allah’s command.

verses.translation: and by those who glide swiftly[1],

verses.arabic: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًا

english_rwwad.text: and those who overtake one another as in a race[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To execute Allah's commands.

verses.translation: and those who overtake one another as in a race[1],

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا

english_rwwad.text: and those who carry out the command [of Allah],

verses.translation: and those who carry out the command [of Allah],

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ

english_rwwad.text: on the Day when the earth convulses [by the first Blast],

verses.translation: on the Day when the earth convulses [by the first Blast],

verses.arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ

english_rwwad.text: followed by the second Blast,

verses.translation: followed by the second Blast,

verses.arabic: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: hearts[1] will be pounding on that Day,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of those who denied the Resurrection.

verses.translation: hearts[1] will be pounding on that Day,

verses.arabic: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: and their eyes[1] will be downcast.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of the disbelievers.

verses.translation: and their eyes[1] will be downcast.

verses.arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ

english_rwwad.text: They say, “Will we be brought back to life,

verses.translation: They say, “Will we be brought back to life,

verses.arabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًا نَّخِرَةً

english_rwwad.text: after we have turned into decayed bones[1]?”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They would say this in ridicule of the warning.

verses.translation: after we have turned into decayed bones[1]?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: They say, “Then that would surely be a losing return[1]!”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To one another.

verses.translation: They say, “Then that would surely be a losing return[1]!”

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: It will only be a single Blast,

verses.translation: It will only be a single Blast,

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ

english_rwwad.text: then they will immediately be above the ground.

verses.translation: then they will immediately be above the ground.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: Has there come to you the story of Moses,

verses.translation: Has there come to you the story of Moses,

verses.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

english_rwwad.text: when his Lord called out to him at the sacred valley of Tuwa?

verses.translation: when his Lord called out to him at the sacred valley of Tuwa?

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: [Saying,] “Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed all bounds”.

verses.translation: [Saying,] “Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed all bounds”.

verses.arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: And say: ‘Are you willing to be purified,

verses.translation: And say: ‘Are you willing to be purified,

verses.arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and I will guide you to your Lord so that you may fear Him?’”

verses.translation: and I will guide you to your Lord so that you may fear Him?’”

verses.arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Then Moses showed him the greatest sign[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the miracle of the staff turning into a snake. See 20:17-23.

verses.translation: Then Moses showed him the greatest sign[1].

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: But Pharaoh denied it and disobeyed.

verses.translation: But Pharaoh denied it and disobeyed.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Then he turned back striving to plot.

verses.translation: Then he turned back striving to plot.

verses.arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: He gathered [his people] and proclaimed,

verses.translation: He gathered [his people] and proclaimed,

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: saying, “I am your lord, the most high.”

verses.translation: saying, “I am your lord, the most high.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: So Allah seized him for an exemplary punishment in this life and in the Hereafter[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or for his claim of being the greatest god and for his previous oppression of the Children of Israel.

verses.translation: So Allah seized him for an exemplary punishment in this life and in the Hereafter[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, there is a lesson in this for those who fear Allah.

verses.translation: Indeed, there is a lesson in this for those who fear Allah.

verses.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بَنَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: Are you more difficult to create or the heaven that He built?

verses.translation: Are you more difficult to create or the heaven that He built?

verses.arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: He raised its vault high and proportioned it,

verses.translation: He raised its vault high and proportioned it,

verses.arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: and darkened its night and brought forth its daylight.

verses.translation: and darkened its night and brought forth its daylight.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ

english_rwwad.text: And thereafter He spread out the earth,

verses.translation: And thereafter He spread out the earth,

verses.arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: brought forth from it its water and its pasture,

verses.translation: brought forth from it its water and its pasture,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: and set the mountains firmly,

verses.translation: and set the mountains firmly,

verses.arabic: مَتَٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: as a provision for you and your grazing livestock.

verses.translation: as a provision for you and your grazing livestock.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: But when the Supreme Calamity comes[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the second Blast which marks the Day of judgment.

verses.translation: But when the Supreme Calamity comes[1],

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: on that Day man will remember all what he did,

verses.translation: on that Day man will remember all what he did,

verses.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and the Blazing Fire will be exposed for all to see.

verses.translation: and the Blazing Fire will be exposed for all to see.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who transgressed,

verses.translation: As for those who transgressed,

verses.arabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

english_rwwad.text: and preferred the life of this world,

verses.translation: and preferred the life of this world,

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: the Blazing Fire will be their abode.

verses.translation: the Blazing Fire will be their abode.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: But those who feared standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from evil desires,

verses.translation: But those who feared standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from evil desires,

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Paradise will surely be their abode.

verses.translation: Paradise will surely be their abode.

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: They ask you concerning the Hour, “When will it be[1]?”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Lit., "established."

verses.translation: They ask you concerning the Hour, “When will it be[1]?”

verses.arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ

english_rwwad.text: How could you possibly mention that?

verses.translation: How could you possibly mention that?

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ

english_rwwad.text: Its knowledge rests only with your Lord[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., its end and termination. Its ultimate knowledge belongs to Allah alone.

verses.translation: Its knowledge rests only with your Lord[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

verses.translation: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when they see it[1], it will be as if they had remained [in this world] no more than an evening or a morning.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Hour.

verses.translation: On the Day when they see it[1], it will be as if they had remained [in this world] no more than an evening or a morning.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: He frowned and turned away,

verses.translation: He frowned and turned away,

verses.arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: when the blind man came to him[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Abdullah ibn Um Maktūm, an early Muslim who was blind, came to the Prophet (ﷺ) seeking knowledge and guidance, while the Prophet (ﷺ) was in the middle of a discussion with some leading pagans of Makkah, calling them to Islam. The Prophet (ﷺ) frowned and turned his attention from him. So this Makkan surah was revealed.

verses.translation: when the blind man came to him[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: How would you know? Perhaps he might be purified[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Through the knowledge he learns from you.

verses.translation: How would you know? Perhaps he might be purified[1],

verses.arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: or he might take heed and benefit from the reminder?

verses.translation: or he might take heed and benefit from the reminder?

verses.arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: But he who was indifferent[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Towards faith. Here it is referring to that influential pagan of the Quraysh whom the Prophet (ﷺ) had hoped to embrace Islam.

verses.translation: But he who was indifferent[1],

verses.arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: you give him your full attention,

verses.translation: you give him your full attention,

verses.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: although you are not to be blamed if he does not purify himself[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Prophets are only responsible to convey the message, not for people’s guidance.

verses.translation: although you are not to be blamed if he does not purify himself[1].

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: But as for the one who came to you striving [for purification],

verses.translation: But as for the one who came to you striving [for purification],

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and he fears Allah,

verses.translation: and he fears Allah,

verses.arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: you let yourself be distracted from him.

verses.translation: you let yourself be distracted from him.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed; this is a reminder –

verses.translation: No indeed; this is a reminder –

verses.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: so whoever wills may give heed to it –

verses.translation: so whoever wills may give heed to it –

verses.arabic: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: on venerable pages,

verses.translation: on venerable pages,

verses.arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: exalted and purified,

verses.translation: exalted and purified,

verses.arabic: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: [preserved] in the hands of angel-scribes,

verses.translation: [preserved] in the hands of angel-scribes,

verses.arabic: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: honorable and obedient.

verses.translation: honorable and obedient.

verses.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: Woe to man; how ungrateful he is[1]!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the disbelievers.

verses.translation: Woe to man; how ungrateful he is[1]!

verses.arabic: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: From what did He create him?

verses.translation: From what did He create him?

verses.arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: He created him from a drop of semen and proportioned him[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] His creation, provisions, life span, etc.

verses.translation: He created him from a drop of semen and proportioned him[1],

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: then He made the way easy for him[1];
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the way out of his mothers’ wombs (his birth), or the way to guidance.

verses.translation: then He made the way easy for him[1];

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: then He caused him to die and be buried;

verses.translation: then He caused him to die and be buried;

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

verses.translation: then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: Yet he has not fulfilled what He commanded him.

verses.translation: Yet he has not fulfilled what He commanded him.

verses.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ

english_rwwad.text: Let man consider the food he eats:

verses.translation: Let man consider the food he eats:

verses.arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّا

english_rwwad.text: How We pour down rainwater in torrents,

verses.translation: How We pour down rainwater in torrents,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّا

english_rwwad.text: and cause the soil to split open [for sprouts],

verses.translation: and cause the soil to split open [for sprouts],

verses.arabic: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا

english_rwwad.text: and cause grains to grow in it,

verses.translation: and cause grains to grow in it,

verses.arabic: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا

english_rwwad.text: as well as grapes and fodder,

verses.translation: as well as grapes and fodder,

verses.arabic: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا

english_rwwad.text: and olive trees and date palms,

verses.translation: and olive trees and date palms,

verses.arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًا

english_rwwad.text: and dense orchards,

verses.translation: and dense orchards,

verses.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةً وَأَبًّا

english_rwwad.text: and fruits and grass,

verses.translation: and fruits and grass,

verses.arabic: مَّتَٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ

english_rwwad.text: as provision for you and your livestock.

verses.translation: as provision for you and your livestock.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ

english_rwwad.text: But when the Deafening Blast[1] comes,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The piercing Blast; the second Blast for resurrection.

verses.translation: But when the Deafening Blast[1] comes,

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ

english_rwwad.text: on that Day everyone will flee from his brother,

verses.translation: on that Day everyone will flee from his brother,

verses.arabic: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ

english_rwwad.text: and from his mother and father,

verses.translation: and from his mother and father,

verses.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ

english_rwwad.text: and from his wife and children.

verses.translation: and from his wife and children.

verses.arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ

english_rwwad.text: On that day, everyone will have enough concern of his own[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Thus forgetting all others.

verses.translation: On that day, everyone will have enough concern of his own[1].

verses.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day, some faces will be bright,

verses.translation: On that Day, some faces will be bright,

verses.arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: cheerful and rejoicing;

verses.translation: cheerful and rejoicing;

verses.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: while other faces will be dust-stained on that Day,

verses.translation: while other faces will be dust-stained on that Day,

verses.arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: covered in darkness.

verses.translation: covered in darkness.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ

english_rwwad.text: Such are the disbelievers, the wicked.

verses.translation: Such are the disbelievers, the wicked.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: When the sun is wrapped up in darkness,

verses.translation: When the sun is wrapped up in darkness,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the stars fall down,

verses.translation: and when the stars fall down,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the mountains are set in motion,

verses.translation: and when the mountains are set in motion,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when pregnant camels[1] are left unattended,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Which are near delivery. It alludes to the distraction of people from their most valuable possessions, such as ten-month pregnant camels for nomadic Arabs.

verses.translation: and when pregnant camels[1] are left unattended,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when wild beasts are gathered,

verses.translation: and when wild beasts are gathered,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the seas are set on fire,

verses.translation: and when the seas are set on fire,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the souls are sorted[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., "joined" with their groups or sects, wicked with the wicked souls, righteous with the righteous.

verses.translation: and when the souls are sorted[1],

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the baby girl buried alive[1] is asked,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As the pagan Arabs used to do for fear of shame or poverty. The Qur’an condemned this practice. See 16:58-59.

verses.translation: and when the baby girl buried alive[1] is asked,

verses.arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍ قُتِلَتْ

english_rwwad.text: for what crime she was killed,

verses.translation: for what crime she was killed,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when records of deeds are spread open,

verses.translation: and when records of deeds are spread open,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the sky is stripped away[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As the skin of sheep is stripped away.

verses.translation: and when the sky is stripped away[1],

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the Blazing Fire is flared up,

verses.translation: and when the Blazing Fire is flared up,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when Paradise is brought near –

verses.translation: and when Paradise is brought near –

verses.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: then every soul will know what it has brought about[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of faith or disbelief, good or bad deeds for that Day.

verses.translation: then every soul will know what it has brought about[1].

verses.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ

english_rwwad.text: I swear by the receding stars,

verses.translation: I swear by the receding stars,

verses.arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ

english_rwwad.text: that run their course and disappear[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the stars that run their courses and then hide at their setting, as gazelles hide in their dens. "Kanasa" means sweeping or hiding.

verses.translation: that run their course and disappear[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ

english_rwwad.text: and by the night as it departs,

verses.translation: and by the night as it departs,

verses.arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ

english_rwwad.text: and by the day as it breaks –

verses.translation: and by the day as it breaks –

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, this [Qur’an] is a word conveyed by a noble angel-messenger.

verses.translation: Indeed, this [Qur’an] is a word conveyed by a noble angel-messenger.

verses.arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: endowed with power, of high standing with the Lord of the Throne,

verses.translation: endowed with power, of high standing with the Lord of the Throne,

verses.arabic: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: obeyed there [by other angels] and trustworthy.

verses.translation: obeyed there [by other angels] and trustworthy.

verses.arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: Your fellow [i.e., the Prophet] is not a madman.

verses.translation: Your fellow [i.e., the Prophet] is not a madman.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

english_rwwad.text: He indeed saw him [i.e., Gabriel] on the clear horizon[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the eastern horizon, where the sun rises. See footnote 53:6

verses.translation: He indeed saw him [i.e., Gabriel] on the clear horizon[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ

english_rwwad.text: He does not withhold [knowledge of] the unseen[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He (ﷺ) did not withhold the unseen which Allah had revealed to him in the Qur’an.

verses.translation: He does not withhold [knowledge of] the unseen[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: This [Qur’an] is not the word of an accursed devil.

verses.translation: This [Qur’an] is not the word of an accursed devil.

verses.arabic: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So which way are you going[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In your denial of the Qur’an for being the revelation from Allah.

verses.translation: So which way are you going[1]?

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: It is but a reminder to the worlds,

verses.translation: It is but a reminder to the worlds,

verses.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: for those among you who wish to take the straight path.

verses.translation: for those among you who wish to take the straight path.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: But you cannot wish except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: But you cannot wish except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: When the sky breaks apart.

verses.translation: When the sky breaks apart.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the stars fall, scattered,

verses.translation: and when the stars fall, scattered,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the seas burst forth,

verses.translation: and when the seas burst forth,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the graves are overturned,

verses.translation: and when the graves are overturned,

verses.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ

english_rwwad.text: then each soul will come to know what it has done or what it has left undone.

verses.translation: then each soul will come to know what it has done or what it has left undone.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: O mankind, what has lured you away from your Lord, the Most Generous,

verses.translation: O mankind, what has lured you away from your Lord, the Most Generous,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ

english_rwwad.text: Who created you, then shaped and proportioned you,

verses.translation: Who created you, then shaped and proportioned you,

verses.arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ

english_rwwad.text: and assembled you in whatever form He willed?

verses.translation: and assembled you in whatever form He willed?

verses.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed; but you deny the Judgment Day,

verses.translation: No indeed; but you deny the Judgment Day,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ

english_rwwad.text: while there are watchers[1] over you,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., angels who preserve all your deeds.

verses.translation: while there are watchers[1] over you,

verses.arabic: كِرَامًا كَٰتِبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: honorable scribes,

verses.translation: honorable scribes,

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: who know whatever you do.

verses.translation: who know whatever you do.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in Bliss,

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in Bliss,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: and the wicked will be in Blazing Fire,

verses.translation: and the wicked will be in Blazing Fire,

verses.arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: which they will enter on Judgment Day,

verses.translation: which they will enter on Judgment Day,

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and will never come out of it.

verses.translation: and will never come out of it.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: How do you know what Judgment Day is?

verses.translation: How do you know what Judgment Day is?

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: Again, how do you know what Judgment Day is?

verses.translation: Again, how do you know what Judgment Day is?

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ

english_rwwad.text: It is the Day when no soul will be of any help to another, and all command on that Day will be with Allah.

verses.translation: It is the Day when no soul will be of any help to another, and all command on that Day will be with Allah.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe to the defrauders[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those who cheat people by giving them less in sale transactions, an amount so little as to hardly be noticed.

verses.translation: Woe to the defrauders[1],

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those who take full measure when they take from others,

verses.translation: those who take full measure when they take from others,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: but they give less when they measure or weigh for them.

verses.translation: but they give less when they measure or weigh for them.

verses.arabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Do they really not think that they will be resurrected

verses.translation: Do they really not think that they will be resurrected

verses.arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: for a momentous Day,

verses.translation: for a momentous Day,

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: a Day when people will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

verses.translation: a Day when people will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! The record of the wicked is surely in Sijjīn.

verses.translation: No indeed! The record of the wicked is surely in Sijjīn.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ

english_rwwad.text: How do you know what Sijjīn is?

verses.translation: How do you know what Sijjīn is?

verses.arabic: كِتَٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ

english_rwwad.text: It is a clearly inscribed Record.

verses.translation: It is a clearly inscribed Record.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Woe on that Day to the deniers,

verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: those who deny the Judgment Day!

verses.translation: those who deny the Judgment Day!

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: None denies it except every sinful transgressor.

verses.translation: None denies it except every sinful transgressor.

verses.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables[1]!”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., tales of old times, legends of former peoples.

verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables[1]!”

verses.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! Their hearts have been stained by what they used to commit[1]!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., their sins and evil deeds.

verses.translation: No indeed! Their hearts have been stained by what they used to commit[1]!

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! On that Day they will be barred from seeing their Lord[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As a punishment, since the believers will see Him.

verses.translation: No indeed! On that Day they will be barred from seeing their Lord[1].

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: They will then surely enter the Blazing Fire,

verses.translation: They will then surely enter the Blazing Fire,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: then they will be told, “This is what you used to deny.”

verses.translation: then they will be told, “This is what you used to deny.”

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! The record of the righteous is certainly in ‘illiyyīn –

verses.translation: No indeed! The record of the righteous is certainly in ‘illiyyīn –

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ

english_rwwad.text: and how do you know what ‘illiyyūn is? –

verses.translation: and how do you know what ‘illiyyūn is? –

verses.arabic: كِتَٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ

english_rwwad.text: It is a record inscribed,

verses.translation: It is a record inscribed,

verses.arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: witnessed by those who are close to Allah.

verses.translation: witnessed by those who are close to Allah.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in Bliss,

verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in Bliss,

verses.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: seated on couches, gazing in wonder.

verses.translation: seated on couches, gazing in wonder.

verses.arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: You will see on their faces the radiance of bliss.

verses.translation: You will see on their faces the radiance of bliss.

verses.arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ

english_rwwad.text: They will be served to drink pure wine from a sealed container,

verses.translation: They will be served to drink pure wine from a sealed container,

verses.arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ

english_rwwad.text: whose last sip is musk[1] – so let the competitors compete for that –
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., having a lingering odor.

verses.translation: whose last sip is musk[1] – so let the competitors compete for that –

verses.arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: and it will be mixed with water from the spring of Tasnīm[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It is the highest spring in Paradise.

verses.translation: and it will be mixed with water from the spring of Tasnīm[1],

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: a spring from which those who are close to Allah will drink.

verses.translation: a spring from which those who are close to Allah will drink.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers;

verses.translation: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers;

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ

english_rwwad.text: when they passed by them, they would wink at one another,

verses.translation: when they passed by them, they would wink at one another,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and when they went back to their people, they would return exulting.

verses.translation: and when they went back to their people, they would return exulting.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

english_rwwad.text: When they saw the believers, they would say, “These people are truly misguided,”

verses.translation: When they saw the believers, they would say, “These people are truly misguided,”

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ

english_rwwad.text: although they were not sent as their keepers.

verses.translation: although they were not sent as their keepers.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ

english_rwwad.text: So Today[1] the believers will laugh at the disbelievers,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Day of Judgment.

verses.translation: So Today[1] the believers will laugh at the disbelievers,

verses.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: while sitting on couches, gazing around.

verses.translation: while sitting on couches, gazing around.

verses.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Have the disbelievers been rewarded except for what they used to do?

verses.translation: Have the disbelievers been rewarded except for what they used to do?

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ

english_rwwad.text: When the sky is rent asunder,

verses.translation: When the sky is rent asunder,

verses.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ

english_rwwad.text: and hearkens to its Lord[1], as it must,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In full obedience.

verses.translation: and hearkens to its Lord[1], as it must,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ

english_rwwad.text: and when the earth is leveled out[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., spread out.

verses.translation: and when the earth is leveled out[1],

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ

english_rwwad.text: and casts out all what it contains[1], and becomes empty,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., its dead bodies and treasures buried in it.

verses.translation: and casts out all what it contains[1], and becomes empty,

verses.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ

english_rwwad.text: and hearkens to its Lord, as it must,

verses.translation: and hearkens to its Lord, as it must,

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ

english_rwwad.text: O humans, you are toiling towards your Lord[1], and you will surely meet Him[2].
english_rwwad.footnotes:
[1] i.e., striving in doing good or evil until you meet your Lord.
 [2] To be recompensed by Him for your deeds.

verses.translation: O humans, you are toiling towards your Lord[1], and you will surely meet Him[2].

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ

english_rwwad.text: Whoever is given his Record in his right hand,

verses.translation: Whoever is given his Record in his right hand,

verses.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: he will have an easy reckoning,

verses.translation: he will have an easy reckoning,

verses.arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا

english_rwwad.text: and he will return to his people joyfully.

verses.translation: and he will return to his people joyfully.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ

english_rwwad.text: But whoever is given his Record from behind his back,

verses.translation: But whoever is given his Record from behind his back,

verses.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا

english_rwwad.text: he will call out for destruction,

verses.translation: he will call out for destruction,

verses.arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: and he will enter the Blazing Fire.

verses.translation: and he will enter the Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, he used to live among his people joyfully.

verses.translation: Indeed, he used to live among his people joyfully.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ

english_rwwad.text: and he thought that he would never return [to Allah].

verses.translation: and he thought that he would never return [to Allah].

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed he will! His Lord was always watching him.

verses.translation: Indeed he will! His Lord was always watching him.

verses.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, I swear by the twilight,

verses.translation: Indeed, I swear by the twilight,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ

english_rwwad.text: and by the night and what it covers,

verses.translation: and by the night and what it covers,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ

english_rwwad.text: and by the moon when it becomes full,

verses.translation: and by the moon when it becomes full,

verses.arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ

english_rwwad.text: You will surely pass from one stage to another[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., from sperm-drop to clinging clot to lump, from life to death to resurrection.

verses.translation: You will surely pass from one stage to another[1].

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Then what is the matter with them that they do not believe,

verses.translation: Then what is the matter with them that they do not believe,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and when the Qur’an is recited to them, they do not prostrate?

verses.translation: and when the Qur’an is recited to them, they do not prostrate?

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Rather, the disbelievers persist in denying it,

verses.translation: Rather, the disbelievers persist in denying it,

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: but Allah knows best whatever they harbor in their hearts.

verses.translation: but Allah knows best whatever they harbor in their hearts.

verses.arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: So give them the tidings of a painful punishment.

verses.translation: So give them the tidings of a painful punishment.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: But those who believe and do righteous deeds will have a never-ending reward.

verses.translation: But those who believe and do righteous deeds will have a never-ending reward.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ

english_rwwad.text: By the sky full of constellations,

verses.translation: By the sky full of constellations,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ

english_rwwad.text: and by the promised Day,

verses.translation: and by the promised Day,

verses.arabic: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ

english_rwwad.text: and by the witness and the witnessed,

verses.translation: and by the witness and the witnessed,

verses.arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ

english_rwwad.text: cursed be the makers of the trench[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Those who worked for a tyrannical king and did not allow the people to believe in Allah. Their blind obedience to their ruler incurred upon them the curse of Allah.

verses.translation: cursed be the makers of the trench[1],

verses.arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ

english_rwwad.text: the fire full of fuel,

verses.translation: the fire full of fuel,

verses.arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ

english_rwwad.text: when they sat around it,

verses.translation: when they sat around it,

verses.arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ

english_rwwad.text: and were witnessing what they did to the believers[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] After the believers were casted into a trench of fire, they sat around it watching them burn to death. It occurred long before Prophet Muhammad's (ﷺ) time.

verses.translation: and were witnessing what they did to the believers[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ

english_rwwad.text: Their only grievance against them was that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Praiseworthy,

verses.translation: Their only grievance against them was that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Praiseworthy,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and Allah is Witness over all things.

verses.translation: to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and Allah is Witness over all things.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, for those who tortured the believing men and women, and then did not repent, there will be the punishment of Hell and the punishment of the burning fire[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Those who burned the believers will be punished with the burning fire in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: Indeed, for those who tortured the believing men and women, and then did not repent, there will be the punishment of Hell and the punishment of the burning fire[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

english_rwwad.text: But those who believed and did righteous deeds will certainly have gardens under which rivers flow; that is the supreme triumph.

verses.translation: But those who believed and did righteous deeds will certainly have gardens under which rivers flow; that is the supreme triumph.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is severe.

verses.translation: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is severe.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, it is He Who originates [the creation] and then resurrects all,

verses.translation: Indeed, it is He Who originates [the creation] and then resurrects all,

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ

english_rwwad.text: and He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Affectionate,

verses.translation: and He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Affectionate,

verses.arabic: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ

english_rwwad.text: the Lord of the Glorious Throne;

verses.translation: the Lord of the Glorious Throne;

verses.arabic: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ

english_rwwad.text: He does whatever He wills.

verses.translation: He does whatever He wills.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ

english_rwwad.text: Has there not come to you the story of the forces

verses.translation: Has there not come to you the story of the forces

verses.arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ

english_rwwad.text: of Pharaoh and Thamūd?

verses.translation: of Pharaoh and Thamūd?

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ

english_rwwad.text: But the disbelievers are in persistent denial,

verses.translation: But the disbelievers are in persistent denial,

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ

english_rwwad.text: although Allah encompasses them from all sides.

verses.translation: although Allah encompasses them from all sides.

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: But this is a glorious Qur’an,

verses.translation: But this is a glorious Qur’an,

verses.arabic: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: [inscribed] in a Preserved Tablet.

verses.translation: [inscribed] in a Preserved Tablet.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ

english_rwwad.text: By the sky and the night comer –

verses.translation: By the sky and the night comer –

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ

english_rwwad.text: and how do you know what the night comer is?

verses.translation: and how do you know what the night comer is?

verses.arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ

english_rwwad.text: It is the star of piercing brightness[1] –
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Whose light pierces through the darkness or through the sky.

verses.translation: It is the star of piercing brightness[1] –

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ

english_rwwad.text: there is no soul except that there is a watcher over it.

verses.translation: there is no soul except that there is a watcher over it.

verses.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ

english_rwwad.text: Let man reflect on what he was created from.

verses.translation: Let man reflect on what he was created from.

verses.arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ

english_rwwad.text: He was created from a spurting fluid,

verses.translation: He was created from a spurting fluid,

verses.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ

english_rwwad.text: emerging from between the backbone and the ribs[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Both testes and ovaries are sustained by arteries originating between the backbone and the ribcage.

verses.translation: emerging from between the backbone and the ribs[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, Allah is able to bring him back to life.

verses.translation: Indeed, Allah is able to bring him back to life.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ

english_rwwad.text: On the Day when all secrets will be disclosed[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The secrets will be examined, disclosing the real intentions and faiths people harbored, distinguishing between righteous and evil therefrom.

verses.translation: On the Day when all secrets will be disclosed[1],

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: he will then have no power, nor any helper.

verses.translation: he will then have no power, nor any helper.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ

english_rwwad.text: By the sky and its recurring rain[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] And sun, moon, stars, clouds, heat, etc.

verses.translation: By the sky and its recurring rain[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ

english_rwwad.text: and by the earth that cracks open [with the sprout of plants],

verses.translation: and by the earth that cracks open [with the sprout of plants],

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, this [Qur’an] is a decisive word,

verses.translation: Indeed, this [Qur’an] is a decisive word,

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ

english_rwwad.text: which is not for amusement.

verses.translation: which is not for amusement.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, they are devising a plan.

verses.translation: Indeed, they are devising a plan.

verses.arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
