english_rwwad.text: I am too devising a plan.

verses.translation: I am too devising a plan.

verses.arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا

english_rwwad.text: So bear with the disbelievers and respite them for a while[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Do not be in haste in seeking their punishment and destruction.

verses.translation: So bear with the disbelievers and respite them for a while[1].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى

english_rwwad.text: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,

verses.translation: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Who created and fashioned in due proportion,

verses.translation: Who created and fashioned in due proportion,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and Who determined [the creation] then inspired them,

verses.translation: and Who determined [the creation] then inspired them,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and Who brings forth the pasture,

verses.translation: and Who brings forth the pasture,

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: then makes it into withered chaff.

verses.translation: then makes it into withered chaff.

verses.arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: We will teach you [the Qur’an], so you will not forget,

verses.translation: We will teach you [the Qur’an], so you will not forget,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: except what Allah wills[1], for indeed He knows what is manifest and what is hidden.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., except what Allah wills to make you forget for wisdom such as abrogating or replacing a ruling by another.

verses.translation: except what Allah wills[1], for indeed He knows what is manifest and what is hidden.

verses.arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: We will guide you to the easy way[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To the way of Islam which brings about ease in this life and attainment of Paradise in the Hereafter, or will give you opportunities for righteous deeds that lead to Paradise.

verses.translation: We will guide you to the easy way[1].

verses.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: So remind, if the reminder should benefit[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Wherever this Qur’an will be heard.

verses.translation: So remind, if the reminder should benefit[1].

verses.arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: He who fears Allah will take heed,

verses.translation: He who fears Allah will take heed,

verses.arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى

english_rwwad.text: but the wretched will avoid it,

verses.translation: but the wretched will avoid it,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: who will enter the Great Fire,

verses.translation: who will enter the Great Fire,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: wherein he will neither die nor live.

verses.translation: wherein he will neither die nor live.

verses.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, he who purifies himself will attain success,

verses.translation: Indeed, he who purifies himself will attain success,

verses.arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and remembers his Lord’s Name and prays.

verses.translation: and remembers his Lord’s Name and prays.

verses.arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

english_rwwad.text: But you prefer the life of this world,

verses.translation: But you prefer the life of this world,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: even though the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

verses.translation: even though the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, this was in the earlier Scriptures,

verses.translation: Indeed, this was in the earlier Scriptures,

verses.arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

verses.translation: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ

english_rwwad.text: Has there come to you the story of the Overwhelming Event?

verses.translation: Has there come to you the story of the Overwhelming Event?

verses.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day, some faces will be humiliated,

verses.translation: On that Day, some faces will be humiliated,

verses.arabic: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: overburdened and weary[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] They will be burdened with the heavy shackles in the Hereafter, or they performed deeds in their worldly life which were bereft of faith or not done for the sake of Allah.

verses.translation: overburdened and weary[1],

verses.arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً

english_rwwad.text: as they burn in a scorching Fire.

verses.translation: as they burn in a scorching Fire.

verses.arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: They will be made to drink from a boiling spring,

verses.translation: They will be made to drink from a boiling spring,

verses.arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ

english_rwwad.text: and they will have no food except bitter thorny plants,

verses.translation: and they will have no food except bitter thorny plants,

verses.arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ

english_rwwad.text: that neither nourishes nor satisfies hunger.

verses.translation: that neither nourishes nor satisfies hunger.

verses.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: Other faces on that Day will be joyful,

verses.translation: Other faces on that Day will be joyful,

verses.arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: well-pleased with their past striving,

verses.translation: well-pleased with their past striving,

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: in an elevated garden,

verses.translation: in an elevated garden,

verses.arabic: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةً

english_rwwad.text: wherein no idle talk will be heard[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Rather than an insult, falsehood, immorality, etc.

verses.translation: wherein no idle talk will be heard[1].

verses.arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: There will be a flowing spring;

verses.translation: There will be a flowing spring;

verses.arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: and couches raised high,

verses.translation: and couches raised high,

verses.arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: and cups placed ready,

verses.translation: and cups placed ready,

verses.arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: and cushions lined up,

verses.translation: and cushions lined up,

verses.arabic: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: and splendid carpets spread out.

verses.translation: and splendid carpets spread out.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

english_rwwad.text: Do they not reflect on the camel, how it is created;

verses.translation: Do they not reflect on the camel, how it is created;

verses.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and the sky, how it is raised high;

verses.translation: and the sky, how it is raised high;

verses.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and the mountains, how they are firmly set up;

verses.translation: and the mountains, how they are firmly set up;

verses.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ

english_rwwad.text: and the earth, how it is spread out?

verses.translation: and the earth, how it is spread out?

verses.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ

english_rwwad.text: So remind [O Prophet]; your duty is only to remind;

verses.translation: So remind [O Prophet]; your duty is only to remind;

verses.arabic: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ

english_rwwad.text: you are not assigned to compel them.

verses.translation: you are not assigned to compel them.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ

english_rwwad.text: But whoever turns away and disbelieves,

verses.translation: But whoever turns away and disbelieves,

verses.arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ

english_rwwad.text: Allah will inflict upon him the greatest punishment[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the greatest punishment is the Hellfire. The minor punishment includes disasters in worldly life and grave punishment.

verses.translation: Allah will inflict upon him the greatest punishment[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, to Us is their return,

verses.translation: Indeed, to Us is their return,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم

english_rwwad.text: then it is for Us to call them to account.

verses.translation: then it is for Us to call them to account.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْفَجْرِ

english_rwwad.text: By the dawn,

verses.translation: By the dawn,

verses.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ

english_rwwad.text: and the ten nights[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the first ten nights of the lunar month of Dhul-Hijjah.

verses.translation: and the ten nights[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ

english_rwwad.text: and the even and the odd[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of the things.

verses.translation: and the even and the odd[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ

english_rwwad.text: and by the night when it comes,

verses.translation: and by the night when it comes,

verses.arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ

english_rwwad.text: are these oaths not sufficient for those who have sense?

verses.translation: are these oaths not sufficient for those who have sense?

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

english_rwwad.text: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ‘Ād

verses.translation: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ‘Ād

verses.arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ

english_rwwad.text: of Iram[1], who were people of great stature,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Iram: an ancient tribe; or a well-known tribe in Yemen; or the grandfather of the people of ‘Aad, etc. Prophet Hūd was sent to the people of ‘Aad.

verses.translation: of Iram[1], who were people of great stature,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ

english_rwwad.text: the like of whom had never been created in the land;

verses.translation: the like of whom had never been created in the land;

verses.arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ

english_rwwad.text: and Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the Valley;

verses.translation: and Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the Valley;

verses.arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ

english_rwwad.text: and the mighty and powerful[1] Pharaoh?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or the owner of the stakes by which he used to torture people.

verses.translation: and the mighty and powerful[1] Pharaoh?

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ

english_rwwad.text: All of them transgressed in the land,

verses.translation: All of them transgressed in the land,

verses.arabic: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ

english_rwwad.text: and spread therein much corruption,

verses.translation: and spread therein much corruption,

verses.arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ

english_rwwad.text: so your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

verses.translation: so your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, your Lord is ever vigilant.

verses.translation: Indeed, your Lord is ever vigilant.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ

english_rwwad.text: As for man, when he is tested by his Lord by honoring him and bestowing blessings upon him, he says, “My Lord has [deservedly] honored me[1]!”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Instead of being grateful, he is proud, attributing the favor to his own merit.

verses.translation: As for man, when he is tested by his Lord by honoring him and bestowing blessings upon him, he says, “My Lord has [deservedly] honored me[1]!”

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ

english_rwwad.text: But when he is tested by restricting his provision, he says, “My Lord has [undeservedly] humiliated me!”

verses.translation: But when he is tested by restricting his provision, he says, “My Lord has [undeservedly] humiliated me!”

verses.arabic: كَلَّا بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed[1]! You are not kind to the orphan,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It is not as you think. Allah puts people to test through prosperity and hardship and rewards their gratitude and patience in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: No indeed[1]! You are not kind to the orphan,

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

english_rwwad.text: nor do you urge one another to feed the needy,

verses.translation: nor do you urge one another to feed the needy,

verses.arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا

english_rwwad.text: and you greedily consume the entire inheritance[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Whether lawful or unlawful.

verses.translation: and you greedily consume the entire inheritance[1],

verses.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا

english_rwwad.text: and love wealth immensely.

verses.translation: and love wealth immensely.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! When the earth is crushed over and over,

verses.translation: No indeed! When the earth is crushed over and over,

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا

english_rwwad.text: and your Lord comes[1] with the angels, rank after rank,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To pass judgment between people.

verses.translation: and your Lord comes[1] with the angels, rank after rank,

verses.arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and Hell is brought near on that Day – this is when man will understand, but what is the use of that understanding?

verses.translation: and Hell is brought near on that Day – this is when man will understand, but what is the use of that understanding?

verses.arabic: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى

english_rwwad.text: He will say, “Would that I had sent forth something for my [eternal] life!”

verses.translation: He will say, “Would that I had sent forth something for my [eternal] life!”

verses.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

english_rwwad.text: None can punish as He punishes on that Day,

verses.translation: None can punish as He punishes on that Day,

verses.arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

english_rwwad.text: and none can bind as He binds.

verses.translation: and none can bind as He binds.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ

english_rwwad.text: [It will be said to the believer,] “O tranquil soul!

verses.translation: [It will be said to the believer,] “O tranquil soul!

verses.arabic: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً

english_rwwad.text: Return to your Lord, well pleased and pleasing [to Him].

verses.translation: Return to your Lord, well pleased and pleasing [to Him].

verses.arabic: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى

english_rwwad.text: Join My [righteous] slaves,

verses.translation: Join My [righteous] slaves,

verses.arabic: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى

english_rwwad.text: and enter My Paradise.”

verses.translation: and enter My Paradise.”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ

english_rwwad.text: I do swear by this city [of Makkah] –

verses.translation: I do swear by this city [of Makkah] –

verses.arabic: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ

english_rwwad.text: and you are free of restriction [for a while] in this city[1] –
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To punish the enemies of Islam on the Conquest Day.

verses.translation: and you are free of restriction [for a while] in this city[1] –

verses.arabic: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ

english_rwwad.text: and by every parent[1] and his offspring,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Adam.

verses.translation: and by every parent[1] and his offspring,

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ

english_rwwad.text: We have created man in hardship.

verses.translation: We have created man in hardship.

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ

english_rwwad.text: Does he think that none can ever have power over him?

verses.translation: Does he think that none can ever have power over him?

verses.arabic: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا

english_rwwad.text: He says, “I have squandered enormous wealth!”

verses.translation: He says, “I have squandered enormous wealth!”

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

english_rwwad.text: Does he think that no one sees him?

verses.translation: Does he think that no one sees him?

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ

english_rwwad.text: Have We not given him two eyes,

verses.translation: Have We not given him two eyes,

verses.arabic: وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ

english_rwwad.text: and a tongue and two lips,

verses.translation: and a tongue and two lips,

verses.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ

english_rwwad.text: and shown him the two ways [of right and wrong]?

verses.translation: and shown him the two ways [of right and wrong]?

verses.arabic: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ

english_rwwad.text: Yet he did not make his way through the steep path[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He did not spend for the sake of Allah but to show off.

verses.translation: Yet he did not make his way through the steep path[1],

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ

english_rwwad.text: and how do you know what the steep path is?

verses.translation: and how do you know what the steep path is?

verses.arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: It is freeing a slave,

verses.translation: It is freeing a slave,

verses.arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: or giving food on a day of hunger,

verses.translation: or giving food on a day of hunger,

verses.arabic: يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: to an orphan relative,

verses.translation: to an orphan relative,

verses.arabic: أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: or to a needy person in misery,

verses.translation: or to a needy person in misery,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ

english_rwwad.text: then [most importantly] to be one of those who believe and exhort one another to patience and exhort one another to compassion.

verses.translation: then [most importantly] to be one of those who believe and exhort one another to patience and exhort one another to compassion.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ

english_rwwad.text: Such are the people of the Right[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those who receive the records of their deeds in the right hand and proceed to Paradise.

verses.translation: Such are the people of the Right[1].

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who reject Our signs, they are the people of the Left[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those who receive the records of their deeds in the left hand and proceed to Hellfire.

verses.translation: As for those who reject Our signs, they are the people of the Left[1],

verses.arabic: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ

english_rwwad.text: who will be locked up in the Fire.

verses.translation: who will be locked up in the Fire.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: By the sun and its brightness,

verses.translation: By the sun and its brightness,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: and by the moon as it follows it[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., appears after the sun disappears.

verses.translation: and by the moon as it follows it[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: and by the day as it displays it[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the earth or the sun.

verses.translation: and by the day as it displays it[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: and by the night as it covers it[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the earth or the sun.

verses.translation: and by the night as it covers it[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: and by the sky and how He made it,

verses.translation: and by the sky and how He made it,

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: and by the earth and how He spread it,

verses.translation: and by the earth and how He spread it,

verses.arabic: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: and by the soul and how He fashioned it[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By sound natural disposition.

verses.translation: and by the soul and how He fashioned it[1],

verses.arabic: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: then inspired it [to know] its wickedness and righteousness,

verses.translation: then inspired it [to know] its wickedness and righteousness,

verses.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, he who purifies his soul will attain success,

verses.translation: Indeed, he who purifies his soul will attain success,

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: and he who corrupts it will be doomed.

verses.translation: and he who corrupts it will be doomed.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ

english_rwwad.text: Thamūd rejected [the messenger] because of their transgression,

verses.translation: Thamūd rejected [the messenger] because of their transgression,

verses.arabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: when the most wretched among them rose[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To kill the camel that Allah sent as a miracle to them.

verses.translation: when the most wretched among them rose[1].

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: Although the messenger of Allah warned them, “Hands off the she-camel of Allah and her drink!”

verses.translation: Although the messenger of Allah warned them, “Hands off the she-camel of Allah and her drink!”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: Yet they rejected him and hamstrung her[1]. So their Lord destroyed them for their sin and leveled them to the ground.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] And then killed her.

verses.translation: Yet they rejected him and hamstrung her[1]. So their Lord destroyed them for their sin and leveled them to the ground.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا

english_rwwad.text: And He has no fear of the consequences thereof[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah is not asked for what He does, but His slaves will be asked. See 21:23

verses.translation: And He has no fear of the consequences thereof[1].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: By the night when it covers[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Everything between sky and earth with its darkness.

verses.translation: By the night when it covers[1],

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and by the day when it appears,

verses.translation: and by the day when it appears,

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: and by His creation of male and female,

verses.translation: and by His creation of male and female,

verses.arabic: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: surely your efforts are diverse [in aims and purposes].

verses.translation: surely your efforts are diverse [in aims and purposes].

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: As for the one who gives in charity and fears Allah,

verses.translation: As for the one who gives in charity and fears Allah,

verses.arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and truly believes in the best reward,

verses.translation: and truly believes in the best reward,

verses.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: We will make easy for him the way of salvation.

verses.translation: We will make easy for him the way of salvation.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: But as for the one who is miserly and deems himself self-sufficient,

verses.translation: But as for the one who is miserly and deems himself self-sufficient,

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and denies the best reward,

verses.translation: and denies the best reward,

verses.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: We will make easy for him the way of perdition.

verses.translation: We will make easy for him the way of perdition.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: His wealth will be of no avail to him when he tumbles [into Hell].

verses.translation: His wealth will be of no avail to him when he tumbles [into Hell].

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, it is upon Us to show the right way,

verses.translation: Indeed, it is upon Us to show the right way,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and surely to Us belong the Hereafter and the present life.

verses.translation: and surely to Us belong the Hereafter and the present life.

verses.arabic: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: So I warn you of a raging Fire,

verses.translation: So I warn you of a raging Fire,

verses.arabic: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى

english_rwwad.text: none will enter it except the most wretched,

verses.translation: none will enter it except the most wretched,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: who denied and turned away.

verses.translation: who denied and turned away.

verses.arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى

english_rwwad.text: But the most righteous will be saved from it,

verses.translation: But the most righteous will be saved from it,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ

english_rwwad.text: who spends his wealth to purify himself,

verses.translation: who spends his wealth to purify himself,

verses.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: not in return for someone’s favors[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., not as a repayment for a favor he received.

verses.translation: not in return for someone’s favors[1],

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: but to seek the pleasure of his Lord, the Most High.

verses.translation: but to seek the pleasure of his Lord, the Most High.

verses.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: He will surely be well pleased.

verses.translation: He will surely be well pleased.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلضُّحَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: By the morning sunlight,

verses.translation: By the morning sunlight,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: and by the night when it covers with darkness[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] And everything becomes still.

verses.translation: and by the night when it covers with darkness[1],

verses.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: your Lord has neither forsaken you [O Prophet] nor hated you;

verses.translation: your Lord has neither forsaken you [O Prophet] nor hated you;

verses.arabic: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: the Hereafter is better for you than the present life;

verses.translation: the Hereafter is better for you than the present life;

verses.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: and your Lord will certainly give you so much that you will be well pleased.

verses.translation: and your Lord will certainly give you so much that you will be well pleased.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Did He not find you an orphan then take good care of you?

verses.translation: Did He not find you an orphan then take good care of you?

verses.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Did He not find you unguided then guide you?

verses.translation: Did He not find you unguided then guide you?

verses.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Did He not find you in need then enrich you?

verses.translation: Did He not find you in need then enrich you?

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ

english_rwwad.text: So do not mistreat the orphan,

verses.translation: So do not mistreat the orphan,

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ

english_rwwad.text: nor repulse the beggar[1];
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., anyone in need who seeks help.

verses.translation: nor repulse the beggar[1];

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ

english_rwwad.text: and proclaim the favors of your Lord[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., be grateful to Allah by proclaiming the favors He has given you.

verses.translation: and proclaim the favors of your Lord[1].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ

english_rwwad.text: Have We not reassured your heart for you [O Prophet][1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., enlighten and gladden your heart for receiving the revelation.

verses.translation: Have We not reassured your heart for you [O Prophet][1],

verses.arabic: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ

english_rwwad.text: and relieved you of your burden[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] forgave your previous or future errors, or relieved you of the anxiety you experienced at the beginning of your mission.

verses.translation: and relieved you of your burden[1]

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ

english_rwwad.text: that weighed down your back,

verses.translation: that weighed down your back,

verses.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ

english_rwwad.text: and raised high your fame for you[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah raised the Prophet's name in numerous ways, such as his name is mentioned twice in the call to prayer five times a day, as well the second call to prayer; at the end of each of the five daily prayers; believers invoke Allah’s blessings upon him and his family; and upon reverting to Islam, his name is mentioned, etc.

verses.translation: and raised high your fame for you[1]?

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

english_rwwad.text: For indeed, with hardship comes ease[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In Arabic grammar, if a definite noun is repeated, it is referring to the same thing. However, if an indefinite noun is repeated, it is referring to two different things. So here in this and the coming verse they refer to one hardship (a definite noun) and two eases (an indefinite noun), which manifests Allah's favors upon His servants even in times of hardships.

verses.translation: For indeed, with hardship comes ease[1],

verses.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

english_rwwad.text: indeed, with hardship comes ease.

verses.translation: indeed, with hardship comes ease.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ

english_rwwad.text: So whenever you are free[1], strive in worship,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of your duties.

verses.translation: So whenever you are free[1], strive in worship,

verses.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب

english_rwwad.text: and turn to your Lord in devotion.

verses.translation: and turn to your Lord in devotion.

verses.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ

english_rwwad.text: By the fig and the olive[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of Jerusalem.

verses.translation: By the fig and the olive[1],

verses.arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ

english_rwwad.text: and by Mount Sinai[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Of Egypt.

verses.translation: and by Mount Sinai[1],

verses.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ

english_rwwad.text: and by this secure city [of Makkah][1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This passage refers to the land of the three great prophets of Allah: Jesus (ﷺ) lived in the land of figs and olives, Moses (ﷺ) communicated with Allah on Mount Sinai, and Muhammad's (ﷺ) birthplace was Makkah. There is a similar reference in Deuteronomy 33:1, [Moses said:] “The Lord came from Sinai. Rising from Seir upon us, and he shone forth from Mount Paran.” Seir is a mountain near Jerusalem, and Paran is a mountain near Makkah.

verses.translation: and by this secure city [of Makkah][1],

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ

english_rwwad.text: Surely We have created man in the best form[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., in upright and balanced form and nature.

verses.translation: Surely We have created man in the best form[1],

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ

english_rwwad.text: then We will reduce him to the lowest of the low[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., to the depths of Hell due to deviation from uprightness; or to decrepit old age.

verses.translation: then We will reduce him to the lowest of the low[1],

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

english_rwwad.text: except those who believe and do righteous deeds; they will have a never-ending reward.

verses.translation: except those who believe and do righteous deeds; they will have a never-ending reward.

verses.arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: Then, what makes you deny the Judgment Day?

verses.translation: Then, what makes you deny the Judgment Day?

verses.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ

english_rwwad.text: Is not Allah the Most Just of all judges?

verses.translation: Is not Allah the Most Just of all judges?

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ

english_rwwad.text: Read in the name of your Lord Who created,

verses.translation: Read in the name of your Lord Who created,

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ

english_rwwad.text: created man from a clinging clot.

verses.translation: created man from a clinging clot.

verses.arabic: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ

english_rwwad.text: Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous,

verses.translation: Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ

english_rwwad.text: Who taught by the pen,

verses.translation: Who taught by the pen,

verses.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ

english_rwwad.text: taught man what he did not know[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] These five verses (1-5) are the first ever verses revealed of the Qur’an. The Prophet (ﷺ) was retreating at a cave in the outskirts of Makkah when the angel Gabriel appeared before him, and ordered him to read. Since the Prophet (ﷺ) was unlettered, he would respond, “I cannot read.” Gabriel would then squeeze him tightly and order him again to read. Ultimately, Gabriel said to him: “Read in the name of your Lord …”.

verses.translation: taught man what he did not know[1].

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, man transgresses

verses.translation: Indeed, man transgresses

verses.arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: when he deems himself to be self-sufficient.

verses.translation: when he deems himself to be self-sufficient.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

verses.translation: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

verses.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Have you seen the one who prevents[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Abu Jahl was a pagan leader of the Makkah who was an arch-enemy of Islam.

verses.translation: Have you seen the one who prevents[1]

verses.arabic: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: a slave [of Allah] from praying[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Abu Jahl abused the Prophet (ﷺ) when he prayed in the Holy Mosque.

verses.translation: a slave [of Allah] from praying[1]?

verses.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: What if this [slave] is rightly guided,

verses.translation: What if this [slave] is rightly guided,

verses.arabic: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: and enjoins righteousness?

verses.translation: and enjoins righteousness?

verses.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

english_rwwad.text: How about the one who denies and turns away[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] From what the Prophet (ﷺ) has brought and does he not fear Allah?

verses.translation: How about the one who denies and turns away[1]?

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ

english_rwwad.text: Does he not know that Allah sees all?

verses.translation: Does he not know that Allah sees all?

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed; if he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] To the Hellfire.

verses.translation: No indeed; if he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock[1]

verses.arabic: نَاصِيَةٍ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: a lying, sinful forelock[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] It alludes to the frontal lobe of the brain, where reasoning is processed.

verses.translation: a lying, sinful forelock[1].

verses.arabic: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: So let him call his associates;

verses.translation: So let him call his associates;

verses.arabic: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ

english_rwwad.text: We will call the wardens of Hellfire[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the coarse, rigorous, and harsh angels assigned for the Hellfire.

verses.translation: We will call the wardens of Hellfire[1].

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب

english_rwwad.text: No indeed; do not obey him, but prostrate and draw near [to Allah].

verses.translation: No indeed; do not obey him, but prostrate and draw near [to Allah].

verses.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, We sent this [Qur’an] down on the Night of Decree[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Qur’an was first revealed completely to the lowest heaven on this night. Also, its revelation on the Prophet (ﷺ) started on this night.

verses.translation: Indeed, We sent this [Qur’an] down on the Night of Decree[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ

english_rwwad.text: How do you know what the Night of Decree is?

verses.translation: How do you know what the Night of Decree is?

verses.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ

english_rwwad.text: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

verses.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

verses.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ

english_rwwad.text: On that night the angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend by their Lord’s permission with all decrees[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Bringing down the exact provisions, life, death, and other things destined for the creatures for the coming year by Allah's permission.

verses.translation: On that night the angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend by their Lord’s permission with all decrees[1].

verses.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ

english_rwwad.text: It is all peace[1] until the break of dawn.
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Upon the believers.

verses.translation: It is all peace[1] until the break of dawn.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

english_rwwad.text: Those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to desist [from disbelief][1] until there came to them clear proof,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., and from deviant ways.

verses.translation: Those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to desist [from disbelief][1] until there came to them clear proof,

verses.arabic: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً

english_rwwad.text: a messenger from Allah, reciting pure pages[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., that contains no falsehood.

verses.translation: a messenger from Allah, reciting pure pages[1]

verses.arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: containing upright commandments.

verses.translation: containing upright commandments.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

english_rwwad.text: Yet those who were given the Scripture did not disagree[1] except after the clear proof came to them,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Into different sects and denominations.

verses.translation: Yet those who were given the Scripture did not disagree[1] except after the clear proof came to them,

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ

english_rwwad.text: although they were commanded only to worship Allah with sincere devotion to Him, being inclined to the true faith, and to establish prayer and give zakah; that is the true religion.

verses.translation: although they were commanded only to worship Allah with sincere devotion to Him, being inclined to the true faith, and to establish prayer and give zakah; that is the true religion.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

english_rwwad.text: Those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding therein forever. It is they who are the worst of creatures.

verses.translation: Those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding therein forever. It is they who are the worst of creatures.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

english_rwwad.text: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds – it is they who are the best of creatures.

verses.translation: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds – it is they who are the best of creatures.

verses.arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: Their reward with their Lord is Gardens of Eternity under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is for those who fear their Lord.

verses.translation: Their reward with their Lord is Gardens of Eternity under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is for those who fear their Lord.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا

english_rwwad.text: When the earth is shaken with a mighty quake,

verses.translation: When the earth is shaken with a mighty quake,

verses.arabic: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا

english_rwwad.text: and the earth throws out its burdens[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., its dead bodies and treasures.

verses.translation: and the earth throws out its burdens[1],

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا

english_rwwad.text: and man says[1], “What is the matter with it?”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In terror and astonishment.

verses.translation: and man says[1], “What is the matter with it?”

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا

english_rwwad.text: On that Day it will recount all its news,

verses.translation: On that Day it will recount all its news,

verses.arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا

english_rwwad.text: because your Lord has inspired it [to do so].

verses.translation: because your Lord has inspired it [to do so].

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day all people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] From the place of Judgment to see the consequences of their deeds, whether to Paradise or to Hell.

verses.translation: On that Day all people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds[1].

verses.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: So whoever does an atom’s weight[1] of good will see it,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Or a small ant’s weight.

verses.translation: So whoever does an atom’s weight[1] of good will see it,

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.

verses.translation: and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًا

english_rwwad.text: By the galloping, panting horses[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., those horses that fight for the cause of Allah as they race to attack the enemy.

verses.translation: By the galloping, panting horses[1],

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًا

english_rwwad.text: striking sparks of fire [with their hooves][1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] While galloping over rocky terrain.

verses.translation: striking sparks of fire [with their hooves][1],

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا

english_rwwad.text: launching raids at dawn[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] While the enemy is unaware of their raid.

verses.translation: launching raids at dawn[1],

verses.arabic: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا

english_rwwad.text: stirring up thereby clouds of dust,

verses.translation: stirring up thereby clouds of dust,

verses.arabic: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا

english_rwwad.text: plunging thereby into the midst of the enemy[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., penetrating into the ranks of the enemy as a surprise attack.

verses.translation: plunging thereby into the midst of the enemy[1],

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ

english_rwwad.text: indeed, man is very ungrateful to his Lord[1] –
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] disobeying Him by not spending in the cause of Allah from what He has given him and commanded him to spend accordingly.

verses.translation: indeed, man is very ungrateful to his Lord[1] –

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: and he himself is a witness to that[1] –
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] By his words and actions.

verses.translation: and he himself is a witness to that[1] –

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

english_rwwad.text: and he is truly extreme in his love of wealth.

verses.translation: and he is truly extreme in his love of wealth.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

english_rwwad.text: Does he not know that when the contents of graves will be overturned,

verses.translation: Does he not know that when the contents of graves will be overturned,

verses.arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ

english_rwwad.text: and the secrets of the hearts will be brought to light[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., when all secrets of the hearts and faiths are made known.

verses.translation: and the secrets of the hearts will be brought to light[1]?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Nothing of their affairs will be hidden from Him.

verses.translation: Indeed, their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day[1].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

english_rwwad.text: The Striking Calamity!

verses.translation: The Striking Calamity!

verses.arabic: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

english_rwwad.text: What is the Striking Calamity?

verses.translation: What is the Striking Calamity?

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

english_rwwad.text: How do you know what the Striking Calamity is?

verses.translation: How do you know what the Striking Calamity is?

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ

english_rwwad.text: On that Day people will be like scattered moths[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] After having been thrown out of their graves.

verses.translation: On that Day people will be like scattered moths[1],

verses.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ

english_rwwad.text: and the mountains will be like carded wool[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] As they disintegrate.

verses.translation: and the mountains will be like carded wool[1].

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: Then the one whose scales of good deeds are heavy,

verses.translation: Then the one whose scales of good deeds are heavy,

verses.arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: will have a pleasant life[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] In Paradise.

verses.translation: will have a pleasant life[1].

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: But the one whose scales of good deeds are light,

verses.translation: But the one whose scales of good deeds are light,

verses.arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: his abode will be the abyss[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Hāwiyah: the pit of Hellfire.

verses.translation: his abode will be the abyss[1].

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ

english_rwwad.text: And how do you know what it is?

verses.translation: And how do you know what it is?

verses.arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ

english_rwwad.text: It is a Blazing Fire.

verses.translation: It is a Blazing Fire.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ

english_rwwad.text: Competition for worldly gains distracts you [from Allah],

verses.translation: Competition for worldly gains distracts you [from Allah],

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ

english_rwwad.text: until you come to your graves.

verses.translation: until you come to your graves.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! You will come to know.

verses.translation: No indeed! You will come to know.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Again no! You will come to know.

verses.translation: Again no! You will come to know.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! If only you knew for certain[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The conclusion of this verse, "...you would not have been distracted from preparing for the Hereafter by wealth and children."

verses.translation: No indeed! If only you knew for certain[1].

verses.arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: You will surely see the Blazing Fire,

verses.translation: You will surely see the Blazing Fire,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

english_rwwad.text: Again, you will see it with absolute certainty.

verses.translation: Again, you will see it with absolute certainty.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

english_rwwad.text: Then on that Day you will surely be asked about your worldly pleasures[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., of health and wealth and other comforts of the worldly life.

verses.translation: Then on that Day you will surely be asked about your worldly pleasures[1].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَصْرِ

english_rwwad.text: By the time,

verses.translation: By the time,

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ

english_rwwad.text: man is in utter loss,

verses.translation: man is in utter loss,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ

english_rwwad.text: except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and exhort one another to the truth and exhort one another to patience.

verses.translation: except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and exhort one another to the truth and exhort one another to patience.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُّمَزَةٍ

english_rwwad.text: Woe to every backbiter and slanderer,

verses.translation: Woe to every backbiter and slanderer,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: who amasses wealth and counts it over and again[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Instead of spending in the way of Allah.

verses.translation: who amasses wealth and counts it over and again[1],

verses.arabic: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ

english_rwwad.text: thinking that his wealth will make him live forever.

verses.translation: thinking that his wealth will make him live forever.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ

english_rwwad.text: No indeed! He will surely be cast into the Crushing Fire[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., Hellfire, as it crushes and destroys all that is thrown in it.

verses.translation: No indeed! He will surely be cast into the Crushing Fire[1],

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ

english_rwwad.text: and how do you know what the Crushing Fire is?

verses.translation: and how do you know what the Crushing Fire is?

verses.arabic: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ

english_rwwad.text: It is the kindled Fire of Allah,

verses.translation: It is the kindled Fire of Allah,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ

english_rwwad.text: which reaches the hearts[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Penetrating through bodies and reaching the hearts.

verses.translation: which reaches the hearts[1].

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌ

english_rwwad.text: It will be closed down upon them,

verses.translation: It will be closed down upon them,

verses.arabic: فِى عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: locked with towering columns[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., columns of fire or columns of iron to which the inmates of Hell are chained.

verses.translation: locked with towering columns[1].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

english_rwwad.text: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the people of the Elephant[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The army of Abrahah al-Ashram was accompanied by a huge elephant who came with the intention of demolishing the Kaʿba.

verses.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the people of the Elephant[1]?

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ

english_rwwad.text: Did He not turn their scheme into a total loss[1]?
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Leading them to perish.

verses.translation: Did He not turn their scheme into a total loss[1]?

verses.arabic: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ

english_rwwad.text: He sent against them swarms of birds,

verses.translation: He sent against them swarms of birds,

verses.arabic: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

english_rwwad.text: pelting them with stones of baked clay,

verses.translation: pelting them with stones of baked clay,

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: leaving them like chewed-up chaff.

verses.translation: leaving them like chewed-up chaff.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

english_rwwad.text: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Allah had given Quraysh the honor of being guardians of the Holy Ka‘bah, which allowed them to travel in peace without fear of being harmed.

verses.translation: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh[1],

verses.arabic: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ

english_rwwad.text: secure in their winter and summer journeys[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., their trading caravans would travel south to Yemen in winter and north to the Levant in summer.

verses.translation: secure in their winter and summer journeys[1].

verses.arabic: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ

english_rwwad.text: Let them worship the Lord of this [Sacred] House[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Ka‘bah.

verses.translation: Let them worship the Lord of this [Sacred] House[1],

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: Who fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The people of Quraysh were blessed with provision and security probably because of the prayer of Abraham. See 14:35-37

verses.translation: Who fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear[1].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

english_rwwad.text: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

verses.translation: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

verses.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

english_rwwad.text: Such is the one who repulses the orphan harshly,

verses.translation: Such is the one who repulses the orphan harshly,

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

english_rwwad.text: and does not urge others to feed the needy.

verses.translation: and does not urge others to feed the needy.

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

english_rwwad.text: So woe to those who pray,

verses.translation: So woe to those who pray,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

english_rwwad.text: but are heedless of their prayer[1];
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the hypocrites who do not pray except to show off and others who are heedless to pray at their specified times.

verses.translation: but are heedless of their prayer[1];

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ

english_rwwad.text: those who only show off,

verses.translation: those who only show off,

verses.arabic: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ

english_rwwad.text: and withhold even the small kindnesses.

verses.translation: and withhold even the small kindnesses.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ

english_rwwad.text: We have surely given you [O Prophet] al-Kauthar [i.e., abundance][1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., abundance, of which is the river of al-Kauthar in Paradise.

verses.translation: We have surely given you [O Prophet] al-Kauthar [i.e., abundance][1],

verses.arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ

english_rwwad.text: so pray and offer sacrifice to your Lord alone.

verses.translation: so pray and offer sacrifice to your Lord alone.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ

english_rwwad.text: Indeed, the one who hates you is truly cut off [from all goodness][1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Both in this world and in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: Indeed, the one who hates you is truly cut off [from all goodness][1].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “O disbelievers,

verses.translation: Say, “O disbelievers,

verses.arabic: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

english_rwwad.text: I do not worship what you worship,

verses.translation: I do not worship what you worship,

verses.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

english_rwwad.text: nor do you worship what I worship.

verses.translation: nor do you worship what I worship.

verses.arabic: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ

english_rwwad.text: Never will I worship what you worship,

verses.translation: Never will I worship what you worship,

verses.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

english_rwwad.text: nor will you ever worship what I worship.

verses.translation: nor will you ever worship what I worship.

verses.arabic: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ

english_rwwad.text: You have your religion and I have my religion."

verses.translation: You have your religion and I have my religion."

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ

english_rwwad.text: When there comes Allah’s help and the conquest[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the conquest of Makkah.

verses.translation: When there comes Allah’s help and the conquest[1],

verses.arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا

english_rwwad.text: and you see people entering Allah’s religion in multitudes,

verses.translation: and you see people entering Allah’s religion in multitudes,

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا

english_rwwad.text: then glorify the praise of your Lord, and ask His forgiveness. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.

verses.translation: then glorify the praise of your Lord, and ask His forgiveness. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ

english_rwwad.text: May the hands of Abu Lahab[1] perish, and may he perish!
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the Prophet's uncle, who was one of the staunchest enemies of Islam.

verses.translation: May the hands of Abu Lahab[1] perish, and may he perish!

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

english_rwwad.text: Neither his wealth nor his worldly gains will avail him.

verses.translation: Neither his wealth nor his worldly gains will avail him.

verses.arabic: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ

english_rwwad.text: He will burn in a Flaming Fire,

verses.translation: He will burn in a Flaming Fire,

verses.arabic: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ

english_rwwad.text: and so will his wife[1], the carrier of firewood,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., ’Um Jamīl, who used to throw thorny branches in the Prophet's way and she used to slander him (ﷺ). The word hatab (firewood) was used by the Arabs to allude to slander and backbiting.

verses.translation: and so will his wife[1], the carrier of firewood,

verses.arabic: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ

english_rwwad.text: around her neck will be a rope of palm fiber[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] This surah was one of the earliest surahs revealed in Makkah, yet Abu Lahab persisted in disbelief. For him to disprove the Qur’an, all he had to do was to accept Islam, for the Qur’an condemned him to Hell.

verses.translation: around her neck will be a rope of palm fiber[1].

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

english_rwwad.text: Say: “He is Allah, the One[1];
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He is Alone, without a partner, indivisible and distinct from all else. The only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.

verses.translation: Say: “He is Allah, the One[1];

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ

english_rwwad.text: Allah, the Eternal Refuge[1].
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] He is absolute, perfect, complete, self-sufficient; the one eternally and constantly required and sought; all existence depend upon Him; all matters ultimately return to Him.

verses.translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge[1].

verses.arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ

english_rwwad.text: He neither begets nor is He begotten,

verses.translation: He neither begets nor is He begotten,

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ

english_rwwad.text: and there is none comparable to Him.”[1]
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) says that reading this surah (surat al-Ikhlās) equals reading one third of the Qur’an. [Al-Bukhāri and Muslim]

verses.translation: and there is none comparable to Him.”[1]

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak,

verses.translation: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak,

verses.arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

english_rwwad.text: from the harm of all what He has created;

verses.translation: from the harm of all what He has created;

verses.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

english_rwwad.text: from the harm of darkening [night] when it spreads around,

verses.translation: from the harm of darkening [night] when it spreads around,

verses.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ

english_rwwad.text: from the harm of the sorceresses[1] who blow on knots,
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., magicians.

verses.translation: from the harm of the sorceresses[1] who blow on knots,

verses.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

english_rwwad.text: and from the harm of the envier when he envies."

verses.translation: and from the harm of the envier when he envies."

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

english_rwwad.text: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,

verses.translation: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,

verses.arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ

english_rwwad.text: the Sovereign of mankind[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] i.e., the King of mankind.

verses.translation: the Sovereign of mankind[1],

verses.arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ

english_rwwad.text: the God of mankind,

verses.translation: the God of mankind,

verses.arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ

english_rwwad.text: from the harm of the lurking whisperer[1],
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Which disappears when one remembers Allah.

verses.translation: from the harm of the lurking whisperer[1],

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ

english_rwwad.text: who whispers into the hearts of mankind,

verses.translation: who whispers into the hearts of mankind,

verses.arabic: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ

english_rwwad.text: from among jinn and mankind[1].”
english_rwwad.footnotes: [1] Evil prompters and whisperers can be from jinn or from men.

verses.translation: from among jinn and mankind[1].”

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (1 of 4)
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (2 of 4)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without associate, to Him belongs sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable. How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme. O my Lord forgive me
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharyka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, subḥāna llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, walā ilāha illā llāhu, wa-llāhu akbaru, walā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿaliyyi l-ʿaẓīmi, rabbi ighfr lī

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (3 of 4)
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and has allowed me to remember Him.

duas.title: Supplications for when you wake up (4 of 4)
duas.arabic: ﴿ إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ * الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ* رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ* رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ* رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ* فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ * لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ * مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ * لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ * وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ*يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴾
duas.translation: 190 In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of night and day, are signs for people of understanding. 191 They remember Allah while standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and they reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth: “Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. Glory be to You; protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” 192 “Our Lord, anyone You admit to the Fire is truly disgraced, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers.” 193 “Our Lord, we heard a caller inviting people to faith: ‘Believe in your Lord,’ and we believed. Our Lord, forgive our sins, erase our misdeeds, and let us die among the righteous.” 194 “Our Lord, grant us what You promised through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. You never break Your promise.” 195 Their Lord answered them: “I will never let the work of any of you be lost, whether male or female; you are from one another. I will erase the misdeeds of those who emigrated, were driven from their homes, were harmed in My cause, fought, or were killed, and I will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow—a reward from Allah. With Allah is the finest reward.” 196 Do not be deceived by the freedom with which the disbelievers move through the land. 197 It is only a brief enjoyment; then Hell will be their home—and what a miserable resting place. 198 But those who are mindful of their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, where they will remain: a welcome from Allah. What is with Allah is better for the righteous. 199 Among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah, in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed to them. They humble themselves before Allah and do not trade Allah’s revelations for a small price. Their reward is with their Lord; Allah is swift in reckoning. 200 Believers, be steadfast, outdo one another in steadfastness, remain ready, and be mindful of Allah so that you may succeed.

duas.title: Invocation when getting dressed
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا (الثَّوْبَ) وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّة...
duas.translation: All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī ka-sānī hādhā ath-thawba wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī walā quwwah...

duas.arabic: (اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُوراً، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُوراً، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُوراً، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُوراً، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُوراً، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُوراً، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُوراً، وَعَظِّم لِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُوراً، اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُوراً، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُوراً، وَفِي دَمِي نُوراً، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُوراً، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُوراً)([اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً فِي قَبْرِي... وَنُوراً فِي عِظَامِي])[(وَزِدْنِي نُوراً، وَزِدْنِي نُوراً، وَزِدْنِي نُوراً)][(وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً عَلَى نُورٍ)]
duas.translation: ‘O Allaah, place within my heart light; and upon my tongue light; and within my ears light; and within my eyes light; and place above me light; and beneath me light; and on my right light; and on my left light; and in front of me light; and behind me light; and place light within my soul; and augment light for me; and greaten light for me; and grant me light and make me light. O Allaah, bestow upon me light; and place light in my tendons; and light in my flesh; and light in my blood; and in light in my hair and light in my skin.’ [O Allaah, place light for me in my grave and light in my bones]. [And increase me with light and increase me with light and increase me with light]. [And grant me light upon light.]’
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿal fī qalbī nūran, wa fī li-sānī nūran, wa fī samʿī nūran, wa fī baṣarī nūran, wamin fawqī nūran, wamin taḥtī nūran, waʿan yamīnī nūran, waʿan shimālī nūran, wamin amāmī nūran, wamin khalfī nūran, wa ijʿal fī nafsī nūran, wa aʿẓim lī nūran, wa ʿaẓẓim lī nūran, wa ijʿal lī nūran, wa ijʿalnī nūran, allāhumma aʿṭinī nūran, wa ijʿal fī ʿaṣabī nūran, wa fī laḥmī nūran, wa fī damī nūran, wa fī shaʿrī nūran, wa fī basharī nūran allāhumma ijʿal lī nūran fī qabrī... wa nūran fī ʿiẓāmī wa zidnī nūran, wa zidnī nūran, wa zidnī nūran wahab lī nūran ʿalā nūr

duas.title: Invocation for entering the mosque
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)) [بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ] [وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ] ((اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ))
duas.translation: I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi l-ʿaẓīmi, wa bi-wajhihi l-karīmi, wa sulṭānihi l-qadīmi, mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīmi bismi llāhi, wa aṣ-ṣalātu wa as-salāmu ʿalā rasūli llāhi llāhumma iftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik

parts.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)) [بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ] [وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ] ((اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ))

steps.arabic: (يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُمْنَى) ، وَيَقُولُ:

dua.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)) [بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ] [وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ] ((اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ))

duas.category: Invocation for leaving the mosque
duas.title: Invocation for leaving the mosque
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِك، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil.
duas.transliteration: Bismi llāhi wa aṣ-ṣlātu wa as-salāmu ʿalā rasūli llāhi, allāhumma innī asʾaluka min faḍlik, allāhumma iʿṣimnī mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِك، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ

duas.category: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer)
duas.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (1 of 5)
duas.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
duas.translation: ‘There is no might nor power except with Allah.’
duas.transliteration: Lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh

parts.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
parts.transliteration: Lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
parts.translation: ‘There is no might nor power except with Allah.’

context.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (1 of 5)

steps.arabic: يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ المُؤَذِّنُ إِلاَّ فِي ((حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ وَحَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ)) فَيقُولُ:
steps.text: ‘One repeats just as the mu-aththin one who calls to prayer says, except when he says: Hayya ʿAlas-salah or hayya ʿAlal-falah ‘come to prayer, come to success’ instead, one should say:

dua.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
dua.transliteration: Lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
dua.translation: ‘There is no might nor power except with Allah.’

duas.category: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer)
duas.title: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer) (2 of 5)
duas.arabic: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِينَاً
duas.translation: ‘And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His salve and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Muhammad as a Messenger and Islam as a religion.’
duas.transliteration: Wa anā ashhadu an lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu waʾanna muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluhu, raḍītu bi-llāhi rabbā, wa bi-muḥammadin rasūlan, wa bi-l-ʾislāmi dīnā

parts.arabic: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِينَاً
