dua.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.

duas.category: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you
duas.title: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you
duas.arabic:
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ

الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
duas.translation:
All praise is for Allah, by whose grace good things are brought to completion.

All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.
duas.transliteration:
Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī bi-niʿmatihi tatimmu aṣ-ṣāliḥāt

Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi ʿalā kulli ḥāl

duas.category: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH
duas.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (1 of 5)
duas.arabic:
قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً
duas.translation:
The Prophet PBUH said:

‘Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.

context.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (1 of 5)

steps.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

steps.text: ‘Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.

duas.category: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH
duas.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (2 of 5)
duas.arabic:
وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ
duas.translation:
He PBUH also said:

‘Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.

context.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (2 of 5)

duas.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (4 of 5)
duas.arabic:
وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ
duas.translation:
The Prophet [PBUH] said:

'Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings or prayers of peace of my'Ummah nation.

context.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (4 of 5)

duas.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (5 of 5)
duas.arabic:
وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ
duas.translation:
The Prophet [PBUH] said:

'No one sends greetings or prayers of peace upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings

steps.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
steps.text: The Prophet [PBUH] said:

steps.arabic: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ
steps.text: 'No one sends greetings or prayers of peace upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings

duas.category: Spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace)
duas.title: Spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace) (1 of 3)
duas.arabic:
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

لاَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُم عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُم، أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ
duas.translation:
The Messenger of Allah said:

‘You shall not enter paradise until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. Shall I not inform you of something, if you were to act upon it, you will indeed achieve mutual love for one another? Spread the greeting amongst yourselves.

duas.title: Spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace) (2 of 3)
duas.arabic: ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الْإِيمَانَ: الْإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، وَبَذْلُ السَّلاَمِ لِلْعَالَمِ، وَالْإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإِقْتَارِ
duas.translation: Aammar said: ‘Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend charitably out of the little you have.

duas.category: Spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace)
duas.title: Spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace) (3 of 3)
duas.arabic:
وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أيُّ الْإِسْلاَمِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ:

تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ
duas.translation:
Aabdullah Ibn Aamr reported that a man asked the Prophet: ‘Which Islam is the best?’. He replied:

Feed the poor, and greet those whom you know as well as those whom you do not.

duas.category: Invocation upon hearing the cock's crow or the bray of a donkey
duas.title: Invocation upon hearing the cock's crow or the bray of a donkey
duas.arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكاً وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَاناً
duas.translation: If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty for it has seen an angel and if you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah for it has seen a devil.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ

duas.category: How a Muslim should praise another Muslim
duas.title: How a Muslim should praise another Muslim
duas.arabic: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً
duas.translation: I consider so-and-so [to be…], and Allah is his Reckoner. I do not declare anyone pure before Allah.
duas.transliteration: Aḥsibu fulānan wa-llāhu ḥasībuhu, walā uzakkī ʿalā llāhi aḥadā

steps.text: He said: If anyone of you is compelled to praise his companion, then he should say:

dua.arabic: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً

dua.translation: I consider so-and-so [to be…], and Allah is his Reckoner. I do not declare anyone pure before Allah.

steps.arabic: أَحْسِبُهُ – إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَكَذَا
steps.text: If he knows those qualities of him, he may add: I consider him to be such-and-such.

duas.category: What a Muslim should say when he is praised
duas.title: What a Muslim should say when he is praised
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ، [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ]
duas.translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].

duas.title: Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah
duas.arabic:
﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ﴾ أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
duas.translation:
Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with.

There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah. Allah is the Greatest.

There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all dominion, and to Him belongs all praise. He has power over all things. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, supported His servant, and defeated the allied forces alone.
duas.transliteration:
Inna aṣ-ṣafā wa-l-marwata min shaʿāʾiri llāhi abdaʾu bimā badaʾa llāhu bih

Lā ilāha illā llāhu, allāhu akbar

Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu, anjaza waʿdahu, wa naṣara ʿabdahu, wa hazama l-ʾaḥzāba waḥdah

parts.transliteration: Inna aṣ-ṣafā wa-l-marwata min shaʿāʾiri llāhi abdaʾu bimā badaʾa llāhu bih
parts.translation: Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with.

parts.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all dominion, and to Him belongs all praise. He has power over all things. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, supported His servant, and defeated the allied forces alone.

context.title: Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah

steps.arabic: لَمَّا دَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الصَّفَا قَرَأَ:
steps.text: When the Prophet approached Ṣafā, he recited:

dua.arabic: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ﴾ أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ
dua.transliteration: Inna aṣ-ṣafā wa-l-marwata min shaʿāʾiri llāhi abdaʾu bimā badaʾa llāhu bih
dua.translation: Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with.

steps.arabic: فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى الْبَيْتَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكبَّرَهُ
steps.text: He climbed Ṣafā until he could see the Kaʿbah, faced the qiblah, and proclaimed Allah’s oneness and greatness:

dua.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu, allāhu akbar
dua.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah. Allah is the Greatest.

steps.arabic: وَقَالَ:
steps.text: He then said:

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu, anjaza waʿdahu, wa naṣara ʿabdahu, wa hazama l-ʾaḥzāba waḥdah
dua.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all dominion, and to Him belongs all praise. He has power over all things. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, supported His servant, and defeated the allied forces alone.

steps.text: Then make a personal supplication between each recitation.

steps.arabic: ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، وَقَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، وَفَعَلَ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا
steps.text: He made a personal supplication between repetitions and repeated the remembrance three times. At Marwah, he repeated the same sequence of remembrance and personal supplication.

duas.category: Invocation to be recited on the Day of Arafat
duas.title: Invocation to be recited on the Day of Arafat
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.

duas.category: Supplication to be recited at the sacred area of Muzdalifah
duas.title: Supplication to be recited at the sacred area of Muzdalifah
duas.arabic: رَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَشْعَرَ الْحَرَامَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ (فَدَعَاهُ، وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَللَّهُ، وَوَحَّدَهُ) فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفاً حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدَّاً فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمسُ
duas.translation: The Prophet rode his camel, Al-Qaswa, until he reached the sacred area Al-Mash aril Haraam. Then he faced the Qiblah and invoked Allah, and repeatedly said the words: Allaahu Akbar Allah is the Most Great, Allaahu Ahad Allah is One and Laa ilaaha illallaah There is none worthy of worship but Allah. He remained stationary until the sky became yellow with the dawn, and then pressed on before sunrise.

context.title: Supplication to be recited at the sacred area of Muzdalifah

duas.category: Saying Allahu Akbar while stoning the three pillars at Mina
duas.title: Saying Allahu Akbar while stoning the three pillars at Mina
duas.arabic: يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الْجِمَارِ الثَّلاَثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، ويَقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبلَةِ، رَافِعاً يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ الْأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةِ. أَمَّا جَمْرَةُ الْعَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا وَيُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ وَيَنْصَرِفُ وَلاَ يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا
duas.translation: The Prophet PBUH said Allaahu'Akbar Allah is the Most Great with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after stoning the first and second pillar As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allahu Akbar with every pebble he threw but when he was finished he left without standing at it for supplications.

duas.arabic: إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُم مِنْ أَخِيهِ، أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ [فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ] فَإِنَّ الْعَيْنَ حَقٌّ
duas.translation: If you see anything of your brother that pleases you, or of his person or of his property [then ask Allah to bless him in it] for the envious eye is real.

duas.category: What to say to foil the devil's plots
duas.title: What to say to foil the devil's plots
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلاَ فَاجِرٌ: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلاَّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
duas.translation: I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. I take refuge from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. I take refuge from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bkalimāti llāhi at-tāmmāti allatī lā yujāwizuhunna barrun walā fājirun: min sharri mā khalaqa, wa baraʾa wa dharaʾa, wamin sharri mā yanzilu mina as-samāʾi, wamin sharri mā yaʿruju fyhā, wamin sharri mā dharaʾa fī l-ʾarḍi, wamin sharri mā yakhruju minhā, wamin sharri fitani l-layli wa an-nahāri, wamin sharri kulli ṭāriqin illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bi-khayrin yā raḥmān

duas.category: Repentance and seeking forgiveness
duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (1 of 6)
duas.arabic:
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ
duas.translation:
The Messenger of Allah said:

‘By Allah, I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day.

context.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (1 of 6)

steps.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
steps.text: The Messenger of Allah said:

steps.arabic: وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ
steps.text: ‘By Allah, I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day.

duas.category: Repentance and seeking forgiveness
duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (2 of 6)
duas.arabic:
وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ
duas.translation:
He also said:

‘O People, Repent! Verily I repent to Allah, a hundred times a day.

context.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (2 of 6)

steps.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
steps.text: He also said:

steps.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ
steps.text: ‘O People, Repent! Verily I repent to Allah, a hundred times a day.

duas.category: Repentance and seeking forgiveness
duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (3 of 6)
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ
duas.translation: I seek Allah’s forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.
duas.transliteration: Astaghfiru llāha l-ʿaẓyma alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayywumu wa atūbu ilayh

duas.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (4 of 6)
duas.arabic:
وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ
duas.translation:
He said:

‘The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so.

context.title: Repentance and seeking forgiveness (4 of 6)

steps.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

duas.arabic:
وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ

He also said:

‘The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein.

duas.arabic:
وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ
duas.translation:
He also said:

‘verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah’s forgiveness a hundred times a day.

duas.category: The excellence of remembering Allah
duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (1 of 12)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih

parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
parts.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih
parts.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

context.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (1 of 12)

steps.arabic: قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ قَالَ:
steps.text: Whoever says:

dua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
dua.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih
dua.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

steps.arabic: فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْر
steps.text: a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.

duas.category: The excellence of remembering Allah
duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (2 of 12)
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (3 of 12)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.
duas.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdihi, subḥna llāhi l-ʿaẓīm

parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdihi, subḥna llāhi l-ʿaẓīm
parts.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.

context.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (3 of 12)

steps.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ:
steps.text: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:’ There are Two words, which are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious:

dua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

dua.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.

duas.arabic:
وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:

((أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُم أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ)) فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ: ((يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ، فَيُكتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ))
duas.translation:
Sa’d said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah, and he said:

‘Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?’ Somebody then asked him: How does one achieve a thousand good deeds? He replied: ‘He should say: How perfect Allah is. one hundred times, for a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away.

duas.title: The excellence of remembering Allah (9 of 12)
duas.arabic:
لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ

اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي
duas.translation:
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. Allah is the Greatest—supremely great. Abundant praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, and provide for me.
duas.transliteration:
Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, allāhu akbaru ka-bi-yran, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi ka-thīran, subḥāna llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna, lā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm

Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa ihdinī, wa irzuqnī

dua.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. Allah is the Greatest—supremely great. Abundant praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

steps.arabic: قَالَ: فَهَؤُلاَءِ لِرَبِّي، فَمَا لِي؟ قَالَ: ((قُلْ:
steps.text: The man then said, ‘These are for my Lord, but what is for me?’ He replied:

duas.category: How the Prophet glorified Allah
duas.title: How the Prophet glorified Allah
duas.arabic:
عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رضي الله عنه قَالَ:

رَأَيْتُ النَّبيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ

وفي زيادةٍ: ((بِيَمِينِهِ))
duas.translation:
ʿAbdullah Ibn ʿAmr said:

’I saw the prophet make tasbeeh

with his right hand.

context.title: How the Prophet glorified Allah

steps.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
steps.text: ʿAbdullah Ibn ʿAmr said:

steps.arabic: رَأَيْتُ النَّبيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ
steps.text: ’I saw the prophet make tasbeeh

steps.arabic: وفي زيادةٍ: ((بِيَمِينِهِ))
steps.text: with his right hand.

duas.title: Types of goodness and good etiquette for community life
duas.arabic:
قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم

إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ – أَوْ أَمْسَيْتُم – فَكُفُّوا صِبْيانَكُم، فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيلِ فَخَلُّوهُمْ، وَأَغْلِقُوا الأَبْوَابَ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيطَانَ لاَ يَفْتَحُ بَاباً مُغلَقاً، وَأَوْكُوا قِرَبَكُمْ، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَخَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُم، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضُوا عَلَيْهَا شَيْئاً، وَأَطْفِئُوا مَصَابِيحَكُمْ
duas.translation:
The Prophet PBUH said:

When evening descends, bring your children indoors for the devils scatter out at this hour. Then after the passing of an hour i.e. the first hour of the night, you may let them the children go. Close your doors while mentioning the Name of Allah, for the devil may not open a closed door. Fasten your waterskins mentioning the Name of Allah. Cover your eating vessels mentioning the Name of Allah even if you just put something over it, and extinguish your lamps.
